entries.name: Frostmane Hold
entries.how:
I'm behind on my report, and could use your help, {name}. I just managed to find where the trolls are holed up, but I saw so many trolls, I was afraid to go in.

Here's what I need... Go down to the cave, poke around inside, kill a few of the trolls, then come back here.

Take the road north out of Kharanos, when you get to the bridge, follow the frozen river west until you reach Iceflow Lake. You'll find Brewnall Village on the west bank. The Hold is southwest of the village.

entries.name: The Reports
entries.how:
Excellent! Take my report to Senator Barin Redstone. He's a sour type, so don't let his less-than-sunny disposition get to you. He's in Ironforge, in the chamber where King Magni holds court.

Don't know the way to Ironforge? Take the road out of Kharanos north, cross the bridge, then follow the road east--there are large banners flanking the road--up the mountainside.

By the way, if you might avoid mentioning how you assisted me? Can't let them think I'm not working hard out here, you know?

entries.name: Distracting Jarven
entries.how: Hmph! There is all this booze down here, but I have strict orders not to touch it. If only I could get a taste of some of our Thunder Ale...that would sharpen my wits, no lying!

entries.name: Bitter Rivals
entries.how:
I have to admit, those Thunderbrews make some good drinks. But they need to learn that theirs isn't the only decent brew! Maybe you can help me teach them that lesson...

Here, take this barrel of Barleybrew Scalder. Sneak into the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos and switch it with one of their barrels of Thunder Ale. Then we'll see how their patrons like my brew over theirs!

And if the barrels are guarded, then you might have to distract the guard...

entries.name: Return to Marleth
entries.how: Having inserted a barrel of Marleth's Scalder in the Kharanos Distillery's cellar, you grab a barrel of Thunder Ale as proof of the deed...

entries.name: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash
entries.how:
I had a month's worth of dried meats salted and locked away for the cold season.  Kept it locked so the bears wouldn't get it!  But while I was off hunting deer, that beast, Old Icebeard, made off with the meat locker.  He won't be able to smash through that Thorium though.  But I'll starve if I can't get my meats back.

You seem a bit more stealthy than me.  Perhaps you can retrieve my stash?  I'll never make it in and out of that cave fast enough with this bum leg of mine.

entries.name: The Grizzled Den
entries.how:
Driving a Siege Engine isn't for everyone.  It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both!  How about you?  How's your mettle?  Want to prove it to me?

Well...I'm looking to make my engine, Trollplow, a little more cozy.  How about you get me a heap of Wendigo Manes from the Grizzled Den, west of Kharanos.  Those manes would make a great rug for Trollplow's inside deck!

entries.name: Protecting the Herd
entries.how:
We heard the cries in the middle of the night.  Then this morning, sure enough, the herd was missing two rams.  That dastardly beast known as Vagash has been preying on our livelihood.  With most of King Magni's army off in distant lands fighting with the Alliance, there is no one to keep Vagash at bay.

Perhaps you are brave enough to seek out the beast and slay him.  Bring me one of his fangs and I will reward you.  Vagash lurks just above the ranch here, but be warned, he is deadly.

entries.name: The Perfect Stout
entries.how:
I'm on a quest, a quest to make the perfect stout.  I know I can do it -- brewing's in my blood.  I just need to find the right recipe...

The Frostmane trolls grow a plant, shimmerweed, high up in the hills to the east.  They use it in their strange, tribal rituals.  We dwarves haven't found much use for it, but it has a unique taste...and I want to experiment with it in my brews!

Get me some shimmerweed from Frostmane seers, or swipe it from the trolls' shimmerweed baskets.

entries.name: Stocking Jetsteam
entries.how:
I'm preparing to start a mission for the Siege Brigade.  It's a long one, and I need to stock Jetsteam with a month's worth of supplies.  So while Steelgrill is working on my tank, can you do some hunting for me?

I'll need some fur for bedding, and boar meat for food.  You can get meat from boars and fur from the bears... you can find them both in the snow fields south of the Grizzled Den.

entries.name: Evershine
entries.how:
Rejold Barleybrew experiments with his brews.  Some of them taste good, some bad, and some...well, some will lay all but the stoutest dwarf flat.

He lives at Brewnall Village, west of Kharanos, and one of his drinks, Evershine, is what I want.  It'll help keep me warm while I'm on the cold road.

And...the blessed stuff burns so hot I can throw it in Jetsteam's furnace for a burst of power!  That little tactic has gotten me out of more than one tight spot.

entries.name: A Favor for Evershine
entries.how:
I have a cask of Evershine handy, but...can you do me a favor?  Brewnall village could use a hand against the wild animals that wander the nearby snows.  Sometimes they wander close.

We're not afraid of these bears and cats and boars - no self respecting dwarf would be - but if you can take care of those animals for us, then we'd have more time for our crafting and brewing.

entries.name: Return to Bellowfiz
entries.how: Here's your cask of Evershine, {name}.  And again, thank you for the hunting earlier.

entries.name: Tools for Steelgrill
entries.how:
Beldin Steelgrill owns the local mechanic shop, and he's the best siege engine tech there is!  But he's not forgiving to his tools.  I swear he almost breaks more arclight spanners than we can supply him with!

We just filled his last order for tools.  If you deliver it to him I'm sure he'll make it worth the effort.

His shop, Steelgrill's Depot, is just northeast of Kharanos.  And it's a local haunt for veteran siege engine pilots, so keep your ears open for opportunities while you're there.

entries.name: Operation Recombobulation
entries.how:
Upon further analysis of the Gnomeregan situation, it would appear as though we not only failed to eradicate the troggs but we also happened to turn most of the gnomish race into horrific, mindless, evil-doing leper gnomes.

Ozzie and I plan to reverse the horrible leper effect with our latest invention: The Recombobulator.  The machine is almost complete but we are in dire need of some Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.  Retrieve some from the leper gnomes out front of Gnomeregan for us.

entries.name: Shimmer Stout
entries.how:
I'd like my brother Wellart to try my new Shimmer Stout.  He's a Mountaineer stationed in the southern guard tower, one of two towers on the border to Loch Modan.

He may not be a brewer like the rest of us Barleybrews, but he loves his drinks and I know he'll like this one.

Can you bring him this Barrel of Shimmer Stout for me?

entries.name: Rejold's New Brew
entries.how:
Rejold Barleybrew at Brewnall Village has been asking for you.

He wants to talk to you about a new drink he's been brewing...said something about you helping him with it.  You might want to head back to Brewnall Village and see what he has to say.

There could be some free booze in it for you...

entries.name: A Pilot's Revenge
entries.how:
Hildelve wrote in his journal that he was attacked by Mangeclaw, a "huge Ice Claw Bear."  He drove off the beast, but not before it mauled him savagely.

Judging from the state of Hildelve's body, Mangeclaw must have later returned and killed him.

However, Hildelve wrote in his journal his one, final wish:

Revenge against Mangeclaw.

entries.name: The Lost Pilot
entries.how:
My friend and fellow Siege Engine pilot, Mori Hildelve, is lost in the hills.  We were looking for a rare ore that's needed for a high-grade blastpowder, and during our search he drove his engine up a steep hill and busted it!

Still convinced that ore was in these mountains, Hildelve charged me to guard our engines while he continued on foot, searching.

It's been days, and I've heard some beastly growls in the hills at night.  Mori's tough as nails, but I'm worried.

Please, {name}.  Find him.

entries.name: Those Blasted Troggs!
entries.how:
Those Light-blasted troggs, turning my work site into a wreck! Look at that, there goes another barrel of powder!

Ohhh, I wish I could go down there and wring every one of their scrawny little necks! I want to kill them all!

This can't be good for my health, all this stress and anger... What have they left me with? Nothing!

I'd kill them myself, but my aim's no good anymore! You go into the quarry and kill some of the filthy buggers! I'll pay you! Just hurt them, kill them!

entries.name: The Public Servant
entries.how:
As a member of the Senate and the Explorers' League, I've taken it upon myself to take care of this part of the trogg infestation that has gripped our lands.

They've certainly made a mess of Gol'Bolar quarry, and for no reason. As we dug deep into the earth, they poured out, destroying our equipment and driving the miners out. There's not much for us to do but to exterminate the lot of them, rebuild, then get back to work.

If you help me with the troggs, I'll gladly recompense you for your time.

entries.name: Search for Incendicite
entries.how:
I heard that a rare ore, incendicite, was found in the Wetlands, in a cave northwest of Algaz Gate.  Incendicite is volatile stuff and hard to use without blowing yourself up, but I'm sure if it's smelted the right way it could make cannon shells that pack a mighty punch!

Get me incendicite ore and I'll find someone brave enough to experiment with it.

Oh, and to extract that ore from a vein you'll need skill in mining.  If you don't have it, then ... bring a friend who does to that cave!

entries.name: Stonegear's Search
entries.how:
Pilot Stonegear loves his siege engine, as every pilot should!  And he's always eager to find new ways to improve his tank's firepower!

He heard rumors of a rare ore and is looking for someone to hunt it down for him.  If your boots are starting to itch, then find Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh and see what he wants.

entries.name: Supplies to Tannok
entries.how:
Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?

You were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.

Anyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!

entries.name: Ammo for Rumbleshot
entries.how:
Hegnar Rumbleshot sells guns off the road to Anvilmar.  Riflemen and mortar teams spend a lot of time practicing out near his shop, and he's always needing fresh ammunition.

But... the last crate of ammo I sent him got lost along the way.  My courier said he was camped near the Grizzled Den when wendigo chased him away... and the fool left Rumbleshot's ammo behind!

{name}, can you get that ammo and take it to Rumbleshot?  He's been waiting on it and I'm sure he's running low.

entries.name: Data Hoarders
entries.how:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.

The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...

entries.name: Never Saddle on Quality
entries.how:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!

entries.name: Stolen Blasting Powder
entries.how:
The keg is stamped:

BLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER

You get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.

entries.name: Stolen Blasting Powder
entries.how: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it.

entries.name: The Quarry's Smith
entries.how:
So you're looking to learn the blacksmith's trade? Maybe we can help each other.

The supply shipment's late, and I need materials for some repairs around the camp. If you get me what I need, I'll teach you some of my techniques. Sound fair?

entries.name: Nip 'Em in the Bud
entries.how:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.

entries.name: Underground Map
entries.how:
The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.

entries.name: Farsen's Watch
entries.how:
Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.

If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.

entries.name: A Visitor to Dun Morogh
entries.how:
Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.

entries.name: Your First Riding Ram
entries.how:
Ah, it's a big day fer ya I see; here for yer first ram are ye?

These rams are the most steadfast and sturdy in all of Azeroth. They're fiercely protective of their rider. Aye, you'll have a hard time finding a more stalwart companion for yer journeys.

So, you have an important choice to make. You and yer ram will traverse the world together so choose wisely! Not to worry lad, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go see the rams and return to me when you've made yer choice.

entries.name: Learning to Ride
entries.how:
Hello, {class}! It would seem yer now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me ta teach ye how to ride a ram, for a fee o'course.

Veron will provide ye with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you'll be able to purchase any additional mounts ye would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but ye will have to find trainers for each.

Speak ta me when you have enough coin, and I'll teach ye all I know about riding rams.

entries.name: Your First Mechanostrider
entries.how:
Salutations! I see today is a big day indeed; today you will synchronize your biometrics to the rider detection protocol of your first mechanostrider! This protocol will help the strider distinguish you from other possible riders.

As such, you have an important choice to make. You and your strider will traverse the world together so choose wisely! Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the correct one.

Go examine the mechanostriders and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: Learning to Ride
entries.how:
Greetings, {class}! You are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to pilot a mechanostrider, for a fee of course.

Milli will provide you with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough gold, and I will teach you about riding mechanostriders!

entries.name: Secure the Mountain
entries.how:
It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.

entries.name: Flintfire's Shipment
entries.how:
Hoha! Good to see a {race} who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.

entries.name: Secure the Mountain
entries.how:
Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.

Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.

If you're already going to be out and about, what say you check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!

entries.name: Secure the Mountain
entries.how:
Hopefully ye put down a fair number of the mongrels while you were in there. Shame about Cornelius, though.

From what you described, there's not much to report other than the cave is a lost cause. Whitebeard's not gonna like that answer, but I'm not darin' sendin' anybody else into that death trap.

Feel free tae pass along the message, {name}. I'm not leavin' this spot till the mountain's secure.

entries.name: Frosthowl
entries.how:
Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.

Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.

Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.

entries.name: The Treaty of Understanding
entries.how: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to the time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.

entries.name: Dawn in the Mountains
entries.how:
There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if you're going that way?

entries.name: Finding Warmth
entries.how:
My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.

I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.

entries.name: Rime's Wrath
entries.how:
You may have noticed the elementals nearby. A shelf of rock and ice fell from the mountain peaks a few days ago and riled them up.

These frozen mountains are already treacherous for the average dwarf or human without the elements taking form. I am not one for fighting anymore--so any of the spirits you can kill would help make the road safer.

entries.name: Rime's Wrath
entries.how:
I noticed that the first elemental that appeared after the rockslide was larger than its peers. And from what I can tell, it has been the source of occasional weather changes and other minor slides.

I've been calling it 'Avala', if you could kill it and retrieve the core as proof, I will reward you.

entries.name: Treacherous Cold
entries.how:
Even mountaineers from Ironforge have to keep their wits about them when traversing through the peaks of Dun Morogh. Falling snow and ice often spells the end of some more novice members' lives.

After a slide, I usually try to find any sign of survivors or victims--while praying to the Light that there's nothing to be found. But with the elements acting up, I've held off wandering too far. If you could look for some lost mountaineers and bring me their rifles, I will return them to Ironforge.

entries.name: Swift as the Wind
entries.how:
I can tell that you've come far enough to handle one of our top of the line, most powerful swift mechanostriders.

Milli will provide you with a free mount once you have completed your final round of training with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like just as before.

This won't be cheap, but speak to me when you have enough gold. I will teach you about riding our supercharged mechanostriders!

entries.name: Swift as the Wind
entries.how:
Yer back! Good, good. 

Are ye ready for a proper mountaineer's mount, {name}?

Veron will set ye up with a free armored ram once ye have finished the final leg of yer training with me, and afterwards you'll be able to purchase any additional mounts ye would like. 

Speak ta me when you have enough coin, and I'll teach ye all I know about riding armored rams.

entries.name: An Epic Ride
entries.how:
Ah, hail {name}! My, you've certainly grown since the last time you were at my humble stable, eh?

It would seem you have the experience ta be ridin' our fiercest and fastest rams now! Ah, I'm proud of ye.

So, you have an important choice to make. You and yer ram will traverse the world together so choose wisely! Not to worry, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go see the armored rams and return to me when you've made yer choice.

entries.name: An Epic Ride
entries.how:
Salutations! I see today is a big day indeed; today you will synchronize your biometrics to the rider detection protocol of our fastest and fiercest mechanostriders! This protocol will help the strider distinguish you from other possible riders.

It clearly seems like you have enough strider experience to handle one of our very best.

Go examine the upgraded mechanostriders and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: The Lost Fragments
entries.how:
The Scroll of Myzrael...the Scroll of Myzrael?!  You don't want that!  Its magic can pull Myzrael to the surface world and if you do that, we are in trouble!

Or...maybe it's too late.  Maybe she already is free.  Maybe she's just gathering strength before unleashing herself upon us.  If so, then you'll NEED the scroll!

...too bad it's destroyed.  Enraged elementals stole it and tore it up and now fight over the fragments.

But if you can gather those fragments, maybe we can fix it...

entries.name: Barbecued Buzzard Wings
entries.how:
Oh yes, my barbecued buzzard wings are a favorite!  The sauce is rich and the meat is tangy.  And the smell will bring the hungry running from miles away!

I have everything I need to cook up a batch.  Everything...except the buzzard wings!

If you want some then get me the buzzard wings.  Bring me enough, and I might even share the recipe with you!

entries.name: Pearl Diving
entries.how:
The Badlands is a harsh place, filled with vicious predators and bold scavengers.  Scary, especially for a short little goblin.  To survive, I have to be tricky!

I know the recipe for flash bombs.  I use those to scare away wildlife.  But I'm running low on one of the ingredients: crushed blue pearl powder.  Get me some and I'll make it worth your efforts.

Heh, and I hope you have good boots on.  The Blue Pearls I need are found from clams at the Vile Reef.

Yep, the Vile Reef in Stranglethorn!

entries.name: Fiery Blaze Enchantments
entries.how:
As an apprentice to Feranor Steeltoe, I learned his special technique for imbuing weapons with fiery enchantments. Last I heard of him, he was working at a smithy with a hunting party up in Lordaeron.

I can't tell you too many of the details about the process, but I can tell you it requires blood from a rare, still-beating black drake whelp's heart. I don't have much to do waiting for word from Ironforge. If you bring me a heart from the whelps in Lethlor Ravine, I'll show you my skill!

entries.name: The Black Box
entries.how:
The surface of this metallic black box is heavily pitted, as if it had been immersed in acid - it must have been sitting in the giant condor's stomach for a long time.

Turning the box over, a symbol is found stamped on its bottom.  Below the symbol are the words:

"Engine #19 - Ironforge Siege Brigade"

entries.name: Study of the Elements: Rock
entries.how:
Here in the Badlands I've stopped to work on my latest project: my shackles of elemental binding.

When complete, they will allow mages to summon even more powerful elementals for use in even greater capacities. To start things off, I need small stone shards to test some of my newest offensive spells along with a few gizmos I've pieced together.

The shards are easily collected from the lesser rock elementals to the west of here. Could you bring me some?

entries.name: Study of the Elements: Rock
entries.how:
{name}, you've already proven more able than all my apprentices combined.

The next parts I need require a little more strength. Large stone slabs can be found on rock elementals if you're careful enough. Their bodies are stronger and larger, and therefore more prone to having pieces large enough for my tests. You can find them further west of here or southeast along the mountains' edges.

Take your time; I'll need a while to test these smaller pieces you brought me.

entries.name: Study of the Elements: Rock
entries.how:
{name}, there's one more part I need from the elementals here in the Badlands: the bracers of rock binding from the greater rock elementals. By my calculations, those bracers should be enough to gauge the strength of my own shackles.

My attempts at scrying the greater rock elementals showed a group of them southwest of here, near some ogres if I recall.

Bring me 5 of their bracers just so I have extras. Servo's notorious for misplacing my reagents and research.

entries.name: Coolant Heads Prevail
entries.how:
Let me tell you something about Frost Oil: nothing can keep an engine or gears from overheating quite like it.

Its cooling properties are extraordinary, and its longevity as a lubricant without equal. That's not all: it also aids in retaining enchantments on magical items.

I need a vial of it to increase the magical capacity of my shackles and make them powerful enough to stop our summoned friend from killing us all.

Bro'kin, a goblin friend of mine, can teach you to make it. He's in Alterac.

entries.name: Gyro... What?
entries.how:
{name}, you've done your job well beyond all standards.

<Lotwil's obviously distracted by his work.>

If we ever meet in Kharanos, feel free to come apply for work.

Whoops! Quick, grab the... yes, that. Thanks.

Now I just need one more thing. It's a small part, but rather crucial, I'm afraid: a gyrochronatom.

If you could just go grab one and bring it to me, I should be ready to complete this.

entries.name: Liquid Stone
entries.how:
I'm thinking those items you acquired for Lotwil are going to be the least of our worries, {name}. On the other hand, you've proven more than adept at the sciences Lotwil holds sacred, so how about helping me out?

I need an invisibility potion and a healing potion; both might come in handy real soon if he pulls this off.

In return, I'll give you this recipe for a potion I've been developing while learning from Lotwil. It's based on some of the research he's been doing here in the Badlands.

entries.name: Stone Is Better than Cloth
entries.how:
I know how cheap Lotwil can be, {name}, so let me make you something for all your troubles. Maybe it'll even help protect you from the coming atrocity that is Lotwil's newest invention.

I've been working with all the extra stones you collected for him, and I can make some nice bracers that you might want to use. They're enchanted, of course.

I'll just need patterned bronze bracers crafted by a blacksmith so I can complete the bracers I'm making for you.

entries.name: Tremors of the Earth
entries.how:
It has become obvious that we cannot ensure that Blacklash and Hematus will remain imprisoned in Lethlor. That black dragons have taken up residence there, and that the ogres managed to steal the Sign indicates that more drastic measures will have to be taken.

The drakes' prison is maintained by three runestones that may only be retrieved using the Sign of the Earth. Those runestones can then be used to break the seal which imprisons them.

{name}... assure that their dreams are eternal.

entries.name: Mirages
entries.how:
In our hurry to leave the Uldaman excavation site, we were forced to abandon many wagons and crates of supplies along the way. The local ogres from Camp Kosh have been on our abandoned equipment like vultures on a rotting corpse. Don't smell much better, either. Than the corpses, I mean.

Anyways, they took the cart that was carrying all our weapons and such... so--well, this is a bit embarrassing--we haven't been able to get any food.

We're in a bit of a pickle here, suppose you could help us out?

entries.name: A Dwarf and His Tools
entries.how:
Hey, {name}. Be careful 'round here. There be Dark Iron dwarves all around--looked like the Shadowforge clan.

They just attacked the excavation site I was workin' at--killed nearly everyone there, including my boss Hammertoe. I barely escaped with me life.

The site's just to the north of here, and I'm tryin' to plan a way to get some of our supplies back, especially me lucky pick.

Think you'd be up to helpin' me out some? One of those damned Dark Iron must have my pick! Could be anyone of them.

entries.name: A Sign of Hope
entries.how:
<There is text roughly scribbled in chalk on the map.>

"Ryedol, 
They're taking me to Uldaman. Send help.
-Hammertoe"

entries.name: Prospect of Faith
entries.how:
<Hammertoe holds his wounds and takes a moment to regain his composure before speaking again.>

Find Ryedol, {name}. Bring 'im me amulet. <cough cough> He'll... <cough> figure out what to do. He knows I was seeking the origins of our people, and he... <cough>... knows it was also my mission to stop the Shadowforge clan. They must not be allowed to find the scrolls... <cough>

entries.name: Prospect of Faith
entries.how:
Okay, okay... who would know what to do?

Historian Karnik! That's it!

He's in Ironforge. He'll be able to help. He and Hammertoe were workin' together to find the lost artifacts in Uldaman.

Guess the Shadowforge found out the two of them knew more than they were lettin' on.

Tell Karnik what's happened to Hammertoe and give him the amulet--he'll tell you what needs to be done next.

entries.name: Passing Word of a Threat
entries.how:
{name}, run and find Advisor Belgrum as quickly as you can. Tell him what you've witnessed and ask him how he wants us to proceed. This note will explain more to him.

In the meantime, I will take the time to speak to Hammertoe's spirit. Maybe he knows something that will help us put a stop to those Shadowforge cretins' activities in the Badlands. We can only pray.

entries.name: Passing Word of a Threat
entries.how:
<Advisor Belgrum reaches the end of the note, and his eyes widen for a moment.>

Och, these are evil tidings.

{name}, please return to Historian Karnik and tell him on the king's authority to act on this information swiftly and decisively. He must halt the Shadowforge's activities in the Badlands.

entries.name: To Ironforge for Yagyin's Digest
entries.how:
The Tablet tells much.  But not enough!  Not nearly enough!

There is a book, a digest that Yagyin wrote in ages past.  The ... people I fled ... they keep this book in many places.  And their most learned study it.  It holds vast knowledge.  Knowledge to protect us!

Go to Gerrig Bonegrip.  He is in a shop in Ironforge, in the Forlorn Cavern.  Show him this sigil and he'll think you one of them.  Ask him for Yagyin's Digest ... and bring it to me!

entries.name: To the Undercity for Yagyin's Digest
entries.how:
The tablet tells much.  But not enough!  Not nearly enough!

There is a book, a digest that Yagyin wrote in ages past.  The... people I fled from... they keep this book in many places.  And their most learned study it.  It holds vast knowledge.  Knowledge to protect us!

Go to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity of Lordaeron.  Show him this sigil and he'll think you one of them.  Ask him for Yagin's Digest...and bring it to me!

entries.name: Tremors of the Earth
entries.how:
I heard from Sigrun that you have been a great help to him. Perhaps I might enlist your help. I was sent here by my master, Krasus of the Kirin Tor, to put an end to the trouble brewing in Lethlor Ravine.

I cannot divulge the exact nature of my assignment here or the tasks that I must undertake, but be assured it is of vital importance.

A band of wandering ogres, sometimes seen near Camp Boff, stole an object called the Sign of the Earth; I must have it. Bring it to me, and I will tell you more.

entries.name: Scrounging
entries.how:
It's going to be tough going here if I can't manage to scrounge up some materials to construct some defenses and other necessities. I've noticed that the ogres in the area seem to be well equipped with scrap metal. Maybe the stories of siege engines in the Badlands weren't so far off after all...

Anyways, the Prospector's been getting worried about the state of our little camp, so I'd like to get working soon if I can.

The main ogre camp is at Dustbelch Grotto, a good trek to the west of here.

entries.name: This Is Going to Be Hard
entries.how:
Wonderful, wonderful.

<Lotwil looks up at you for a moment before going back to his shackles.>

Go speak to Lucien, {name}. I need a cog #5. Bring it to me, will you?

entries.name: The Star, the Hand and the Heart
entries.how:
Yagyin's Digest, eh?  Are you starting a new chapter of us, somewhere?  Never mind, it is not my place to ask.

I will help you, for I have an extra copy.  We must aid each other, yes?  That is how we flourish.

I require three items of power.  Bring them to me and I will give you the digest.

I will not speak their names.  Ears may be on us.  But here, I will write them down.

entries.name: Forbidden Knowledge
entries.how:
I have the digest for you, {name}.  I need not tell you to take great care with it.  And to keep it far from unfriendly hands.  

This book holds many truths...

...And the truth can burn.

entries.name: Find Agmond
entries.how:
Prospector Agmond was in charge of our excavation sites in the Badlands, to the southwest.  I say "was" because...well, I haven't heard from him in weeks.  I need you to find Agmond so I can get his report.

Last I heard Agmond was at the southernmost dig site in the Badlands--a tiny operation past the Angor Fortress.  I'd start your search for him there.

entries.name: Murdaloc
entries.how:
Agmond's tracks lead from the west.  It is easy to tell from the bloody smears across rock and sand that the dwarf crawled some distance.

And here he died.

Upon close inspection, the word "Murdaloc" is roughly scrawled in a patch of Badlands sandstone.

Scrawled next to Agmond's dead hand.

entries.name: <UNUSED>
entries.how:
This quest will take players into the Searing Gorge.

Stay tuned...

entries.name: An Ambassador of Evil
entries.how:
Ambassador Infernus was sent to Angor Fortress by Ragnaros himself to mind the Shadowforge seeking lost artifacts in Uldaman.

It has already meant tremendous casualties for our people, but it has obviously grown worse. I hesitate to guess how many artifacts they would be able to find and use against Ironforge.

Our goal is simple, {class}. Return to the Badlands and destroy Ambassador Infernus. Once the threat is eliminated, return to Advisor Belgrum with proof of your victory.

It is in your hands now.

entries.name: This Is Going to Be Hard
entries.how:
Okay, here you go.

I'm going to be over here... behind cover.

Feel free to join me.

entries.name: This Is Going to Be Hard
entries.how:
Haha! Done! The shackles are done!

It's time, Lucien. It's time, Servo!

Are you ready to bear witness to the perfect blend of alchemy, engineering, and the arcane, {name}?

I shall summon forth a powerful elemental now. This is a groundbreaking day for all of us.

entries.name: Seal of the Earth
entries.how: The Seal of the Earth lies here, with three recessed alcoves for the Amethyst Runestone, the Opal Runestone, and the Diamond Runestone.

entries.name: Broken Alliances
entries.how:
From the Horde's alliance with the dragon Deathwing during the Second War, we know that two of his lieutenants, Blacklash and Hematus, were imprisoned within Lethlor Ravine far to the east. We must silence our depraved allies of old to restore honor to the Horde!

We hired Tho'grun and his band of ogre mercenaries to help us obtain the Sign of the Earth, a key needed to unlock the drakes' prison. Tho'grun betrayed us though, overwhelming us and taking it for himself. Go to Camp Boff and take it back!

entries.name: Broken Alliances
entries.how:
The Seal of the Earth is held by three runestones, held in the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst in Lethlor Ravine. Using the Sign of the Earth, you will be able to remove the runestones and unlock the Seal of the Earth.

Be wary though, {name}, the black drakes Blacklash and Hematus are not to be trifled with. See them dead and return their bindings to me.

To reach the ravine, travel to the far eastern part of the Badlands.  Be careful though, for the ravine is home to countless drakes.

entries.name: Seal of the Earth
entries.how: The Seal of the Earth lies here, with three recessed alcoves for the Amethyst Runestone, the Opal Runestone, and the Diamond Runestone.

entries.name: Coyote Thieves
entries.how:
Have you spent many days in the Badlands, {class}?  Have you felt its heat? Have you faced the beasts that wander its dusty plains?  It's time you did.

Crag coyotes are a tough breed.  Tough, and bold enough to creep into Kargath and steal from our food supplies.  Help rid the outpost of these thieves!

Hunt crag coyotes, {name}.  Hunt them and bring me their jawbones.  Bring me enough, and maybe I'll believe it when you say you know the Badlands.

entries.name: Report to Helgrum
entries.how:
I wrote a fresh report for Helgrum in Stonard.  Bring it to him.

And if you consider yourself an outrunner, then don't lose your way.  Or fall to an enemy.

entries.name: Badlands Reagent Run II
entries.how:
You have been most helpful to me, {class}.  I would reward you with the very recipe for the potion I gave you earlier... but I would ask of you a task that is quite dangerous.  Hear my request.

This lockbox contains three empty thaumaturgy vessels; they are imbued with an attunement aura that will drain the blood of a scorched guardian dragon.  Using one on the beast will anger it greatly, so be warned.  Once you have all three filled, bring them to me.

Do this, and the recipe will be yours.

entries.name: Badlands Reagent Run
entries.how:
{name}, I could use your aid if you're up for it.  I am an alchemist of some note, and I seek your aid in acquiring some reagents found out in the Badlands.

I need the following items to replenish my stocks: five buzzard gizzards, ten crag coyote fangs, and five rock elemental shards.  Obviously, you can get them off of the beasties themselves; if you're not the fighting type, then find friends who are.

Acquire these items for me, you'll get some coin out of the deal.  Watcha wanna do?

entries.name: Dreadmaul Rock
entries.how:
Sha'ni was sent to investigate reports of strange ritualistic activity coming from the Firegut ogres of the Burning Steppes over three weeks ago.

Goretooth tells me that he hasn't heard from anyone in that platoon and that it's best that I move on and focus on the task at hand. Can you believe it? That's my wife!

I can't leave my post, {name}, but I must know what became of Sha'ni. Travel to the Burning Steppes and search for her.

entries.name: The Rise of the Machines
entries.how:
G.L.A.

Those are the 'initials' imprinted on the elemental shards. Below the initials are a rank marking of some sort. The machinations you destroyed in the Burning Steppes were of 'Rank IV.' I assume that this is a lowly rank.

Take this shard sample to Lotwil Veriatus in the camp to the east. He is a scholar of some renown in the field of elemental sciences. He may be able to assist us in our search.

entries.name: Terror of the Desert Skies
entries.how: The drawing is composed of rough, broad, strokes and seems to depict a large bird of prey. Despite the simple composition, the artist clearly viewed this creature with fear and awe. An expert on big game could likely tell you more.

entries.name: Terror of the Desert Skies
entries.how:
This drawing reminds me of a story I'd heard on another expedition, not long ago. I was told of a great bird, Gharrik, who reigns over the Badlands as an apex predator.

She was last spotted northeast of Camp Cagg. Perhaps her nest is somewhere nearby?

You'll need live bait to draw her out. I'll lend you a cage to catch some. Small wildlife is scarce in the Badlands, so you'll need to find your bait elsewhere.

A quill from Gharrik would make a fine prize. You'd certainly be the talk of the camp.

entries.name: The Burning Beast
entries.how:
<The carving before you depicts a two-headed beast emerging from the Dark Portal. Fel-fire spews forth from its mouths. A plaque beneath the image reads: "Calefactus the Unleashed". 

Intuition tells you the Twilight cultists may have plans to harness this creature's destructive power for their own aims.

You reason that the next step in your hunt is towards the Blasted Lands. Someone there may know more of this hellish beast.>

entries.name: Safety Checks
entries.how:
Hullo there, you look like the helpful sort.

The name's Dorgaron, and I'm with the Explorers' League. We've not had the best of luck with diggin' in the Badlands, but I know darn well there's artifacts to find and collect!

Before I can convince the boss to let us send another crew out here, I need to prove that the dig sites are safe AND haven't been picked clean.

If you find yourself down south, gather a few reasonably intact artifacts and some leftover equipment that hasn't been smashed yet.

entries.name: Supplies and Studies
entries.how:
I noticed a few rocks that seemed unusual in the Dustbowl. Upon closer inspection, I saw that they had carvings! I could not resist making rubbings of them to study later.

The nearby ogres took notice of my presence and before I could even react, I woke up under the care of the innkeeper, and with a terrible headache.

Now, I am down all of my supplies and without any study material while I heal. Can you venture to the east in search of my pack, and take rubbings of the etchings yourself?

entries.name: Mirage Mirror
entries.how:
<Upon the elemental's demise, a relic fell from its core that glimmered in the sand.

As it was tilted in your hands, the reflection of the surrounding environment obscured it from your own view. Only once you saw a cracked surface that warped the reflection was it clearly visible again.

Perhaps someone would be interested in this discovery.>

entries.name: Snickerfang Jowls
entries.how:
It is a well known fact that hyenas possess tremendous strength in their jowls, but the strength to snap through three inches of thorium steel? Impossible, improbable, and yet I have seen this demonstrated with my own eyes.

Venture forth, into the Blasted Lands, and bring me three snickerfang jowls. As you search for the snickerfang, be on the lookout for boars and scorpoks: The initial assay also requires two blasted boar lungs and one scorpok pincer to complete.

entries.name: Rage of Ages
entries.how:
Ah, {name}, welcome back. It seems you enjoyed the effect of the robust, operational imbue, derived from snickerfang. Be warned, while the immediate effect is a titanic burst of strength, the long term effects on your spirit and intelligence could be hazardous.

With that said, do you require more? If so, bring me another three snickerfang jowls, two blasted boar lungs, and one scorpok pincer.

entries.name: A Boar's Vitality
entries.how:
Within these blasted lands exists two species of boar: the ash-mane boar and the helboar.

It would appear that the stamina of these beasts renders them nearly immune to harm, as the other animals find them too difficult to kill and consequently, not worth the effort.

We need to perform further analysis, {name}. Should you bring me three blasted boar lungs, two scorpok pincers, and one basilisk brain, I shall create a divine elixir from the residue of the assay. You will be my first test subject!

entries.name: Spirit of the Boar
entries.how:
When I first administered the elixir, {name}, I could tell that one or two applications would not satiate your appetite. Even now, I can see the hunger in your eyes. The concoction has addictive properties of which, seemingly, the most strong of will cannot resist.

So be it! Should you require more of the lung juice cocktail, venture back into the wasteland and find for me three blasted boar lungs, two scorpok pincers, and one basilisk brain.

entries.name: The Decisive Striker
entries.how:
Have you ever watched them in battle, {name}? The scorpoks, I mean. Have you ever seen the grace and agility with which they move? The decisiveness of their strikes?

If only we could somehow isolate that agility and encapsulate it, we would be wealthy beyond our... I mean... it would be a boon for the scientific community.

Assist me, {name}, and I shall allow you a sampling of the assay.

In order to create a stable sample, I will need three scorpok pincers, two vulture gizzards, and one blasted boar lung.

entries.name: Salt of the Scorpok
entries.how:
You live! This is good news, indeed. I assume you are back for more of the scorpok assay?

Very well, {name}, back to the wasteland with you and do not return until you have collected three scorpok pincers, two vulture gizzards, and one blasted boar lung.

entries.name: The Basilisk's Bite
entries.how:
These wastelands are riddled with redstone basilisk, {name}. These basilisk have adapted and flourished, more so than any of the other wildlife within the region.

I have watched from afar as they hunt and go about their daily activities - the beasts exhibit a thought process more complex than even some humanoids.

I must study their brains!

Retrieve ten of their brains for me, {name}. The compound cannot be complete, however, without two vulture gizzards to form the base of the solution.

entries.name: Infallible Mind
entries.how:
Your focused concentration has dwindled so soon? More research must be done!

Oh yes, the price remains the same, {name}. Venture forth into the blasted lands and return to me with ten brains from the redstone and two vulture gizzards.

entries.name: Vulture's Vigor
entries.how:
Death does indeed have wings in these blasted lands, {race}. I have witnessed the black slayers and bonepickers feasting upon the corpse of many a fallen explorer - sometimes feeding upon the most vile and disease ridden of carcasses. It is a wonder, then, how their internal systems overcome the pestilence that claims these lands.

Assist me in my studies, {name}! Gizzards I need! Two snickerfang jowls will also be required for the base of the concoction.

You shall be rewarded two-fold for your efforts.

entries.name: Spiritual Domination
entries.how:
I see that the inner fire has dwindled. Would you say the spiritual euphoria lasted an hour?

If it's more of the gizzard gum you desire, then more of the gizzards I require. Back to the wastelands, {name}. Do not return until you have recovered ten gizzards and two jowls.

entries.name: The Disgraced One
entries.how:
Regret. It is all I have now. One bad decision resulting in several horrible outcomes. If only I had waited for those orders. Maybe they would have detailed the horrors that awaited us in those cursed lands! Maybe they were to redirect us to another detail? Ultimately, it was my fault. All of it was my fault.

So here I stand, awaiting orders. I must know. I must have those orders.

Dispatch Commander Ruag resides in Stonard. Find him and find out what became of the orders.

entries.name: The Stones That Bind Us
entries.how:
It will take more than you alone to overcome the forces of Razelikh and his subordinates.

Gather a suitable group of adventurers and free my men of their eternal torture! Eighteen stones you must shatter.

Fight hard and die with honor, {name}.

entries.name: Heroes of Old
entries.how:
Please, take from this a relic of old. We no longer have a use for the item.

May it serve you well in your fight against the legion.

entries.name: Heroes of Old
entries.how:
You have honored me with your nobility and heroism, {name}.

You have also honored them...

entries.name: Kirith
entries.how:
As one chapter of your adventure closes, another one begins, {name}.

One of my men is still unaccounted for, lost somewhere in the Blasted Lands. I am talking about Lieutenant Kirith, of course.

As I had mentioned earlier, we were both imprisoned and tortured by Allistarj, but poor Kirith, his strength of will faltered. I could hear the experiments from my cage; the tortured screams rang through the halls of the cave. That was the last I saw or heard of Kirith.

entries.name: The Cover of Darkness
entries.how:
Let us not mince words, {race}; my time here is limited.

You must destroy the triad of power which protects the demon lord, Razelikh. Doing so will not be as simple a task as freeing a damned soul.

<Kirith grins.>

You see, each of Razelikh's underlings wears a third of an amulet of Razelikh's creation around their neck. The very same amulet you will need in order to summon the arch demon.

Return to Trebor and tell him what is required to summon Razelikh. He will be able to instruct you further.

entries.name: The Demon Hunter
entries.how:
The triad is protected by Razelikh.

In exchange for their servitude, Razelikh granted each of them nearly unlimited power within the Blasted Lands. The amulet pieces are each attuned to the lifeforce of their owner, granting them immortality. As long as they remain within the Blasted Lands, they cannot be slain, their life spans extended until the end of days.

There is one who may be able to assist you further, {name}. Travel to Azshara and find the demon hunter, Loramus Thalipedes. Search the islands.

entries.name: Petty Squabbles
entries.how:
We fight the wrong enemy, {name}.

The true power in these lands continues to grow in strength and number while we squabble over scorched earth with orcs.

Do we continue to fight a war in these lands against the Horde, only to be routed one day by the armies of the Burning Legion? It is futile.

Put your differences aside, {name}, speak with the fallen hero of the Horde. He knows the truth behind the Blasted Lands.

entries.name: Fall From Grace
entries.how: Hear my story, {race}.

entries.name: A Tale of Sorrow
entries.how: Before we may continue, you must hear my story.

entries.name: Everything Counts In Large Amounts
entries.how:
Although you may never find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, you will undoubtedly uncover various imperfect fragments of the draenethyst in your exploration of these lands.

While it is doubtful that Kum'isha will be able to use the flawed fragments to return home, the pieces may serve other, useful purposes for the draenei.

Return any piece of flawed draenethyst fragments that you may find and I shall reward you.

entries.name: One Draenei's Junk...
entries.how:
Well, after that display of voracious greed, I feel nauseous.

Regardless, I shall not dwell too long on your material addiction.

For each imperfect draenethyst fragment you turn in, I shall reward you with more junk. My junk heap gets smaller while your junk heap gets larger. On Draenor we call this a 'win-win' situation.

entries.name: Uniting the Shattered Amulet
entries.how:
To reach the Defiler, you must first destroy the triad of power and recover the amulet pieces. When you recover all three pieces, return to me and I shall give you further instruction.

Go {name}! To the Blasted Lands! Sevine, Allistarj, and Grol must fall!

entries.name: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon
entries.how:
Razelikh's lair is atop the highest mountain in the Blasted Lands. The only way to the lair is through the use of the teleport runes near the mountain. As long as you hold the amulet, you can freely transport up to the lair. Once you reach the lair, you must conjure the beast. The amulet is your key, {name}. Use it on the Altar of the Defiler.

Should you defeat the Defiler, bring back his horn. It will become a symbol of hope for all that view it - proof that heroes do exist in this war torn world.

entries.name: Chains That Bind
entries.how:
I have seen this creature you call "Calefactus" many times in my field studies. By all accounts, it appears to be a nigh-invulnerable core hound made from Fel energies.

However, if what you say is true, and the Twilight's Hammer were planning to enslave it, then there may be a way to subdue the beast.

The Shadowsworn, to the south-east, are known to perform dark rituals, including the enslavement of Fel creatures. Perhaps members of their order carry a clue to weakening Calefactus?

entries.name: Brought to Heel
entries.how:
I have fashioned a tool from the chain links you found. You might call it a "lasso" of sorts.
 
The energy within this chain is best suited for binding demons, but seeing as Calefactus may be from beyond the dark portal, I suspect it will work on him as well.

If you take him down bring me a sample of his fel lifeblood. Such an anomalous being warrants further study.

Calefactus' current location among these wastes is unknown, but I trust you'll track him down, {class}.

entries.name: Deflective Surface
entries.how:
You may have seen the Redstone basilisks wandering the wastes outside while you were on your way to Nethergarde Keep. They're tough creatures, well adapted to survival in the Blasted Lands. One of their key qualities is their sturdy scales, which reflect heat, protect against sand and wind, and even deflect weapon blows!

They're a perfect material for making shields, and if you can bring me a bundle, I'll compensate you well. Only bring ones in good condition!

entries.name: Memories of Rockard
entries.how:
This trinket, carried by the ogre, seems to be a small stone carving depicting an orc family. It may be a memento from the orcs who lived here when this was the town of Rockard, before the ogres invaded.

It probably has sentimental or spiritual value to the survivors at Stonard.

entries.name: Vek'zol
entries.how:
I do not speak Thalassian, but these diagrams are familiar to me.

Knowing the blood elves' addiction to mana, I'd say they were trying to summon demons to drain them of their fel magic.

Simply consuming such powerful energy is a waste. We could harness it for a much greater purpose.

<Zevrost bookmarks a page in the tome>

There is an Altar of Storms in the Blasted Lands. Perform this ritual there to summon the demon Vek'zol. His heart will make a potent reagent. Think of the power we could have!

entries.name: The Grand Alliance
entries.how:
Years ago, the Horde and the Alliance put aside their differences to fight a greater threat--the Legion. On Mount Hyjal, the Grand Alliance forces battled Archimonde and his minions to a halt.

The retreat from the mountain was perilous, however, and some brave fighters were left behind.

Now that the way up the great mountain is again open, perhaps some of these heroes remain alive in the wilds? Go to Mount Hyjal and brave its dangers. Find what became of our forces there.

entries.name: To Serve The Draenei
entries.how:
You may have brought Kum'isha a draenethyst sphere, but that only shows Kum'isha you are lucky, not skilled. If you wish to earn your reward, you will aid Kum'isha's brethren in returning home.

Kum'isha will use this sphere to open a rift, while other draenei will go through. Whatever dangers come out, you will fight. If any of Kum'isha's brothers and sisters are harmed, you can forget about that reward.

Are you ready, {race}?

entries.name: The Found One
entries.how:
While I know of no other settlement like ours, I have seen lost ones south of here in the Blasted Lands. They are much like the ones of Fallow Sanctuary--hostile and mindless. I assumed that was the fate which befell all of our kind there.

However, if Onku's vision points to a lone draenei wandering a wasteland, then perhaps I was wrong.

I am calling on you once again, {name}. Find this draenei and aid them however you can.

entries.name: To Serve Kum'isha
entries.how:
Can your miniscule brain comprehend the rarity of a flawless sphere of draenethyst, {race}? Draenei have spent lifetimes in search of just one of these crystals, only to meet horrible fates, their purpose unfulfilled.

So you stand before Kum'isha, knowing what Kum'isha has requested and still wish to assist? Very well, {race}... At any time during your travels across these lands, should you find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, return it to me and I shall reward you with riches beyond your wildest dreams.

entries.name: Kum'isha's Endeavors
entries.how:
Even though the rift was only a partial success, Kum'isha must continue his attempts.

The hope of the Draenei is as fervent as your greed for trinkets, {race}. Go back out into these cursed lands and recover another flawless draenethyst sphere.

Of course, the choice to take on this task is completely left to you *grin*.

entries.name: The Orphan
entries.how:
We often try to find surviving family for many of our charges, and occasionally we find something hopeful. I've received word that Randal here may have a surviving family member. The man's name is Danneth, and he is a soldier stationed at Nethergarde Keep. I need someone to travel there and find the man.

If you can, please convince Danneth to come retrieve his nephew. I don't think the two have ever met, but they are family all the same and Randal belongs with him.

entries.name: Into the Darkness
entries.how:
Sergeant Danneth was last seen on patrol with his squad near Serpent's Coil, just south of Nethergarde Keep. One of the members of his squad stumbled back into the keep, badly wounded and claiming that the entire squad was killed or captured. That soldier died a few hours later, unfortunately.

We don't have confirmation that Danneth is dead, but chances aren't good. I can't spare the men to push into the cult's lair, but if you wanted to go and look for the man, I'd not refuse the aid.

entries.name: A Heavy Responsibility
entries.how:
<Lieutenant Connar listens as you tell him the reason you are here.>

So, Danneth has an orphaned nephew in Dalaran? If you haven't spoken to him about this yet, I'd suggest you do so. He doesn't exactly seem like the parenting type, but he might surprise me.

If he does want to go and collect the boy once he's recovered, he has my blessing to take leave for that.

entries.name: Escaping the Shadows
entries.how: I think I'm ready now. Let's get going when you are ready.

entries.name: Lack of Surplus
entries.how:
I'm working on getting some supplies together for our outpost near the beach to the east--Tok'kar does what he can, but between shifts of guard duty and cooking for his soldiers there's not much time left in the day.

They do enjoy cooking up some sawtooth meat when they can, but I haven't had time to get them another shipment. Would you mind helping them out?

The young sawtooths aren't as tasty as the older ones, so stay clear of those; give them a year or two to get to full size.

entries.name: Lack of Surplus
entries.how:
With the threat of murlocs along the coast, we're stationed out here to protect--or warn if the force is too large--of any coming threats to Stonard. It doesn't give us much time for relaxation, and we could use some more help if you're able.

The sawtooth snappers' claws make for fine weapons when properly prepared. Bring me some of their claws and I'll see you're rewarded with one of our weapons in thanks for the fresh meat and the good company.

entries.name: Draenethyst Crystals
entries.how:
The lost ones who live in the Fallow Sanctuary look as we look, but they are monsters... driven mad by the rigors of our journey to Azeroth.  Once our brethren, they now live in the Fallow Sanctuary to the east, catching or killing any who wander near.

And they have stolen something sacred to us--draenethyst crystals.

We lack the force to enter the Fallow Sanctuary and reclaim our stolen draenethyst from among their huts and campfires, but without those crystals... we too may lose our way.

entries.name: Noboru the Cudgel
entries.how: Noboru has plagued the Draenei of the Harborage for months, and his cudgel is a symbol of the brutality they have suffered at the hands of the lost ones.

entries.name: Galen's Escape
entries.how:
Please help!  These creatures are going to eat me!

Help me out of here, and I'll give you a great treasure!  It's in my camp in the swamp north of Stonard, but it's locked in a strongbox that can be opened through a trick that only I know.

If you help me escape, then I'll teach it to you.

entries.name: Encroaching Wildlife
entries.how:
My caravan was destined for the eastern coast, but we did not reach our goal. Lost Ones attacked us, killing guards and dashing supplies.

I alone survived their assault. I have sworn to protect what supplies remain, but wild creatures skulk near. Please, help me defend my camp from the beasts!

entries.name: Driftwood
entries.how:
I owe you greatly, {name}.  An honorable heart beats within you.  And now I have another task for which I humbly ask your aid.

If I'm ever to reach Nethergarde, then I must fix this wagon.  And for that... I will need wood.  Strong, dry wood--not the spongy, tangled wood of the swamp's trees.

{name}, go east to the coast and search for driftwood that has been dried by the sun.  Bring it to me.

entries.name: Neeka Bloodscar
entries.how:
The Badlands is harsh and lies close to the Alliance-held land of Loch Modan, so communication between Stonard and the Badlands outpost of Kargath is often cut.

Prove yourself, {name}.  Travel to the Badlands and speak with Neeka Bloodscar, head scout of the Kargath outpost.  Speak with her, and then send her report back to me.

entries.name: The Lost Caravan
entries.how:
I was stunned during the attack by the Lost Ones, but before my sight went black I spied one of our wagons being dragged to the Fallow Sanctuary, the lost one village to the north.

A caravan chest with valuable reagents was in that wagon, reagents vital to the studies of the wizards of Nethergarde Keep.  Find the chest and get those reagents, {name}.  Get them and bring them to me.

entries.name: Threat From the Sea
entries.how: While I begin work on your weapon, why don't you talk to Katar? He mentioned needing help with patrols along the beach, and I'd rather see you keep your wits and weapons prepared instead of getting drunk with some of the other louses I share this camp with.

entries.name: The Lost Supplies
entries.how:
This barrel is small yet sturdy.  Its seams are sealed with a yellow, pungent wax.  Stamped on the bottom of the barrel are the words:

QUARTERMASTER LUNGERTZ

NETHERGARDE KEEP

entries.name: Pool of Tears
entries.how:
The Warchief sent us to investigate strange happenings at The Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

The Atal'ai trolls are a tribe of dark casters, known for practicing forbidden magic. You can imagine how astonished we were when we arrived here to discover the temple had been sunk.

The green dragons now guard the site, claiming to be protectors of Azeroth.

We need to discover what happened. Explore around the Pool of Tears and gather Atal'ai artifacts. From those I can begin to piece together this puzzle.

entries.name: Deliver the First Shipment
entries.how:
While I fix this wagon, {name}, I have one last task for you.

I have packed the most vital supplies saved from the Lost Ones' attacks. Take them to Nethergarde Keep. The keep is nestled in the northern hills of the Blasted Lands, keeping watch over the Dark Portal.

To reach Nethergard, follow the road east. When it branches head south into the Blasted Lands, then turn left at the next fork. Follow the road, {name}, and be wary.

entries.name: Threat From the Sea
entries.how:
I have no love for the sea, nor any creature I've seen come from its depths. It is a powerful but blind mistress; callous and brutal. It would bring me great pleasure to slay the fish men by the hundreds if it were within my power. But I garner some pleasure from watching their deaths at the hands of any who do the Horde's will.

Which brings us to you, {class}. How many can you slay? Would you test yourself against their most powerful kind?

entries.name: Threat From the Sea
entries.how: Before you take rest, speak to Tok'Kar again. While you were gone I believe he finished a few weapons. For your help here, he would offer one of them to you. You would do well to test its strength against the fish men when you are ready... but only to please me further.

entries.name: Continued Threat
entries.how:
It pleases me to see your hatred for the fish men grows with mine.

Find more of their kind along the beach, and when you've had your fill of combat, return to me. We shall speak then of a reward for your diligence.

entries.name: The Atal'ai Exile
entries.how:
While you were braving the dangers of the Pool of Tears, one of my scouts returned with a scroll written in blood on dried flesh. It seems to be a judicial sentence against a priest of the Atal'ai tribe.

This priest was sentenced to a fate worse than death amongst the Atal'ai.

He was exiled to live far north in the Hinterlands, with the Witherbark trolls.

I will bundle these artifacts. You are to seek out the exile and discover their true use. Return to me once your journey is complete.

entries.name: Fresh Meat
entries.how:
There's a high demand for the succulent taste of crawler meat among my customers; especially the meat from the monstrous crawlers.

If you plan on heading to the coast, then I could easily make it worth your while to bring me back some of their legs to have transported back to Orgrimmar.

The coast is to the east from here, and you should have no problem finding the creatures scurrying along the beaches and under the sea.

entries.name: The Missing Orders
entries.how:
The orders? What could you possibly want with the orders?

What are you implying, {name}? Of course I relayed those orders! The soldiers I sent the orders with were ambushed and brutally beaten by murlocs. Only one survived, if you can call that surviving. He can hardly speak, cannot walk, and must be fed through a tube. If you want to know what happened to those orders, speak with Bengor. I'm sure he is around here somewhere... and, {name}, be mindful of what you stick your nose into - it may get bitten off.

entries.name: The Swamp Talker
entries.how:
Orders were given by the dispatch commander. We took... took orders. On way to Blasted Lands, ambushed.

Murlocs... Many murlocs... One named Swamp Talker. Took orders from my hands as spear thrust into my skull. East... cave....

<Bengor passes out.>

entries.name: The Essence of Eranikus
entries.how:
You engage the Oathstone, and Itharius speaks directly to your mind through the stone.

"By accepting the charge placed in this Oathstone, you agree to aid my cause and the cause of Ysera's Dragonflight in redeeming the corrupted soul of Eranikus.  The first sacrifice, one of many you and I will no doubt make, will be to relinquish the gem to me that has chained what free-willed part of Eranikus' psyche remains."

"Do this {name}, and we will work together to redeem a soul worthy of redemption."

entries.name: In Eranikus' Own Words
entries.how:
{name}, our first step will be to devise a method to speak with Eranikus through the gem.  He lies in a precarious state between sleep and death now, twisted within a weave of nightmares.  Though the essence you have given me is badly tainted, there is a chance we can reach him.

Travel far to the icy lands of eastern Winterspring and seek one of our mortal allies, Umbranse the Spiritspeaker.  He is a human medium who speaks for the dead.  Though Eranikus is not truly dead, he may be of aid to us still.

entries.name: Itharius
entries.how: Are you familiar with the Temple of Atal'Hakkar? It has a storied history that I will not retell here, but it is currently under the stewardship of a host of mighty green dragons. The chief guardian of the temple is a great dragon named Eranikus, and he is known to be particularly attuned to the dream. It is my hope that he may be able to aid us. Go to the Swamp of Sorrows and meet with the ranger there known as Itharius. He may know how to reach out to Eranikus to petition his aid.

entries.name: The Essence of Eranikus
entries.how:
You engage the Oathstone, and Itharius speaks directly to your mind through the stone.

"By accepting the charge placed in this Oathstone, you agree to aid my cause and the cause of Ysera's Dragonflight in redeeming the corrupted soul of Eranikus.  The first sacrifice, one of many you and I will no doubt make, will be to relinquish the gem to me that has chained what free-willed part of Eranikus' psyche remains."

"Do this {name}, and we will work together to redeem a soul worthy of redemption."

entries.name: My Little Friends
entries.how:
Admiring my little menagerie, are you? They are my un-life's work. I've spent countless hours studying them: their anatomy, their diets, even their social rituals.

Do you wish to join me in the hobby? Here, take this package. The notes and materials contained within should get you started. If you lose it, you'll have to purchase another one from me for a small fee.

entries.name: Blood of My Blood
entries.how:
Although they are our kin, the Lost Ones of Fallow Sanctuary have become beings of pure violence and hatred.

There can be no redemption or salvation for them. They are doomed to wander this swamp as mindless, hateful creatures for all their lives.

Their suffering must end. Someone must put them out of their misery. A grisly task, I know, but would you do it to protect those of us who remain?

entries.name: Taking the Bait Back
entries.how:
Now they've really done it! As if those wretches weren't already enough to deal with, one of them has stolen my lucky lure!

I was just out fishing this morning, when one came up out of the muck, cut my line, and ran off with it. The thief is almost certainly one of the Lost Ones' own fishermen, hoping to use the lure themselves.

Well, our supply of fish depends on that lure, so I need it back. The Lost Ones fish along the banks east of here. Find that thief, {race}!

entries.name: The Visiting Mage
entries.how:
Allow me to admit something, {name}. While draenethyst is sacred to us, and keeps us sane, none here fully understand it.

I recall a mage who once came to the Harborage, from Desolace. A human by the name of Azore. He feared the power of the draenethyst; said it shouldn't fall into the wrong hands. 

At the time, we drove him away to protect what was ours. Lately, however, I find myself wondering what exactly he knew.

I ask that you find this mage, {race}. His knowledge could be of immense value to us.

entries.name: This Light of Mine
entries.how:
Oh thank goodness, someone civilized!

I came here on behalf of the Church of the Holy Light to make contact with the draenei of the Harborage. The Alliance has no foothold here, you see, and a bit of diplomacy with the locals may help us in that regard. The Light welcomes all into its fold, after all!

However, the road past this bridge is crawling with the draenei's more savage kin. If I am to make it to the Harborage safely, I will need protection. Would you aid me, {class}?

entries.name: Lost in Transit
entries.how:
The draenei of the Harborage are skilled fishermen, and willing to trawl more dangerous waters than I. We occasionally trade. They give us some of their catch, and I offer some of our extra supplies.

I'd sent a goblin courier to deliver my latest shipment, but he never returned. A crocolisk likely made a meal of him.

More importantly, my business reputation is at stake. That shipment must be found, and delivered to the harborage. Please, find it if you can. Check near the waters along the road.

entries.name: Visions of Another
entries.how:
It is good to see you again, {name}. I have been reading the notes you brought to us, and speaking with Onku, our eldest seer, about the matter.

He has recently been granted a vision that may lead us to the draenethyst sphere. We would like to share the revelations of that vision with you, if you'd join us for a moment?

entries.name: Deliver the Second Shipment
entries.how:
I know I said that was it, but I promise, I wouldn't ask this if it weren't important. It's a shipment of utmost urgency.

An old acquaintance resides in a keep within the Riverglades. To get there, travel northeast through the bogs avoiding the deadly creatures within. Along the northeastern hillside sits an old path. Travel its road all the way through the hills and when you hit the fork in the road stay north, then east. You should see Farholde along the eastern shore.

I thank you for your aid.

entries.name: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot
entries.how:
Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge.  Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!

But be wary, {name}.  Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him.  He will not be an easy man to reach.

entries.name: Kobold Camp Cleanup
entries.how: Your first task is one of cleansing, {name}.  A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north.  Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find.  Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.

entries.name: Investigate Echo Ridge
entries.how:
{name}, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought.  A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.

Go to the mine and remove them.  We know there are at least 10.  Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.

entries.name: Brotherhood of Thieves
entries.how:
Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire.  They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.

I don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good!  Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.

entries.name: Skirmish at Echo Ridge
entries.how:
Your previous investigations are proof that the Echo Ridge Mine needs purging.  Return to the mine and help clear it of kobolds.

Waste no time, {name}.  The longer the kobolds are left unmolested in the mine, the deeper a foothold they gain in Northshire.

entries.name: Wolves Across the Border
entries.how:
I hate those nasty timber wolves!  But I sure like eating wolf steaks...  Bring me tough wolf meat and I will exchange it for something you'll find useful.

Tough wolf meat is gathered from hunting the timber wolves and young wolves wandering the Northshire countryside.

entries.name: Report to Goldshire
entries.how:
{name}, you are a {class} with proven interest in the security of Northshire.  You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding Elwynn Forest.

If you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.  Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.

entries.name: A Threat Within
entries.how:
I hope you strapped your belt on tight, young {class}, because there is work to do here in Northshire.

And I don't mean farming.

The Stormwind guards are hard pressed to keep the peace here, with so many of us in distant lands and so many threats pressing close.  And so we're enlisting the aid of anyone willing to defend their home.  And their alliance.

If you're here to answer the call, then speak with my superior, Marshal McBride.  He's inside the abbey behind me.

entries.name: Milly Osworth
entries.how:
You've shown yourself a dependable {class}, {name}.  Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?

I have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble.  She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable.  I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.

entries.name: Milly's Harvest
entries.how:
A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting!  I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes!  If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.

Please, you must help me!  I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.

Bring me those crates!  Save my harvest!

entries.name: Grape Manifest
entries.how:
Now that my crop is saved, take this Grape Manifest to Brother Neals.  He manages the store of food and drink in Northshire, and I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear that he has fresh grapes.

You'll find Brother Neals in the abbey, in the bell tower... where he likes to taste his wine.

entries.name: Eagan Peltskinner
entries.how:
Eagan Peltskinner is looking for someone to hunt wolves for him.  That's good news, because we're seeing a lot more wolves in Northshire Valley lately.

If you're interested then speak with Eagan.  He's around the side of the abbey, to the left.

entries.name: Waskily Wabbits!
entries.how:
These rabbits are breeding uncontrollably.  Something must be done!

Help us {name}, you're our only hope.

entries.name: Wabbit Pelts
entries.how:
