I want LeCrafty rabbit pelts.  Get me some from LeCrafty Rabbits.

This is important!

entries.name: Rascally Rodents
entries.how: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.

entries.name: Mining Consultant
entries.how: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.

entries.name: The Big Picture
entries.how:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.

entries.name: Follow That Kobold!
entries.how:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.

entries.name: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
entries.how:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.

entries.name: Book Inventory
entries.how:
We need to take stock of how many books are missing!

Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.

He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.

Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!

entries.name: Jitters' Growling Gut
entries.how:
I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds!  I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.

Bring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.

I heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...

entries.name: Morbent Fel
entries.how:
Morbent Fel hides in his lair, the house perched atop the hill to the east overlooking the Raven Hill cemetery.  His time in this land is drawing to an end...

Use Morbent's Bane against him.  It will render his protective magics powerless.

Slay him.  Slay him, and save us from his wickedness.  Be the instrument of my revenge, and a hero of Duskwood!

entries.name: The Night Watch
entries.how:
As Commander of The Night Watch it is my sworn duty to protect the citizens of Darkshire.  Stormwind has retracted their commissioned guards from their posts here, leaving us to our own devices.

If you feel worthy of the task, we need your help! Assist The Night Watch by venturing forth into Tranquil Gardens, just south of Darkshire, and slaying 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages.  The undead threat must be thwarted!

entries.name: The Night Watch
entries.how: {name}, I'm getting reports of an undead infestation in the forest!  If you're up to the job, journey to the Raven Hill graveyard and slay 15 of those vile Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors.  There are also reports of skeletons just south of Darkshire, in and around Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.  The undead must be driven from Duskwood!

entries.name: The Night Watch
entries.how: The situation in Raven Hill is still grim.  The safety of Darkshire is in your hands, {name}.  I don't have enough Watchers to keep the town safe.  We need you to dispatch for Raven Hill yet again and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders!

entries.name: The Legend of Stalvan
entries.how:
Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins.  I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger.  I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.

After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery.  A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.

Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character.  I fear for us all.

entries.name: The Legend of Stalvan
entries.how:
Stalvan, eh?  Let me check the town registry.

Stalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see.  Ah, here we go!  I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle.  The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse.  My, talk about outdated!

Do me a favor will you, friend?  If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow.  I like to keep the records clean.

entries.name: The Legend of Stalvan
entries.how: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.

entries.name: The Legend of Stalvan
entries.how: Oh my!  Must have missed this the first time.  In the registry, right beneath the first address for Stalvan there's another one listed, only partially scratched out.  Looks like he was headed to The Lion's Pride Inn over in Goldshire.  Might want to check there, {name}.

entries.name: The Legend of Stalvan
entries.how:
The name Stalvan rings a bell.  I remember now.

Many years back, on a stormy night, a messenger came in, seeking refuge for the night.  Near the stroke of midnight, the man ran down the stairs screaming, his face pale with fear.  Still wearing his bedclothes, he disappeared into the downpour.

In his haste he forgot his letters in the chest upstairs.  He never returned for them. One remains from that Stalvan fellow, intended for the Canal District in Stormwind.  Help yourself to it.

entries.name: The Legend of Stalvan
entries.how:
My father was the caretaker of the estate long before I was.  He had to mop the blood up after the massacre.  But that's neither here nor there.

The last funds of the Flintridge trust have dried up.  Now the last of the family possessions are headed for auction.  Blame the tax vultures.  I guess if you're really itching to learn more you're free to look through this junk.  Who knows what you might find.

entries.name: The Legend of Stalvan
entries.how: Inside the crate you find various objects: musty heirlooms, a family portrait, a few hunting trophies and some old books.  Near the bottom, underneath a ceramic vase, you uncover A Torn Journal Page.

entries.name: The Legend of Stalvan
entries.how:
There was a bundle of parchments in the chest upstairs when I moved into this place.  I looked at them once when I first arrived but I gave up once the fog hazed over my peepers. 

Do an old, nearly-blind man a favor and check the chest upstairs for anything that might help you in your quest to discover more about this Stalvan character.  I'm pretty sure there's a faded journal page that might be of interest to you.  Bring it to me and I'll help in anyway I can.

entries.name: The Legend of Stalvan
entries.how: I know of someone who might be able to assist you.  Back when I was leading the Stormwind Guard, we used to get drinks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire.  The Innkeeper there, Smitts, was quite an expert on the local lore.  Show him this page and see what he has to say about it.

entries.name: The Legend of Stalvan
entries.how: I followed the legend of that Stalvan character for years.  When those visiting nobles were slaughtered a few years back I went with Haggard to investigate.  I found these muddy pages but we were never able to link the handwriting to that crazy man in the woods.  Your trail of evidence proves his guilt.  Take this to Commander Ebonlocke immediately and fill her in on what you've discovered!

entries.name: The Legend of Stalvan
entries.how:
I have had my eye on that creep, Stalvan, for quite sometime.  But if this page was written by the same hand it proves his guilt beyond a shadow of a doubt.

In all his days keeping the Town Registry, Clerk Daltry has become an expert at identifying handwriting.  Show him this page and see if the writing matches that of the registry signature.

entries.name: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs
entries.how: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite!  Sure, I can make you some.  But first I'll need the supplies.  Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks. Given the many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem.  Fortunately for you, I just received my recent shipment of Stormwind Seasoning Herbs, so all I need are the flanks to get started.

entries.name: Dusky Crab Cakes
entries.how:
I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider legs!  I know it's a bit disgusting, but the cakes have a nice, tangy flavor and make great snacks!  Bring me Gooey Spider Legs and I'll whip you up a few of them.

I hear Venom Web Spiders are a good source - they nest to the north, between the foothills and the river.

entries.name: Sven's Revenge
entries.how:
I used to work one of the farms to the southeast...until Dark Riders from Deadwind Pass descended upon my farm and slaughtered my family when I was away!

When I returned I saw a shadowy figure skulking near my barn, burying something.  He fled before I could catch him, and I couldn't linger for I was hot on the heels of the Dark Riders.  So I never discovered what was hidden.

If you can find what that shadowy figure buried, I would be grateful.  The hiding spot is behind the old stump near my barn.

entries.name: The Legend of Stalvan
entries.how: Let Commander Ebonlocke know immediately that the handwriting matched, {name}!  Her suspicions were correct!

entries.name: The Legend of Stalvan
entries.how:
Stalvan Mistmantle led a life of depravity.  Innocent victims died by his hand.  Undoubtedly he is guilty of countless crimes.  Now the lunatic threatens Darkshire.  The Light only knows what sordid acts he is plotting.  Travel to his cottage just north of town, {class}, and execute Stalvan, once and for all.

When the deed is done, travel to Madame Eva's and show her his family ring.  After all, it was her premonition that led to this gruesome discovery.  But Darkshire is safer because of her.

entries.name: The Totem of Infliction
entries.how:
As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, {name}.  The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.

If you wish to protect yourself, noble {class}, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.

entries.name: Ghoulish Effigy
entries.how:
I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me!  In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!

I want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls.  To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs.  You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.

Get the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.

entries.name: Ogre Thieves
entries.how:
A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me!  I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.

After they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood.  I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.

Please, {name}, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.

entries.name: Supplies from Darkshire
entries.how:
Oh, what is a poor old man to do?  I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip.

Can you go to Darkshire and bring me back some Ghost Hair Thread?  You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.

entries.name: Ghost Hair Thread
entries.how:
There is a poor, sad spirit, Blind Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire.

Here, take this Spectral Comb and ask Blind Mary to comb her hair.  Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread.

And take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...

entries.name: Return the Comb
entries.how:
NO!!!!!

Take it, take this comb away from me!

I'm a monster, and no one will ever think me lovely again!

entries.name: Gather Rot Blossoms
entries.how:
If you bring me some rot blossoms then I can brew you up a batch of zombie juice.

Rot blossoms grow in strange places.  In particular, I hear you can find them inside the skulls of Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends... not that I've gotten close enough to look!

The Raven Hill Cemetery and the Tranquil Gardens are both lousy with those skeletons.  You may as well get rid of them while you're looking for rot blossoms.  The town of Darkshire would be grateful.

entries.name: Deliver the Thread
entries.how: Here is your thread, {name}.  It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.

entries.name: Zombie Juice
entries.how:
I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice.  Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some.

And please hurry, {name}.  These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!

entries.name: Juice Delivery
entries.how:
Here's your Zombie Juice...

...and be careful with this stuff.  It's strong enough to raise the dead!

entries.name: Note to the Mayor
entries.how:
Take this note to Ello Ebonlocke, the Mayor of Darkshire.

He and I are old friends...and when he reads it and discovers what you did for me...I'm sure he'll be just as happy as I am!  Hahahaha!

entries.name: Raven Hill
entries.how:
Something's amiss at Raven Hill, {name}. Calor swears that someone--or something--is haunting the buildings there. Two nights running he's noticed the shadows moving, and the third before that he says he saw light in one of the windows.

If, as you say, you care about the safety of Duskwood, find out what monster haunts in Raven Hill.

entries.name: Deliveries to Sven
entries.how:
Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.

Unfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?

entries.name: The Hermit
entries.how: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.

entries.name: Worgen in the Woods
entries.how:
Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.

You believe yourself worthy to join us?

I once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.

Test your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.

entries.name: Look to the Stars
entries.how:
My Gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars.  A truth exists, beyond magic, that can explain the strange transformation in the forest.

Bring to me a bronze tube made by a skilled engineer.  That is the first step, according to Cog's blueprint.

entries.name: Look to the Stars
entries.how: According to Cog's blueprint, what I need now is a way to reflect light.  I remember a woman by the name of Mary who became well known around these parts for always carrying a looking glass.  Perhaps you can track Mary down and see if she might lend us a reflective surface for this project?  I believe she once resided in southern Duskwood. . .

entries.name: Look to the Stars
entries.how: The looking glass was one of my finest treasures until. . .the incident.  After that happened, I discarded it behind the barn.  There was an Insane Ghoul who used to roam back there.  Perhaps he picked it up.  Rumor has it the devilish beast resides in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

entries.name: Look to the Stars
entries.how:
Now there is just one more item needed to complete this device.  Cog's blueprint calls for a lens of some sort.  The only lens I know of that would be large enough will be very difficult to acquire.

There is an ogre by the name of Zzarc'Vul who resides in the mound in southern Duskwood.  If you can, bring to me his monocle and I will use that as our lens!

entries.name: Worgen in the Woods
entries.how:
You might have noticed some larger worgen wandering around with the Shadow Weavers in the woods? From what we can tell, these Dark Runners make up the bulk of the worgen numbers.

On my rangings, I've also noticed that they have overrun the Rotting Orchard southwest of town. These worgen are a bit tougher than the last you faced.

Be on your guard.

entries.name: Worgen in the Woods
entries.how:
Your previous accomplishments have convinced me that you are ready to take on the toughest worgen infesting the woods.

Of the worgen that have made their new home here, the Vile Fangs and the Tainted Ones have proven the most dangerous. They've settled down near some of the caves and in the mine to the south.

From far away you can even see the light from their bonfires...

entries.name: Worgen in the Woods
entries.how:
Here you go, {name}. Bring this message to Master Carevin.

<He quickly removes a piece of faded parchment and offers it to you.>

A few more like you, and we will outnumber the Night Watch! Perhaps then we could complete the work that we few carry on today.

entries.name: The Weathered Grave
entries.how:
The weathered grave marker reads simply:

MORGAN LADIMORE

<Upon further examination, you notice that dirt over the grave has been recently disturbed, and that a good amount of the dirt seems to have been displaced...>

entries.name: Wolves at Our Heels
entries.how:
Sven and I have dangerous days ahead of us, what with the Necromancer to the east and all.  And out here alone as we are, we have to hunt for our own food.  It seems every time I'm heading back to camp with some meat on me, starving or rabid dire wolves come out of the forest wanting a bite.  It goes without saying, living out here is dangerous work!

But if you can rid us of some of those wolves, we'd have an easier time of it.  They mostly prowl north and east of here, near the river.

entries.name: Morgan Ladimore
entries.how:
<He searches through the shelves and comes up with a leatherbound book.>

If you would like to know more, you might ask Althea, she's been the one to handle the... trouble... with him of late.

entries.name: Mor'Ladim
entries.how:
From what my scouts tell me, Mor'Ladim wanders throughout Duskwood, following a strange and meandering path through the cemetery. We buried him out past the house on the hill, you know where that is?

There isn't anything I can do to help you, but I wish you good luck.

entries.name: The Daughter Who Lived
entries.how:
I should have told you this earlier...

How do I put this...

Morgan may have believed that his family was all dead, but, in fact, his daughter Sarah Ladimore is now a Watcher. She's always been troubled by the... circumstances... surrounding her father's death. Perhaps you could go to bring the news to her.

entries.name: Sven's Camp
entries.how:
Digging through the mound, you find a small, dirt-stained book.

The book has no title, but...it has information Sven would like to know.

entries.name: A Daughter's Love
entries.how:
Here, take this and lay it on his grave. Maybe... somehow, he'll know that I'm okay, and that none of us hold him responsible for what happened.

<There are tears in her eyes now, as she slides a ring from her right hand, and presses it into your hands.>

And... thank you, {name}.

entries.name: Return to Jitters
entries.how: And here we are - "Crab" Cakes ala Grual!

entries.name: Eight-Legged Menaces
entries.how:
Hail, {class}. Perhaps you've seen those spiders that have taken over the western border? The eight-legged menaces are too much for us to handle, and the Commander hasn't enough manpower to spare so far from Darkshire.

I hate to ask this of you, but you seem like you might be able to handle them. I can't promise you anything of great value, but I can reward you if you can help root out the filthy bugs.

Oh, and a word of advice, you'll want to avoid their venom if you can.

entries.name: Translate Abercrombie's Note
entries.how: Take the note you gave me to Sirra Von'Indi.  He's very learned in languages and ancient arts - if anyone here can translate this message, it's he.

entries.name: Translation to Ello
entries.how:
Oh my!  If what is written on this note is true, then Abercrombie's done something...unspeakable.

You better bring the translated note back to Ello.

And do so quickly, for I fear a doom already lumbers toward our town...

entries.name: Bride of the Embalmer
entries.how:
The Embalmer is a name told in one of our children's stories.  He was a kindly alchemist, driven mad by the death of his wife, Eliza.  To restore her, he used dark magic to place his own heart within the bosom of his dead spouse.

This revived Eliza...but it cursed her with a hunger for human flesh, forcing the Embalmer to keep her buried.

His heart is his power.  Find his wife's grave, retrieve his heart, and bring it to me while it still beats.  Do this and his power will be broken.

entries.name: The Shadowy Figure
entries.how:
I must know who was that skulker in the shadows I saw the night my family was killed!

Please, {name}, you have shown your resourcefulness.  Please find that shadowy figure.  I must learn what secrets he holds!

I do not have clues that you do not already know, but here - take the book you found at my farm.  Perhaps some of the townsfolk can link this book with its owner.

entries.name: The Shadowy Search Continues
entries.how:
Here is your book back, {name}, and I bid you fortune with your search.  If you ask others in town, perhaps they can offer you more clues.

And here is one more for you - although the author of this book is a stranger to Darkshire, the book itself was purchased here.

entries.name: Inquire at the Inn
entries.how:
Here is your book, and good luck with your inquiries.

You might want to expand your search to the inn.  If the person whom you seek spent time in town, then chances are someone saw him there.

entries.name: Return to Sven
entries.how:
The book you found was only half finished.  I had to leave it at Sven's farm when I fled there...

Here.  Take my completed journal to Sven.  It describes more fully what happened at his farm.

Although this journal has been my only company these past weeks, if giving it up keeps me from having to face Sven and his wrath, then I do it willingly!

entries.name: Seeking Wisdom
entries.how:
Go to the city of Stormwind and speak with Bishop Farthing in the Cathedral of Light.  Give him Jitters' journal and tell him you mean to face Morbent Fel.

Although Stormwind has forsaken Darkshire, Farthing is a kind soul and very wise.  He may help you on your quest to save us.

Your mission is perilous, but hurry, {name}.  With each passing hour, the shadows of Duskwood grow ever darker.

entries.name: The Doomed Fleet
entries.how:
Years ago, the Third Fleet of Kul'Tiras sunk along the coasts of The Wetlands, an expanse of marsh north of the Dwarven kingdom of Ironforge.  Aboard one ship was a load of Lightforge Iron.

This metal is precious to us, for items crafted from it strike with holy truth.  If you are to face Morbent Fel, then you will need such a weapon.

Go to Menethil Harbor and speak with my dwarven colleague Glorin Steelbrow.  If that lost metal can be found, he'll know where to look.

entries.name: Lightforge Iron
entries.how:
The shipwrecks off the shore here are the doomed Third Fleet of Kul'Tiras, burned and sunk by Red Dragons during the last Great War.

The Fleet hailed from Lordaeron, but one ship, an Elvish Destroyer: Flying Osprey, was with it.  It was shipping a load of Lightforge Iron and joined the Third Fleet for protection.  Ironic that it sunk to the same dragons...

Enough history.  The Flying Osprey is wrecked to the south of Menethil Harbor.  If you find the Lightforge Iron there, bring it to me.

entries.name: Blessed Arm
entries.how:
There is a dwarven weaponsmith in the Dwarven District of Stormwind who can craft with lightforge iron.  His name is Grimand Elmore.

I've packed the iron you found into a crate.  Take it to Grimand and tell him your tale.  I'm sure he'll oblige someone on a quest such as yours, and craft for you a weapon - a weapon to give even Morbent Fel worry!

entries.name: Proving Your Worth
entries.how:
Morbent Fel is a necromancer, and an ally to the dark riders.  I would pit you against the power of Morbent Fel, but I will not send you against that vile fiend without first knowing your strength.

You have already proven your bravery to me, but if you truly wish to face the necromancer, then you must now prove your skill against his minions.

entries.name: The Lost Ingots
entries.how: Having grabbed the single lightforge ingot from the waterlogged chest, it is clear that murlocs have stolen the rest.  Hunt the murloc raiders near the Flying Osprey wreckage for the lost lightforge iron.

entries.name: Armed and Ready
entries.how: Here is the weapon against the fiend of which you spoke.  You're all ready, {name}.  Best of luck to you, and I look forward to your tale of glory!

entries.name: An Old History Book
entries.how:
Although the cover of this book is marred by scratches and caked with mud, the words "The History of Stormwind" can still be read along its spine.  Upon opening the book, the seal of the Stormwind Library is clearly stamped on the book's first page.

It looks like someone checked out this book, and never returned it...

entries.name: Wait for Sirra to Finish
entries.how: I'm almost finished translating that note.  If you come back in a few moments I should be done.

entries.name: Sirra is Busy
entries.how: I'm sorry, but with the town in the state it's in I'm afraid have other duties to attend to.  Perhaps later, if we survive, I can finish this translation.

entries.name: Finding the Shadowy Figure
entries.how:
Good luck, {name}.  I hope you find the chap, and I hope you find him alive.

If he's left the safety of Darkshire then he could be prey to the beasts of the wilds.

entries.name: Lightforge Ingots
entries.how:
You might have found one lightforge ingot in that chest, but that's not enough to craft anything decent!

You should go back there and look for more.  Maybe the murlocs around that wrecked ship have lightforge ingots on them.

entries.name: Nothing But The Truth
entries.how:
Our expeditionary force was sent at Varimathras's behest to survey lower Azeroth.

While out scouting I noticed a human Infiltrator spying on Beggar's Haunt. Before I could apprehend him, some of our orcish... brethren... captured him and took him to Stonard, their stronghold in Swamp of Sorrows.

I want to... help... our orcish allies. They did not see our camp here but nonetheless I want to lend a hand.

Work with Faustin here to develop a... truth serum for our friend in Stonard.

entries.name: Nothing But The Truth
entries.how:
I have just the right serum in mind. It will deal with the truth in precisely the way the truth should be dealt with.

For this concoction I will need several Shadow Panther hearts from the Swamp. I also require the enchanted fungus off of the Mire Lord who resides there. I am sure one as able as you, {name}, can persuade him to part with some.

Now the hard part will be locating a Deepstrider tumor from far-off Desolace. Very rarely the giants there become ill and a tumor forms.

Now, off you go!

entries.name: Nothing But The Truth
entries.how:
Everything is proceeding according to plan, {name}. I want you to give this truth serum to Deathstalker Zraedus and he'll show you how to administer it.... properly.

Haha!

entries.name: Nothing But The Truth
entries.how:
We need to operate with a certain amount of discretion. After all, it's not like you're going to waltz in there and convince the fool to drink Faustin's concoction here, right?

But if there's one thing those humans cannot deny it's the booze. I'll take Faustin's serum and mix it into this ale. I guarantee the poor sap will show no reluctance when it comes to chug-a-lugging a brew.

Make haste to Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows, {name}. And keep our little mission nice and quiet...

entries.name: Supplies for Nethergarde
entries.how:
This crate of powerstones needs to go to Nethergarde Keep, in the Blasted Lands.  They won't hold their power for long, so we can't ship them with the next caravan.

You must take them, and you must take them quickly.

Bring them to Quartermaster Lungertz in Nethergarde Keep.  To reach the keep, you must travel east through Deadwind Pass, then east through the Swamp of Sorrows, then south through the Blasted Lands.

Use caution, {name}.  You will travel through dangerous lands, yet you must not fail.

entries.name: Grant's Shield
entries.how:
A shield left behind by the specter of Grant Valor, father of the Valor family and hero of Raven Hill.

With Grant's spirit still battling the undead, perhaps his unfinished business was to slay the scourge that injured him in the Raven Hill Cemetery. It is likely the one his mace is still imbedded in.

entries.name: Silvia's Sword
entries.how:
A sword left by the spirit of Raven Hill's guard, Silvia Valor, who lived her life protecting civilians and their homes.

With Silvia's spirit still visiting farmsteads, perhaps her unfinished business was to route the defias who have taken up residence in Addle's Stead south of Raven Hill.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission I: Defeat Worgen
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in the Rotting Orchard. Defeat worgen there and return to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission II: Defeat Ogres
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Defeat ogres there and return to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission III: Defeat Dragonkin
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead. Defeat dragonkin there and return to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission IV: Ogre Intelligence
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Thalinar there and return to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission V: Worgen Intelligence
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Dorilar there and return to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission VI: Dragon Intelligence
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead . Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Amalia there and return to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission VII: Recover Shadowscythe
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Retrieve a powerful artifact known as the Shadowscythe and deliver it to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission VIII: Recover Ogre Magi text
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Retrieve an Ogre Magi Text and deliver it to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission IX: Recover Dragon Egg
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead. Retrieve an Unhatched Green Dragon Egg and deliver it to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission X: Nightmare Moss
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove and collect Nightmare Moss from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of an herbalist.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission XI: Cold Iron Ore
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove and collect Cold Iron Ore from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of a miner.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission XII: Dream-Touched Dragonscale
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove and collect Dream-Touched Dragonscales from dragonkin within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of a skinner.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission XIII: Defeat Ylanthrius
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead. Defeat the dragon Ylanthrius there and return to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission XIV: Defeat Vvarc'zul
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Defeat the ogre warlord Vvarc'zul there and return to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission XV: Defeat Amokarok
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Defeat the worgen leader Amokarok there and return to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission XVI: Rescue Kroll Mountainshade
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Kroll Mountainshade there and escort him to safety. Then return to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission XVII: Rescue Alara Grovemender
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Darmstead. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Alara Grovemender there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.

entries.name: Duskwood Mission XVIII: Rescue Elenora Marshwalker
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Elenora Marshwalker there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.

entries.name: Buried Bones
entries.how:
This skeleton looks different than the others you've seen in these catacombs. Although unmoving, there seems to be a very faint spark of something burning inside its hollow eyes. 

You hear a faint buzzing sound in your head. There are no words, but it seems to be somehow... pleading for something. An image forms in your mind of a small chest containing a faintly glowing urn.

You are being shown the phylactery of a lich.

entries.name: The Phylactery
entries.how:
It's clear giving this phylactery to the skeleton is going to awaken *something*. What that could be is anyone's guess. If you plan on going through with this, you better be prepared for a fight.

If you survive, you ought to tell someone what you've seen down here too.

entries.name: Ira's Dagger
entries.how:
A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.

With Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.

entries.name: Merrick's Bow
entries.how:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.

entries.name: The Valor Family
entries.how:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.

entries.name: The Valor Family
entries.how:
Despite you putting down the Valor family ghosts, the reports of attacks have not ceased. It was a good gamble, but perhaps we did not settle their unfinished business after all.

From my research, it sounds like this family all went missing at the same time. Whatever trauma caused their spirits to be chained to this realm must have happened all at once.

Our only clue is where you found the book. Return to Raven Hill and see what you can find. Maybe bringing their weapons will spark something.

entries.name: Blisters on the Land
entries.how:
I do not know why, but a festering grows within the Wetlands. Fen Creepers have risen. They are diseased, fevered blisters on the land, and for the fever to break they must be dispatched and allowed to settle back into the marshes.

The Fen Creepers shamble amidst the waterways of the Wetlands.

entries.name: Tramping Paws
entries.how:
The Mosshide Gnolls have lived in the Wetlands peacefully for many years, but now grow in numbers. Their feet stamp flat the fen's bushes and flowers, and their foul axes cut too much wood to fuel their fires.

They are no longer in balance with the land. For the Wetlands to survive, the Gnolls must be reduced.

Kill 15 Mosshide Gnolls and 10 Mosshide Mongrels. Hunt them to the south, near the Dwarven gate of Algaz. After you do this, return to me.

entries.name: Fire Taboo
entries.how:
The Mosshides are cutting the trees of the Wetlands, using the trees' flesh to warm themselves with fire. I will suffer this pain no longer!

Rid the Mosshides of their crude flints, the tools they use to make fire. The flints are borne by all Mosshides except the smaller Mosshide gnolls and Mosshide mongrels.

entries.name: Claws from the Deep
entries.how:
Murlocs are crawling out from the deep waters and building their villages on the coastline.  They are harassing our fishers and merchants and must be stopped.

One of these Murlocs, Gobbler, skulks with other Bluegill Murlocs and harries merchants along the road, always then retreating to the safety of the nearby Murloc hovels.  Our merchants are in jeopardy, and we will pay to secure them.

Gobbler prowls the river inlet north of here.  Find him, slay his kin, and bring me his head.

entries.name: Reclaiming Goods
entries.how:
Not long ago a merchant vessel, the Blind Princess, was raided by Murlocs.  Although the ship escaped intact, much of its cargo was dragged overboard by the creatures, including a very valuable statuette of Terenas Menethil.  We want that statuette recovered.

Search the coastal Murloc hovels for crates, barrels and other evidence of lost cargo.  Find the Menethil Statuette and return it to me.

entries.name: The Search Continues
entries.how:
You thoroughly search this cluster of Murloc hovels, and find no trace of the Menethil Statuette.

Perhaps one of the two nearby hovels to the north and northeast will have more clues.

entries.name: Search More Hovels
entries.how:
This grouping of Murloc hovels, after a thorough inspection, reveals nothing.

...but you're certain that the next clue you find will be fruitful.

One of the hovels to the north must have the Menethil Statuette!

entries.name: Return the Statuette
entries.how:
After pulling the barrel free from the muck and opening it, a silvery figurine is found packed in fine straw.  It depicts a young, long-haired Paladin with hammer upraised.

This must be the Menethil Statuette!  You must now return it to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.

entries.name: The Third Fleet
entries.how:
I was once First Mate on the Wave Mistress, ship-of-the-line in the Kul Tiras Third Fleet. The Doomed Fleet. Doomed, for on its last voyage the fleet was attacked by Red Dragons. Dragons controlled by Orcs!

We didn't stand a chance against that dragonfire...and our fleet was burned and sunk off this here coast. I'm the sole survivor of those poor vessels...

...Oh, my head hammers and pounds! I'll need a fresh drink if I'm to get a handle on this hangover and continue my tale.

entries.name: The Cursed Crew
entries.how:
<Bolstered, Fitzsimmons continues his tale...>

I am the sole survivor of the ill-fated Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, wrecked off the coast to the north. But although I'm the only member of the fleet still breathing, I'm not the only one still walking about! For on one of our ships was hidden a great, and terrible treasure, and the eerie power of it keeps the souls of my brothers trapped within the ships' rotting hulls.

But if you can free some of my brothers, then perhaps you can break their curse.

entries.name: Lifting the Curse
entries.how:
To break the curse and free all of my brethren, the...thing...stowed on my ship must be retrieved and cleansed! I don't know what it was, but I do know that it was stored securely in the ship's strongbox, which Captain Halyndor lorded over.

My old captain is still in my dreams. I know he walks my doomed ship, the Intrepid. Get the key from him, and use it to open the Intrepid's strongbox.

Then, after you have the cursed thing, bring it to the priest Glorin Steelbrow in town.

entries.name: The Eye of Paleth
entries.how:
Opening the chest reveals a blackened orb, pulsing with an eerie light.  It is the treasure of which Fitzsimmons spoke: a Cursed Eye of Paleth.

Take the Cursed Eye of Paleth to the dwarven priest Glorin Steelbrow, in Menethil Harbor. Ask him how to remove the Eye's curse.

entries.name: Cleansing the Eye
entries.how:
I can't lift the curse from the Eye of Paleth. The Eyes were crafted by Human Priests, so you'll have to go to Stormwind to find someone who can help you. Speak with Archbishop Benedictus. He is head of the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.  He can help.

I hope, for your sake.

entries.name: Ormer's Revenge
entries.how:
The situation is severe, that much is for sure. When we uncovered these bones it attracted the Raptors. These filthy beasts killed my brethren and trapped me, Merrin and the poor Prospector up here.

Help clear the Wetlands of these Raptors, {name}. Mottled Raptors and Mottled Screechers are just West of the bluff there. Kill 10 of each, if you can.

That will be a good start to the vengeance I have planned for them.

entries.name: Ormer's Revenge
entries.how: Now it's time to really make those dreaded Raptors regret their blood-thirst. Just down below there are scores of Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws. Make those rotten creatures pay by slaying 10 of each!

entries.name: Ormer's Revenge
entries.how:
While you were down there I happened to notice that one of those beasts stood out from the rest. He was bigger and more menacing. I bet he's the one who led the others here to cause the disruption to the dig site.

I ask of you now one final task, {name}. See to it that Sarltooth is brought to justice. And considering the gravity of his crimes, justice in this case means death! Bring me one of his talons as proof of his death.

entries.name: Uncovering the Past
entries.how:
Just before the invasion I uncovered a large tablet called the Goaz Stone. The translated text breaks off in 4 places. The text speaks of a "divine plan" and a "doomed prophecy."

I fear we are running out of time. I am too old to go down and brave those beasts. But you are strong.

Scour the excavation site and uncover the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru. Search for them in ancient artifacts or where the soil is loose. Bring them to me so I can begin unlocking the mystery!

entries.name: The Dark Iron War
entries.how:
War rages both home and abroad. While mighty Dwarven soldiers give their lives in far off territories in the name of the Alliance, our own lands fall prey to the evil deeds of the Dark Iron Dwarves.  They laid waste to the Thandol Span. Dun Modr fell soon after.

We need you to gather force and push the front back.  If you can kill 15 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Tunnelers, 5 Saboteurs and 5 Demolitionists, the reserve might arrive in time to finish the drive.

Now make haste!

entries.name: A Grim Task
entries.how:
Many of my soldiers died in the battle of Dun Modr.  My own brother perished when the West Bridge over the Thandol Span was destroyed.  Aye, the Dark Iron dwarves are a devilish breed.  From what Roggo was able to gather, the leader of this band of thugs in the Wetlands is a warlock named Balgaras the Foul.  He is quite a coward however.  He sends his soldiers to do his bidding but stays elusive, avoiding danger.

If you can find the spineless scum, slay him and bring me his ear.  I will reward you, {class}.

entries.name: In Search of the Excavation Team
entries.how:
You cannot imagine how worried I have been.

My wife, Merrin, has been sending me letters each week for the past month. She is part of the Whelgar Excavation team. But it has been nearly two weeks since her last correspondence. Surely something is wrong!

Longbraid said that he would send a scout to check up on things if we did not hear from the team soon. I assume that scout is you, {name}. Find Merrin at the excavation site to the east!

entries.name: In Search of the Excavation Team
entries.how:
It was horrible! We were uncovering some rare artifacts and we began to discover these large bones.

Before we knew what was happening, these Mottled Raptors overwhelmed the dig site. Many lives were lost.

Ormer here -- so brave -- saved the Prospector and me. He defended us as we ran for shelter. Now we are trapped. And our hard work lies in ruin.

Here, take this note back to my sweet Tarrel. It will explain the situation to him.

entries.name: The Algaz Gauntlet
entries.how:
Orcs of the Dragonmaw clan have a haven in the Wetlands.  And now they have expanded into Dun Algaz!  We can't let them keep their foothold here or Loch Modan will be cut off from Menethil Harbor, our port and stronghold in the Wetlands.

Break through Dun Algaz to the Wetlands beyond, and kill some orcs for good measure!  Report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.

Menethil is through Dun Algaz, then north along the road, then west at the fork.

We're counting on you, {name}.  Do not fail.

entries.name: <UNUSED>
entries.how:
Other than you, we sent two scouts through Algaz.  Only one returned.  Here's what he discovered:

The Dragonmaws sent one of their Lieutenants, Maruk Wyrmscale, to organize a crew of orcs in Algaz and cut off the land route to Menethil Harbor!

We have to stop this, now.  Take out Maruk, and then report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.

Maruk is headquartered in a small cave, across a pond between the second and third tunnels of Algaz.  Menethil is through Algaz, then west along the road.

entries.name: The Greenwarden
entries.how:
You've heard of the Greenwarden? You're not looking for him, are you? Well I say you're crazy if you are, but who am I to keep a fool from his death?

If you are seeking that beast, then I hear he is in the marsh, east of the road where it forks to Dun Modr. He's lurking there among the crocs...and worse!

And leave your money here. You won't need it where you're going...and you don't want to chip ol' Greenie's tooth on your gold when he bites you in half, do you?

entries.name: War Banners
entries.how:
The Dragonmaw orc clan was all but destroyed by the end of the Second War, after they lost control of their red dragon pets. The dragons were not very happy with their old masters, and fiercely hunted the Dragonmaws. What few remained fled from Grim Batol and into the Mountains east of Whelgar's Excavation.

Now they've gained strength, and have an encampment northeast of Menethil.

We want you to attack that encampment. Gather and bring me their war banners as proof.

entries.name: Nek'rosh's Gambit
entries.how:
The Dragonmaw are closer to enacting their attack plans than we thought.

Nek'rosh has built catapults and aims to lay siege to Menethil! And with the fighting in Dun Algaz, we're effectively blocked from reinforcements!

You need to take out those catapults. They're in the Dragonmaw encampment.

Here, take this tinder. Fight your way to the catapults and light them with the tinder.

And after you've done that, find and kill Nek'rosh. We need to cut this Dragonmaw beast down...at its neck.

entries.name: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar
entries.how:
Mountaineer Rockgar is looking for volunteers for a mission through Dun Algaz and into the Wetlands.  

If you want to get your boots wet in that soggy county to the north, then speak with Rockgar at Dun Algaz.  Dun Algaz is north up the road, beyond the guard tower.

entries.name: Daily Delivery
entries.how:
Greetings, traveler!

Don't suppose you might be heading in the direction of Menethil, would you? If you're not, I'd suggest you stop there, it's a good place to purchase goods and even have a pint and relax.

Now, if it just so happens that you're heading in that direction, I don't suppose you'd mind taking this bundle of crocolisk skins to James Halloran, the tanner?

I'd do it myself, but my wife's been in quite a mood lately, and I'd like to put off facing her as long as possible.

entries.name: Digging Through the Ooze
entries.how:
On my weekly visit to Ironbeard's Tomb I was attacked by dreadful, dripping oozes! Naturally, I panicked.

I threw my bag at one, but it didn't do anything! The ooze just sucked it right up... Luckily, it did give me enough time to get away.

The bad news is that I really need to get the contents of my bag!

I don't know which ooze I threw my bag at; they all looked the same! Ironbeard's Tomb is northeast of here, near Dun Modr. Thank you so much!

entries.name: Apprentice's Duties
entries.how:
I sent my apprentice out into the marshes to skin some of our famous giant Wetlands crocolisks. When he didn't return, I went out to look for him... Let's just say it wasn't a pretty sight.

Midwife says he might pull through, but in the meantime I still need my skins!

...If you'd like to kill a few more of the brutes, I wouldn't be opposed, after what they did. You'll find the crocs north up the coast, beyond the murloc hovels.

entries.name: Fall of Dun Modr
entries.how:
Dun Modr has fallen to the Dark Iron Dwarves!

My wounds are grave, {class}.  Most of the regiment was killed!  The Dark Iron thugs attacked us before we could regroup from the Thandol Span ambush.

Our leader, Longbraid, sounded the retreat horn.  As we left the town I was hit by a stray axe in the back.  All went black.

I awoke here in Menethil but I fear for my fellow soldiers.  Hope still burns within me.  Perhaps Longbraid is still alive!  See if you can find him near Dun Modr, {race}!

entries.name: Report to Captain Stoutfist
entries.how:
{name}.  The Dragonmaw orc clan is showing its strength in more than just Algaz.

Captain Stoutfist has asked to speak with those willing to offer aid against these orcs.  He is inside the keep, in the war room.

entries.name: Defeat Nek'rosh
entries.how: Now that the catapults have been burned, find and kill Chieftain Nek'rosh.

entries.name: Young Crocolisk Skins
entries.how:
I'm James Halloran, the tanner. My cured crocolisk skins are sought after all over, shipments leaving by boat to ports around the world.

Met Einar? He's one of the hunters that brings crocolisk skins in for me.

I'm a bit short on the softer skins that come off crocolisk young.

Being that I'm running low, I'll pay you top coin for a stack of the skins. You can find the young crocs in the waters right outside of town.

entries.name: The Thandol Span
entries.how:
A tremendous explosion roared through the hills. 'Twas horrible, I tell you!

Good soldiers died defending the Thandol Span. Longbraid says we'll take revenge on the Dark Irons before all is said and done.

We're in a world of hurt though and I don't see any reinforcements in sight. Longbraid sent Ol' Rustlocke to scout the eastern bridge to see if we could secure it.

That was days ago. We haven't the manpower to search for him with Dun Modr under siege.

Perhaps you can find him...

entries.name: The Thandol Span
entries.how:
It seems as though poor Ol' Rustlocke ran into a Dark Iron ambush.  You notice a parchment next to his clenched fist.

Report the grim news to Rhag Garmason and show him what you found.

entries.name: The Thandol Span
entries.how:
Heavens no!  Poor Rustlocke. 'Tis quite a tragedy indeed.

We must not let his death pass in vain.  This parchment you discovered indicates that Kam Deepfury, the mastermind behind the original attack, arranged for a cache of explosives to be stashed just across the Thandol Span, in Arathi Highlands.

If those explosives make it to the bridge, our major supply line to the north will be severed! The cache must be destroyed, {name}! Return to me when your mission is complete.

You're our only hope.

entries.name: Plea to the Alliance
entries.how:
I ask of you one more small favor, {class}.  We await the reserves of Ironforge.  However, Roggo has knowledge of an Alliance camp to the north in Arathi Highlands at Refuge Pointe.

Travel there and seek out Captain Nials.  Ask the good Captain if the Alliance can spare some soldiers to help us reclaim Dun Modr and the Thandol Span.

entries.name: MacKreel's Moonshine
entries.how:
Had quite a bit of the ol' Moonshine last night!  Longbraid would have my head if he knew that I passed out during my watch.

The noggin hurts something fierce.  Felt as though a whole brigade of siege engines passed overhead, all that rumbling.

Oh my, look at the time! I promised Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore that I'd repay my debt to him by sending some Moonshine.

But there are just 15 minutes left before I'm overdue!  Take him this batch, would you please?  And hurry!

entries.name: The Absent Minded Prospector
entries.how:
Prospector Whelgar now holds the original fossil at his site in the Wetlands. When I discovered the Stone of Relu, I believed it to be the key to unlocking the mystery of the fossil.

While I traveled on the road to meet Whelgar, I was attacked by raptors and the relic was lost. I don't know which one of the mottled beasts swallowed the relic but if you can retrieve it, I can unleash the power of these artifacts.

Bring me both the Stone of Relu, and the original fossil he holds.

entries.name: Fiora Longears
entries.how:
Oh, to be at sea once again!  To feel the kiss of the wind, and to have the waves rock me like my blessed mother, long ago!

Oh, I wish I had your fortune, good {class}, for I see the sea in your future!

It's my job to tell eager souls of the land of Kalimdor, the land of opportunity!  If you're willing to try your luck across the sea, then take a ship from here to the lovely port of Theramore.  Speak there with my partner, the elf, Fiora Longears.

She'll start you on your Kalimdor adventure!

entries.name: James Hyal
entries.how:
My brother James went with Lady Proudmoore across the sea. Last I heard, the fighting had settled down over there, and James was setting up an inn somewhere on the continent. Wherever he is, I'm sure he's doing good business. Damn fine cook he was.

I haven't heard from him for a while now--too busy with his inn, I'd wager--but the clerk in Theramore could probably point you to him.

entries.name: Hearts of the Lost
entries.how:
Thandol Span has been a dangerous place since the Dark Irons blew up the bridge, but I didn't expect to run into them there!

I managed to escape, but I lost sight of my partner, Essene. I've been searching all over for her, but I haven't found any sign of her. Did the Dark Irons capture her? Did she fall into the river below? Did she make it back to the other side? I don't know! I don't even know if she's alive!

Please, if you see any sign of her, let me know!

entries.name: Spark of Freedom
entries.how:
Sss! The foul Dark Irons have summoned me and kept me caged next to their petty fire pit!

Fire must run wild, run free! Release me! Must escape! Must BURN!

No Dark Iron is safe! Burn them to the ground! Burn their black powder! Burn their fortress, their fuses, their folly!

Let me out and I will BURN THEM ALL!

entries.name: Bring Back a Bang
entries.how:
The Dark Irons have a few camps east of here on Direforge Hill, and they've stolen a bunch of explosives from our construction site and hauled 'em back to their tents.

I don't need tae tell ya what kinda mischief Dark Irons can get up tae with a barrel o' powder!

I know the Dark Irons are dangerous, but we need those barrels back. You can tell 'em from other barrels because of the red markings on 'em. We cannae let the Dark Irons keep 'em!

entries.name: Accessories of the Lost
entries.how:
While I was fleeing from those Dark Irons, I wound up dropping lots of my gear!

It looks like I lost... my green leather waterskin, my spellbook, my necklace, and... well I need these things!

If you can find them while I repack and catch my breath, that would be a great help.

entries.name: Sentiments of the Lost
entries.how:
I just need to finish repacking, and I can get out of here!

If you'll do me one last favor, here--take this note to Corma. It'll let her know that I'm alive and I'm on my way!

entries.name: Your First Horse
entries.how:
Greetings! Are you here to examine our horses?

These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Don't forget, you and your horse will traverse the world together. I'm sure whatever choice you make will suit you best.

Go examine the horses and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: Crocs of the Sky
entries.how:
You're quite the go-getter! I have just one more favor to ask, if you're up for something a bit more dangerous.

The crocolisk trade is steady money, but they're small fish compared to what whelp scales will bring. Folks will pay top dollar for a sack of those.

Crocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!

You'll find whelps far to the east, along the Green Belt. But be careful, there's nasty orcs in those hills!

entries.name: Your First Horse
entries.how:
Greetings! Are you here to examine our horses?

These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Don't forget, you and your horse will traverse the world together. I'm sure whatever choice you make will suit you best.

Go examine the horses and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: Return the Statuette
entries.how:
My goodness, it's--it's beautiful!

The Blind Princess was to deliver this to Menethil Harbor before tragedy struck. We were so close!

I believe it was to be signed for by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep just behind us. Why don't you do the honors of finishing the job?

entries.name: Spoils of War
entries.how:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.

entries.name: Bloom of the Heavens
entries.how:
I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!

entries.name: Bloom of the Heavens
entries.how:
Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?

The boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.

I apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!

entries.name: Understanding Our Present
entries.how:
Old Gods?! This cannot be good news at all!

I've made out a new bit on the stone that speaks of a guardian of some kind. Whatever it is, it must be linked to the stone!

Take it with you and see if you can find a big Titan construct of some sort in the excavation. Read this here final passage on the stone and see what happens!

If I'm right, you'll activate the thing. Take it out if so, but try to preserve anything interesting! We simply must know more!

entries.name: From the Ashes
entries.how:
In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!

They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!

entries.name: Old Habits
entries.how:
This book has been badly burned--perhaps by the dragonfire that destroyed much of the Dragonmaw clan.

Of what little is legible, it seems to describe rituals relating to the use of the Demon Soul that the clan had used to control the dragons.

It is far too incomplete to be of real use, but based on roughly inserted pages on animal hide it seems Nek'rosh had attempted to salvage it. Freshly dried ink mentions a "Shadow Council."

Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor would want to know about this.

entries.name: This Land Was Their Land
entries.how:
After the War of the Three Hammers that tore dwarven life as we knew it apart, the Wildhammers settled here, founding the mountain fortress of Grim Batol.

It was a wondrous place. Gryphons soared everywhere you looked, diving down through the wetlands to grab a fish.

It didn't last long, sadly.

Howin Kindfeather is one of the first Wildhammers to return in ages. Keeps to himself, far outside of town. Follow the road east--you'll find him eventually. He could surely use a hand.

entries.name: Crimson Crate Delivery
entries.how:
Word is officially out on those whelps, {name}. We already have an order in!

I'll package 'em up all nice for you, then you take it out to the customer. I know, I know; it's just one last favor, I promise!

These will be for one "Howin Kindfeather". Sent his gryphon into town of all things with a letter for the order! Says he's just off the road to the east, a bit past Whelgar's Excavation Site, if you're familiar.

entries.name: Razormaw Needling
entries.how:
I don't know who I hate more: the bloody Dark Irons, the Dragonmaw, or the drakes they rode.

<Howin spits.>

I aim tae make things right. But we're gonna need some supplies.

These whelp scales will protect against dragonfire a good bit, but they're a pain in the arse tae weave together.

The Razormaw raptors up in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest are so named for their pointy chompers--they oughta break through the scales.

Bring me a handful of the incisors.

entries.name: Trying Times
entries.how:
I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.

They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.

Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.

Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.

entries.name: Alchemical Hazards
entries.how:
Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!

entries.name: Carnage
entries.how:
The natural order of this land is breaking. Once it was that the Razormaw raptors kept the land from overgrowth. They now live in fear of their alpha, named only for the carnage it leaves behind.

I fear the beast has been driven mad by the sickness that we have yet to fully excise.

It will respond to the malignant flesh of the diseased bears below Raptor Ridge, to the northeast. Leave their entrails in its cave lair.

Carnage will come. Bring me its head.

entries.name: Death to the Dragonmaw
entries.how:
I plan tae get back into Grim Batol and reclaim it for the Wildhammers, {name}. Or at least learn a thing or two.

Don't look at me like that, now. I know the risks. I don't intend tae go in hammer swingin', ye know.

Regardless, I'll need your help first. The Dragonmaw orcs march as we speak. They're all up an' down the Dragonmaw Retreat, where the red dragons routed them before.

I need you tae thin their numbers before I have any chance of gettin' close. Ye can't miss 'em if you follow the road east.

entries.name: Forced Disarmament
entries.how:
The Dragonmaw are stockpiling all manner of weaponry. It would be wise to relieve them of these before more soldiers can be armed.

Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep would surely be interested in these.

entries.name: Stopping the Cycle
entries.how:
I did a quick test flight while ye were out. The good news is the armor ye helped me craft for Bassbeak works like a charm!

The very bad news is I saw a group o' them Dragonmaw in the process of enslavin' a red dragonspawn.

Absolutely not. Not again.

You have tae take it out. You'll certainly need friends tae do so. Kill the warlocks holding it down first--that ought tae free it. Then put it out of its misery.

None of them will stand in the way of the Wildhammer.

entries.name: Gleaning Our Future
entries.how:
There are other, larger golems all around the Wetlands. They each bear inscriptions marking them as Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru--matching the missing pieces of the Goaz Stone you found!

I'd be willing to bet if we can bring pieces of them as well, we'll reveal more of the Goaz Stone!

You'll find Ados at the Dragonmaw Gates to the east, near Grim Batol. Modr is right outside Dun Modr to the north. Golm lies beneath Grim Batol, east of Dun Algaz. Neru's behind Direforge Hill, to the northeast.

entries.name: A Lack of Virtue
entries.how:
Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!

"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!

If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.

There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!

And he cheats at poker!

entries.name: Unrequited Love
entries.how:
If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!

My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.

<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>

Sorry, and his wife... Merrin.

It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.

entries.name: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty
entries.how:
Gnolls, brutish creatures with no decent business in these lands, have been seen along the borders of Elwynn Forest.  A large pack of them, many more than we can handle alone, have infested the woods south of the guard tower yonder.  Another group has infested the areas near Stone Cairn Lake to the east.

The Stormwind Army will commend whomever helps kill them.  Bring me their painted gnoll armbands as proof of your deed.

entries.name: Give Gerard a Drink
entries.how:
Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.

If you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.

entries.name: Further Concerns
entries.how:
If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with Guard Thomas.  He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.

Bring me his report.

entries.name: Find the Lost Guards
entries.how:
A few days ago we sent two Guards, Rolf and Malakai, to investigate along the river, and they have not yet returned.  To complete my report, I must know what happened to those men.

Travel north along the river and find the guards... or their remains.

entries.name: Deliver Thomas' Report
entries.how:
Tell Marshal Dughan of Malakai and Rolf's deaths, and report to him that the Murlocs in eastern Elwynn cannot be contained by our current troop presence.

I know we don't have many troops to spare, but hopefully Dughan can find someone.

entries.name: A Fishy Peril
entries.how:
{name}, there's a new threat in Elwynn Forest!  Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!

I warned Marshal Dughan, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits.  He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.

Please, {name}, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!

entries.name: Discover Rolf's Fate
entries.how:
Upon further searching the area, you find webbed footprints leading east along the shore of Stone Cairn Lake.  In the distance to the east, you can just barely see a Murloc village.

Perhaps Rolf's fate ended there...

entries.name: Bounty on Murlocs
entries.how:
The Stormwind Army has placed a bounty on murloc lurkers and foragers in Elwynn.  Slaughter them and bring me their torn murloc fins, and the Stormwind Army will reward you well.

The murlocs have built a village at Stone Cairn Lake north of here, and another to the south where the stream forks.

entries.name: Gold Dust Exchange
entries.how:
The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them.  I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!

You can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.

entries.name: Protect the Frontier
entries.how:
Hail, {name}.  Wild animals are growing more and more aggressive the farther we get from Goldshire, and the Eastvale Logging Camp suffers nearly constant attacks from wolves and bears!

We could use your help out here.

entries.name: Cloth and Leather Armor
entries.how:
For your shrewdness and valor, I have a marker here that is good for one piece of armor.  I want you to take it to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp.  Give her the marker, and she will fashion the armor for you.  And after you receive it, {name}, use it in the defense of Elwynn.

The Eastvale Logging Camp is beyond Guard Thomas' post to the east.

entries.name: Kobold Candles
entries.how:
Hello, good sir!  Do you have a moment?

My brother and I run an apothecary in Stormwind, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax.  Can you help me?

You can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines ... the Fargodeep mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east.  I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.

entries.name: Shipment to Stormwind
entries.how:
My brother Morgan is waiting in Stormwind for my shipment of candles.  I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.

I've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the Stormwind Trade District.

entries.name: The Fargodeep Mine
entries.how:
The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.

Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.

entries.name: Report to Thomas
entries.how: Now that you have both medallions, deliver them to Guard Thomas at the bridge so that he might know the fate of his murdered guards.

entries.name: The Jasperlode Mine
entries.how:
Thanks to you we know the Fargodeep Mine is infested with kobolds.  Now we need a scout to investigate the more distant Jasperlode Mine.

Explore Jasperlode and confirm any kobold presence.  To reach the mine, travel east along the road until you reach the Tower of Azora.  From the tower, head north and you'll find the mine in the foothills.

entries.name: Red Linen Goods
entries.how:
The Defias gang in Northshire wears burlap masks, but the Defias in Elwynn wear linen which I can use to make fine linen goods.

Bring me red linen bandanas and I'll use them to fashion something for you.

Defias gang members have camps pocketed throughout Elwynn.

entries.name: Back to Billy
entries.how: Here you go.  And when you give this pie to that Billy, you tell him I hope he chokes on it!

entries.name: Lost Necklace
entries.how:
I lost my necklace, and think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it!  He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure vineyards east of here. 

Get my necklace back for me, and you'll warm an old widow's heart.

entries.name: Pie for Billy
entries.how:
Maybe if I got a pie, I could tell you who has that necklace.  And you know, I think that old Bernice lady at that other farm makes great Pork Belly Pies... 

Maybe if you gave her some chunks of boar meat from the boars that hang around our farms, and told her what it was for, she'd bake up a pie for you.

entries.name: Goldtooth
entries.how:
I was playing near the Fargodeep Mine, and I think I dropped, er...I mean I saw, the old lady's necklace.  Don't ask me how it got there...it wasn't me!

Well anyway, I saw this big, gold-toothed kobold pick up the necklace and run into the mine.  Go find that kobold and you'll find the necklace, I swear!

entries.name: Princess Must Die!
entries.how:
The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess.  The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!

So before she comes to our fields...Princess must die!  Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!

Princess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm.  Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!

entries.name: Young Lovers
entries.how:
Oh, I'm cursed!  My heart belongs to Tommy Joe Stonefield, but our families are bitter enemies.  So I can't see him, even though my eyes ache to gaze upon that handsome face!

Please, take this letter and give it to Tommy Joe.  He's usually at the river to the west of the Stonefield Farm, which is due west of here.

entries.name: Note to William
entries.how:
I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!

Here, take this note to William.  He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.

entries.name: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle
entries.how: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, {class}.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.

entries.name: Speak with Gramma
entries.how:
Please, {name}, talk with my Gramma.  If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.

She's inside our house east of here.

entries.name: Collecting Kelp
entries.how:
I can make an invisibility liquor for Maybell, so she can slip away from the Maclure Vineyards and go to Tommy Joe.  But to make the Liquor, I need some crystal kelp.
