Although the kelp usually grows in the ocean... sometimes murlocs collect it.  See if the murlocs near Crystal Lake have any.  Crystal Lake is just east of Goldshire.

entries.name: The Escape
entries.how: Take this invisibility liquor to young Maybell.  It should last long enough for her to visit Tommy Joe.

entries.name: The Collector
entries.how:
This note is a schedule with a list of days and times when a person -- described only as "The Collector" -- will receive a shipment of gold from the mines in Elwynn Forest.

From the schedule, it looks as if the Collector resides near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn.

This sounds important.  You should report it to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

entries.name: Manhunt
entries.how:
If the "Collector" is taking gold from our mines then he's stealing from the kingdom!  Bring the Collector to justice, and bring me the ring mentioned in the pickup schedule you gave me.  It may tell us whom the Collector is working for...

That Pickup Schedule says the Collector is hiding out at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch.  You should search for him there.

entries.name: WANTED: "Hogger"
entries.how:
Wanted: Hogger

A huge gnoll, Hogger, is prowling the woods in southwestern Elwynn.  He has overpowered all attempts at his capture.

The Stormwind Army has placed a generous bounty on the Gnoll.  To earn the reward, bounty hunters should bring proof of Hogger's demise to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

entries.name: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!
entries.how:
The Garrison on our western border sends word of increasing gnoll and thief activity.  They're requesting we send more Stormwind soldiers... but we just don't have any to spare!

If you can help, we could use it.  Go and speak with Deputy Rainer at the Westbrook Garrison and see what he needs done.

The Garrison is down the road to the west.  After you cross the bridge over the small brook it will be to the right.

entries.name: Rest and Relaxation
entries.how:
Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!

My best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.

To find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!

entries.name: A Bundle of Trouble
entries.how:
I've got a real problem on my hands. I have a deadline looming for an order of lumber, and I'm running out of time. The wolves and bears north of here have chased my workers away from the bundles of wood that they've already chopped.

I've already talked to Deputy Rainer about clearing the animals, but I need someone to go collect the wood for me. If you could collect eight bundles of wood for me I might just make my deadline.

entries.name: Delicate Instruments
entries.how:
Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?

entries.name: Delicate Instruments
entries.how:
Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.

This is most frustrating, {name}. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?

entries.name: Stolen Enchanting Supplies
entries.how:
I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!

I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?

entries.name: Good Steel
entries.how: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?

entries.name: Downstream
entries.how:
I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.

Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort. Do you think you could find them for me?

entries.name: Applejack Still
entries.how: A strong scent of apples burns your nose as you inspect the device.

entries.name: An Apple Treat
entries.how: The sergeant's eyes light up as he notices your bottle of Thunder Applejack...

entries.name: Croaky's Head
entries.how: This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.

entries.name: Elmpaw's Head
entries.how: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.

entries.name: Rough Wolf Pelts
entries.how: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.

entries.name: An Enchanting Lesson
entries.how:
Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.

entries.name: Book Return
entries.how:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!

entries.name: Rare Books
entries.how:
There are just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.

entries.name: A Taste of Darkness
entries.how: Enough, enough. I yield.

entries.name: Your First Horse
entries.how:
Greetings! Are you here to examine our horses?

These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Don't forget, you and your horse will traverse the world together. I'm sure whatever choice you make will suit you best.

Go examine the horses and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: Learning to Ride
entries.how:
Hello, {class}! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a horse, for a fee of course.

Katie will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding horses.

entries.name: A Net Disaster
entries.how:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.

entries.name: Slimy Menace
entries.how:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. 

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.

entries.name: A Man About a Murloc
entries.how:
Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do. 

He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.

entries.name: An Enticing Offer
entries.how:
I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process.

There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.

And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.

entries.name: Baited for Success
entries.how:
Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.

Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.

entries.name: Bottles and Baubles
entries.how:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.

entries.name: Swift as the Wind
entries.how:
I'm glad you made your way back to me. I can tell by the scratches on your skin and the dirt on your armor that you've seen much of the world. It's time we got you a proper steed.

Katie will provide you with a free mount once ye have completed the final leg of your training with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like just as before.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding armored horses.

entries.name: An Epic Ride
entries.how:
Greetings, {name}! I am so glad to see you've returned to us.

It would seem you have enough experience to ride our fastest and fiercest steeds. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Some may even recognize you from the last time you were here.

Go and examine the armored horses and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: An Epic Ride
entries.how:
Greetings, {name}! I am so glad to see you've returned to us.

It would seem you have enough experience to ride our fastest and fiercest steeds. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Some may even recognize you from the last time you were here.

Go and examine the armored horses and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: An Epic Ride
entries.how:
Greetings, {name}! I am so glad to see you've returned to us.

It would seem you have enough experience to ride our fastest and fiercest steeds. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Some may even recognize you from the last time you were here.

Go and examine the armored horses and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: Vanquish the Betrayers
entries.how:
Led by Admiral Proudmoore, the humans of Kul Tiras encroached on Durotar, violating the Warchief's pact made with Jaina Proudmoore in order to defeat Archimonde years ago.

The human aggression was repelled and Tiragarde Keep fell. But recently, the Admiral's reserves, led by Lieutenant Benedict, have retaken the keep and once again pose a threat to our homeland. These humans show no respect for diplomacy.

Prove your honor and travel south to Tiragarde Keep to eliminate the human invaders.

entries.name: A Strategic Alliance
entries.how:
Thrall is a most wise and noble leader. His tenacity on the battlefield is matched only by his diplomatic tact.

The Darkspear Trolls have proven to be invaluable allies to orckind. Out of loyalty and honor we have sworn a pact of protection with them.

The Warchief has sent orders to make sure our Darkspear friends in Sen'jin Village are not under any direct threat. One of their most trusted scouts, Lar Prowltusk is keeping a close watch on their western flank.

Seek out Lar and assist as needed.

entries.name: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression
entries.how:
Lower your voice, {class}. The Kolkar centaurs lie just over the ridge to the west in Kolkar Crag.

Last night while they were raiding, I snuck into their village and discovered that the dirty beasts have a three-tiered attack planned on the trolls and orcs of Durotar.

We mustn't let their invasion come to fruition. Perhaps you can muster the might needed to infiltrate Kolkar Crag and destroy their attack plans.

Last I saw, they had divided them up amongst three of their leaders.

entries.name: Carry Your Weight
entries.how:
Age has rendered me useless in battle. Now I make myself useful in other ways.

From this vantage point I watch for invaders. As our strength here grows, I find myself blowing the signal horn less and less.

To pass the time I fashion goods to help younger, more able warriors defend our homeland.

For you, I can fashion you a bag for your belongings. If such an item would be of use to you, bring me some canvas, a material common to the humans and centaurs.

entries.name: Dark Storms
entries.how:
We cannot allow the Burning Blade a foothold in Durotar!  We must destroy them before their evil festers!

I have undergone my own investigations and found that a Burning Blade warlock, the goblin Fizzle Darkstorm, has camped within Thunder Ridge to the northwest.  There he and his cultist minions spread chaos.

Find and defeat Fizzle, and bring me his dead claw!

entries.name: <UNUSED>
entries.how:
My scouts report that some of the Durotar wildlife have become infected with a demonic taint.  They were seen to the north and west.

They wander among their brethren as normal beasts, but evil powers flow through them, and burning within each one is a heart scorched by black magic.

These beasts must be destroyed!

If you find such an animal while you explore Durotar, kill it and collect its Scorched Heart.  Bring the hearts to me and I will have them studied, then destroyed.

entries.name: Minshina's Skull
entries.how:
I hear the voice of my brother, Minshina, calling to me in my dreams.

He was taken by Zalazane, the warlock on the Echo Isles to the east. And he is dead.

But death is not freedom for my brother. Minshina's spirit was trapped within his own skull by Zalazane's magics. In my dreams I see it with other skulls, in a circle of power on the largest Echo Isle. As long as it remains there my brother's soul is doomed.

Please, {name}. Find the circle and retrieve Minshina's skull. Bring it to me.

Free him!

entries.name: Ak'Zeloth
entries.how:
Since the last great war when the Burning Legion was defeated, I have searched for sources of demonic corruption in orc society.  The collar you brought me confirms my fears.

It belongs to the Burning Blade, a cult that rallies around an item of demonic power.  It is called the Demon Seed, and it resides in the Barrens atop Dreadmist Peak.  It must be destroyed!

Go to Far Watch Post, on the border of the Barrens to the west, and speak with my assistant, Ak'Zeloth.  He will direct you further.

entries.name: <UNUSED>
entries.how:
You would do well to learn how dangerous this land can be, {class}.

The wildlife here can teach us such things... if we are wise and observant.

The scorpids are a perfect example of survival in Durotar. If you are to survive, it would be wise to take on some of their characteristics as your own. Their hardened carapaces can protect you from the harshness of the sun, or even a deadly weapon.

Bring me 6 Small Scorpid Carapaces from the Clattering Scorpids, {name}, and I shall see about rewarding you justly.

entries.name: <UNUSED>
entries.how:
One of the other traits of the scorpids is their fierce loyalty. They will protect one another if they are in danger--you've probably already seen this behavior in your first scorpid hunt.

You would do well to heed that lesson and adapt it for yourself: we are stronger as one; we are weak when we are divided into many.

Bring me 8 Large Scorpid Carapaces from the Armored Scorpids and I shall reward you for learning this wisdom.

entries.name: Need for a Cure
entries.how:
{name}... your timing is perfect. I just hope I can compliment your haste as well.

I was careless while fighting a few of the venomtails nearby, and one of them stung me deeply. I can feel its poison weakening me even as we speak. At this rate, I got maybe an hour left to live. But I'll need your help if I'm to do so...

Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar knows how to make the antidote. Find him... and hurry, {name}. I won't be able to last much longer. He should be in the Cleft of Shadow.

entries.name: Finding the Antidote
entries.how:
Venomtails are some of the deadliest scorpids in Durotar. It was unwise for Rhinag to hunt them without having some of the antidote with him, but right now, chastising is the last thing he needs.

Bring me a few venomtail poison sacs from any of the venomtails near the entrance of Orgrimmar and I'll make an antidote for him.

Make haste, {name}. One of our own needs your help.

entries.name: <UNUSED>
entries.how:
Cook and clean--that's all I do!

You want to eat, you get me some more meat! I don't have all day to hunt and prepare food for all these louses. You got to learn to pull your own weight around here if you wanna be treated equal.

Get me some Chunks of Boar Meat if you want to make yourself useful... or you don't want to starve to death.

entries.name: Break a Few Eggs
entries.how:
Bah! I almost forgot I need to get breakfast ready.

{name}, get yourself movin' and get me some taillasher eggs. I'll need at least three of them if I'm going to have enough for tomorrow's meal.

The Bloodtalon taillashers can be fierce, and protect their eggs to the death more often than not. They sometimes bury their eggs too deep in the earth to uncover safely, but if you head to the Echo Isles to the southeast of Sen'jin Village, you can usually find them all over those islands.

entries.name: Lost But Not Forgotten
entries.how:
{name}, please, can you help me? My son Kron went hunting days ago, and he still hasn't returned. He went west towards the Barrens to hunt crocolisks along Southfury River. I fear the worst.

As strong as he was, his stubborn pride has always drawn him into trouble. I warned him that the crocolisks were powerful and vicious. He grew angry and stormed off.

If you can't find him, at least bring me a sign of his fate... even if you have to open up the stomach of every crocolisk along the Southfury's banks.

entries.name: Practical Prey
entries.how:
Many of the hides we use come from Durotar tigers, {name}. Blankets, armor, tents: there are a great many reasons we hunt the beasts, and many reasons we let them thrive at the same time.

The time has come for us to cull the flock, so to speak. Our numbers grow, and our needs are beginning to overwhelm our stocks. I need more hides if I'm to prepare suitable goods for our people.

Bring me 4 Durotar tiger furs, and I shall reward you. You can find them on the islands south of here.

entries.name: A Solvent Spirit
entries.how:
Although my eyes fail me, I still can see clearly enough. More often I must rely on my alchemical skills to aid me in magics that once came easily. But I refuse to take on an apprentice--no troll or orc worthy enough has ever come forward.

Are you worthy? Yes, of course you are... of course you think you are.

I need a few things. Will you get them for me?

I need intact makrura eyes, and vials of crawler mucus. You can find them on any makrura or crawler in Durotar. We shall speak again soon.

entries.name: <UNUSED>
entries.how:
Truly a spirit of strength resides in your body--or maybe it was only luck, yes?

That is what the young rely on these days: luck... and the generosity of those more powerful than they. Not many take the time to find their own path. It's always begging for help... always the reward, and never the quest. I'm sure you'll be the same.

But there is hope. I need one other thing for my potion, {name}: 8 shimmerweed herbs. They can be found in Thunder Ridge to the northwest of Razor Hill.

entries.name: Report to Orgnil
entries.how:
We at Sen'jin Village are not without our own troubles, and we thank you for your aid.  But the news you bring regarding the Burning Blade could be trouble for everyone.

There is an orc stationed at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar, who polices Durotar from evils such as the Burning Blade!  Go to Orgnil and tell him of our plight, as well as your news from the Valley of Trials.  He will want to know these things.

Razor Hill lies to the north.

entries.name: From The Wreckage....
entries.how:
One of my most observant scouts brings back word that the wreckage of Proudmoore's fleet still remains off the coast of Durotar, just east of Tiragarde Keep.

It is no secret that the humans, in alliance with those foul little creatures known as gnomes, have an advanced knowledge of mechanics. We must have a complete understanding of all our potential enemies. And our people will benefit from this new knowledge as well.

Swim through the wreckage, {name}, and retrieve for me the tools of the Alliance.

entries.name: Zalazane
entries.how:
The witchdoctor Zalazane dwells on the Echo Isles to the east.  They are the isles we once called home.

From there he sends his trolls to the mainland, to hex our people and drag more of them under his sway.

He must be stopped.

Defeat Zalazane and his minions -- former Darkspear trolls, now lost to us.  Bring me his head and I will know his reign of evil is over.

entries.name: Skull Rock
entries.how:
{name}.  The Burning Blade has infested the cave east of Orgrimmar known as Skull Rock.  Inside that cave they perform vile rituals, and burn their own flesh with Searing Collars.

By wearing these collars, I believe the cultists attune themselves to demonic power.  But to confirm this, I must have a collection of the collars to study.

Go to Skull Rock and gather Searing Collars from the cultists you find there.  Bring them to me, and I will uncover their secrets.

entries.name: Margoz
entries.how:
One of our Shamans, Margoz, knows more of the Burning Blade's corruption.  He speaks of a cave called Skull Rock in the mountains - just outside Orgrimmar! - that shelters a large band of Burning Blade cultists.

Before you go to Skull Rock speak with Margoz.  He is wise and his council is valued.

He is camped to the northeast, between the coast and Drygulch Ravine.

Follow his advice, but whatever Margoz says, {name}, I still want you to crush those cultists!

entries.name: Neeru Fireblade
entries.how:
The Searing Collars you brought me are powerful, demonic implements.  Divining their origin is, I'm afraid, beyond my skills as a shaman.  We will need a warlock to study them.

Take a searing collar to Neeru Fireblade.  Although he is a skilled warlock, he professes to use his powers to thwart demons, and claims his research in the occult is benign.  Be that true or false, we may need his aid against the demonic cult in Durotar.

You may find Neeru in Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow.

entries.name: The Admiral's Orders
entries.how:
You open the aged and weathered envelope and discover an official looking document. You recognize the seal of Admiral Proudmoore.

This looks important. Perhaps Gar'Thok, the commander of Razor Hill, would be interested in having this information.

entries.name: The Admiral's Orders
entries.how:
Humans cannot be trusted. We fought alongside them with a weary heart, knowing they would betray us one day.

Admiral Proudmoore's death was not enough to stop his legacy of deceit. The human scum had his plans well laid out before he ever met his demise.

His reign won't even die with Benedict it seems. Who knows how long it will be before the next waves of Proudmoore's men land upon our shores.

We need to get these orders to Nazgrel in Orgrimmar immediately! He can be found in Thrall's chamber.

entries.name: Burning Shadows
entries.how:
<Words emanate from the pendant and into your mind.>

Gazz'uz?

Gazz'uz...report!

There is word of your discovery in Skull Rock.  You must prepare for an attack!

Gazz'uz, I order you to speak!  Speak or I will make sure Neeru Fireblade knows of your presence, and he will descend on you with swift brutality.

Do not test your skills against Neeru...

...Gazz'uz, are you there...?

entries.name: Winds in the Desert
entries.how:
I'm Rezlak, one of Gazlowe's boys. Boss sent me to help the orcs here in Durotar. Things'd been going good except for the caravans. Can't manage to keep them safe! Makes my job a little harder, you know?

The last shipment--they promised it'd get through!--was snatched by the Dustwind harpies of...where was it...Razorwind Canyon?

I gotta have those supplies or I'll never get anything done! Follow the big canyon to the south, you'll find the ravine cut right into the west and east sides of the walls.

entries.name: Securing the Lines
entries.how:
Gazlowe told me once, "Rezlak. There's one thing you need to know in life, and that's if you want something done well, do it yourself."

I can't deal with losing all our caravans, so I'm just going to take matters into my own hands. Drygulch Ravine lies through the eastern part of Razorwind Canyon. If we kill all the harpies there, the routes will be safe.

Of course, there was one other thing that Gazlowe taught me, and that's "You can get anything done for a price." So, going to help me out, {name}?

entries.name: Encroachment
entries.how:
When we arrived, the Razormane quilboars possessed much of the land, and proved a thorn in our sides. Through our efforts we have driven out the largest part of their numbers, but still they remain well-fortified in some areas.

It has gone on long enough, however. For our own protection, we cannot allow the Razormane any hold in our lands. Their camps can be found to the west of here. Look for the brambles and you will find them. Today we drive them from Durotar, tomorrow, perhaps from all of Kalimdor.

entries.name: Conscript of the Horde
entries.how:
Hmm, you look pretty strong.

Listen, my good friend Kargal needs some new recruits for Barrens duty. I know you want to do what's right for the Horde. Well, this is your chance.

Take this recruitment letter to Kargal and see if he'll sign it.

entries.name: Crossroads Conscription
entries.how:
Take this signed recruitment letter to the Crossroads.

Sergra Darkthorn, curse her hide, is in charge there. She's a nasty shaman who will talk your head in circles before she lets you do anything useful. Thrall is convinced she's something special, but I'm not so sure.

You'll just have to decide for yourself, pup...

entries.name: The Demon Seed
entries.how:
The Demon Seed is a powerful tool for the Burning Legion. It rests in a cave on Dreadmist Peak, above a demonic altar of fire.

I have prepared power stones that when placed near the Seed will disrupt its connection to the Legion.

Take a stone from the table and bring it to the altar of fire atop Dreadmist Peak. Travel west, then north when the road forks. The Peak will be to your left. The safest climb to the top is on its northern face.

And hurry--the stone's power will consume itself in time.

entries.name: A Peon's Burden
entries.how:
Excuse me?  Can you help me?

I have a load of food here.  I walked along the road and braved scorpids and spiders and worse!  I brought the food to the Valley of Trials because I thought they needed it and I like to help out.  But they don't need any food!  Now I have to take it back to Razor Hill and I'm afraid of all the beasts along the way...

Can you take it for me?  I'm just a peon, but you're a hero.  You fear nothing!

Take it to Innkeeper Grosk at the Razor Hill inn.  Thank you!

entries.name: Legging It
entries.how:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.

entries.name: For Honor
entries.how:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.

entries.name: This Fruit Could Bite Back
entries.how:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!

entries.name: A Pain in the Neck
entries.how:
The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.

Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!

entries.name: This Is Spinal Axe
entries.how:
Have you seen the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge? I keep thinking the spines on their backs would be perfect for crafting the head of a mighty axe. Saru laughed when I told him... but what does he know!?

As part of your smithing lessons, you can help me out! Bring me some of those spines, along with grinding stones to sharpen them.

entries.name: Beasts of Thunder Ridge
entries.how:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, {class}. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!

entries.name: Ukor's Lost Pack
entries.how: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.

entries.name: Halikor's Hoof
entries.how: The enormous hoof serves as proof of your victory over the mighty lizard.

entries.name: Your First Riding Raptor
entries.how:
Ey mon! Today be a big day for ya, I see. Ya think you're ready to take de reins of one of these fierce creatures, huh?

Most be underestimatin' how intelligent and savage these beasts be. Ya won't be findin' a better, faster or more lethal companion once ya be bonded with it.

So, you be havin' an important choice to make. Ya raptor and you will be traversin' the world together, and the raptor will also be needin' to choose ya in return.

Go an' take a look and return to me when ya made ya choice.

entries.name: Bloodtalon Matriarch
entries.how:
All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.

entries.name: Forgotten Loa Idols
entries.how:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.

entries.name: A Simmering Storm
entries.how:
<Before you is a strange orb with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen.

It is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?>

entries.name: Stormy Potential
entries.how:
"Rezlack, when an opportunity comes knocking make sure you're ready to seize it." That's another gem Gazlowe taught me and that's exactly what I intend to do.

This orb doesn't seem damaged, it just looks like it's out of juice, but I've the idea to supercharge it back to full strength!

There are a bunch of thunder lizards in a gorge west of here. They have organs that hold a strong electrical charge that would be perfect for this.

Go harvest some and bring them back to me!

entries.name: A Missing Hand
entries.how:
A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.

I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.

entries.name: Threat from Below
entries.how:
The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.

Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.

entries.name: Threat from Below
entries.how:
It wouldn't be the first time those snakes bothered us. They need to be taught that their presence is not tolerated here.

Find where their scouts are setting up camp and slaughter them. Bring me back their fins as proof. We need to act fast to make sure they understand.

entries.name: Threat from Below
entries.how:
One of my scouts has reported a sea giant followed those naga down here. Not sure if they brought him intentionally or what, but he's dangerous in any case.

It's a young one, but it could still rip an orc in half in a heartbeat if they were caught off guard. I need him gone. But I'd suggest you find some help to deal with it.

entries.name: Lost in the Shadows
entries.how:
I decided to do a bit of scouting in the crag on my own. Unfortunately my magic ran out at the wrong time and I've been stuck hiding here since.

If you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.

entries.name: An Epic Ride
entries.how:
Ey, {name}! Today be a big day for ya, I see. It seems ya be ready to take de reins of our fastest and fiercest raptors. 

Now that you be ridin' a raptor, you know how intelligent and savage these beasts be. I think you be ready for a real raptor now. An armored raptor.

So, you be havin' an important choice to make. Ya raptor and ya will be traversin' the world together, and the raptor will also be needin' to choose ya in return.

Go an' take a look and return ta me when ya made ya choice.

entries.name: The "Chow" Quest (123)aa
entries.how: punk;!  Kill Kobold Vermin, 2 of em. NEW TEST AGAIN

entries.name: Journey to Astranaar
entries.how:
If you're fresh off the boat from Menethil, then the first thing you should do is... go to Astranaar.  I'm sure an eager member of the Alliance such as you can do some real good there.  Speak with Shindrell Swiftfire and offer your services.

But don't bother mentioning who sent you.  Shindrell does not know me...

entries.name: Highperch Venom
entries.how:
As you may know, wyverns are often tamed by orcs for use as mounts.  But what is less known is that the venom of a wyvern, in some circles, is more valuable than the beast itself.  So if you're not afraid to do a little wyvern hunting, then... I have a job for you.

There is a place called Highperch in the land of a Thousand Needles, west of here.  The Highperch wyverns have a potent venom.  Potent, and valuable.

entries.name: Overlord Mok'Morokk's Concern
entries.how:
Bow before Overlord Mok'Morokk!

Rexxar make me mighty leader of Stonemaul Clan!

Me good leader. Me keep clan safe.

Big dragons come and make fire at old home. Me smart ogre. Find new home for clan here.

Leave old home so fast, me forget stuff. Tiny {race}, go get my things. Go south and find my yummy grog, my snuff and my strongbox. Me like you after you do that. You look in Den of Flame and Stonemaul Ruins... they be there, me sure!

entries.name: Army of the Black Dragon
entries.how:
Mok'Morokk was made Overlord by Rexxar. He care more for power than he care for ogres.

Black dragons kill many ogre. Kill Tharg's wife. Mok'Morokk tell us to run. Make us come here.

Ogre should fight. Ogres not good at running. Mok'Morokk care only about Mok'Morokk.

Me call Stonemaul Ruins home. Me like it in the south. This place not home.

Help ogres fight army of the black dragon. Me want revenge. Me want to go home.

entries.name: Identifying the Brood
entries.how:
Whilst that craven fool, Mok'Morokk, wallows in power and Tharg wrestles the demons of sorrow and vengeance and vies for leadership of the clan, I seem to be the only one concerned with identifying the source of aggression on our old home.

Why the puzzled stare, {name}? Expecting me to speak like an uncouth ruffian merely because I am an ogre?

Now back to business, bring to me the hearts and tongues from the whelps and hatchlings. I shall trace the root of this evil...

entries.name: The Brood of Onyxia
entries.how:
Stonemaul Village was invaded by the brood of Onyxia. But why would the daughter of the black dragonlord, Deathwing, descend upon our lands?

This is most troubling. Surely, Onyxia was driven here for a purpose beyond laying siege to a small band of ogres.

Notify Mok'Morokk at once! Action must be taken.

entries.name: The Brood of Onyxia
entries.how: You leave me alone now. Go tell Draz'Zilb we stay here. No black dragon here.

entries.name: The Brood of Onyxia
entries.how:
Onyxia's brood has been scattered across the Dragonmurk. It is imperative that no more whelps be permitted to hatch.

Make haste to Wyrmbog in the south of Dustwallow Marsh. Surely, she has made her lair there. Track down the evil dragon's eggs and destroy them.

We will never reclaim Stonemaul Village if the surrounding area remains a breeding ground.

As for Mok'Morokk... I have other plans for the sod.

entries.name: Challenge Overlord Mok'Morokk
entries.how:
You dare challenge Overlord Mok'Morokk?

Haw!

Me crush tiny {race}!

You tell me when ready for good beating.

entries.name: Hungry!
entries.how:
Mud big ogre.

Me hungry.

Go bash fishy. Bring Mud food.

You feed Mud or Mud eat you.

entries.name: Theramore Spies
entries.how:
The Horde and Alliance hold an uneasy truce.  Outlying skirmishes and covert actions are taken by one side against the other, and it is our duty to ensure the Horde is on top!

Now is the chance to do just that.

Alliance infiltrators have taken positions east of Brackenwall Village.  They spy on the village and report our movements to Theramore, which we cannot allow.

Hunt down the infiltrators and slay them.  Send a clear message to their superiors that we will not tolerate their spies' presence!

entries.name: The Theramore Docks
entries.how:
{name}, two of our spies were sent to steal documents from a ship at the Theramore docks.  They gained the papers but were discovered, and were forced to throw the documents into the sea.

One spy later escaped, but was unable to recover the prize.  He reported his failure to me, and I now charge the task to you.

The documents are in a footlocker, in the waters somewhere beneath the Theramore docks.  Find those documents, {name}, and bring them to me.

entries.name: Jarl Needs a Blade
entries.how:
I have cutting to do.  I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade.  A certain blade...

Some people call it a moonsteel broadsword.  I call it a swing blade.

You help me?  Maybe you find it in town, maybe you talk to a blacksmith and he'll make it special.

But don't sleep on this.  What I'm cutting won't keep forever...

entries.name: Mudrock Soup and Bugs
entries.how:
I'm working on a dish I call "Mudrock Soup and Bugs."  I still need the major ingredients, and... well, I don't think I'd last long trudging through Dustwallow Marsh!

So, {name}, can you do some hunting for me?  First, I need the tongues of Mudrock turtles.  You can find Mudrocks along the coast, mostly around the bay.

But I don't want just any tongues!  I hear that the tongues of some Mudrocks are forked...

They say the forked tongues have a distinct flavor, and I want that flavor in my dish...

entries.name: Deadmire
entries.how:
Deadmire is an ancient crocolisk in Dustwallow marsh.  And it is his time to die.

Old bones grind as he pulls his huge body through the swamp, and although he still moves with the strength and speed of youth, his aging body tortures the great spirit within it, a spirit whose flame will not waver.

Yet now he lives in constant, maddening pain.  You must end the life of this noble creature, {name}.  You must lead Deadmire to peace.

entries.name: Jarl Needs Eyes
entries.how:
Eye juice is good juice for drinking.  Too bad most critters only have two eyes.

But spiders have lots of eyes.  Lots and lots.  And Darkmist eye juice is tasty.  Smooth and salty!  Unpopped spider eyes... I taste them already.

Darkmist spiders are west of here, in the Darkmist Cavern.  You figure the spiders are named after the cave... or is it the other way around?

entries.name: Soothing Spices
entries.how:
I like cooking.  Good swamp cooking.  Fried green frog legs and the like.

And for cooking, I need spice.  Soothing spice.  Then I'll make a stew and stew it up and suck it down and give you some too.

Do you like stew?

entries.name: The Orc Report
entries.how:
Sifting through the loose dirt, the severed hand of an orc is found.  And clutched in the hand is a bone-carved tube.  And in the tube is a dirt-stained parchment.

The parchment is written in orcish... and it looks important.

entries.name: Captain Vimes
entries.how:
Captain Vimes should see the orc report you found, {name}.  He knows the orcish language better than most.  And he should know that there are Horde spies near Theramore!

The captain is in the barracks, on the northeastern side of Theramore Isle.

entries.name: Stinky's Escape
entries.how:
Great, finally something that doesn't want to eat me!

I need help handling the critters around here, and you fit the mold, buddy.

The cook Morgan Stern is researching a new recipe, and he sent me out here to gather bogbean leaves.  I guess he thinks they're tasty.

Anyway, while looking for a bogbean plant... I got myself surrounded!  Can you help me out of here, and watch my back as I look for the bogbean?

entries.name: The Lost Report
entries.how:
Sifting through the loose dirt, the severed hand of an orc is found.  And clutched in the hand is a bone-carved tube.  And in the tube is a dirt-stained parchment.

The parchment is a report made by an orc who spent weeks spying on the city of Theramore.

After scanning the parchment, it is clear that it must be brought to the orc spymaster in Brackenwall Village.

entries.name: The Severed Head
entries.how: Vigorous digging reveals the head of a male orc, raggedly severed at the neck.  His lips are frozen in a snarl, and its dark eyes stare defiantly.

entries.name: The Troll Witchdoctor
entries.how:
We must know the events surrounding Marg's death!  And the only way to do that, {name}, is through the witch-magic of trolls.

Bring Marg's head to Kin'weelay in Stranglethorn Vale, at the Grom'gol Base Camp.

Kin'weelay is the most powerful witchdoctor of the Darkspear trolls.  If anyone can speak to Marg Nighteye's spirit, it is he.

entries.name: The Black Shield
entries.how:
An iron shield, blackened by the fire that raged through the inn, is affixed to the crumbling chimney, one of the few remaining parts of the structure that once made up the Shady Rest Inn.

The shield can be removed from the brick of the chimney.

entries.name: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
entries.how:
A glint of light on the ground catches your eye from underneath the rubble. Brushing away debris and ash caked onto the object reveals the insignia of a gold anchor on white enameled on the surface: the sign of Theramore.

Underneath the anchor is embossed the name "Lieutenant Paval Reethe".

entries.name: The Black Shield
entries.how:
An iron shield, blackened by the fire that raged through the inn, is affixed to the crumbling chimney, one of the few remaining parts of the structure that once made up the Shady Rest Inn.

The shield can be removed from the brick of the chimney.

entries.name: ... and Bugs
entries.how:
Another component of my new recipe is the shelled leg of a giant crab.  And the crabs they have in Dustwallow -- Muckshells they call them -- just won't do!  I'm afraid the only suitable crabs live far away, in the Swamp of Sorrows.

The shell of the crab leg is a key element of the dish's presentation so I need pristine, unscarred legs.  An adult crab might only have one or two such legs, and I need a lot in order to research my dish.

So, {name}... are you willing to travel?

entries.name: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
entries.how:
I don't recognize the name of Lieutenant Paval Reethe. Your best bet would be to check with Adjutant Tesoran. He keeps track of all the records for the Theramore guard, from personnel to their equipment.

He should be able to tell you who this Reethe is with a quick check of his books.

entries.name: Morgan Stern
entries.how:
I'm developing a new menu for the restaurant.  It will be filled with rural dishes with a "bayou" theme.  I think my clientele at the Blue Recluse will love them!

I sent my nephew Morgan to Theramore, a city on the edge of the Dustwallow Marsh.  He's there gathering recipes from the locals, and I must know what he found so far.

The trip to Theramore is long.  Too long for me.  But I bet a young {class} like yourself would jump at the chance to travel, yes?

entries.name: Marg Speaks
entries.how:
Cursed muckshell!  You can't kill Marg!  Ah, but I am dead.  So it must have slain me...

But my mission!  My mission!  You, {name}, must complete it.

While near Theramore, I spied a group of Alliance soldiers camped on the beach.  And one soldier wore a pendant... a pendant laden with more gems than any soldier could afford!

That night I snuck into their camp and stole the pendant, but on my return to base a muckshell crab-man killed me!

{name}, you must find that muckshell and recover the pendant!

entries.name: Report to Zor
entries.how:
It is strange that the pendant Marg stole was in the hands of common soldiers.  Perhaps its owner was in disguise, or perhaps the soldiers themselves stole it!

Regardless of which is true, this is a noble's pendant and we must discover its true owner if we are to unravel its mystery.

Take the pendant to Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar.  He is well schooled in Alliance politics, and will know if this pendant has a history among the nobles of Stormwind.

entries.name: Suspicious Hoofprints
entries.how: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.

entries.name: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
entries.how:
A glint of light on the ground catches your eye from underneath the rubble. Brushing debris and ash caked onto the object reveals the insignia of a gold anchor on white, enameled on the surface: the sign of Theramore.

Underneath the anchor is embossed the name "Lieutenant Paval Reethe".

entries.name: Stinky's Escape
entries.how:
Great, finally something that doesn't want to eat me!!

I need help handling the critters around here, and you fit the mold, buddy.

A goblin from Ratchet named Mebok Mizzyrix needs some bogbean leaves for a potion, or something... I honestly don't care why -- his money was good and I know this swamp, so here I am.

Too bad I got myself surrounded before I found the bogbean!  Can you help me out of here, and watch my back as I look for Mebok's plant?

entries.name: Questioning Reethe
entries.how:
It took a long time, but I found Reethe. He hide good for a human.

Ogron worried that he might be crazy after so much time in swamp. You come with me for we go get answers from him.

entries.name: The Black Shield
entries.how:
Ah, I remember now! Mosarn is a well-respected blacksmith in Thunder Bluff. I knew I had heard his name somewhere, before.

In thanks, the Earthen Ring awarded me with a set of armor crafted by Mosarn. Very good work.

Perhaps he can tell you more about the shield he crafted.

It's not much of a lead, but since we didn't get anything useful out of Reethe, it's all we have.

entries.name: They Call Him Smiling Jim
entries.how:
I can't help it if I feel sorry for ol' Jim there. He wasn't always like that. Ran an inn out in the marsh for a while, wonderful place.

Look, I don't really want to talk about it. Bring it up with Captain Vimes if you really have to.

entries.name: Fire at the Shady Rest <CHANGE TO GOSSIP>
Suspicious Hoofprints
entries.how: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.

entries.name: Daelin's Men
entries.how:
Reddon... Redpath... Ah, here it is! Lieutenant Paval Reethe.

Joined the Theramore guard along with most of the recruits that came across the sea with Lady Proudmoore. Enlisted with the marines of Kul Tiras at the age of sixteen. Distinguished service, promotions...

Listed as missing.

entries.name: The Deserters
entries.how:
It has been a struggle maintaining a presence in the marsh, but through strength of our resolve, we have been able to maintain several defensive watchtowers throughout the area.

The latest information and scouting reports I have received indicate that a group of deserters has squatted in our abandoned tower at Lost Point, southeast of the inn.

The deserters' leader is a man named Jacken. See if you can get some information out of him.

Be warned, {name}. He may be a tough nut to crack.

entries.name: The Deserters
entries.how:
Reethe? That coward?

We threw him out of camp because he insisted on raiding the supplies of the ogres up at Brackenwall Village. We're not so many in number that we could stand up to those mindless brutes.

He crossed the line one too many times, so we left him to fend for himself.

Now, I helped you out... So, why don't you help us out and forget you bumped into us?

entries.name: Vimes's Report
entries.how:
You've done some good work, {name}, best I've seen from an amateur.

Lady Proudmoore asked that I keep her apprised of this delicate situation, and I haven't spoken to her for some time now.

I was going to deliver my report to her later, but it seems more fitting that you should be the one to speak with her about it. You can probably answer her questions better than I could.

entries.name: <nyi> Vimes's Report
entries.how:
Well, judging from Captain Vimes's report, you've been a huge help to his investigation, and for that I thank you.

I can put my mind more at ease knowing that the matter is in such capable hands. If you would, I would request that you return to Captain Vimes and help him in getting to the bottom of this mystery.

entries.name: The Black Shield
entries.how:
I'm sorry I can't be of much help, {name}, but I can refer you to someone who would be. Caz Twosprocket, one of our best blacksmiths, works the forge at the smithy.

Take the shield to him, and see what he can tell you.

entries.name: The Black Shield
entries.how:
Ah, I almost missed this... The leather strap on the back must have burned off, but it seems like it was made to fit a large person. I'd guess a tauren, actually.

That's about all I can tell you. Tell Captain Vimes I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help.

entries.name: The Black Shield
entries.how: Hmm... I don't see anything out of the ordinary with this shield. We should have Do'gol, the blacksmith, take a look at it, and see if he can tell us more about it, but I wouldn't hold out hope...

entries.name: The Black Shield
entries.how:
Hmmm, there's writing right here on the rim of the shield, but it's hard to read from all the burned stuff.

I need acid to make it clear. Venom from the Darkfang spiders in the marsh would do good. Get me some of their sacs and I can clean this up.

entries.name: The Black Shield
entries.how:
Oh, I think I might have dropped too much acid onto the shield. Let me just rub a little...

Hm, kind of hard to read, but it looks like the name Mosarn. Never heard of him. Maybe Krog knows. Krog knows many people.

entries.name: Emberstrife
entries.how:
I have attuned this medallion with the magic necessary to create and maintain an illusion within the bounds of the den of Emberstrife.

Emberstrife is an ancient drake; an old gatekeeper of Nefarian, burdened with the duty to test those dragonspawn that would ascend to the rank of elite guard to Onyxia.

Travel to the Wyrmbog of Dustwallow Marsh and enter the lair of Emberstrife. Once there, put on the amulet and follow where your destiny may lead!

entries.name: The Test of Skulls, Scryer
entries.how:
We are Deathwing's children, whelp. Our dominance over the lesser Aspects must be enforced.

If you are truly worthy of ascension, the lesser dragonflight will wilt in your presence.

Find their champions and lay waste to them in the name of our Father!

Travel to Winterspring and track down the mighty blue drake, Scryer. Crush him and any of the Blue Flight that stand in your path. Tear out his skull and return it to me.

entries.name: The Test of Skulls, Somnus
entries.how:
Just as our Father crushes the Aspects themselves, so too must we strive to bring chaos and destruction to their children.

You must test your battle prowess against the sleepless dreamers: The children of the Green Flight.

Travel to the Swamp of Sorrows and track down Somnus, drake champion of the Green Flight. Let flow your hatred; dominate the insect... Return to me with his skull...

entries.name: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis
entries.how:
The time watchers, children of Nozdormu - Lord of the Centuriesss...

It is three that guard the Caverns of Time, but only one that holds the interests of the Black Flight: The Time Shifter, Chronalis, favored drakeling of Nozdormu.

Ssstrike at this champion, a blow to make even the stoic sands of time weep. Return to me with his skull.

entries.name: The Test of Skulls, Axtroz
entries.how:
It was over the mountains of Grim Batol that our Father raged against the combined might of the Aspects. The cowardly act of the betrayer, Alexstrasza, bought the other Aspects enough time to escape from Father's wrath.

Sssuch a shameful act...

The Red Flight now guards Grim Batol, their lieutenant, Axtroz, must be destroyed. Return the skull of Axtroz to me. For Father, whelp!

entries.name: Ascension...
entries.how:
From the skulls of our enemies is shaped a medallion. You know this medallion, yesss? You have no doubt seen it worn by your elders.

Take it, whelp. Return to the Spire and present it to General Drakkisath. The General will place the final enchantment upon the medallion, attuning the trinket to your spirit.

You will wear the finished medallion as a badge of honor, symbolizing your ascension to one of our most guarded ranks: Guardian to the brood mother.

Go!

entries.name: The "Chow" Quest (123)aa
entries.how: punk;!  Kill Kobold Vermin, 2 of em.

entries.name: The Lost Ancient
entries.how:
A putrid seed is all that remains of the wandering ancient. Its outer coat is brittle, and the insides emit a foul odor.

Given its size, the ancient this seed came from must have been fairly young; at least by ancient standards. One has to wonder why such a creature would be found trudging through The Quagmire.

To find your answers, you should take this seed to someone with knowledge in the lore of ancients.

entries.name: Jarl Needs a Blade
entries.how:
I have cutting to do.  I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade.  A certain blade...

Some people call it a moonsteel broadsword.  I call it a swing blade.

You help me?  Maybe you find it in town, maybe you talk to a blacksmith and he'll make it special.

But don't sleep on this.  What I'm cutting won't keep forever...

entries.name: Our Man in Theramore
entries.how:
Greetings, {name}. There's a matter that SI:7 could use your help with. Our man on Theramore Isle tells us that Jaina Proudmoore's marines just brought in a man found washed up on the shore.

Normally this wouldn't be of much interest to us but it seems that this man told the marines that he was none other than the king of Stormwind, Varian Wrynn. Go to Theramore and meet a dwarf named Sully at the inn. He's expecting you and will give you instructions when you arrive.

Find out what's going on.

entries.name: Watch Yer Back
entries.how: Listen up. I'm going to walk out that door behind you. Yer gonna wait until I'm good and gone, and then yer gonna meet me behind the graveyard outside o' town. Ensure yer not followed.

entries.name: The Return of the King?
entries.how:
Take this. It's a handy bit o' glamour that the mages back home put together to make a quick disguise. It'll make you look like a Kul Tiras Marine which should do nicely for this mission.

Sneak in to the tower and do yer best to listen for any mention of the man that washed up on the beach. I warn you though, do not get too close to Jaina. She will see right through this disguise. 

Come back and see me if you lose your disguise, I'll set you up with a new one.

entries.name: The Missing Kor'kron
entries.how:
Lok-tar, {name}. I find myself in need of assistance with a serious matter. 

Some time ago we dispatched a contingent of Kor'kron Elite to Dustwallow Marsh on a special mission. The problem is, we are far past their scheduled check-in with no word from them.

Head down to Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh and speak with an orc named Nazeer Bloodspike. No one is more knowledgeable about the state of Dustwallow than he. Find out what you can.

entries.name: The Elite of the Elite
entries.how:
A small force of Kor'kron soldiers passed through here a few days ago. Never told me why they were here, and I didn't ask. They bought supplies, took a bit of rest, then moved on.

The Kor'kron are the elite of the elite and tougher than elekk hooves, but I can't help feeling that something went wrong.

I did overhear one of them mention "the island", and there's an island called Alcaz just off the coast. It's a really nasty place. Get some friends and look into what befell these Kor'kron.

entries.name: Right Place, Wrong Time
entries.how:
<Sergeant Ulka struggles to sit up to speak with you. You offer your hand in aid, but she merely swats it away.>

Alright recruit... let's get you caught up.

entries.name: Skin Careful, Skin Sharp
entries.how:
You little! You help Krak smash the red bities and get scale hide!

Krak smash red bities to take scale hide, but Krak hands too big. Krak keep cutting hides, make them full of holes.

But you little! You go get hides from red bities in Dragonmurk in south. They mean and fast. You little, could get eaten.

entries.name: Whelps are the Worst!
entries.how:
My associate Gizzix and I are looking to set up an outpost, and I can smell an opportunity here!

Or maybe that's just the swamp gas. Either way, I could use some help.

The little black dragons flyin' around here haven't exactly been "friendly". They even singed poor Miss Melly!

Look, I have some good coin for you if you're willing to get rid of some of these horrible dragon whelps.

So, you in or not?

entries.name: Dragon Scales, Post Burnt Tails
entries.how:
After going through a gauntlet of very cranky whelps, I think it's time we fix this little reoccurring problem we keep running into.

Being flammable.

I've been watching these dragons for awhile and it seems like they are immune to their own fire! Well, at least their scales are.

If you're willing to do some extra work, I'd be happy to compensate you for any shed scales you come across out there. With any luck we'll have enough to make us some gear to cover ourselves. Oh, and Melly too of course.

entries.name: Active Ingredient
entries.how:
Miss Melly got burned pretty bad by those whelps. I think they scared her. I haven't been able to convince her to move!

Listen, I have an idea.

I once bought this snake oil potion that obviously didn't work as intended but it DID heal a cut I had. One of the active ingredients was supposedly an herb called Wyrmtail that's found around these parts.

If my hunch is correct that might help Miss Melly's burns. Go see if you can find some and bring it back! Anything is worth a try.

entries.name: Sword in the Slime
entries.how:
I was having a drink with my buddies over at the tavern a few nights back and they dared me to try and take on one of those nasty oozes alone.

Seeing as I don't have a sword, you can probably guess how well that went.

When I went to attack it my sword got stuck and things didn't go as planned.

I need to get it back before my sergeant realizes I lost it! It should be stuck in an ooze out there somewhere, west of here across the bay.

Please, if you're headed out that way, can you look for it?

entries.name: Loramus
entries.how: So you wish to battle demons? You would do well to listen to my tale.

entries.name: A Meeting with the Master
entries.how:
Ah, a young {race} come to speak to Sanath. What a wonderful day! I am so honored to have you grace me with your presence. Thank you!

Please... do not be so arrogant to assume my sarcasm was a compliment. Let us get one thing straight: I don't like you. But this little conversation doesn't have anything to do with us--it has to do with my master.

Bring me a couple hippogryph feathers for my arrows and I'll give you leave to see him. He's asked that I send adventurers to him if they proved worthy enough.

entries.name: A Crew Under Fire
entries.how:
We were just off the coast looking for a safe haven to make anchor. The sun hadn't been down for more than an hour when they attacked... those damned naga!

I'm not sure what they were looking for, but it's clear they didn't find it--they've already come back once. A couple of my scouts are on watch at the entrance of the valley to give us fair warning when the next attack comes.

I'm sorry you've come along now, {name}, but it's out of my hands.

Are you ready for the fight of your life?

entries.name: Betrayed
entries.how:
This camp used to be a dozen warriors strong, {name}. Now, they are all dead.

That mage, Rimtori, has slain them all. She played Belgrom like a lute; claiming Azshara would hold great riches... powerful items.

Belgrom sent us to protect her, and said we would be rewarded. Well, look who's the fool--we were slaughtered.

The blood elves are camped along the southern bluffs on the northern peninsula. Kill every one you see. Then, find the source of Rimtori's power so we can exact our revenge.

entries.name: Breaking the Ward
entries.how:
You are foolhardy, {name}. It is an admirable quality of your kind - to blindly enter battle when you have little to no chance of success. I will assist you, if only to see just one of Razelikh's minions fall.

To break the ward placed over Razelikh's subordinates will take time and require the acquisition of rare artifacts.

Be still, I must first perform the enlightenment ritual. The information I gather will assist me in forging weapons of great power.

entries.name: The Name of the Beast
entries.how:
There is only one way to harm the demon lord and his minions. A weapon of power must be forged bearing his true name.

When such a weapon is forged, the demon and all under his command are vulnerable.

A lesser deity resides in Azshara: Lord Arkkoroc. You must seek him out but be warned, his minions will stop at nothing to destroy you if you are discovered.

Undoubtedly, you will have to pay a price for such information.

entries.name: The Name of the Beast
entries.how:
She kills my children, mortal. She that calls herself the ruler of these oceans. A false god, nothing more. Crush her and bring back all of her heads.

For that, you will be given the name that you seek and something else of equal importance.

She roams the clutch... Hetaera she is called.

<Lord Arkkoroc points to the southwest.>

Go!

entries.name: The Name of the Beast
entries.how:
As promised, I will reveal the name of the demon lord, Razelikh the Defiler. First, however, I must prepare something of utmost importance for your journey.

The weapon you seek to create requires a temper. Give me a moment to drain the blood from these heads.

<Lord Arkkoroc squeezes the heads in between his gigantic fists, draining them of their blood.>

Take the temper back to Loramus along with the name of the beast: Rakh'likh.

entries.name: Stealing Knowledge
entries.how:
I admit, {name}, I've made the most of my situation in Azshara. Belgrom's punishment has had its share of benefits.

Before I left, I did some research and you would be surprised how many valuable items are lying around.

There are tablets throughout the Ruins of Eldarath to the east that I need. All four are named after highborne wizards. Get them for me and we'll talk some more.

entries.name: Delivery to Magatha Grimtotem
entries.how:
The first tablet goes to a tauren ... one called Magatha Grimtotem. She is among the elders in Thunder Bluff, and is one of the proponents of the alliance between the tauren and the Forsaken. She, more than anyone among the elders, feels the tauren and their ways can help the Forsaken find a path back to being human.

Bring her the Tablet of Beth'Amara. The tablet may be the link she needs in finding a way to help the Forsaken... or so she claims.

entries.name: Delivery to Jes'rimon
entries.how:
I have a fence in Orgrimmar. He resides in The Drag. He's difficult to nail down if you don't know where to look, but if you go looking in one of the highest buildings there you should have no problem finding him.

Do me a favor though, don't go shouting to all of Kalimdor that he's there and what his business is--it'd be bad for both of us.

He'll give us more than a fair price for the Tablet of Jin'yael. I'm not sure why, but you should have seen how excited he was to hear about its whereabouts.

entries.name: Delivery to Andron Gant
entries.how:
Andron Gant is my next contact. He usually holds himself up in the Undercity... right near the Apothecarium.

He was a little more loose-lipped when it came to speaking about what he wanted the Tablet for. Apparently some of the mages of Undercity are looking to study some of the arcane spells the highborne used. They think this tablet will help them. Markri was adept at summoning creatures; especially elementals.

Take the Tablet of Markri and return to me for your part of the reward.

entries.name: Delivery to Archmage Xylem
entries.how:
This final tablet goes to someone very dangerous, {name}. Heed me when I tell you that I trust this person far less than anyone else I've asked you to meet with.

Archmage Xylem has a tower up in the hills overlooking Azshara. He's human, but he acts like no human I've met... or killed. He exudes power, and I dare not ask him what he plans on doing with the tablet.

He came to me, but told me that his bodyguard Sanath would help me get to the tower when I was ready to meet him. Look north for Sanath.

entries.name: Magatha's Payment to Jediga
entries.how:
Take this note to Jediga. Tell her the payment will be here for her when she returns. And tell her I am pleased with her work.

Go swiftly, {name}. Tell your master I will be awaiting her here.

entries.name: Jes'rimon's Payment to Jediga
entries.how:
Take this letter to Jediga. Let her know that our deal has been beneficial and I be pleased with her work.

You tell her she come back to Orgrimmar fast and Jes'rimon make sure he take good care of her.

Tell her that, and maybe in the future I have need of your services again, {name}.

entries.name: Andron's Payment to Jediga
entries.how: Here... take... <hic> this to Jediga. Good luck to ya!

entries.name: Xylem's Payment to Jediga
entries.how:
What is it? Oh yes, your payment. Of course.

Take this and be off with you. I'm sure Jediga is awaiting oh so patiently for your return.

entries.name: Kim'jael Indeed!
entries.how:
Kim'jael indeed!! Do you know what Kim'jael means to the Blood elves, {name}? Little rat... or something like that. The big bullies!

They hired me to help them scout the area looking for some sort of lost treasures. Of course I jumped aboard the moment they said "treasure" and the amount they were willing to pay, but of course, they turned on me and tried to kill me... ME!

Goes to show you, you can't trust a Blood elf.

The problem is, they still have my equipment and I can't get it back. Help me out?

entries.name: Azsharite
entries.how:
The ancient cliff giants of the southern region of Azshara consume the rock and buildings of the land for sustenance. The excrement from their consumption is a highly malleable and extremely strong crystal known as Azsharite.

The formations litter the southern arc, but few are ever recovered due to the extremely violent nature of the giants.

You are to venture south and recover enough of the Azsharite for the creation of the weapon's body. My felhounds will aid in the recovery of the crystal.

entries.name: The Formation of Felbane
entries.how:
The weapons are ready to be forged. You must take the tempered azsharite to one with the ability to harness fel energy.

In Stranglethorn Vale such a blacksmith exists. Galvan the Ancient, leader of the Mithril Order, will craft the weapons to your specifications. You will find his encampment between Zul'Gurub and the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound.

May your determination and faith carry you through this ordeal. Should you fail, know that your God smiles down upon you, mortal.

entries.name: Kim'jael's "Missing" Equipment
entries.how:
What?! What?!

That wasn't good enough for you? You know how expensive those explosives are? They sell for... oh, nevermind. Fine, you want to make some real money? Cause that's how business is done: you prove you're a valuable employee and then you're rewarded adequately after you stick it out some.

If you're a "valuable" employee, then hit the Ruins of Eldarath and find me some rune that them Blood elves were lookin' for. The naga apparently have it in their possession.

entries.name: Spiritual Unrest
entries.how:
Long ago, the Highborne were some of the most powerful students of the arcane the night elves ever produced. The corruption that comes along with such studies caused much harm to night elf society and greatly affected all of Azeroth... as I'm sure you well know.

I promised the Sentinels that I would release the spirits from their mortal bonds as I find them. If you would do the same, then I am sure I can reward you some.

The spirits haunt the Shadowsong Shrine to the northeast of here.

entries.name: A Land Filled with Hatred
entries.how:
The satyr, a disfigured, evil aspect of the night elves, now infect the sacred lands once traveled by Cenarius. I cannot speak for the night elves when it comes to all the atrocities those demonic creatures have committed, but I have sworn an oath to the Earthmother to aid the elves in ridding the land of such a nuisance.

I am sure you would prove yourself if you aided me in purging them.

Northeast of here, you can find the Haldarr clan. Return to me after you've tested yourself against their power.

entries.name: Poisoned Water
entries.how:
A force of elemental scouts was sent to the eastern plaguelands of Lordaeron, and the disease of that place twisted and infected them.  The Waterlords cannot allow this affront to our purity!

Take this vial.  In it is a quantity of one aspect of Neptulon.  If used on the plagued elementals it will fight the poison within their bodies and cure them!  But their inner conflict will drive them into a surging madness.

Defeat the discordant surges and bring me their bracers of binding.

entries.name: Stormers and Rumblers
entries.how:
We, the elementals of water, wage war with those beings of the lesser elements.  If you are truly our ally in this conflict, then show me your conviction!

Far to the south, in the desert land of Silithus, the servants of air and earth scurry in a corner of rock named the Crystal Vale.  They protect items of power from smaller beings, mortals, and although I do not know why they do this, I wish to foil their efforts.

Go to the Crystal Vale in Silithus and defeat our enemies, then return to me.

entries.name: Eye of the Emberseer
entries.how:
You have shown me that you can defeat our enemies and perform missions to further the cause of the Waterlords.  But until now you have only faced lesser foes... if pitted against a powerful enemy, can you prevail?

That is your new task.

High up in Blackrock Spire the orcs have captured a servant of fire, the Pyroguard Emberseer.  Find his place of imprisonment, slay his captors, and then slay the emberseer.  Bring me his eye and it will show me your worth.

entries.name: The Molten Core
entries.how:
{name}, perhaps it is time to give you a real test.  Are you ready?

At the bottom of Blackrock Depths is a passage to the Molten Core.  This is a stronghold of our enemy, held by the most powerful servants of fire on this world.

Go to the Molten Core, {name}.  Show me you have the strength and the will to defeat what you find there.

And if you have allies among your people, then rally them.  Nothing short of an army can hope to enter the Molten Core and live.

entries.name: Agent of Hydraxis
entries.how:
If you truly wish an allegiance with us, then I invite you to wage war on our foes, the servants of air and earth and fire.  Each defeat you heap upon them will weaken their foothold here, and further prove your adherence to our cause.

The campaign will be long, but if you persevere then your glory and honor will be great.

entries.name: Hands of the Enemy
entries.how:
{name}, your service is of great value to us, so we are reluctant to send you on this last mission for we do not want to lose such a useful agent.

But its success would further our war efforts tremendously and... it was deemed worth risking you.

We want these captains in the Molten Core destroyed: Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah.  Kill them and bring me their hands!

This task will take every resource you possess, {name}, but if can do it then the Firelords will be dealt a terrible blow.

entries.name: A Hero's Reward
entries.how:
{name}, your services to the Warlords surpassed all we could expect from the denizens of this world.

We do not understand your people's notions of gratitude, or rewarding good works, but in this case... perhaps a reward is warranted.

Under the surf at the southern base of this island, you will find a coffer.  In it you will find your... reward.

Go, {name}.  Claim your reward.

entries.name: Azuregos's Magical Ledger
entries.how: You cannot understand a single word on this ledger. You don't even know what language it is written in!

entries.name: The Wrath of Neptulon
entries.how:
Did I mention the bad news yet? Its name is Maws: 100 feet of death and destruction. I guess I may have forgotten that little tidbit.

According to my superior psycho-psionic clairvoyance, you'll find that the best spot to cast this buoy is off the coast of Azshara, in the Bay of Storms.

Look for a swirling maelstrom, most likely cluttered with wreckage.

By the by, I hope you have friends.

Now if you somehow miraculously succeed, take the scepter shard to Anachronos.

entries.name: A Hero's Reward
entries.how:
{name}, your services to the Warlords surpassed all we could expect from the denizens of this world.

We do not understand your people's notions of gratitude, or rewarding good works, but in this case... perhaps a reward is warranted.

Under the surf at the southern base of this island, you will find a coffer.  In it you will find your... reward.

Go, {name}.  Claim your reward.

entries.name: The Wrath of Neptulon
entries.how:
Did I mention the bad news yet? Its name is Maws: 100 feet of death and destruction. I guess I may have forgotten that little tidbit.

According to my superior psycho-psionic clairvoyance, you'll find that the best spot to cast this buoy is off the coast of Azshara, in the Bay of Storms.

Look for a swirling maelstrom, most likely cluttered with wreckage.

By the by, I hope you have friends.

Now if you somehow miraculously succeed, take the scepter shard to Anachronos.

entries.name: The Legashi Threat
entries.how:
My people are struggling, {name}. 

The Legashi satyr have invaded our den, corrupting many of the Blackmaw and separating us from our Timbermaw allies. Those of us who survive their attacks are huddled in makeshift camps. Worse still, the satyr's corruption is spreading across the land, and poses a threat to my already vulnerable tribe.

The Legashi lurk among the ruins northeast of here. I must ask you for help in defeating them.

entries.name: Legashi Horns
entries.how:
You have certainly proven yourself to me, {name}, but the others of my tribe are less easily persuaded. For that, you will need to continue your efforts against the Legashi.

Bring to me the horns of slain Legashi satyr. Every bundle you bring me will serve as a symbol of your service to the Blackmaw.

entries.name: Report to Rageroar
entries.how:
There is much more to be done in our fight against the satyr, {name}.

If you wish be of further help, speak with Gatekeeper Rageroar at the camps of Ursolan to the north. He will know where to use your abilities best. You should find Ursolan to the north of here.

entries.name: Master Feardred
entries.how:
Many satyr corrupt Azshara, but none are as terrible as the Legashi. Led by Varrox Bleakhoof, their camps litter the northern peninsula. They have driven us from our homes, and I fear they will ransack Ursolan before long.

We must strike back if we are to have any chance of survival.
