Master Feardred, a servant of Varrox, oversees a nearby camp to the south. You can see it from here. Feardred is a key target in weakening Varrox's forces. Kill him, and bring me his amulet.

entries.name: Missing Blackmaw Scouts
entries.how:
Not long ago I sent a party of scouts to gather information on the Legashi stronghold and possibly find our chieftain. They have yet to return. I am beginning to fear the worst.

The Legashi have many camps to the east of here. If any members of the party are still alive they are likely somewhere nearby.

entries.name: Thinning Their Forces
entries.how:
The satyr within the Legashi stronghold are even more fearsome than those of the outer camps. When our party was discovered, we found ourselves overwhelmed.

One of us was slain, and another captured. I was the only one able to successfully retreat. I cannot return to Rageroar with my head hung in shame, but I cannot fight the Legashi alone, either.

I ask you, then, to assist me in weakening the satyr's forces. Go into their stronghold and slay them.

entries.name: Later, Satyr
entries.how:
You there, {race}!

These fiends ambushed my scouting party, and have taken me captive. I don't know what plans they have for me, but I don't intend to find out. I must escape and return to Ursolan; no doubt Korsa is worried about me.

While I would love to break out of this cage and leave a trail of satyr corpses in my wake, I'm afraid I'm slightly outnumbered.

Perhaps you share my hatred for the fiends, and would help me escape?

entries.name: Return to Rageroar
entries.how:
With the Legashi stronghold weakened, we can return to Ursolan in honor.

Go ahead of me, and inform Gatekeeper Rageroar of the situation here.

entries.name: Encroaching Corruption
entries.how:
<Furze lets loose an ugly, hacking, cough.>

Hear me, {race}, I haven't much strength to speak. I am stricken by an illness unlike any I have ever known. It is as if my blood itself is aflame, and my very essence is coming undone. I can hardly move, much less fetch help.

Please, go find Elder Bramblesnap. Her tent is just northwest of here. She will know what to do.

entries.name: An Unlikely Source
entries.how:
Furze is not the first with his affliction. Since the Legashi's attacks against us began, many Blackmaw have presented with a similar illness. Each one eventually fell to corruption, becoming mindless and destructive.

I have been working towards a cure. My studies indicate that one could possibly be made by transmuting the Legashi's own firewater, but I cannot acquire it myself.

You might find firewater, or a way to brew it, in the Legashi camps to the east. You would be a great help in doing so.

entries.name: Transmuted Tincture
entries.how:
I have transmuted the firewater into a tincture which I believe will be the key to undoing the Legashi's corruption. Eager as I am to ease the suffering of the Blackmaw, it must be tested.

I have seen many of the coursers and skystormers east of Ursolan suffering from the satyr's corruption. They will serve as our test subjects.

Go, and test my would-be cure on the afflicted beasts. Before giving the tincture the beast must be weakened to ensure it can be administered with little resistance.

entries.name: Potential Panacea
entries.how:
I must say, {class}. I have not felt this optimistic in some time. This tincture could be the panacea that saves us from the satyr's ever-expanding blight. Even if we remain in these camps for the rest of our lives we will stand strong and free of corruption.

Go to Furze and give him this panacea. He has suffered for long enough. Return to me to report any findings.

entries.name: Blackmaw Counter-Offensive
entries.how:
I will send the reinforcements to Ursolan at once. 

Take this banner. When you are ready to face Halanox, plant it in his demonic summoning circle. This will provoke him, and signal our warriors to strike.

Once Halanox is defeated, inform Gatekeeper Rageroar.

entries.name: Toil and Trouble
entries.how:
It appears this cauldron could be used to brew the firewater that Elder Bramblesnap is after.

If only you knew how. Surely, one of the satyr in the Legashi Encampment must carry a recipe.

entries.name: Felfire Burn, Cauldron Bubble
entries.how:
The recipe reads:

Harvest ye the sprout of hell
bushel o' five will serve ye well
mixed with mote of demon's power
shall usher in their final hour

entries.name: Running Firewater
entries.how:
As the satyrweed and fel mote splash into the boiling liquid, a plume of noxious gas emerges.

Best to hold your nose, quickly grab a sample, and bring it back to Elder Bramblesnap.

entries.name: Chieftain Bloodmaw
entries.how:
When the Legashi overran the Blackmaw, the rest of the Timbermaw sealed their passage to the hold to keep out the satyr. We had no idea they lived on as refugees.

I would gladly aid my brethren, but we are fighting our own battles. Like the Legashi threaten the Blackmaw, the Deadwood do likewise to us. We haven't many warriors to spare.

The Deadwood chieftain, Bloodmaw, is in Felpaw Village to the south. Eliminating him would greatly ease our struggle. Bring me his mace, and you will have our aid.

entries.name: Slay the Spitelash
entries.how:
Azshara may appear beautiful, but it is a cursed place. There are horrors deep beneath its waters, waiting to emerge and tear the world asunder.

All we can do for now is fight the horrors that have already surfaced.

The Spitelash Naga occupy the Ruins of Eldarath to the north east. The ones within the ruins are well-fortified, so we must pick off the weaker ones along the outskirts first.

As you can see, we could always use another fighter here, if you are up to the task.

entries.name: Preserving Eldarath
entries.how:
Millennia ago, Eldarath was a sight to behold; a living testament to the glory and might of the Kaldorei. What we call Eldarath today is hardly a pile of rubble by comparison.

Nonetheless, what remains is worth salvaging, if only to preserve our history. The Spitelash must be driven out before Eldarath is completely ransacked.

Following the road north east will lead you right into the heart of the ruins. Go there, and retrieve as many of our relics as you can--and their commander's head.

entries.name: Reclaiming Ravencrest
entries.how:
I fear time may soon forget the Kaldorei house of Ravencrest. A lone, crumbling, monument is the only surviving proof of their presence here.

The monument can be found atop the cliffs at the very tip of the southern peninsula. Spitelash enchantresses there have a set of power stones which they use to channel their magic. Take this ward, and nullify them. This will cripple the Spitelash's magic, and give us an upper hand in driving them out.

While you're at it, be sure to take out a few naga yourself.

entries.name: The Head of the Serpent
entries.how:
Your final target is Warlord Krellian, the leader of the Spitelash. He cowers behind his guards in the Temple of Zin-Malor in the ruins of Eldarath.

Cut off Krelian's head, and his minions will be slithering back to the sea in fear. Then, finally, Azshara will belong to Kaldorei once again.

entries.name: Making Contact
entries.how:
While scouting along the cliffs of the Shattered Strand, one of our sentinels noticed a kaldorei woman on the beach.

Clearly, she is not with our expedition, and she did not have the makings of a fighter. I wonder then, what she could be doing in such a hostile place as this.

If you can, try to make contact with her. I would like to know her purpose for being here, and if our interests are perhaps aligned.

She was last seen on the eastern coast, along the north side of the Bay of Storms.

entries.name: Saving a Sentinel
entries.how:
<The sentinel speaks in a low whisper>

Listen, {class}, before they hear us. I am a sentinel from Talrendis Point. The satyr here believe me injured, but I am only feigning; waiting for the moment they drop their guard and I can escape.

Your arrival is perhaps such a moment.

Help me out of here, would you?

entries.name: Highborne Tablets
entries.how:
Just south of here, along the beach, there are some tablets of highborne writing. They document the highborne's investigations into the laws and powers of the arcane. 

The tablets are being kept in pagoda-like structures, guarded by naga, so I wouldn't dare attempt to procure them myself.

Fortunately, I've found myself a new assistant! 

So, what do you say? Think you could be of further use in the pursuit of knowledge?

entries.name: Slithering Looters
entries.how:
I came here in search of highborne artifacts. You could call me an archaeologist of sorts.

The ruins of Eldarath to the west hold many of them, although the naga are looting the ruins as we speak.

A naga called Lady Sesspira leads the pillaging; no doubt keeping the best finds for herself. 

If my research is correct, I believe she may be in possession of the staff of Archmage Selwyn, a fallen highborne mage.

I need your help to get that staff, {race}. Scholars like me are ill-suited for combat.

entries.name: Home on the Range
entries.how:
Greetings traveller!

If yer lookin' for a place to hang yer hat, look no further than Berdun's travel lodge! The tent's in a bit o' disrepair right now, but that can be remedied.

Tell ye what. If ye get me what I need to fix the tent, I'll let ye stay here for free. How's that sound?

I'll need some mosshoof hides. The easiest to hunt mosshooves are just north o' here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.

entries.name: Gettin' Buzzed
entries.how:
What's a travel lodge without somethin' to drink?

I can brew a fine mead, but I'm gettin' a bit on in years to gather the honey myself. There are wasp nests in the trees north of the Haldaar camp, an' west of Valormok. If ye see hippogryphs, yer in the right place.

They're nasty buggers, but the honey is like nothin' ye've ever tasted. I'll lend ye my pellet gun to knock down the hives, ye can't reach 'em otherwise.

entries.name: Summer Frontier Fishery
entries.how:
Any travel lodge worth its salt's gotta have somethin' to eat.

Summer bass are in season, and ye can fish 'em up from the coasts here in Azshara. Never was much of an angler myself, but I'm a mean cook!

What do ye say? Feelin' some seafood?

If ye aren't much for fishin', try makin' friends with one! Or pay 'em for their goods and buy some.

entries.name: Deadliest Catch
entries.how:
If ye fancy yourself a real angler, there's bigger fish out here than ye can catch with a rod.

Mammoth Sharks lurk in the deepest waters of the northern an' southern coasts. They swim far out, right before the sea floor drops away into the great ocean.

They're mighty big; I'd advise ye take a group of anglers with ye. 

Dwarf like me? I prefer dry land. Those sharks'd swallow me in one bite.

If ye do go hunting one, bring me a cut o' the meat. I'd be mighty thankful.

entries.name: Murloc Thieves
entries.how:
On the beaches of the northern peninsula, east of here, I came upon the Tower of Eldara. While surveying the site, I noticed a large orange murloc wielding a spiked club, and carrying a peculiar glowing crystal. Given the location, it was likely the kind that the highborne used to store their history and memories.

We must recover that crystal, {race}. Who knows what secrets it could contain?

The best route to the tower is along the cliffs, with the nearest way up being just west of here.

entries.name: A Monumental Task
entries.how:
It is said that Queen Azshara once bestowed a gift upon the kaldorei of House Ravencrest; an emblem of great beauty and magical power. This mark was given as recognition of the Ravencrests' unwavering loyalty to the queen. 

The mark was last seen near the Ravencrest Monument, atop the cliffs of the southern peninsula. Securing such a relic would be the discovery of a lifetime.

As always, the ruins of the monument are crawling with Spitelash, but I trust you're rather adept at handling them by now.

entries.name: Your Final Reward
entries.how:
I know you were initially sent here on reconnaissance, {name}, but you've done a great deal for the field of archaeology.

Surely, after all of your toil, you'd like to know what fruits my studies will come to bear.

To that end, before you return to your camp, I'd like to show you something. Would you oblige me?

entries.name: Winter Frontier Fishery
entries.how:
Any travel lodge worth its salt's gotta have somethin' to eat.

Squid are in season, and ye can fish 'em up from the coasts here in Azshara. Never was much of an angler myself, but I'm a mean cook!

What do ye say? Feelin' some seafood?

If ye aren't much for fishin', try makin' friends with one! Or pay 'em for their goods and buy some.

entries.name: Ill Tidings
entries.how: <With Saria's true intentions revealed, and a bag of powerful artifacts in hand, perhaps now would be a good time give Commander Truesong her report.>

entries.name: Pay Dirt!
entries.how: <The large hunk of crystal is even heavier than it looks. While it appears to be quite the prize, its true nature is unknown to you. Someone with knowledge in geology could say what you've really found.>

entries.name: Home on the Range
entries.how:
During our last skirmish with the blood elves, my tent was badly damaged. For three nights, I have been at the mercy of the elements.

It can be repaired with a few mosshoof hides, but a lack of sleep has left me unable to hunt them myself.

The easiest mosshooves to hunt are west and south of here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.

entries.name: Seals of the Sin'dorei
entries.how:
<The seal of the first crystal bears the mark of a sword. Its energy must be channeled by an expert warrior.

The seal of the middle crystal bears the mark of a glaive. Its energy must be channeled by one of both martial and magical prowess.

The seal of the last crystal bears the mark of a talon. Its energy must be channeled by one at home in the wilds.

It's likely that some of Rimtori's officers are carrying these seals to aid her in the spell. Taking them would no doubt be troublesome for her.>

entries.name: An Explosive Gambit
entries.how:
<Seeing how the energies of the crystals are attuned to the seals, you reason that destroying a seal, thereby releasing its energy all at once, could cause its crystal to do the same.

The explosive results would certainly draw Rimtori's ire. It would also present the perfect opportunity to attack her while she's flustered.>

entries.name: Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning
entries.how:
Rimtori's tome still sits atop its pedestal. Who knows what secrets its pages could hold? 

Perhaps it would be best not to leave such a powerful artifact out here in the wilds.

entries.name: Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning
entries.how:
You were wise to take this, {name}. More than killing Rimtori, keeping this out of the blood elves' hands will ensure they are powerless to retaliate against us.

As for deciphering the tome itself, I have a contact in Orgrimmar who dabbles in such things--a warlock named Zevrost. He can be found in the Cleft of Shadow.

entries.name: Long Walks on the Beach
entries.how:
What the beaches here lack in looks, they make up for in value!

Most of the ruins here have been picked clean, but there's some serious loot under that sand. Problem is, it's all scattered, and the naga make a long search a bit impractical. So, what's a girl to do?

Enter the Treasure Trowel 3000! The all-in-one treasure detecting shovel! A personal invention of mine.

Take this baby down to the eastern shore, and bring back whatever you find. Then, we can split the profits!

entries.name: Blue Gold
entries.how:
Listen kid, everyone out here's scramblin' for the same thing. Belgrom, the elves, the naga, they all wanna piece 'a that ancient highborne magic.

Me? Couldn't care less, but I know a seller's market when I see one.

I've seen blood elf arcanists carrying special wands. They're used to extract magical energy from artifacts the elves find. The arcanists stay at a camp east of the elves' base camp, along the cliffs. Get me one of those wands and I'll put you on to the score of a lifetime!

entries.name: Pay Dirt!
entries.how: <The large hunk of crystal is even heavier than it looks. While it appears to be quite the prize, its true nature is unknown to you. Someone with an eye for valuables could say what you've really found.>

entries.name: Gettin' Buzzed
entries.how:
There are few luxuries out here on the frontier. A barrel of good drink would surely boost the camp's morale.

In my younger days, I took a recipe for a delicious brew off the corpse of a dwarf I killed. All I need is some honey. Fortunately, the wasp nests to the west are overflowing with it.

Take my pellet gun. This will allow you to knock the nests out of the trees. Be warned, however, it will do little against the wasps themselves.

entries.name: Summer Frontier Fishery
entries.how:
Meat is well and good, but a varied diet makes the body stronger.

Summer bass are in season, and can be fished from the coasts here in Azshara. I never took to angling myself. I much prefer the safety of land. Although, were you to fish some up, or obtain them via some other means, I would greatly appreciate it.

entries.name: Winter Frontier Fishery
entries.how:
Meat is well and good, but a varied diet makes the body stronger.

Winter squid are in season, and can be fished from the coasts here in Azshara. I never took to angling myself. I much prefer the safety of land. Although, were you to fish some up, or obtain them via some other means, I would greatly appreciate it.

entries.name: Deadliest Catch
entries.how:
If you wish for a true test of angling prowess, there are bigger fish than you can catch with a rod.

Mammoth Sharks lurk in the deepest waters of the northern and southern coasts. They swim far out, right before the sea floor drops away into the great ocean.

They are massive creatures. I would advise you to bring a hunting party. 

If you do go after one, bring me a cut of the meat.

entries.name: Ley of the Land
entries.how:
When we first got here, I did some surveying for any untapped resources. Y'know, typical prospector stuff.

I didn't see nothin' special 'til I searched Lake Mennar, to the south. There, I saw a huge rift floating above the water's surface. I couldn't get close, but I think it was an open leyline.

If I'm right, we can use this wand to siphon magic straight from the source! Bottle that up, sell it to the highest bidder, and bam! I'm rich!

If you go and siphon that rift for me, I'll cut you in.

entries.name: Remote Contact
entries.how:
<The Forsaken sways unsteadily> 

'ey! <hic> Do me a favor ... would ya? 

Go to uh ... Azshara 'n ... tell <hic> Jediga ...

Expectin' a ... 'mportant deliv'ry <hic>

entries.name: Remote Contact
entries.how:
Listen, {class}, you'd best not be hangin' round here for long. But since you are, perhaps you can do a little favor for me?

I be expecting a certain something from a Jediga, in Azshara. She and some orcs be havin' a camp out there. Go and tell her Jes'rimon sent you, and I'll owe you one.

entries.name: Remote Contact
entries.how:
My duties occasionally require reagents from the farther corners of Azeroth. However, I am always needed here in Thunder Bluff, and so I am in need of competent aides.

To that end, I am awaiting a delivery from an orc named Jediga, in Azshara. If you care to make yourself useful, find her camp, and inquire as to when I can expect it to arrive.

entries.name: Demon Hunter's Hunter
entries.how:
Not many demon hunters remain on Azeroth now, but a few of us continue to hunt the most dangerous or hidden threats.

A colleague of mine, Maerion Thaelemaches, headed to Hyjal to investigate rumors of demons there. While there are many demons in the dangerous Darkwhisper Gorge, there is suspicion that the demons that assaulted the mountain during the last war might not be completely defeated.

This bears investigation.

entries.name: Beneath Nordrassil
entries.how:
You may have noticed the furbolg and satyr north of here fighting over a burrow. The conflict does not interest me as much as what could be inside. That burrow seems to lead beneath Nordrassil.

I don't think I need to tell you how this could be of interest to the Kaldorei.

We have our hands full here as it is, but the druids of Darnassus should be informed. Find Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave. He can decide if this is something worth pursuing.

entries.name: Beneath Nordrassil
entries.how:
You may have noticed the furbolg and satyr northeast of here, fighting over some burrow. The conflict does not interest me as much as what's inside. That burrow seems to lead beneath the world tree, and who knows what could be under there?

We're spread too thin to investigate ourselves, but I know a tauren who may appreciate the tip. Her name is Nara Wildmane, a druid in Thunder Bluff. Tell her Jediga sent you. Always good to have someone owe you a favor.

entries.name: Sisters In Duty
entries.how:
I joined the Sentinels following my elder sister, Keldara. She's stationed out at Talrendis Point in Azshara. I sadly have not seen her for some time.

If you are able, would you be willing to make sure she's okay? She hasn't responded to my last letter... I fear the worst.

She reports to Commander Truesong. I would start there and follow the chain of command--I wouldn't want you to get into trouble on my behalf!

entries.name: Chen's Empty Keg
entries.how:
A small placard on one of the ends of the keg says,

"Chen Stormstout-

May your spirit be raised and always raise your spirits."

entries.name: Chen's Empty Keg
entries.how:
Would you like a taste of Chen's namesake? Ahh, the stormstout is a mighty brew. Chen taught the recipe to my mentor, and my mentor passed it on to me. I'll need you to get me a few things, but I can tell you this: the kick is worth it.

Bring me 5 savannah lion tusks from any savannah lion, 5 plainstrider kidneys from any plainstrider, and 1 thunder lizard horn from any species of thunder lizard. That should do the trick nicely.

You can find these ingredients throughout the Barrens.

entries.name: Chen's Empty Keg
entries.how:
Good stuff, that stormstout, huh?

I have another recipe that I learned from Chen. Would you be interested? It won't take long to make, and it might be useful if you plan on adventuring some more.

Bring me 5 lightning glands from any stormhide, 1 thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a kodo liver from any of the Barrens' kodos.

Like I said, this stuff has kick; it's the trogg brew that I mentioned to you before.

entries.name: Gann's Reclamation
entries.how:
In solitude I wander these roads.

The dwarves of Bael Modan show no respect for my land. Horrendous blasts drive holes deep into the ground as noisy machines rip apart the hills. Lands which once served as home and provider to my tribe are now riddled with destructive dwarves.

Attempts at reaching a diplomatic resolution have failed. Now is the time for decisive action.

Drive the dwarves from the Bael Modan excavation by force and bring to me the journal of their leader, Prospector Khazgorm.

entries.name: Plainstrider Menace
entries.how:
Your first prey will be easy.

The plainstriders to the east have been harassing our food supplies and have become a nuisance.

Put down the plainstriders and return to me with their beaks.

entries.name: The Zhevra
entries.how:
The zhevra, although not the fiercest beast in the Barrens, are a shade tougher than the plainstriders.  Don't worry -- we'll send you against bigger prey in good time, but for now your teeth could use a little more cutting.

Hunt the zhevra to the north and south, and collect their hooves.  Bring them to me and perhaps we'll next send you against something tougher.

entries.name: Revenge of Gann
entries.how:
It is clear the prospector depended on explosives and those noisy vehicles to rip the ground apart. We can expect a new foreman to take over soon.

I want to give the dwarves a taste of their own medicine. According to these plans if we combine nitroglycerin with wood pulp and sodium nitrate we can create an explosive charge. The rifleman, soldiers and officers in the Keep are known to have the supplies.

Collect these items and bring them to me. I will fashion a charge that the dwarves won't forget!

entries.name: Fungal Spores
entries.how:
The oases of the Barrens hide a mystery.  Life energy flows from their waters, invigorating the plants and beasts that drink it.

Invigorating, and altering.

There is a mushroom that grows near these oases.  Its spores hold properties that we, the apothecaries of Lordaeron, find useful.

Bring me these spores and you will earn our gratitude.

entries.name: Revenge of Gann
entries.how:
Following Khazgorm's plans it should be no problem to fashion an explosive charge

Ah, there we go.

Now, {name}, I am going to entrust you with a special task. Take this explosive stick and use it to blow up the flying machine at Bael Modan.

Not only is the flying machine a key part of the site's infrastructure it also serves as a weapon of war. More importantly it is an icon of power and an insult to the memory of my tribe.

Make me proud by completing this heroic task and you shall be rewarded.

entries.name: Kolkar Leaders
entries.how:
The centaurs have plagued the Tauren for years.  And recently, the Kolkar centaurs of the Barrens have grown into a real threat.  Normally they were disorganized in these lands, but new leaders have risen among them.  Rallying them.

To preserve our holdings here, these centaur leaders must be destroyed.

Bring me the head of Barak Kodobane.  He camps near the Forgotten Pools to the north.

Defeat him, then return to me.

entries.name: Verog the Dervish
entries.how:
The centaur Verog the Dervish wanders the Barrens, and will be difficult to find.  But he is based at the centaur command tent at the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast.  It may be possible to draw him to you.

Travel to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast and attack centaur near the command tent.  It will be dangerous, but if you can kill enough centaur then they should raise an alarm.  And Verog will come.

Bring me his head and I will place it with Barak Kodobane's.

entries.name: Hezrul Bloodmark
entries.how:
Hezrul Bloodmark is the leader of the Kolkar centaurs in the Barrens.  He is fierce, brutal and cunning.  Defeating him would disrupt and fracture the Kolkars, greatly reducing their threat to us.

So kill him.  As with Barak and Verog, bring me Hezrul's Head.

He leads his people from the Lushwater Oasis, to the south.

entries.name: Apothecary Zamah
entries.how:
I have rendered the spores you gave me into an emulsion.  I must now send it to my associate, Apothecary Zamah.  If you were to carry this to her, she can offer you something from our stores of alchemical goods.

She is in the Pools of Vision, a cave beneath the shamans of Thunder Bluff.  The path to this cave is well hidden, but you may find it on the Spirit Rise bluff.

Do hurry.  This emulsion will maintain its potency for only a short time, and must be resealed and processed before then.

entries.name: Centaur Bracers
entries.how:
The Kolkar are a threat to the Horde's claims in the Barrens; we must reduce the numbers of their troops.  And so, I have a bounty task for you.

While in Kolkar territories, slay their warriors and collect centaur bracers.  Return when you have a heap of bracers and the Horde will reward you well.

entries.name: The Tear of the Moons
entries.how:
The power was mine! In my very hands! And I want it back! Back I say!

Those dirty excavators uncovered it... so beautiful it was. Deemed the Tear of the Moons, it was the first great discovery we made at Bael Modan.

It should have been mine! Mine I say!

General Twinbraid grew jealous of the power it gave me. He locked it away in the Keep. Called it cursed, he did! The fool!

Others wanted it and they had to be stopped! That bastard Twinbraid drove me off.

Now I want it back. Back I say!

entries.name: Ignition
entries.how:
I don't suppose Sputtervalve sent you? I'm in a bind here. I hopped in without realizing that I need a key to unlock the shredder's movement column. One of the other shredder operators asked me if everything was okay, and I panicked! Instead of telling him that I was missing my key, I told him there was some sort of mechanical problem.

We need to get out of here on the double! Go up to the control room at the top of the derrick, the supervisor should have a key for this shredder.

Help me out here!

entries.name: Sergra Darkthorn
entries.how:
If you wish to walk the hunter's path, then your journey leads to the Barrens.  Its beasts are strong-willed and fierce.  You will learn much by hunting there, and your spirit will grow.

Speak with Sergra Darkthorn.  She will be your first guide in the Barrens.

Sergra is at the Crossroads.  To reach her, travel east from Bloodhoof Village into the Barrens, then north as the road forks.  And have care as you travel--the Barrens holds great danger for the unprepared and unwary.

entries.name: The Escape
entries.how: I suppose I'll learn as we go... Couldn't be too hard. Just some buttons here, and a lever or two... Well, are you ready to go?

entries.name: Raptor Horns
entries.how:
The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands.  And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns!  If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks."  I could sell them for a fortune!!!

And you can help me.  Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws.  They roam in the southern Barrens, and in the northern Barrens near the border of Ashenvale Forest.

entries.name: Harpy Raiders
entries.how:
The blasted harpies have been ravaging our caravan supplies for too long. It's time we slit a few of their throats and diminished their numbers.

I've been snooping around their nests and figured out who leads who. The most devastating attack will destroy a good section of their lower chain of command and then we can work our way to the top.

I'll start you off slow, take out Witchwing Harpies and Witchwing Roguefeathers in the Northwest and bring me 8 Witchwing talons. That should be a good start...

entries.name: Egg Hunt
entries.how:
Hey, {name}. I been sent to the Crossroads to watch over the land and take note of its happenings for my masters in Orgrimmar.

One object of my studies are the insect-like creatures found to the south in the Field of Giants. We know little of the creatures, so I be makin' it a point to discover more. They seem to have intelligence to them, more so than any normal animal.

Take this digging claw and collect some of the creatures' eggs from their mounds, but be careful: if alerted, they will attack you.

entries.name: Raptor Thieves
entries.how:
Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen from our guard tower.  It was meant as payroll to the Crossroads' guards, and we want that silver back.

The strange thing is... we caught one of the thieves on the night of the theft.  And... it was a raptor!  Unbelievable!

I don't know what raptors would want with silver.  But I don't care -- I want the raptors dead so they won't steal from us again!

Hunt raptors in the Barrens.  Collect for me their heads!

entries.name: The Forgotten Pools
entries.how:
Long ago, the Barrens was a lush place, teeming with life.  But war and cataclysm raged across the land, scorching it and leaving a dry husk.  Such is the way of things, and it saddens my heart.

But within the past few years, new oases have formed in the Barrens, and life stirs.  And deep down, we druids sense a power leaking its way to the surface.

We must find its source.  Travel to the Forgotten Pools, northwest of the Crossroads.  Search its waters for a source of power, then return here.

entries.name: Disrupt the Attacks
entries.how:
All the quilboars are our enemies, {name}. Some just prove to be more of a nuisance than others.

The Razormane tribe has been attacking our supply lines from Durotar, causing us no end of annoyance. I have scouts seeking the leader of these raids, but until then, any losses you can inflict on the filthy pig men would aid us.

Start in the northeast towards Durotar. You can always tell their dens from the huge thorny vines that come up from the earth. Seek them out, and slay them.

entries.name: The Disruption Ends
entries.how:
One of my scouts witnessed an attack on a caravan from Durotar, {name}. The culprits are indeed the Razormane tribe of quilboars. One of the quilboars in particular is leading the raids: Kreenig Snarlsnout. He was seen northeast of here, just south of the road from Durotar. If the threat is to be ended, then Kreenig must die.

To be sure the attacks cease, though, I say we add insult to their injury. Kill Kreenig along with more of their tribe, and return to me when you have his tusk.

entries.name: Isha Awak
entries.how:
The grand Isha Awak is lord of these waters.  Great is his strength, and solemn his pride.  The humans on the coast fear him, for he has consumed many of their number.

But I do not fear him.  I am grateful he is here.  He is a worthy challenge, and honorable prey.

If you are ready, then swim out and search for Isha Awak, the Deep Doom.

His spirit dwells in his heart, and to hear its beat is to know your fate.

entries.name: Mahren Skyseer
entries.how:
You have hunted the beasts of the Barrens.  Your spirit is strong.  But a hunter must always be prepared.  A true hunter can stalk prey down any path.  Mountains and swamps will not sway him.

Not even the sea.

Find my sister, Mahren.  She hunts the great water beasts along the coast.  She will be your teacher in their ways.

But be wary in your search for her, for the Barrens' coast is held by humans.

entries.name: Harpy Lieutenants
entries.how:
Hahaha, {name}. Back for more? Good, I like to hear that.

This time I want you to assassinate some of the harpy lieutenants in the Dry Hills. Only Witchwing Slayers can be lieutenants, and you can tell them apart by the rings they carry. They are a nasty bunch, but they lead some of the underlings in that area. Taking out 6 of them will be a decisive strike against their matriarchy.

Make sure they die painfully, {name}. We want those harpy wenches to know the idiocy of picking fights with the Horde.

entries.name: Serena Bloodfeather
entries.how:
You did so well with the lieutenants and underlings that I'd like you to do one last thing for me.

Serena Bloodfeather is the sister of a harpy named Bloodfeather who was slain by Rexxar quite a while ago. Apparently, these attacks on the Horde caravans are revenge for her sister's death.

I need you to slit her throat and bring me back her head. I want to place it on the next caravan we send out... Give those harpies something to think about.

entries.name: The Stagnant Oasis
entries.how:
Like the one you found at the Forgotten Pools, there may be fissures at the other oases in the Barrens.  If so, then perhaps the fissures are the oases' source of life.

We must test this.

Here, take these seeds.  They are dead and infertile, but take them to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast.  If there is a fissure there, then place the seeds within it...and observe.

entries.name: Tribes at War
entries.how:
You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war.

If you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.

entries.name: Betrayal from Within
entries.how:
Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the Horde, {race}. <snort> They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the Barrens will learn peace... <snort> at least from the Razormane tribe. <snort>

Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south  of the Barrens. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, <snort> a warrior. Kill them, {race}, like they have killed me.

entries.name: Altered Beings
entries.how:
Your findings are incredible, {name}.  These oases hold properties that must come from an outside source.  Or perhaps an inside one.

I want to know how these fissures are affecting the beasts who drink from the oases' water.

Hunt oasis snapjaws at the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases.  Bring me their shells so I may examine them.

entries.name: Echeyakee
entries.how:
Whitemist, Echeyakee in the Tauren tongue, is the king of the savannah cats.  He hunts with such stealth, they say he's like a thin, white mist on the earth.  And he kills so fast his prey have no time for fear, or pain.

The Tauren say he is both mercy and death.

You will learn if that's true, for I now set you on the path to hunt Echeyakee.  His lair is northeast of the Crossroads, among the bones of giant Kodo

Go.  Blow this horn when you reach his lair.  Blow the horn, and he will come.

entries.name: Ishamuhale
entries.how:
Ishamuhale, Speartooth, is the fiercest sunscale raptor of the Barrens.  He does not hunt for sport, nor for food.  He hunts because hunting is his passion.  He kills because it is his nature to kill.

And you will learn of his nature, {name}, for your path now follows the taloned tracks of Ishamuhale.

Begin the hunt.  Slay his favorite prey, a zhevra, then bring its carcass to the dead tree northwest of Ratchet.  Ishamuhale will smell the carcass and be drawn to it.

Be ready when he comes.

entries.name: Lakota'mani
entries.how: The Hoof of Lakota'mani is a symbol of the strength of the great kodo.

entries.name: Owatanka
entries.how: When touched, sparks fly from the tailspike of Owatanka.

entries.name: Washte Pawne
entries.how: The feather of Washte Pawne is painful to the touch.

entries.name: The Barrens Oases
entries.how:
The druids of Thunder Bluff sense a strange power leaking into the Barrens, east of Mulgore.

Tonga Runetotem was sent to discover the source of this power, but we fear he will need aid.

Travel to the Barrens and speak with Tonga.  He will be at the Crossroads.  To reach there, take the road east out of Bloodhoof village.  Enter the Barrens, then turn north when the road forks.  Continue north and  you will find the Crossroads.

And do not leave the road, {name}, for the Barrens is a harsh land.

entries.name: Southsea Freebooters
entries.how:
I sure wish Vice Admiral Grezzlik did a better job of keeping the seas safe for our trading vessels. With all the gold the trade princes have poured into the Trade Fleets, it ticks me off to see so many pirates running willy-nilly, raiding my ships and stealing my goods!

I heard that the Southsea Freebooters have set up a camp just south of here. They've been a real thorn in my side and if Grezzlik won't take care of them, well, maybe you can help me get rid of them.

entries.name: Stolen Booty
entries.how:
While I'd like to recover all my goods, I'm sure that's not possible. Still, there's a few things that I absolutely must have!

As you see, my observatory is ready to go, but it needs the smaller of the two lenses. The first arrived by caravan from Durotar, but the second was bound by ship, and never arrived. Also, I never got my boot shipment from Drizzlik in Booty Bay!

Head down to the pirate camp and see if you can find them.

entries.name: Spirit of the Wind
entries.how:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.

entries.name: The Missing Shipment
entries.how:
I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?

Here, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.

entries.name: The Guns of Northwatch
entries.how:
Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans at Northwatch Hold!

Those bastards must be dealt with. Their paranoia has them in a state of frenzy. Trigger happy, reckless louts are shooting at anything in their sights.

Travel south along the Merchant Coast to the Hold and lay siege to their forces. Bring me the medals of their soldiers as proof. And for the love of my fleet, slay Captain Fairmount and her overzealous cannoneers!

entries.name: The Missing Shipment
entries.how:
Everything looks square from my records, {name}. Go on back and tell Gazlowe he's out of luck. I wouldn't be surprised if it was the pirates that nabbed his goodies.

Nothing else I can do for him. Oh... though you could tell him that I've got some things from Undermine for him, when he has the time to come pick them up.

entries.name: Weapons of Choice
entries.how:
The Razormane quilboars to the south, beyond the Field of Giants, have no skilled blacksmiths from what I am told, but they've apparently started to develop sturdier weapons. I'd like to get my hands on a few different types to learn their techniques if possible.

If you wish to help bring honor to the Horde, then bring me examples of their weapons. Find me a dagger from their stalkers, a wand from their seers, and a shield from their warfrenzy. That should do nicely!

entries.name: Samophlange
entries.how:
The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".

Now what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.

I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.

entries.name: WANTED: Baron Longshore
entries.how:
WANTED!

Baron Longshore, Captain of the Heedless

Captain Longshore of Gilneas leads vessels of the Southsea Freebooters, and is wanted on charges of piracy. Remains must be in identifiable condition!

-- Gazlowe

entries.name: Miner's Fortune
entries.how:
Being Wharfmaster of a busy port like Ratchet, I keep my finger on the pulse of information. I know all about the exchange of goods and money between here and Booty Bay.

The latest bit of news I've heard is about the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine northeast of the Sludge Fen. One of the miners discovered an emerald the size of your fist. I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale.

entries.name: The Harvester
entries.how: This strange, insect-like creature looks outside of the natural order, as though it does not belong in the Barrens.

entries.name: Free From the Hold
entries.how:
Finally! Someone to rescue me!

I can't believe you got past the guards. These zealots from Theramore are out of their minds. They sank our ship and imprisoned me, the only survivor. I was called an enemy and threat to the Alliance.

Me! A threat to their great sham of an Alliance? I was a deckhand on a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay.

Enough talk. Help me get back to Ratchet will you? Let me know when you're ready and we'll make our break.

entries.name: Consumed by Hatred
entries.how:
Perhaps you know the pain of uncertainty, perhaps not, {class}. But know this: I stand here every day, from the sun's rising till its decline, scouring the horizon for more of those monsters. I've killed every pig man I've come across since, but my thirst for their blood is far from quenched. Perhaps instead of heading north to the Crossroads I should have headed to Taurajo.

You, {class}--you  could help me.

Kill them. Kill as many as you can. Bring me their tusks, and we will celebrate their deaths together.

entries.name: Samophlange
entries.how: The three control valves are currently opened. The various readings on the control panel lead you to presume that they must be shut off before the apparatus can be shut off.

entries.name: Samophlange
entries.how: With the apparatus deactivated, the control panel can be opened up and the samophlange removed from the console. With everything else in place, all that is left is to acquire the key to unlock the console.

entries.name: Samophlange
entries.how: Pulling open the face of the control console reveals a dense jumble of wires, tubing and other strange mechanical objects--most of which seem to serve no practical purpose. Pushing them aside and digging deeper into the console, you find the samophlange. A tug removes it from its housing.

entries.name: Prowlers of the Barrens
entries.how:
Now it's time to go after something that really bites.  The prowlers of the Barrens are a tough breed.  Tough, resourceful, sly... and deadly.  You'll find them among the tall grasses.  You'll find many to the southwest of the Crossroads.

Be wary as you hunt them, {name}, or you may find yourself no longer the predator, but instead the prey.

entries.name: The Angry Scytheclaws
entries.how:
Now, {name}, the hunt deepens.  Now you must defeat your prey, and then find your way to its lair.

Hunt the sunscale raptors to the south.  Slay them and remove the feathers they wear.  Place the feathers on the scytheclaw nests southwest of the Stagnant Oasis. Show their brethren you do not fear them!

entries.name: Betrayal from Within
entries.how:
Take Lok's head to Thork in the Crossroads, {race}. <snort> He should know what has happened to my tribe without any words--ha, not that he would believe Mangletooth helped in <snort> such things. But I am sure he'll reward you for carrying out such a great deed. <snort>

I will continue to bless you with Agamaggan's power for as long as I remain in this cage, {race}. Until then, farewell.

entries.name: Enraged Thunder Lizards
entries.how:
Now, {name}, you must face the great thunder lizards.  So large are the beasts, the ground rumbles as they stomp across the plains.  Take care as you fight them, for one false step and you may find yourself beneath their feet.

You will find the thunder lizards in the southern Barrens.  They are known as Stormsnouts, Stormhides and Thunderheads.  Return to me after you have bested them.

entries.name: Cry of the Thunderhawk
entries.how:
The thunderhawk, {name}, is a fierce beast.  It is time for you to face them.  You must find where it roams, and bring me its wings as proof of your successful hunt.

Do this, and your time with me will near its end.

entries.name: Letter to Jin'Zil
entries.how:
You've done so well for me, {name}. You're a regular lucky rabbit's foot and there's something I want you to see.

The harpies are not from around the Barrens. They come from a place called Stonetalon, far to the northwest of here. Though it is probably a dangerous place for you, I need this letter delivered to an old friend of mine who lives there, a witch doctor by the name of Jin'Zil.

He'll be happy to know that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and I think you'll find Stonetalon an interesting place.

entries.name: Deepmoss Spider Eggs
entries.how:
Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay!  The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.

I smell an opportunity!

In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider.  Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!

In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.

In Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...

entries.name: The Swarm Grows
entries.how:
Many travelers who've come through the Crossroads helped me gather eggs from the Field of Giants, and many of them have tales of how deadly the creatures are. I've heard enough to consider them insects a much larger threat than my masters first thought.

I need a courier to travel to Orgrimmar to meet Belgrom Rockmaul. It be no simple matter, and someone who would take the task seriously should go.

Belgrom usually be found outside the warriors' guild house.

entries.name: A New Ore Sample
entries.how:
{class}, you have done well in helping me in the past. The warchief is pleased thus far with what I've accomplished, and asks me to continue with renewed determination. My honor dictates that I give you proper recognition to the warchief for all you have done, but first I would ask you for your help again.

Travelers recently came from the south from a place called Thousand Needles. There they killed a kobold who had an unusual ore sample, but they would not sell it. I want a sample of that ore to examine.

entries.name: Ziz Fizziks
entries.how:
The Venture Company stole many of the best goblin minds, but from time to time, we get the opportunity to steal some back.

A while ago, the Venture Company outfit in the Stonetalon Mountains hired Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle--a gnome! Their other engineer, Ziz Fizziks, was so taken aback by this, he pleaded with me to find him new employment with the Tinkers' Union. I set him on a few tasks, but he might need help.

Maybe you could look in on him for me? He's stationed at the western edge of Windshear Crag.

entries.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
entries.how:
I have need to send a crate of potions, reagents and other items to my associates in the Old World. Little time I have to actually see them to the dock at Ratchet, and the last caravan has already left.

If you could, please take this to Wharfmaster Dizzywig. He will ensure that it is placed on the next boat to Blackwater Cove.

entries.name: Jorn Skyseer
entries.how: Your time with me is over, {name}.  To learn more, you must go to Camp Taurajo to the south and speak with Jorn Skyseer.  He will continue your guidance.

entries.name: Stolen Silver
entries.how:
You may have killed the raptors, but the silver they stole must be recovered!  I have reports that the raptors have a large grouping of nests south of Ratchet, known as the Raptor Grounds.  It is likely that they brought our stolen silver there.

Go to this raptor haven and search for the stolen silver.  When you find it, return it to me.

entries.name: Mura Runetotem
entries.how:
My clanmate, Mura Runetotem, traveled to Silverpine so that she might aid our undead allies.  Silverpine is an ailing forest, a dying forest, and it was Mura's hope to bring it new life.  Perhaps the strange life found here in the Barrens can help her work in Silverpine.

Take a sample of the shells you gathered, and bring it to Mura in Silverpine.  She is staying at the Sepulcher.  With luck, studying the shell will give her the insight she needs to heal that dying place.

entries.name: In Nightmares
entries.how:
This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.

I do not wish to alarm you, {name}, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can.

Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise is who you need to find. Head to Thunder Bluff. I cannot say more.

entries.name: In Nightmares
entries.how:
This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.

I do not wish to alarm you, {name}, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can... 

Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Circle is who you need to find. Head to Darnassus. I cannot say more.

entries.name: The Runed Scroll
entries.how:
The official-looking scroll is wrapped tightly with a silvery ribbon. You're sure someone would be interested in seeing this, but who?

There is an outpost close to the Ashenvale border to the north, and if the information on this scroll involves the night elves, this would be the place to take it.

entries.name: Horde Presence
entries.how:
This scroll is from that scheming dryad Rynthariel, Keymaster of the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak.

She'll not be making any more contact with the messenger you looted this from, heh, but we must stand our ground here. The Horde will not tolerate her outrunners here.

{name}, travel to the Talon Den. Kill Rynthariel, and then put up a symbol for all to see. Take this Horde flag, {name}. Put it up in the Talon Den so that they will not be so rash as to send another messenger through our territory again.

entries.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
entries.how:
I think I might have broken that Samophlange.  That's not good, because I already told some colleagues in Undermine about it and they were very intrigued.  We must find a way to fix it!

Take the broken samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket, just south of Mor'shan Rampart, the horde outpost between the Barrens and Ashenvale.  She is very clever and inquisitive.  If you show her the samophlange I bet she'd jump at the chance to fix it.

entries.name: Nugget Slugs
entries.how:
I want to fix this samophlange, but to do that I'm going to need some supplies.  I ran out of seventeen-point-five gauge nugget slugs and I'm going to need a bunch of those for the work ahead.

The closest place to get them is the Sludge Fen to the east.  The Venture Company usually keeps them in their tool buckets.  Go to the Sludge Fen and look in the tool buckets you find there, then return to me when you've gathered enough nugget slugs.

entries.name: Rilli Greasygob
entries.how:
Well, that didn't work.  I put some extra gauges on the samophlange to measure its structural integrity, and they read the integrity at an all-time low.  I could add some more dials and maybe a lever or two to try and fix it, but... I think that might make things even worse.

You should take the samophlange to Rilli Greasygob.  He used to work for the Venture Company -- if anyone knows how to fix it, it's Rilli.

You can find him at Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar, in the Valley of Honor.

entries.name: Samophlange Manual
entries.how:
I think I can fix the samophlange, but I'm going to need the user's manual first.  When I was in the Venture Company I had a rival, Boss Copperplug, who hoarded the secrets of the samophlange, giving out small bits of knowledge on the device to those he trusted.  I wasn't one of the trusted few...

Boss Copperplug used to stay at the Boulder Lode Mine in northeastern Barrens.  Get the manual from him, and if he's given pages from it to anyone, you'll have to collect them too.

entries.name: Counterattack!
entries.how:
The Horde commends your successes against the Kolkar, but the Kolkar themselves are maddened.  I have reports that a contingent of Kolkar has traveled to the Barrens from their home in Desolace, to seek vengeance.  My latest report was that, even now, they move against these bunkers, from the west!

Face the Kolkar invaders, and end their threat in the Barrens.  Kill them until their leader, Warlord Krom'zar, appears.  Defeat him and bring me a piece of his banner as proof.

We're counting on you, {name}.

entries.name: Lost in Battle
entries.how:
We battled in a small tauren camp when we were separated--she held three of the Bristlebacks off by herself. But the odds began to overwhelm us. I led some away only to see her overwhelmed by newcomers. In my rage, I turned to face my enemies, but they brought me down easily with their vast numbers.

I awoke to a tauren druid tending my wounds--he had come across me on the Gold Road as I fell.

Please, {class}, find some sign of my wife.

entries.name: Supplies for the Crossroads
entries.how:
That attack on the caravan contained supplies we desperately needed.

You've been brave enough to take on the Razormane tribe so far, and I will ask you to do so again, but this time, I wonder if I could ask you to keep your eyes open for some of our lost supplies. You can probably find them throughout their camps, the quilboar getting fat off their dishonorable acts.

The people of the Crossroads would be in your debt.

entries.name: Agamaggan's Strength
entries.how:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, {race}.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!

entries.name: Agamaggan's Agility
entries.how:
My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue <snort> could measure up to their quickness in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.

entries.name: Wisdom of Agamaggan
entries.how:
The shaman and geomancers of the quilboar tribes <snort> call upon the strength of Agamaggan to help them in battle and in their rituals, {race}.

If you too wish the added power of Agamaggan's blessing with your spells, then bring me 4 blood shards and Mangletooth will aid you. <snort>

entries.name: Rising Spirit
entries.how:
Warriors of all types <snort> have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the <snort> Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess <snort> in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle. <snort>

entries.name: Razorhide
entries.how:
All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection.

entries.name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
entries.how:
Along with the thorns, the blood affected <snort> other aspects of the earth: blood red stones mixed in with other minerals. The Bristleback dig up these shards and carry them as totems <snort> for strength in battle and as totems for their magics. <snort>

I know the secrets of that magic.

Bring Mangletooth one of these blood shards to show you understand. Bring Mangletooth many of the shards, and he will bless you with quilboar magic--the magic of Agamaggan! <snort>

entries.name: A Bundle of Hides
entries.how:
I have a bundle of hides from the animals of the Barrens, and must get them to Thunder Bluff.  A colleague there, Ahanu, will use the hides to create leather goods.

Will you take the hides to him for me?

The quickest way to Thunder Bluff is on the back of a wind rider.  Bring the bundle of hides to Devrak, our wind rider master in the Crossroads, and speak to him about transport to Thunder Bluff.

entries.name: Ride to Thunder Bluff
entries.how:
For a small fee, I will give you a wind rider to Thunder Bluff.  There's no faster way to the city!

If that is acceptable, speak to me again when you are ready to go.

If you're taking those hides to Ahanu, then I think he's at Hewa's Armory, at the base of the wind rider tower in Thunder Bluff.  And that's right where you'll land!

entries.name: Tal the Wind Rider Master
entries.how:
I have prepared leather goods for Jahan to sell at the Crossroads.  Will you bring them to him?

If you have already been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master, then you can fly one of our Thunder Bluff wind riders back to him.

Take the leather goods to Tal, our wind rider master in Thunder Bluff, and speak with him to arrange transport to the Crossroads.

entries.name: Return to Jahan
entries.how:
In order to fly to a town, you must have already been there and spoken with the wind rider master of that town.  You have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so for a small fee you can take a wind rider to him from here.

Speak with me again when you are ready.  Once at the Crossroads, you can then deliver the leather goods to Jahan Hawkwing.

entries.name: Meats to Orgrimmar
entries.how:
I have some choice cuts of meat that I want to send to a friend.  Her name is Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar.  Will you deliver the meat for me?

The fastest way to Orgrimmar is on a wind rider.  Take the meats to the Crossroads wind rider master, Devrak, and speak with him about transport to Orgrimmar.

entries.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
entries.how:
Your strength impresses me, {class}.  Your willingness to embrace the hunt gives me confidence that you could move on to bigger game... and bigger challenges.

The forests of Ashenvale represent a vast untamed wild that the Horde seeks to impose its own will upon, both politically and spiritually.  If you seek to prove yourself in an unproven land, seek the guidance of Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post.  The outpost is due north of the path leading from the Barrens.

entries.name: Ride to Orgrimmar
entries.how:
For just a few coins I will have a wind rider bring you to Orgrimmar.  When you get there, you can take Zargh's Meats to Gryshka.  Her inn is in the Valley of Strength, not far from the Skytower, where my wind rider will drop you off.

Speak with me again when you are ready for the journey.

entries.name: Doras the Wind Rider Master
entries.how:
I've written a letter of thanks to Zargh.  Will you deliver it for me?  If you've already been to the Crossroads and spoken with their wind rider master, then you can fly a wind rider back there.

Take my letter to Doras, the wind rider master of Orgrimmar, and speak with him about transport to the Crossroads.

entries.name: Return to the Crossroads
entries.how:
My wind riders are trained to fly to many different places, as long as you have already been to that place and spoken with the wind rider master there.

You have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so now you can fly directly to him from here.  Once you're at the Crossroads, you can deliver Gryshka's letter to Zargh.

Speak with me when you are ready to go.

entries.name: Report to Kadrak
entries.how:
Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.

If you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.

entries.name: The Warsong Reports
entries.how:
I recently deployed a few scouts into Ashenvale and I need a runner to take them their orders, and bring me back a report of what they have observed.

Your first stop should be the Zoram'gar Outpost, along the coast to the west, at the Zoram Strand, to locate the first runner. You also need to stop at Splintertree Post, to the north, and along the road to the east, near Azshara. You will find a scout and an outrider there.

Give them each a report, and from them, get an update on their findings.

entries.name: Mending Old Wounds
entries.how:
You'd better think twice before setting foot in Ratchet, {name}!  Word's been getting around of your dirty deeds.

You're in luck though, a ship just arrived with many wounded from an encounter with the Bloodsail Buccaneers.  This is your chance to prove you're not a complete scoundrel.  Lend us a hand by bringing linen cloth for bandages and empty vials for potions.

entries.name: Rumors Abound
entries.how:
Whispers within the shadows speak of a weapon containing the soul of a great demonic being. Lesser demons like Soran'ruk are one thing, but much more powerful entities, bound as punishment for their failures, offer unimaginable power.

This weapon was lost ages ago, shattered during the Third War.

Recently these rumors have said that mages meddling with dark magic beyond their comprehension have claimed fragments of the weapon, but they are unable to unlock the powers without reforming it.

entries.name: The Conjuring
entries.how:
The demon, Des'Altek, seems to have broken free of it's prison, but its still bound to it like a prisoner to their cell. We must summon forth the demon to capture its soul again.

To the north, in Ashenvale, where great demons fell, there is a location on the ridge that was once used by the Legion for sacrifices. The ground is permanently scarred from the atrocities that occurred here, but if we can gather the Blood of the Legion from the demons that still infest this land... that's the key.

entries.name: Mysterious Traveler
entries.how:
What? Where am I? How... how did I get here?

<The man before you stumbles around as if sea sick. His eyes widen and his hands tremble and you stare at each other in a moment of shared confusion.>

Ah... A fellow warlock I see. Perhaps we discuss what led to this series of events and maybe we can find out what went wrong?

<Unsure of what to do next, you suggest they return to speak with Doan Karhan.>

entries.name: ... and that note you found
entries.how:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."

entries.name: Stepping Stones
entries.how: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."

entries.name: WANTED: Bruuz
entries.how:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe

entries.name: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides
entries.how:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.

entries.name: The Hermit Tanner
entries.how:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.

entries.name: Vrang's Game
entries.how:
While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.

Bring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.

entries.name: Unwelcome Guests
entries.how:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!

entries.name: Trouble in the Valley
entries.how:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras. 

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.

entries.name: Her Name Is Olgra
entries.how:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.

entries.name: Sign Me Up!
entries.how:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Durotar Supply & Logistics Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!

entries.name: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle
Legacy Reward: Reins of the Spectral Bear
Chol'aruk the Ravener
entries.how:
You there, {class}. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, {class}.

entries.name: Chol'aruk the Ravener
entries.how:
There are rumors of a colossal abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say it's so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.

Few believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.

Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me its head.

entries.name: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected
entries.how:
Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.

Rumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.

Kill first, investigate later!

entries.name: Parts and Pieces
entries.how:
Hey, got a sec?

So, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!

I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?

entries.name: Journey to the Crossroads
entries.how:
After journeying here from the elemental plane, the problems our lands face may seem small. Rest assured, the dangers the horde faces are very real, and you will grow formidable should you survive your service.

If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, travel southwest to the vast lands known as the Barrens. There is a settlement there known as the Crossroads. The proud citizens there are ever in need of aid.

Go with honor, adventurer!

entries.name: Field to Clear
entries.how:
I'm so glad you saw me!

The weather was lovely this morning, so I walked from Camp Taurajo down the golden road. When it came time to head back, I couldn't--a pack of hyenas started circling, and Stormhide lizards blocked my only escape.

Scrambling up this tree I went, and now there are too many foes about at this hour for me to make the run home through the fields.

Would you mind clearing out these Stormhide and Hecklefang Stalkers for me?

entries.name: Shipping Label
entries.how:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Return damaged shipments or empty crates to the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade outpost, now conveniently located due west of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Your time is valuable and we will compensate you for your efforts!"

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>

entries.name: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Armguards
entries.how:
You are a heathen.  Heathens have a place in the tribe.  Heathens are freethinkers of Zandalar.  Freethinkers do not fear oppression.  Freethinkers die for what they believe in.  We know you would die for what you believe in.  This earns our acknowledgement.  This earns you a chance to prove yourself further.

We must have the Paragons of Power.  Go to Zul'Gurub.  Kill the minions of Hakkar.  Return when you have what I seek.  Claim the first battle gear of a Zandalar freethinker.

Go.

entries.name: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Belt
entries.how:
Your beliefs are alien to us, heathen.  Ancient Zandalar were once branded as heretics.  This was when the Gurubashi Empire was strong.  Heathens dared to challenge the priest of Hakkar.  Heathens then were hunted and killed as vermin.  Those heathens never wavered in their fight against the Blood God.  We honor the price they paid.  They are the freethinkers.

Destroy the minions of Hakkar in Zul'Gurub.  Bring me the Paragons of Power I seek.  Success will be greatly rewarded.

Go.

entries.name: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Breastplate
entries.how:
Battle gear gives you power in the tribe.  The freethinkers are honored in this way.  They are zealots.  They imbue their breastplates with powerful mojo.  If their beliefs falter in the face of the enemy, their breastplate will not.

You must be revered amongst us to possess such a breastplate.  Go to Zul'Gurub.  Take the Paragons of Power I need.  Take the Paragons most painfully from the fools inside.  Bring them to me.  Prove your worth as a freethinker once and for all.

entries.name: Paragons of Power: The Augur's Bracers
entries.how:
The augurs of our tribe are revered for their gifts of the divine sight, ya mon.  They ain't a witch doctor; they spend their time castin' bones or readin' the leaves for insight - not hexin' people.  As a shaman, you already know somethin' about the power of augury; we Zandalar prize the insight they give to the tribe.

Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us.  Do this for us, and I'll give ya some bracers that our augurs prize above all others!

entries.name: Paragons of Power: The Haruspex's Bracers
entries.how:
A haruspex is a key member of our tribe; you'll be wise to listen to their portents.  By communion with animals and givin' them up to the spirits when needed, they give us divine guidance.  In times past, the haruspex's insight and wisdom gave us an edge in the wars against the splintered tribes of the Gurubashi.

Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us.  Do this, and I'll give ya bracers that any haruspex of the Zandalar would want.

entries.name: Paragons of Power: The Vindicator's Armguards
entries.how:
Vengeance is power.  The Zandalar vindicator is such power.  The tribe has many enemies.  The vindicator exacts retribution on them.  No crime against us is unpunished.  The vindicator delivers this punishment.  Our enemies fear our vengeance.  They should.  They forever will.

Become one of our vindicators.  Seek the Paragons of Power inside Zul'Gurub.  Slay the minions of Hakkar and claim vengeance in the tribe's name.  You will be rewarded.

entries.name: Paragons of Power: The Demoniac's Wraps
entries.how:
Warlocks tread dangerous ground in dealing with demons, but our demoniacs take this one step further.  Through an ancient and arcane ritual, they allow a demon to enter their being.  Rather than let it possess them though, they enslave the demon from the inside, absorbing the power of the beast for their own command.  It is a feat few are ever able to master.

For you to learn of the power of the demoniac, I must have Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub.  Go there and retrieve that which we seek.

entries.name: Paragons of Power: The Illusionist's Wraps
entries.how:
Mages in our tribe are known as illusionists.  They employ powerful mojo in their incantations, often befuddling and confusing the tribe's enemies!

<Al'tabim laughs wickedly.>

It is quite the sight to see a powerful illusionist at work, bringing our enemies to their knees from their own madness!

For you to know the way of our illusionists, go to Zul'Gurub and bring back to me selected Paragons of Power.  For this, I will give you arm wraps our illusionists use to weave their spells.

entries.name: Paragons of Power: The Confessor's Wraps
entries.how:
We Zandalar invest power in those who speak with the authority of divinity.  Our priests are more than just healers - they are our confessors.  Evil comes both from outside threats - such as Hakkar - and from within the tribe.  Our confessors act as the judges amongst us, preserving us from the same evil that devoured the Gurubashi from inside itself.

Go to Zul'Gurub and bring back the Paragons of Power from the Gurubashi.  Learn what it means to be the confessor, and preserve us from evil.

entries.name: Paragons of Power: The Predator's Bracers
entries.how:
In the dark times after the fall of the Gurubashi Empire, Zandalar predators used their prowess to provide sustenance for the tribe.  Hunters claim to be much like our tribe's predators - to seek the hunt is to embody the essence of the predator, yes.  Your hunt in Zul'Gurub, however, will show us how you truly rate amongst our finest predators.

Bring to me a sampling of the Paragons of Power from within Zul'Gurub.  Do so, and you'll take first steps in becoming the penultimate predator.

entries.name: Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Bracers
entries.how:
The madcaps of Zandalar are similar to rogues, but above all else they embrace madness... chaos... the unpredictability of existence.  A terror to behold on the battlefield, they sowed the seeds of confusion and mayhem amongst our enemies in the savage times after the tribes splintered.  We would not be here today without them.

Bring to me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub that I seek, and I will grant you the first of the madcap's prized armors.  Embrace the madness!

entries.name: Paragons of Power: The Haruspex's Belt
entries.how:
We Zandalar know not of druidic ways; nature is to be shaped by our need, not the other way around.  Still, a haruspex is the one of us most in tune with nature, and rightly so.  To give up the ghost of a beastie is to know what it is to be one of them.  That is the real power of nature.

Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub, proving yourself to us.  Do this, and I'll give ya a powerful item - a belt used by many of the Zandalar's haruspices.

Strong mojo, ya mon!
