Tell ya what... bring me what I need to whip up a Kalimdor Kocktail and I'll tell ya all about it.

Gonna need some Roc gizzards from Tanaris... and let's see... some Groddoc and Ironfur livers from Feralas...

A nice stiff Kalimdor Kocktail... that'll get me talking!

entries.name: Rhapsody's Tale
entries.how:
Before the flight, I drank me a whole keg of stout. Hiccup!

And what a flight it was. Zipping around with Brohann following me. Didn't see no temple though. Hiccup!

Well, didn't see no temple till I got a little too tipsy and fell off my mount. I plunged right into the water and was sucked down. Found myself surrounded by a bunch of creepy trolls. Sure swam out of there fast! Even made off with this troll souvenir. Here, take it to Brohann and let him know his temple is down there, indeed. Hiccup!

entries.name: Rin'ji is Trapped!
entries.how:
Hey {race}!

Rin'ji lost axe and was captured! Please, help Rin'ji escape. Me know that {race} like you don't like Rin'ji's kind, but Rin'ji begs! Must get out of here!

Got something for nice {race} if he helps Rin'ji out of here...

Rin'ji is hiding something secret at the Overlook Cliffs.

entries.name: Rin'ji's Secret
entries.how:
The tablet is covered with Witherbark troll markings. Rin'ji's secret truly is a mystery... 

It's possible that you might have something quite valuable on your hands here. On the other hand, quite the opposite is also possible. A Witherbark troll in distress would probably do anything to find his way out of trouble...

entries.name: Skulk Rock Clean-up
entries.how:
We Wildhammers remember the past, more than our brothers in Ironforge.  If you want to make friends here, then you get your hands dirty for us!

The Horde abandoned their positions in the Hinterlands around Skulk Rock; it's now overrun with nasty sludges and oozes.  We've got plans on that area, but first we need a clean-up crew to make a hole for us.

That's where you come in, Sunshine!  Head down there and take out ten green sludges and ten jade oozes, then report back to me here.  Move out!

entries.name: Troll Necklace Bounty
entries.how:
Get this straight, {race} - we are NOT part of the Alliance!  The Wildhammers are independent, relying on deeds and actions to prove one's worth, rather than the blather of those who use jibber-jabber to bolster their do-nothing attitudes!

If you're looking for friends here, then prove your worth to us first!  The foul trolls that choke the hillsides of the Hinterlands sometimes carry tribal necklaces.  Bring five of them to me, and we'll mark it down as a step in the right direction for you.

entries.name: Troll Necklace Bounty
entries.how:
You've done it already, but we will continue to accept any troll tribal necklaces you find and are willing to turn in.  By turning them in to me, you'll continue to improve your standing amongst the Wildhammers; if you're willing to fight for us, then we'll be willing to fight for you!

I need five troll tribal necklaces for them to count, {name}.

entries.name: Grim Message
entries.how:
The Witherbark trolls were once allies to the Horde, but they betrayed Thrall... and that must be punished!

Here, take my pike and go to the Hinterlands, far to the north.  You will find it northeast of Tarren Mill, a village held by our allies, the Forsaken.

When you enter the Hinterlands, hunt Witherbark trolls.  Gather their skulls and drive my pike into the ground at one of their smaller villages, Hiri'watha or Zun'watha.

Show them their vile actions are of consequence!

entries.name: Venom Bottles
entries.how:
These bottles hold a vile, green venom.

Considering the number of bottles in this village, the Witherbarks must deem it very important.  Perhaps an apothecary in nearby Tarren Mill would like a sample.

entries.name: Undamaged Venom Sac
entries.how:
I must have a fresh sample of the venom you brought me.  The spiders from which it was gathered must dwell in the Hinterlands -- hunt them until you find an undamaged venom sac and bring it to me.  You will find many spiders near the troll city of Shadra'Alor.

Do not tarry, {name}, for the venom sac must be fresh when you deliver it.

entries.name: Consult Master Gadrin
entries.how:
The venom from the broodguards wasn't as potent as the venom you brought originally.  It must have come from a different spider.

I want a fresh sample of that venom.  To find out where it came from, you must consult with a troll who knows the Witherbark well--Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.  Travel to Durotar and speak with Gadrin.  With luck, he'll know where the Witherbarks get their venom.

entries.name: Summoning Shadra
entries.how: Take his parchment, and read it at the altar of Shadra'Alor, deep within the witherbark realm in the Hinterlands.  This will summon Shadra the spider god.

entries.name: Venom to the Undercity
entries.how:
The venom you gathered from the Witherbark's spider god is quite a find!  I've been able to kill nearly two dozen rabbits with just a drop of the stuff.  Granted, some of those rabbits were very young and small enough to fit in the palm of one's hand so I'm certain their resistance to toxins was low, but it can't be denied that this poison is powerful!

I'd like a sample sent to my superior, Apothecary Faranell in the Apothecarium of the Undercity.  I am positive he would want to test this himself.

entries.name: Witherbark Cages
entries.how:
The son of our mightiest gryphon is gone! Swiftwing's heir, Sharpbeak, was lost while hunting with his parents a few days ago, and we believe it was the trolls who took him.

You must aid us!  Search the cages in the two Witherbark troll villages to see if Sharpbeak is there.

entries.name: The Altar of Zul
entries.how: Sharpbeak was not with the Witherbark trolls.  Perhaps the Vilebranch trolls took him.  Go to the Altar of Zul on the western edge of Vilebranch territory and search for the gryphon child.

entries.name: Thadius Grimshade
entries.how:
Take this feather to Thadius Grimshade, the diviner.  He left Aerie Peak years ago to pursue darker knowledge, but in his heart he is still a Wildhammer!

And perhaps his talents can help us find Sharpbeak.

This feather was taken from the nest where the gryphon child sleeps.  If you give it to Thadius then, with luck, he can use his divining magics to find Sharpbeak.

Good luck, {name}.  You will find Thadius in the Blasted Lands, in the mage tower of Nethergarde Keep.

entries.name: The Divination
entries.how:
Give me room while I perform a ritual of divination.  I will find the connection between the feather you brought me and its owner, and follow that connection to Sharpbeak himself.

That is... I will if all goes according to plan.  If it does not, then... you better close your eyes.

entries.name: Return to the Hinterlands
entries.how:
Sharpbeak is held in a cage, high on a cliff at the top of Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.  The key to this cage is possessed by the high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, Vile Priestess Hexx.

There.  I have done my part.  I bid you fortune on your quest, {name}.

entries.name: Saving Sharpbeak
entries.how:
We must save Sharpbeak!

Fight your way to the top of Jintha'Alor in the heart of Vilebranch territory, gain the key to Sharpbeak's cage from the vile Priestess Hexx, and then find and save Sharpbeak!

entries.name: The Ancient Egg
entries.how:
The Prophecy of Mosh'aru speaks of an ancient egg.  It is a relic of a time when trolls ruled vast empires, and it has the power to hold the essence of Hakkar.  It may be the only way to keep our world safe from his evil.

Bring me the ancient egg, {name}.  It is said to lay hidden deep within Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands, in a cave behind the amphitheater at the top of the city.

entries.name: Snapjaws, Mon!
entries.how:
Don't let their big eyes fool you, mon! Those saltwater snapjaws be a menace. I can't fish for five minutes without getting a broken line from one of those oversized fish vacuums stealing my bait.

Do me and the people of Revantusk Village a service and kill em, mon.

Kill the whole lot of em!

entries.name: Gammerita, Mon!
entries.how:
Yo! There be a turtle out there not like the others. She be the Gammerita, leader of the saltwater snapjaws - a downright dirty thievin' reptile.

Mon, she stole my best lure. Snapped it right off my line! Since then, the fish just aren't biting the same.

Find Gammerita and get my lure out of her stomach.

entries.name: Stalking the Stalkers
entries.how:
Many brave trolls have been lost to the harsh wilds of the Hinterlands, {race}. The Silvermane wolves are one of the biggest threats to our hunters. They lay in wait, hiding amongst the bushes and landscape, then strike out when the opportunity presents itself.

This type of ferocity will not go unchecked!

You must think like the Silvermane. Stalk the stalkers! Slay them all!

entries.name: Hunt the Savages
entries.how:
Among the more ornery of the wildlife of the Hinterlands are the savage owlbeasts. Many a good Revantusk warrior has been lost to the ferocious claws and beak of the beasts.

Kill every savage owlbeast you see, {race}. Return to me when you can stand no more bloodshed. Your contribution will then be weighed, measured, and judged.

entries.name: Avenging the Fallen
entries.how:
The filth that calls itself Wildhammer trains gryphon to slay troll. Horrible, I know, but worry not, justice will soon be meted out.

For now, I want you to focus on eradicating the elder gryphons of the region. They are known as Skylords.

Slay one and return to me with its plume.

entries.name: Vilebranch Hooligans
entries.how:
Vilebranch scum invaded our village and stole my tools! I have backup tools but the set they stole was a gift given to me by a kind hearted gnome that saved my life when I was a young orc.

I want those tools back, {name} - they mean the world to me.

Markhor reported that the tools were spotted near the Agol'watha and Shaol'watha temples.

Those temples are in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands.

Recover my tools!

entries.name: Lard Lost His Lunch
entries.how: Lard was at secret special spot having picnic when ugly mean Vilebranch hit Lard wit da big stick. Lard run back to Revantusk but forget Lard lunch. Lard hungry. Maybe you go back to secret special spot and get Lard lunch? Lard scared. Go nort! Island der to da nort is da secret special spot.

entries.name: Message to the Wildhammer
entries.how:
The Wildhammer be striking up deals with our enemies, forgin' new alliances. This time, they be workin' with the high elves, mon.

<Otho spits.>

We be needin' to send those Wildhammer dwarves a message - a message in the blood of our enemies. Slaughter every Highvale high elf that you come across, leave their bodies as a warnin'.

Never mess with trolls!

entries.name: Another Message to the Wildhammer
entries.how:
They say the Wildhammer and gryphon are as close to each other as troll and mate. Disgusting, but we be able to use this to our advantage, mon. We send them another message.

Kill all the gryphons you see in the Hinterlands, collect their feathers. From this we make the final message.

entries.name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
entries.how:
<Otho hands you a long, blood drenched spear, wrapped in several gryphon feathers.>

You take this, mon. You take this to Aerie Peak, dead center of town by the well. You plant it! Drive it right into the ground! Show those dwarves that troll mean business! Come back when you do this. Hopefully you come back alive.

entries.name: Cannibalistic Cousins
entries.how:
Three different tribes of trolls inhabit the Hinterlands, {name}. That is about as far as the similarities between the tribes extends: We are all trolls and we live in the Hinterlands.

The Vilebranch - aptly named - are a depraved lot; feeding on other trolls and humanoids.

If Zul'jin were here, he would have destroyed the whole lot of them with a flick of his wrist - alas, Zul'jin has not yet returned and we are left to our own devices.

It is up to you to destroy the filth of the region!

entries.name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
entries.how:
My mate was taken by Vilebranch savages in a bold midnight raid on our village. Our spies have told me that he is still alive and being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor. The Vile Priestess Hexx is said to be preparing him for a sacrifice to the faceless blood God, Hakkar.

You must save him, {name}! Our village could not stand a loss this great.

entries.name: Recover the Key!
entries.how:
The key to my bindings is held by Hitah'ya the Keeper. She is in the nearby cave. Be careful, {class}, for she is guarded well.

Kill her and bring the key back to loosen my shackles. Only then will I be free to return home.

entries.name: Return to Primal Torntusk
entries.how: Return to my mate, Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village. Tell her that I am coming home! She is sure to reward you.

entries.name: Separation Anxiety
entries.how:
Like many in our village, I too have lost a loved one to the wilds. Alas, it was my twin brother Malkhor - taken in the same raid as Torntusk's mate by the Vilebranch.

Sadly, he was not fated to live and was given a swift, brutal execution; his remains fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch.

It is too late to save his life but not too late to save his soul. Recover his remains, {name}.

entries.name: Dark Vessels
entries.how:
The Vilebranch fight with supernatural ferocity. This is due to the foul magical weavings of the Vile Priestess Hexx.

Throughout Jintha'alor you will find dark vessels of tainted blood. The vessels radiate the foul magic of the faceless blood God, empowering the Vilebranch and also driving them to madness.

Steal those vessels and return them to me so that I may remove the taint and ultimately loosen the grip of the blood God.

entries.name: WANTED: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions
entries.how:
By order of Primal Torntusk, Vile Priestess Hexx and her minions are to be brought to justice!

A grand reward is offered for any that slay the Vile Priestess Hexx and all of her Aman'zasi elite guard.

entries.name: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village
entries.how:
With the loss of Guard Captain Malkhor, the position of Guard Captain of Revantusk is once again open. If you are interested in becoming Captain of the Guard for Revantusk, complete the following tasks and submit your application to Primal Torntusk:

Exterminate Vilebranch Berserkers.

Exterminate Vilebranch Shadow Hunters.

Exterminate Vilebranch Blood Drinkers.

Exterminate Vilebranch Soul Eaters.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission I: Defeat Moonkin
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Skulk Rock. Defeat moonkin there and return to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission II: Defeat Giant Turtles
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Shaol'watha. Defeat giant turtles there and return to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission III: Defeat Dragonkin
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Agol'watha. Defeat dragonkin there and return to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission IV: Dragon Intelligence
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Agol'wath. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Laninar there and return to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission V: Turtle Intelligence
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Shaol'wath. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Sanathel there and return to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission VI: Moonkin Intelligence
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Skulk Rock. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Valori there and return to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission VII: Recover Star-Touched Dragonegg
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Agol'watha. Retrieve a Star-Touched Dragonegg and deliver it to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission VIII: Recover Elunar Relic
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Skulk Rock. Retrieve an Elunar Relic the moonkin have hidden there and deliver it to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission IX: Recover Dreampearl
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Shaol'watha. Retrieve a Dreampearl the turtles have hidden there and deliver it to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission X: Star Lotus
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane and collect Star Lotus from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of an herbalist.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission XI: Starsilver Ore
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane and collect Starsilver Ore from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of a miner.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission XII: Starshells
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane and collect Sharshells from the giant turtles within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness their magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of a skinner.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission XIII: Defeat Florius
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in Agol'watha. Defeat the dragon Florius there and return to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission XIV: Defeat Doomkin
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Skulk Rock. Defeat the giant moonkin known as the Doomkin there and return to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission XV: Defeat Ghamoo-Raja
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Shaol'watha. Defeat the turtle "king" known as Ghamoo-Raja there and return to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission XVI: Rescue Elianar Shadowdrinker
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Agol'watha. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Elianar Shadowdrinker there and escort him to safety. Then return to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission XVII: Rescue Serlina Starbright
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Shol'watha. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Serlina Starbright there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.

entries.name: Hinterlands Mission XVIII: Rescue Veanna Cloudsleeper
entries.how: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Skulk Rock. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Veanna Cloudsleeper there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.

entries.name: Troll Necklace Bounty
entries.how:
You've done it already, but we will continue to accept any troll tribal necklaces you find and are willing to turn in.  By turning them in to me, you'll continue to improve your standing amongst the Wildhammers; if you're willing to fight for us, then we'll be willing to fight for you!

I need five troll tribal necklaces for them to count, {name}.

entries.name: More Star Lotus
entries.how: We still need more Star Lotus to reverse the Nightmare Incursions. Travel through the Emerald Portal in Seradane and bring me back some.

entries.name: More Starsilver Ore
entries.how: We still need more Starsilver Ore to reverse the Nightmare Incursions. Travel through the Emerald Portal in Seradane and bring me back some.

entries.name: More Starshells
entries.how: We still need more Starshells to reverse the Nightmare Incursions. Travel through the Emerald Portal in Seradane and bring me back some.

entries.name: Repurposed Totems
entries.how:
As a shaman, one of the challenges of communing with the elements is that there are other shaman with opposing agendas. The elements do not care why we do what we do, they just do as we ask!

The trolls at Jintha'alor also practice the shamanic arts, and their interruptions and attacks are a constant thorn to us here.

Find their Vilebranch totems and bring them back to me so that I can nullify their powers. Some they carry, some they place as wards around their altar.

entries.name: Witch Doctor Ti'ik
entries.how:
The Witherbark know we be huntin' them like the traitors they are. Makin' plans and hideouts to keep their tribe in the shadows even after we burn 'em for their deceit.

Our scouts be findin' a cave west of Hiri'watha. One witch doctor, Ti'ik, he bring his voodoo inside--rot, decay, an' wrigglin' larvae for some foul magic.

We not lettin' that filth crawl through our homes while we sleep. Go, take his head, and crush whatever they be growin'. 

He be tough, so don't go underestimatin' him, ya?

entries.name: The Horn of the Beast
entries.how:
The gigantic horn has numerous scratches and cracks. An unusual metal object is lodged into the rough surface.

Upon further examination, you notice that the metal is actually a broken axe head. On the metal, the following words are etched:

Property of Mountaineer Pebblebitty.

When you try and dislodge the broken axe head, it shatters into a million pieces.

Woops!

entries.name: Suntara Stones
entries.how:
<Dorius groans.>

I'm badly injured, {race}. Feel... light headed... World spinning... Bleeding... internally.

I must get back to Ironforge. Help me, {name}.

entries.name: Suntara Stones
entries.how:
Brother,

If you are reading this letter, I am no more. How it got to you, I do not know, but thank and reward the ones responsible.

About the stones: They exist and the Dark Irons have them in their possession. Their leader, Lathoric the Black, is using the power of the stones to enslave my excavation team. They were taken to the cauldron. Their minds are twisted, working night and day to complete something called Obsidion.

Help them, brother. It is the final wish of a dead man.

-Dorius

entries.name: Release Them
entries.how:
Release them, {race}. Even after their bodies give out, the power of the Suntara forces them to complete their tasks.

The altar of Suntara is the key. Go northwest; in the hills above the cave... Twilight's Hammer guard a relic. Retrieve it and place it on the altar of Suntara.

<The dying archaeologist collapses.>

entries.name: Prayer to Elune
entries.how: Will you assist me, mortal? Hear my tale.

entries.name: Prayer to Elune
entries.how:
Will you assist me, mortal? Will you find the prayer to Elune?

As I stated, the prayer was etched onto a golden tablet. One of these idol worshipping scoundrels must have it on their person.

If you do recover my prayer, take it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus. It matters little that my faith has been rekindled after the countless malevolent actions that I have taken against this world and its inhabitants, but my prayer must be heard. Absolution is the last thing I expect.

entries.name: Divine Retribution
entries.how: Hear my tale, adventurer.

entries.name: The Flawless Flame
entries.how:
You have made the right decision, {name}.

We must strike where we will do the most damage: the four sentry towers.

With the four towers in flames, we can initiate an offensive before they have time to react.

You will need the proper tool to set the towers ablaze. To make the tool requires some materials.

Bring me four hearts of flame and four golem oil and I shall craft the torch of flawless flame.

The golems and elementals in these lands should be your first target.

entries.name: Forging the Shaft
entries.how:
To hold the flawless flame, we will need a shaft and a casing. You must first find a suitable shaft.

The Dark Iron taskmasters and slavers of the cauldron use weapons of enchanted thorium, an extremely sturdy alloy. If you bring me eight thorium plated daggers, I can break the alloy down and reforge a shaft.

entries.name: The Flame's Casing
entries.how:
We need one final piece to form the torch.

In the mountains to the northwest you will find a large encampment of Twilight's Hammer. It is rumored that they carry symbols and idols that pay homage to their god. These symbols and idols could carry sufficient enchantment to form a magical casing. Bring me a single symbol of Ragnaros and I will try to extract the magic from the item to create the casing.

entries.name: The Torch of Retribution
entries.how: Give me a moment to combine the pieces and apply the necessary enchantments.

entries.name: The Torch of Retribution
entries.how: The torch must now be bound to its owner. Pick up the torch, {name}.

entries.name: Squire Maltrake
entries.how: Speak with my envoy, Squire Maltrake. He will further instruct you as to the use of the Torch of Retribution.

entries.name: Set Them Ablaze!
entries.how:
Listen well, {name}. While the four towers can never be destroyed, you can use the torch of retribution to set them ablaze for a very long period of time: A fire that no element or force can subdue.

While they are ablaze, no guard or sentry unit can inhabit the watch posts and thus, their first line of defense is nullified.

You must enter each tower and use the Torch of Retribution within their fortifications. Beware the elite sentry units of the Dark Irons, {name}.

entries.name: Trinkets...
entries.how: The chest appears locked.

entries.name: Rise, Obsidion!
entries.how:
It... It... It was all a trap.

Forgive... me.

Kill the bastard... Kill him for us... for Thorius.

entries.name: Caught!
entries.how:
Hey! Hey, you! Get over here!

Ya gotta help me out. I was runnin' from them Dark Iron dwarves, and I hid in here to get out of sight. Damn bastard geologists and their magic ways! They musta seen me hide, cause next thing I knew, they locked the door and stuck me in here.

Teach them geologists a lesson! Oh... an' can ya get me some pieces of silk cloth for... for... nothin'.

entries.name: Ledger from Tanaris
entries.how:
Oh, you know what? That reminds me.

You wanna finish up a little job I took up while I was in Tanaris? It's easy...

Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan was lookin' for some stuff found here in Searing Gorge and a few other places. Maybe you could take a look at the list and then bring it all to him?

I'll just slide his ledger under the door if you're interested. Take that, and the stuff he wants back to him after ya collected it all.

entries.name: The Key to Freedom
entries.how:
The small brass key looks simple enough.. The only thing that seems to make it stand out are some words scratched into the head of it:

"Dark Iron Outhouse - Do Not Duplicate."

You have no idea what it means or what it will lead to.

entries.name: WANTED: Overseer Maltorius
entries.how:
By order o' 'is eminence, Overseer Oilfist, the rogue Thorium Brotherhood agent an' newly hired commander o' the Dark Iron Slag Pit crew o' the Cauldron, Overseer Maltorius, is to be killed an' 'is head brung back as proof o' the deed.

See Lookout Captan Lolo Longstriker fer the reward on this bounty.

entries.name: Kill 'Em With Sleep Deprivation
entries.how:
If we want to put a dent in the productivity of the Dark Iron forces working out of the Slag Pit, we have to hit them where it's going to hurt the most.

It's a little known fact but dwarves, particularly of the Dark Iron variety, need rest! Lots of rest!

Now I ask you; How can they sleep without pillows? Exactly, {name}, they can't. This is why you must weasel your way into the Slag Pit and steal their pillows.

entries.name: Look at the Size of It!
entries.how: Well, well, well... Isn't this a surprise. The Chambermaid had a gigantic ornate pillow and now it's yours. Evonice Sootsmoker will definitely want to get her grubby little hands all over this item. Take it to her and see if she'll offer you any goodies for your trouble.

entries.name: What the Flux?
entries.how:
When that bastard, Maltorius, left our clan, he left with something more valuable than a pristine arcane crystal: Our recipe for fiery flux! I'd bet anything that the recipe was part of the deal in his new promotion amongst the Dark Irons.

I want you to get our secret plans back, {name}. I'm sure they're somewhere near Maltorius, deep inside the Slag Pit.

entries.name: Curse These Fat Fingers
entries.how:
Unfortunately, I can't dish out the beats like I used to, due to this here fat finger problem. Ye see, the climate out here combined with the lack o' air pressure makes me fingers expand. They're like gigantic Thelsamar Blood Sausages, they are...

Ye're gonna have to carry out me orders of business and what have ye.

First on me agenda: Poundin' the livin' daylights out o' the heavy war golems o' the Gorge. Get crackin'.

entries.name: Fiery Menace!
entries.how:
Wouldn't ye know it, every time ol' Hansel wants to take a moment to relax and reflect upon his life, the powers that be give him another job.

Me gots to think, come on! Ye know what I be saying? Come. On.

So, these here searing lava spiders are causin' a ruckus o' some sort. Oilfist says they shoot fire out their... erm, yea well, anyway, such things upset the children.

I guess we gots to kill 'em. Rather, ye gots to kill 'em.

entries.name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
entries.how:
Bunions, lad. Me bunions got bunions. How am I supposed to do any sort of killin' with me feet in such disarray? That's why ye're gonna help.

Scrange and Burninate tasked me to kill these things so they can send some expeditionary teams down into the Slag Pit lava pools to do some explorin'. Supposedly some incendosaurs or some such nonsense down there causin' all kinds o' problems. Now move along an' don't come back 'til the incendosaur population be extinct.

entries.name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
entries.how:
The following items have been stolen:

*One Dark Iron Tuyere.

*One Lookout's Spyglass.

A reward is being offered to individuals who find and return these pilfered items.

The Thorium Brotherhood is certain that these items were stolen by unscrupulous and jealous Dark Iron dwarves that inhabit the Searing Gorge.

The spyglass in question was an excellent tool for the lookouts and the tuyere was an irreplaceable smithing tool.

Should you find the missing items, return them to Scrange.

entries.name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
entries.how:
Taskmaster Scrange is looking for a few good men and women to help 'cull the competition' in the Searing Gorge.

If you are interested in this position, venture out into the Searing Gorge and slaughter every Dark Iron Taskmaster and Dark Iron Slaver that you see.

Return to Taskmaster Scrange when your clothes are bloody enough.

You'll know when they're bloody enough so don't ask.

entries.name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Kingsblood
entries.how:
Let's not waste more of my precious time with jibber jabber, {race}. It's time to focus on replenishing our dwindling fiery flux supply.

What I'm gonna need from you is the following:

*Incendosaur scales.

*Kingsblood.

*Coal.

I'll take all that you can offer!

And you'll do it fast if you wanna get in good with the Brotherhood.

entries.name: Gaining Acceptance
entries.how:
You've worked your way up through the Brotherhood's corporate hierarchy, {race}. We have begun to look favorably upon you. Quite an accomplishment!

If you're interested in more work and earning more respect amongst us, listen up.

We can refine the fiery flux by adding a simple Dark Iron residue to the mix. The Dark Iron residue can be found in Blackrock Depths.

Bring me all the Dark Iron residue you find!

entries.name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Iron
entries.how:
Let's not waste more of my precious time with jibber jabber, {race}. It's time to focus on replenishing our dwindling fiery flux supply.

What I'm gonna need from you is the following:

*Incendosaur scales.

*Iron bars.

*Coal.

I'll take all that you can offer!

And you'll do it fast if you wanna get in good with the Brotherhood.

entries.name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Heavy Leather
entries.how:
Let's not waste more of my precious time with jibber jabber, {race}. It's time to focus on replenishing our dwindling fiery flux supply.

What I'm gonna need from you is the following:

*Incendosaur scales.

*Heavy Leather.

*Coal.

I'll take all that you can offer!

And you'll do it fast if you wanna get in good with the Brotherhood.

entries.name: Head of the Obliterator
entries.how:
You have certainly proven yourself to me, {name}, but the others of my tribe are less easily persuaded. For that, you will need to continue your efforts against the Legashi.

Bring to me the horns of slain Legashi satyr. Every bundle you bring me will serve as a symbol of your service to the Blackmaw.

entries.name: Heart of the Obliterator
entries.how: Built and destroyed again; the heart of Iodax the Obliterator rests in your hands. The golem was likely an invention of the dark iron dwarves, or of something before them. As such, the dwarves at Thorium Point may be interested in your discovery here.

entries.name: To Feed an Army
entries.how:
If I am to be keeping a stockpile of goods for adventurers passing through, I need ample supply of food. The Alliance can have their breads and cheese, but true soldiers of the Horde eat meat!

Upon my arrival, I saw a pack of worgs wandering far to the southeast, on the other side of the ravine. Bring enough meat to fill a few crates.

While you're out, I've heard the Alliance innkeeper muttering something about spiders as a delicacy. I'm skeptical but curious, so fetch a few to taste as well.

entries.name: Inn and Out
entries.how:
Keep this between us, but I am ashamed to ask for assistance with this whole hearthstone problem. However, I think I have enough of a handle on it to give it a try. We should probably be... thoughtful of who we decide to be the first to test these out.

I have heard mutterings of a slave operation within the Slag Pit, deep beneath where we are standing right now. Let's see if they work to aid their escape. If not, then we can both be thankful I haven't bound your hearthstone yet.

entries.name: To Feed an Army
entries.how:
I'm realizing quick that my stash of food is barely enough to keep the brotherhood fed. How am I supposed to keep up once our own start to show up in greater numbers?

I heard the orc around the hill sending Horde toward the worgs on the far southeast side of the gorge. I think you should kill a few and bring back their meat, but you can focus most of your efforts on the lava spiders to the west to hopefully minimize some competition with the enemy.

Don't worry, I know how to cook a delicious spider.

entries.name: Inn and Out
entries.how:
I overheard the brotherhood discussing a slave mining operation beneath what they call the Cauldron. It sounds like they aren't focused on liberating them as much as they are with disrupting their leadership.

Now, I've spent a long time running inns and taverns, but never have I been in a position to help someone who couldn't at least leg it to my establishment. This seems like an opportunity to break in some freshly enchanted hearthstones. Who knows, maybe they'll make for good recruits?

entries.name: Grund and Gozwin
entries.how:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.

Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.

Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!

entries.name: Deaths in the Family
entries.how:
The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades.  I used to work their mills...before the Plague.

When the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend.  We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.

The Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath.  And now they are minions of the Scourge!

Serve the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the Plague.  Serve me by bringing me their remains.

entries.name: Speak with Sevren
entries.how:
You have given me the remains of the Agamands, and satisfied my desire for revenge.  But the Agamand Mills hold a threat to all the Forsaken, not just to me.

I have spoken to Magistrate Sevren of your exploits against the Agamands, and he wishes to speak with you.

entries.name: Rear Guard Patrol
entries.how:
The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the Plaguelands are on constant alert. But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.

Our success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.

Assist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.

entries.name: Graverobbers
entries.how:
The Mass Graves, southwest of Garren's Haunt to the north, were made to accommodate the...impressive...number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the Plague first came.  

The bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide Gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies.  This cannot be allowed!

Your task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the Mass Grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the Embalming Ichor that gives them life.

entries.name: Forsaken Duties
entries.how:
I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east.

I must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal.  Our vigilance on the border to the Plaguelands must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here!

Travel south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation.  Speak with Deathguard Linnea.  She has the information I need.

entries.name: Return to the Magistrate
entries.how:
Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you.  He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.

And if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.

entries.name: A Letter Undelivered
entries.how: This is a letter written by Thurman, the eldest son of Gregor Agamand.  It is addressed to an Yvette Farthing, though it does not appear to have reached her...

entries.name: The Haunted Mills
entries.how:
Devlin Agamand was the younger of two sons in the Agamand family, and in life the two could not be more different.  Thurman was tall and gentle while his younger brother was weak and sharp tongued.

When Agamand Mills fell to the Plague, I was not surprised to hear that Devlin was quick to succumb.  His mad chattering can still be heard near the road leading to the Agamand Mills.

I'm collecting the remains of the Agamands, and I want poor Devlin.  Find him, destroy him, and bring me his bones.

entries.name: Fields of Grief
entries.how:
What have we here?  You look like a fledgling {class}.  If you hope to prove yourself to The Dark Lady, you need to learn the ways of The Forsaken.

To the west you'll find a farm.  Humans infest the land like mold on a rotting corpse.  And worse yet, the Scarlet Crusade patrols nearby from their tower.  Teach those scum a lesson and steal 10 of their precious pumpkins.

Once you have 10, take them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.

entries.name: Return the Book
entries.how:
Long ago Gunther and I, along with the now Scourge Necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, were friends and students within the Kirin Tor - a society of mages in Dalaran.

Gunther and I both fell to the Plague, but I thought he either remained dead, or was raised into the ranks of the Lich King.  It is good to know he is free.

We must have him.  I have placed a spell on his book that, when he sees it, will show him that I too am free of the Lich King.  After knowing this, it is my hope that he will join us.

entries.name: A New Plague
entries.how:
Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society. The Dark Lady believes our knowledge coupled with the newfound magic will provide the key to Arthas's demise.  She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on Azeroth. This new disease will bring Arthas's Scourge Army to ruin.

My studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. Bring to me 5 vials of darkhound blood so I can test my theory.

entries.name: A New Plague
entries.how:
While you were collecting samples for me, my experiments led me to realize that more reagents will be required for this new disease to spread properly. Poisoning some hapless victim is child's play. Plaguing an entire world proves to be a bit more complicated.

I will need 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in the vicinity.  You will find the creatures along the coast to the north or to the west.

entries.name: A New Plague
entries.how:
While you were out gathering, I uncovered some old text in one of my tomes that indicates that an ancient plague wiped out thousands of innocent victims.  Later it was discovered that the deadly agent in the plague was preserved through the venom of Night Web Spiders.

Bring me some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider to complete this experiment.  I want to see if the contagious element from the venom will work with my new concoction.  Rumor has it the spiders can be found in Eastern Tirisfal Glades.

entries.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
entries.how:
The strategic documents from Executor Arren contain all the details we need to wipe the human infestation from the lands.  According to the information, The Scarlet Crusade has assigned Captain Perrine and a brigade to the ruined tower southwest of Brill.

Kill Perrine along with 3 Zealots and 3 Missionaries and report back to me.

entries.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
entries.how:
We are still at war and the Scarlet Crusade grows in strength.  The report Executor Arren sent me indicates Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon.

Kill Vachon along with 5 Scarlet Friars. It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!

entries.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
entries.how:
Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest.  According to the information we have, a ruthless commander named Captain Melrache is in charge of this evil crew.

I am entrusting you now with a special and dangerous mission.  Slay Melrache and his two bodyguards, in the name of The Dark Lady.

entries.name: Proof of Demise
entries.how:
Executor Zygand tells me you've been out killing Scarlet Crusaders. Tirisfal Glades is crawling with them.

Varimathras, lieutenant to The Dark Lady, is seeing to it personally that the scum of Azeroth, the Human race, gets wiped into oblivion. Here in Tirisfal Glades we face a particularly annoying breed of humans: The Scarlet Crusade.

Venture forth and wage an offensive on the Scarlet Crusade, {class}. Bring me back 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings as proof of your loyalty to Varimathras and The Dark Lady.

entries.name: The Chill of Death
entries.how:
It's so cold, now.  The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent.  The Mindless State will be upon me soon.  But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady.  When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.

Now my hands shake from the chill.  If you would bring me five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread I could sew myself a blanket.  Help me, {name}, so that I can continue to serve the cause.

entries.name: WANTED: Maggot Eye
entries.how:
Wanted: Maggot Eye!

A foul beast, even by Gnoll standards, Maggot Eye has been sentenced to death for his crimes against The Forsaken.  This despicable villain has been stealing corpses for use by the Lich King's army.  Maggot Eye was last seen pillaging the lands near Garren's Haunt to the north of Brill.

The town of Brill hereby offers a reward to the capable soul who can carry out the execution.  Show Executor Zygand the villain's paw once the deed is done.

Mercy is for the weak.

entries.name: A Putrid Task
entries.how:
Scourge have trickled into Tirisfal Glades and have infested the area west of Brill, near the old bridge.

Go there and beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses you find.  Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws, and the Deathguards will reward you.

entries.name: The Prodigal Lich
entries.how:
Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful mage in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge.  You, {name}, will be that agent.

Present these orders to Bethor.  He will then instruct you on your mission.  I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich.  And it will be dangerous.

So ready yourself, {class}.  You must not fail.

You may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

entries.name: Fields of Grief
entries.how:
Harmless pumpkins, right?  Or so it would seem.  If we are to defeat Arthas's advances from the North and the Human infestation from the South we need to start realizing the full potential of our gift of undeath.

With a little ingenuity a simple pumpkin becomes an agent for our Dark Lady.  This pumpkin, laced with my latest formula, will prove to be quite a treat.

Yet another Scarlet Zealot has been captured and is being kept in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern.  Take this pumpkin to the fool.

entries.name: The Family Crypt
entries.how:
The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge.  Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered.  With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.

This cannot pass, and you must stop it.  Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.

And, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.

entries.name: Proving Allegiance
entries.how:
You say you are not bound by the will of the Lich King, and the enchantment Bethor placed upon my book corroborates this.  But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge.

There is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island.  it is used by a powerful Scourge agent, Lillith Nefara.

Take a Candle of Beckoning from this crate here.  Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake.  Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are the Lich King's foe.

entries.name: The Dormant Shade
entries.how: This is an old, beaten, bloody table.

entries.name: The Prodigal Lich Returns
entries.how: Take this Nether Gem to my old comrade Bethor.  It will let us communicate ... and I have much to tell him.

entries.name: The Mills Overrun
entries.how:
The Scourge are trying to form a base at the Agamand Mills.  If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.

The orders have been given.  The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.

Go to the Mills.  Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.

To get to the Mills, follow the road west.  After crossing the bridge, take the next fork north then keep going north.  When you see windmills, the battle will begin.

entries.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
entries.how:
The documents Executor Arren provided are just the break we needed in our battle with the wretched Scarlet Crusade.  We now know their exact locations throughout Tirisfal Glades.

But the Deathguard has larger concerns.  The Lich King's army grows in number each night.  We need someone with "initiative" like yourself to drive the Scarlet Crusade to the grave.

Prove to me you are capable of serving The Dark Lady by travelling west to the tower past the Solliden Farmstead and slay 10 Scarlet Warriors.

entries.name: Candles of Beckoning
entries.how:
In this crate lie a collection of Candles of Beckoning, one of which will be needed to summon Lillith Nefara.

Will you take one of the candles?

entries.name: Delivery to Silverpine Forest
entries.how:
Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas.  Surely you know this by now.

As a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.

Take these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.  Follow the roads to the south from Brill.  From the Undercity go southwest.

entries.name: A New Plague
entries.how:
According to the Deathguard, another one of those foolish Dwarven Mountaineers has just been captured.  The Deathguard likes to use the cellar of the Gallows End Tavern as a holding cell until prisoners can be "properly" dealt with.

Why don't you go see how the Captured Mountaineer enjoys this special drink I made for him?  It contains a subtle hint of what The Dark Lady has planned for the rest of Azeroth.

entries.name: Gordo's Task
entries.how:
Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.

When you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill graveyard.

entries.name: Doom Weed
entries.how:
So you can see the predicament that I'm in, {name}. That thing is out there collecting the wrong weeds! I'll make it worth your while to gather what I need. Bring back to me enough doom weed and I'll give you a suitable reward.

It is my understanding that they like to plague the flora near the mass gravesite, to the north of the Brill graveyard. Hurry and be mindful of the gnolls in the area.

entries.name: A Plague Upon Thee
entries.how:
So, to bring pain and strife to the Scarlet Crusade, I want to take their precious lumber mill from them. I'm sure the loss of such a resource will cause them a great deal of harm in defending and rebuilding the town for their own reasons. Will you help me, {name}?

Start by taking this jar to Plaguewood in the Eastern Plaguelands. Fill it with the termites you find in their mounds throughout the woods. Come back when you have enough.

entries.name: A Plague Upon Thee
entries.how:
Now that we have plenty of termites, take this steel reinforced barrel to the Northridge Lumber Mill south of Hearthglen--you'll find it to the west of the road that leads you up to the town.

Once there, place the barrel in the center of the lumber mill; someplace high, like on a crate or something.

After you open it, the rest should take care of itself. Just come back here and I'll reward you for helping me.

entries.name: Sticks and Bones
entries.how:
My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.

entries.name: The Knight of Mourning
entries.how:
I once was a knight like you--bound to the service of the light. Then, I died. It seems that we both have that much in common.

Unlike you, however, I am bound to this place by a purpose unfinished, an oath unfulfilled. If you would listen, I would tell you of my quest... and my failure.

entries.name: That Shadowvale Green Elixir
entries.how:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.

entries.name: Whispering Horror Residue
entries.how: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.

entries.name: The Argent Emissary
entries.how:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.

entries.name: A Righteous Cause
entries.how:
Danitha and I fought against the Scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.

He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the Light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.

If only the rest of the Forsaken felt the same way...

entries.name: The Cult of the Damned
entries.how: The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.

entries.name: Remnants of War
entries.how:
It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal mounted atop Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the Scourge of them.

entries.name: Bandarion Keep
entries.how:
You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.

entries.name: A Steed in Death as They Were in Life
entries.how:
Greetings, {class}. I imagine I can guess what has brought you to my stables today.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place. Be warned though, riding an undead steed is not for the faint of heart.

As such, you have an important choice to make. You and your undead steed will travel the world together for good or ill. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the correct one.

Go examine the undead horses and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: Learning to Ride
entries.how:
Greetings, {class}. It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a skeletal steed, for a fee.

Zachariah will provide you with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you desire. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about skeletal horses.

entries.name: Hides for the Forsaken
entries.how:
One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?

Well, it doesn't.

Ours is a cursed life, {name}. We must take from the living to further our own existence.

When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!

Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.

entries.name: Leonid's Letter
entries.how:
Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.

You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.

<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>

entries.name: Discipline
entries.how:
You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.

As a reward for your relative lack of incompetence, you shall punish those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.

Swiftly now--{name}, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.

entries.name: Patience
entries.how:
Make no mistake, {class}--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.

Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.

entries.name: Tomb Weed
entries.how:
If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.

Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.

entries.name: Seeking Refuge
entries.how:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.

entries.name: As Above, So Below
entries.how:
While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.

I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.

Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.

entries.name: The One That Got Away
entries.how:
Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.

Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.

Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.

entries.name: Rear Guard Patrol
entries.how:
Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.

Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.

Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.

See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.

entries.name: Swift as the Wind
entries.how:
You are back. Good. It's time for you to learn to master the steed of a true Forsaken--the skeletal warhorse.

Zachariah will provide you with a free mount once you have completed the final round of your training with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you desire.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about skeletal warhorses.

entries.name: An Epic Ride
entries.how:
Greetings, {name}. I didn't expect to see you back to my humble stables again so soon.

You certainly have had quite a journey. I think I can guess what has brought you here today.

You now have enough power, experience and skill to ride our deftest and most fearsome warhorses. These armored fiends will bear you through any trial, even past the gates of death itself. 

Go examine the armored undead warhorses and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: Arugal's Folly
entries.how:
As my understanding of Arugal's magic grows so does my disdain for the hapless fool.  I am close to completing my research on his so called remedy.

My knowledge will be complete when I learn what enchantment is causing the strange behavior going on in Pyrewood Village.  By day, the peasants appear to be Human.  But when the sun goes down the townsfolk turn into Moonrage Worgen.

I need to draw energy from the enchanted shackles Arugal cast on them.  Bring to me six enchanted Pyrewood Shackles, {name}.

entries.name: Prove Your Worth
entries.how:
Lady Sylvanas has charged Varimathras with the conquering of the human and dwarven lands to the south.

But that fool, Arugal -- charlatan of Dalaran and now cursed beast of Shadowfang Keep -- let his reckless magic wreak havoc with the strategic stronghold of Silverpine Forest.

I need someone skilled in the ways of combat to help clean up Arugal's mess.  Prove yourself to me by killing 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.  The wretched beasts can often be found just off the road, down the hill below.

entries.name: Arugal's Folly
entries.how:
How Arugal gained acceptance within the Kirin Tor is beyond me.  His spell-casting knowledge seemed as transparent as a blown glass bauble.

What's important now is learning exactly what magic Arugal used so that I can turn it against him and secure Silverpine Forest for the Dark Lady.

Arugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge.  One of the Deathstalkers reported seeing some spellbooks but could not secure them.  Retrieve for me the spell labeled Remedy of Arugal from those books.

entries.name: Arugal's Folly
entries.how:
After examining Arugal's work my worst suspicions were confirmed.  The old hack was not qualified to clean chamber pots in Dalaran let alone represent the Kirin Tor in its most dire hour.  Fools!

Arugal used enchanted items to reinforce his weak magic.  I need to examine these items first hand.  Travel forth and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have collected enough of their enchanted shackles for my research.  The foul creatures have been seen to the north and east.

entries.name: Arugal's Folly
entries.how:
It will indeed take me longer than I had thought to uncover the dark secrets behind the enchantments Arugal was using.

But in the meantime I need you to take care of a slight problem our Darkstalkers have discovered.  It seems that Arugal let his magic spread to the Deep Elem Mine in the hills to the southeast.

The mine would prove to be quite a resource for Varimathras's advance.

I want you to behead the tainted foreman of the mine, Grimson the Pale.  With his death, the mine shall be ours.

entries.name: Ivar the Foul
entries.how:
My brother Quinn and I were tasked to recon Silverpine Forest and report to High Executor Hadrec.  But we didn't get far -- when moving through this farm we were attacked by the ghoul Ivar the Foul.

We escaped from Ivar, but he seriously mauled Quinn.  He's healing from the potion you gave him, but Ivar may return before Quinn recovers.

Kill Ivar so Quinn will have time to heal.  Ivar is usually in the barn yonder, waiting for my guard to drop.

entries.name: Lost Deathstalkers
entries.how:
A couple weeks ago two of our Deathstalkers, Rane and Quinn Yorick, were sent on a reconnaissance mission through northern Silverpine.  We have not heard from them.

They may have become victim to the Scourge, though if that is true then I want it confirmed.  Find these Deathstalkers.

Their first objective was to scout the farms in northern Silverpine.  You should begin your search there.

entries.name: Wild Hearts
entries.how:
My brother Quinn was badly hurt by the ghoul, Ivar the Foul, and I don't know if he will heal properly without alchemical aid.  Although I am not an apothecary, I do know that our apothecaries can make healing potions from the discolored hearts of worgs.

Gather such hearts and take them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher to the south.  Then return here with the potion.

You can find plenty of worgs between here and Malden's Orchard to the east.

entries.name: Return to Quinn
entries.how:
Here is the potion to aid in Quinn Yorick's recovery.

Now if you will excuse me, I have very important work to continue...

entries.name: Escorting Erland
entries.how:
The wolves outside won't leave, and they eye me evilly every time I step foot out that door.  They must be incredibly hungry to think I'm worth eating.

I have to report to my teammate, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick.  And to get to Rane, I'll need help against those wolves.

Please escort me!  And there are a lot of wolves out there, so we'll have a better chance if you have friends who can help...

entries.name: The Dead Fields
entries.how:
Our initial scouting reports of Silverpine show the rot hides have a base at an old farm to the north, the Dead Fields.  We have sent small assaults against them, but each time they are reinforced by the banshee Nightlash, who uses her magic to rout our forces.

We want Nightlash destroyed.

Go to the Dead Fields and assault the rot hides.  If you don't see Nightlash then kill the rot hides until she appears, then defeat her.

Her essence will turn to dust.  Bring me that dust as proof.

entries.name: The Decrepit Ferry
entries.how:
{name}, we've discovered a new hive for the Scourge: the Decrepit Ferry.  The ferry lies east of the Sepulcher, and is heavily patrolled by rot hides and other undead.

There must be a reason for the Scourge's occupation of the area.  Go to the Decrepit Ferry and find out why the Scourge are there.

entries.name: Rot Hide Clues
entries.how:
Among the corpses a hand protrudes, unwrapped.  It is the hand of a woman, pockmarked from the plague but relatively fresh.  

On the hand is a ring.  Removing the ring and inspecting it reveals an engraving:

"For Deliah"

entries.name: The Engraved Ring
entries.how:
If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... then speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.  He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.

But I wouldn't hope.  Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead.  Or if he's undead he probably no longer cares about Deliah.

entries.name: Raleigh and the Undercity
entries.how:
Deliah had a husband, Raleigh, who now dwells in the Undercity.  If the Deliah who lived in Brill is the one who owned this ring, then Raleigh will know.

Raleigh is in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.

entries.name: Assault on Fenris Isle
entries.how:
Now is the time to assault the Scourge's place of strength in Silverpine: Fenris Isle.

You must again go to the Isle and destroy Thule Ravenclaw.  I want his head!

This mission is as dangerous as it is vital, {name}.  You must not fail.

entries.name: Rot Hide Ichor
entries.how:
Before we launch an assault on Fenris Isle, we must determine who is behind the rot hide gnolls.  Our apothecaries believe their origin lies within the strange fluid that flows through their bodies.

Go to Fenris Isle, east of the Decrepit Ferry, and collect rot hide ichor from the gnolls you find there.  Bring it to Apothecary Renferrel, stationed outside the Sepulcher.

entries.name: Rot Hide Origins
entries.how:
I have reduced the ichor you brought me and separated it into its base components.  My findings are not conclusive, but I have determined that warlock and necromantic magics were used in the ichor's creation.

While I continue to study the ichor, I want you to take a sample to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.  Bethor is not an apothecary, but his knowledge of magic may help to unravel the mystery of the rot hides.

Go.  You will find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

entries.name: Thule Ravenclaw
entries.how:
This Ichor was crafted by an old colleague of mine: Thule Ravenclaw.  He was a young, promising mage before the great war, but when the Lich King rose to power, he betrayed his brethren and allied with the Scourge.

I did not realize he still lives, nor that he leads the Rot Hides in their forays against us!

I know many of his spells, and can help concoct a potion to counter them.  Take this scroll back to Apothecary Renferrel.  It has the incantations needed for the potion.

entries.name: A Recipe For Death
entries.how:
Arthas's numbers are overwhelming. But with a New Plague we could eradicate both the Scourge Army and the Human infestation once and for all.

My studies have proven that spider blood combined with a toxin derived from a grizzled bear heart results in a deadly elixir. Collect samples from the spiders in the Skittering Dark to the northwest and from the bears wandering throughout Silverpine Forest. Deliver the reagents to Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity.

entries.name: Report to Hadrec
entries.how: Before you launch an assault on Fenris Isle, report to High Executor Hadrec.  He may have additional information or equipment you'll need.

entries.name: The Deathstalkers' Report
entries.how: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible.  It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.

entries.name: A Recipe For Death
entries.how:
You can be of further service to the Royal Apothecary Society, {name}.

When Arugal cast his wretched magic on the forest, he cursed one of our most promising members, Apothecary Berard.  Now a mindless servant of Arugal, Berard is useless to us.  But his findings might prove to be of worth.  He was studying an ancient plague that killed off all the aquatic life in Lake Lordamere ages ago.

Retrieve Berard's Journal from his study in the Pyrewood Village Inn and take it to Apothecary Renferrel.

entries.name: A Recipe For Death
entries.how:
According to Berard's Journal the moss from Lake Skulkers and Creepers might prove useful for our quest to brew a new plague.  Those beasts dwell on the islands in Lake Lordamere to the east.

He also mentions a very rare Hardened Tumor that he discovered on a Vile Fin murloc.  Apparently the tumor is so rare Berard was only able to obtain one.

Collect samples of the moss as well as the rare hardened tumor and take them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

entries.name: Pyrewood Ambush
entries.how:
You got here just in the nick of time, {name}!

The Pyrewood Council will be returning any moment.  Arugal has other matters to tend to in the keep.  He uses the Council as mere puppets to keep the mindless minions of Pyrewood under his control.  But I believe that without the guidance of the Pyrewood Council, the sons of Arugal will turn against their master.

I cannot handle them all by myself.  I need you to help me.  Together we can lay waste to the Council for Lady Sylvanas.

entries.name: Resting in Pieces
entries.how:
You don't look like a rot hide.  Good.  I had lost hope...

My name is Alaric, and I was once Thule's head servant and bodyguard.  He used his magic to "protect" me from the Plague of Undeath, but instead his spell gave me an unlife from which I cannot escape.  And after creating the cursed rot hide gnolls, Thule beheaded me... and gave my head to the gnolls as a plaything!

Please, take me to my body.  I believe the gnolls buried it here in Fenris Keep, near the stable, in an unmarked grave.

entries.name: The Hidden Niche
entries.how:
I know of a hidden niche within the keep that holds an item dear to Thule, and his old colleagues.  It also holds something you might find useful.  Take me there!

The alcove is in the southwestern tower of the keep, behind a dusty shelf.

Take my body, but leave my boots.  They never fit me anyway...

entries.name: Border Crossings
entries.how:
As you may know, the town of Ambermill remains a source of human opposition, mainly through the support they receive from the wizards of Dalaran.

I don't know what their plan is, but for them to show interest in a backwater village like Ambermill indicates that it must have some greater importance.

They've been shipping crates by the wagon from Hillsbrad. Many of those supplies end up at a small camp north of Pyrewood Village. Retrieve the contents of a crate and return them to me.

entries.name: Maps and Runes
entries.how: <You quickly remove the pendant from the crate and replace the lid.>

entries.name: Ambermill Investigations
entries.how:
Dalar is attempting to locate the source of the wizards' spellcasting. For now, we'll have to slow their progress in any way we can...

The conjurers, mages and protectors are no doubt carrying the pendants. Remove and retrieve them.

Take the main road south and the eastern fork into Ambermill.

entries.name: The Weaver
entries.how:
An archmage of great power is overseeing the reactivation of the ley energy node. With the progress they have made, our only hope of stopping them is by killing him. It will be difficult, he is no doubt protected by many other mages and warders.

You must go, and you must dispatch him quickly. When he is dead, retrieve his staff for me. Go now.

entries.name: Dalar's Analysis
entries.how: Take the pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver, perhaps he can shed some light on the wizards' plans.

entries.name: Dalaran's Intentions
entries.how:
Of course! How could I have forgotten?

Ambermill was one of the sites earmarked by the Kirin Tor, noted because it houses a dormant ley energy node. The wizards must be planning to reactivate the node and use its energies for some greater purpose.

We cannot allow this to happen...

It will take a great amount of power to activate the area's ley energies, we can stall them by taking the pendants away from the wizards.

Relay this information to Allister, he will decide a course of action.

entries.name: Wand to Bethor
entries.how:
Thule once told me that, long ago, he and two colleagues created a magic wand, woven together from the apprentice wands each mage possessed.  This wand was a symbol of their friendship, and although Thule came to despise it he could not part with it, nor could he let the others have it.  So he stole the wand, and hid it in Fenris Keep.

Here.  Take the wand to Bethor Iceshard, one of Thule's friends from years past.  I'm sure he will want it.

entries.name: Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills
entries.how:
The Royal Apothecary Society is under extreme pressure from the Dark Lady to develop a New Plague.  We are working diligently and have made much progress.  It is our belief that the success will be achieved much faster if we share information amongst the Society.

For that reason I want you to deliver my latest findings to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill, a small town nestled in the Hillsbrad Foothills.  The journey will be a long one.

Head south and stick to the roads.  Follow the signs closely!

entries.name: Beren's Peril
entries.how:
I have received reports that a group of undead are holing up to prepare for an attack against us. Armed with this information, we can turn the tables and attack them first, nipping their little plan in the bud.

Unfortunately, my information is spotty, at best. They are reported to be hiding in a location known as Beren's Peril. The exact location is unknown, but it appears to be a cave in the hills, near a pocket of Dalaran wizards.

I trust your resourcefulness. Find them, and put them down.

entries.name: A Husband's Revenge
entries.how:
Valdred, once my good friend, was my wife's murderer.  Although I am incapable of grieving, I do yearn for revenge.  If you kill Valdred and bring me his cursed hands, then I will reward you.

I last heard he was at the Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine, trying to flee into the kingdom of Gilneas.

entries.name: Speak with Renferrel
