A druidic cult known as the Blackthorne Pact has taken root nearby, operating in service to something they call the Wild King.

Find the domain of this "Wild King" and mark it. Then we can report back to Stormwind with certainty.

entries.name: A Shaw Deal
entries.how:
Your help has been key to our scouting efforts. Take this information to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

Remember, you're not to speak of our activities here, my presence, or SI:7 involvement to anyone else. I have a lot to continue setting up here, and plans to keep on track. 

We'll be in touch.

entries.name: Battle Recall
entries.how:
The aged scabbard is embellished with carved designs and markings. This matches the description spoken by the war veteran. A dramatic view of the land below is a breathtaking sight.

Perhaps simply holding the scabbard in your hand while remembering the veteran's words will beckon the spirit to this memory.

entries.name: Soldier's Solace
entries.how:
Beneath the shattered stones of that watchtower lies a cache we buried in haste, when the world was starting to burn. What little we carried from Hyjal rests there still. Take it--you have earned that much.

The pull is increasing... the mountain no longer holds me as it once did. I am unsure if we will ever speak again.

Because of you, I remember who I was, and who we were. Go with my thanks, and let this spirit finally be at peace.

entries.name: Supply Drop
entries.how:
Every Gnomish test pilot knows that one must be prepared for the worst-case scenario when taking to our great skies!

That's why we never leave the hangar without our pilot survival kits. They have a self-activating beacon attached that will radio our position home as soon as you open it. Not to mention being stuffed full of other useful supplies.

If you can find that pack wherever it fell, by all means open it immediately and help yourself to the contents. You'll still be doing me a favor!

entries.name: Last Wishes
entries.how:
<You unfold the simple parchment.>

To my Rowdy Redridge Rebels,

The lumberjacks here say the gulpers in that pond are biting like they're racing each other to the bait. Good fish, better eating. After this war is over, we're due an angling competition between friends.

The setting is simple: we stand on the center island and fish till the sun slips behind Hyjal's highest peak.

Whoever catches the most, doesn't have to gut 'em for our dinner!

-- Tobin --

entries.name: Herbs for the Bruised and Weary
entries.how:
Could this be? Travelers have returned to Hyjal!

I can hardly believe it! Perhaps with your aid we will finally be freed of this place. With the Scourge remnants to the east we have been subject to constant raids and many have fallen victim to their corruption.

Please, {class}. I would ask a favor of you. In the valley north of here grows an herb with blue flowers that can alleviate the pains of the infection. Gather some and bring it to me so I may help the wounded.

entries.name: Burrow Bonding
entries.how:
Barkskin speak more good on you, friend, but there is yet more for you to do.

Raise your hand to our foes. Honor our ways.

We watch close, and then we will have more to say to you.

entries.name: Unsealing Blackthorne Pact
entries.how:
Well, informant, you're being promoted.

Take these updated orders to Johun at his base camp in Hyjal. There's some additional equipment in here that he'll be needing for our operations in the Summit.

Your assistance in these matters is pivotal to our overall strategy in Kalimdor, {name}. Tarry not.

You are dismissed.

entries.name: The Darkened Glaive
entries.how:
Quel'Shalla. That is the name the magic whispers to me. I can only assume it was made for an influential sentinel, or warden. I wonder if perhaps...

<Lydros reaches out and his fingers idly brush the blade as he speaks. As soon as his skin touches the metal, he freezes.>

Wait...

No... wait... there is something else here. Darkness. I... I cannot continue. Please, take the blade from my sight at once!

entries.name: Woods Workshop
entries.how:
This looks like something that the tinker in the hills, Kaylaena, could make use of. She barely visits ever since the loss of her mentor, Yaely.

Look for her workshop in the hills to the north. After Archimonde's fall in the great battle, the two of them scavenged what they could easily bring back themselves, picking many of the machines on these foothills clean.

Putting this debris to new use is better than allowing it to rust here. Your errand helps new life sprout where it was choked by metal.

entries.name: Farsight Guided
entries.how:
My axe still bled demon gore when I heard a human screaming high above.

I looked up and saw this man dangling in the claws of a great chimaera. He fought back fiercly causing the beast to lose its grip and drop him. 

From that height, no warrior walks away. Even enemies deserve dignity, so I dragged him into the shade to pass in peace.

For my part, I track the farseers' visions--friends remain in Hyjal, far northwest.

Find the remaining Horde in my stead. Honor requires me here.

entries.name: Venom Maws
entries.how:
Gh... Ghan. Sur... Okk... Ghansurok. That's the fel chimaera's name. I thought I could manage out here... ugh... alone. No chance. Picked me clean into the air.

Stuck my dagger through its closest eye I could find, and I fell farther than the tree tops.

I wasn't the only one who bit off more than I could chew this time. Haha--agh... I shouldn't make myself laugh, this hurts bad enough.

Broken bones we could mend, but... the venom... is too vile.

Pass on a warning. I beg you!

entries.name: The Capricious Corvid
entries.how:
We need powerful magic indeed to counter the strength that Ve'han Talongrasp now commands. The staff Velician snatched might just be the key.

My powers as a druid are not what they once were. We will need aid from the divine denizens of the mountain in order to stop this evil.

Return to the crow you met up the mountain. She is wise but the spirits of the wilds are ever-capricious, even in the face of dire threats. She may be challenging, but we will need her help.

entries.name: Heading Up the Mountain
entries.how:
Listen, dirtwalker. I am, of course, known for my intellect and wit but there is one that is even more majestic and powerful than I.

Naturally, I am speaking of cleverest, most cunning, and comely of the Wild Gods, Jereman! Every bird knows her name, and she is wise beyond her wingspan. She certainly will know what is needed for that oldstone's magic.

She nests up in what you dirtwalkers call the Cradle of Tranquility. Touch the crow effigy on the old bridge and she may appear!

entries.name: The Balance of Life and Death
entries.how:
I believe one of my good friends may have an idea for an additional source of power for Ketharas's gambit.

He is close friend, of course, and he will be thrilled to lend his aid to an agent of my will such as yourself!

You can find that old stinkfeather in the area south of here that is crawling with undead. Mourning's Rest I think you mortals call it?

Make sure you mention that I sent you! He will LOVE that... most certainly!

entries.name: Bone Sweet Bone
entries.how:
Listen, mortal. Though it may not appear a glorious job, those that are under my wing help keep the natural balance. We return many essential nutrients to the soil, allowing for new life.

These undead have disrupted the cycle here and have driven off those that seek shelter under my wings. While you are out there being the little murderous creature you are, would you collect some bones for me?

I would like to rebuild the nests of my children and followers so we may feast when this blight has ended.

entries.name: Blademaster's Bonfires
entries.how:
War.

By the time I heeded the call of our clans, the battle had passed, and only ashes answered my blade.

My purpose is forged anew.

This mountain remembers strength--ancient power riding its winds and holding its water. I would earn the right to walk its spine, to reach the fallen stronghold that lies upon the road to the summit.

Demons profane these graves. Before I fight at your side, I must know you stand capable. Light the two bonfires and return to me. Their flames draw our enemy out.

entries.name: A Clever Creature
entries.how:
If the hermit truly wants his little gambit to leave the nest and fly, it will likely need a potent energy source. One that can sustain itself without collapse.

<Jereman looks to the sky and clacks her beak together as she considers.>

Ah, yes. I know just the clever creature we can consult. Go north into the area you mortals refer to as Dae'gun, the one with the demons, and seek out the fox Wild God Renalard. I believe he will have a solution to our little puzzle.

entries.name: To Outfox a Demon
entries.how:
Say, while you're out and about prancing in my lands, would you mind doing me a favor?

Once the war had been won, many of the various armies up and left. For whatever reason, they decided some of their supplies were not worth taking. That, or they all died. Who could say?

Regardless, these supplies are of use to my kits and me. Unfortunately they also tend to be where the demons are. Take this tuft of fur with you and use it on the demons to distract them while you grab the tools.

entries.name: Violent Venison
entries.how:
Ever since those nasty Blackthorne druids came to power many of the less powerful gods here on Hyjal have... well to be blunt they've attempted to upend the natural order of things.

The very worst offender of this is Kala'th.

<Jereman rolls her eyes.>

That silly deer seems to fashion herself and her herd as predators. Again.

Don't get me wrong, it was quite amusing at first, but now it is time we get things back in wing.

Go speak to her to see if you can bring her back to reason, please.

entries.name: Sacred Refreshment
entries.how:
I am a druid of the Circle, walking the long path to honor the great world tree. I misjudged how much the climb would ask of me, and the winged hunters that haunt these slopes have made caution a necessity. These old ruins offered shelter, and I accepted it.

This place is suitable for a humble offering, yet no ritual should be given without living water. If you would, fill my gourd at the falls ahead. 

When you return, speak to me of the trail you walked, and of what stirs upon it.

entries.name: Yashiro's Windwalk
entries.how:
You're capable, fast, fearless. Fire will draw the demons from their hiding places, and with them, their warlords. They will come seeking dominance. Instead, they will find vengeance waiting. This is the moment where the will of the mountain speaks through us.

Come, let us carve a path through these hellspawn and end their reign. My blade yearns to cleave through their ranks.

entries.name: Trail Assist
entries.how:
The climb grows steeper from here, as you say. Even an empty pack weighs on tired legs. I would ask another kindness of you, traveler. Take my excess gear and carry it ahead to the Summit, where Marn Euhron aids in restoring a foothold near Nordrassil.

I will follow at my own pace when my ceremonies here are complete. When I arrive, I will reclaim them from him and assist him in their work. This way, we both honor the journey and gifts of the mountain.

entries.name: Resupply
entries.how:
You know, they packed enough tools to get the essentials started, but there's never enough fastening material. Only so much cordage-winding my hands can take.

Resourcefulness is even better than being prepared.

Take an empty bag to the burned-down remains of the alliance buildings around the Cradle of Tranquility southwest of here, and fill it with as many nails and brackets as you can find in the ashes.

entries.name: Tribal Colors
entries.how:
The skeleton still clutching a throwing spear has the telltale signs of a troll headhunter.

In one of its bony clutches is a wrap of leather adorned with troll characters and smudges of face tints in Darkspear colors. This must have been a makeup pouch used to apply war paint.

Darkspear tribe members may recognize the writing on the sacred skins.

entries.name: Wrap Return
entries.how:
Whoever wore dis fought wit' purpose. An' Sen'jin be a small village... blood an' kin run close dere.

Somebody back home be missin' dis wrap--and da warrior who carried it.

When ya trek to Echo Isles, take dis wrap wit' ya. Bring it home to Sen'jin. Dey'll know who it belong to--and dey'll honor ya for seein' it returned.

entries.name: Grain of Memory
entries.how:
Before this... second life, I learned the grain of wood in my father's shop.

When war reached Hyjal, he stayed behind, crafting arms for those bound to the summit. I fled to Lordaeron. His final letter came from that mountain camp, and no word followed.

My death was likely no gentler than his. When I rose in Undercity, it felt like years had passed--but barely two had.

You look capable of the climb. Any remnant you find of my father, Lawrence Sawyer, would bring me solace.

entries.name: Sawyer's Legacy
entries.how:
Inside the wardrobe, a ledger records trades of hay, lumber, draft animals, and land. Other notes--personal and unfinished--are tucked between its pages.

The figures tell their own story: the Sawyer family was skilled at turning timber into weapons, tools, furniture, and wagons alike.

Thumbing through the pages reveals other kin of the family. Abigail Sawyer is listed among the relatives.

She would be very interested in this.

entries.name: Notarized Claim
entries.how:
I've added a note and my signature beside my name on the original page.

Take it to Royal Overseer Bauhaus at the Undercity Census and explain where it was found. He must know how it came to me while I remained at my shop.

You can be honest and say to him that Abigail Sawyer told another stranger her sob story and you happened to actually have the means to follow up on it.

Again, thank you for doing this for my family.

entries.name: Wood Remains
entries.how:
I've stamped the pertinent pages for Abigail's records and updated our own documents.

Abigail will have to send a follow-up to the Royal Census when she intends to transport any of the property into Forsaken territories.

You may return her ledger and bring with it a reminder: Her contractual obligations to the War Quarter's commissary are not yet fulfilled, so she would be prudent to wait before attempting to act on any of these pre-war ownership claims.

entries.name: Maerion's Misery
entries.how:
Left bleeding and abandoned--thrown aside so an army could flee. I was meant to die buying them moments. 

Instead, I was cursed to endure, forced to watch ever-burning demons finish what steel could not. This is my fate.

But something is changing. Horde and Alliance return to this desecrated mountain, and war stirs again.

My fury answers it. 

If yours does as well, prove it. Bring me two handfuls of felhound spikes from these Defiling Hounds.

The pain will align our wills.

entries.name: Blind Vengeance
entries.how:
The rune-etched shards are prepared. Dropped from high enough, they'll shatter upon impact, ripping through armor and demon flesh.

There's a tower overlooking this wasteland. It will give us the height we need.

We climb. I'll keep to the shadows and guard your flank.

When we reach the top, signal me by making the first throw. I'll bring ruin down on them.

entries.name: Now We're Cooking
entries.how:
In addition to seeing to the spiritual needs of the people here, I feed them as well. I'm not exactly a trained cook, but after five years, I've learned a thing or two about preparing food!

I'm sure that folks here would love a taste of something different. I remember, before we assembled on the mountain, there was a goblin from Everlook who was serving platters of tiny, Savory Stag Sliders... I would love to taste one of those again. We have plenty of stags up here, too! Think you can cook some up?

entries.name: The Darkened Glaive
entries.how:
I could smell the stink of demonic corruption on this glaive from the start. The demon that influenced it must be powerful, indeed. Particularly if the Shen'dralar--of all elves--want nothing to do with it.

Pouring the level of corruption that would be needed to taint a deeply magical artifact such as one of the storied "Chromatic Blades" would leave a connection. If you have the will, you can exploit that connection.

I will explain what is needed.

entries.name: Halt the Hail
entries.how:
Hey bub, I'm trying to break down some junk to get parts for my machine, but things are gettin' too hot.

I know what you're thinking, Winterspring? Getting hot? As you can see, my crusher and reployer are running, but sputtering hard! What they really need is something to cool 'em down that won't melt, slide, or burn off.

In the southern hills roams a nasty giant we call Hailspite. Put an end to Hailspite and bring me the frosty moss that grows on his crags. 

It might work for me!

entries.name: The Eyes of the Spire
entries.how:
This was once a helm of sorts, though it is difficult to tell it now in its twisted form. We can restore it, however. Like all things, there is a cost to this.

Go to the bastion of Blackrock Spire and claim the left eye of the false warchief, Rend Blackhand. From there, reach the pinnacle of the stronghold and claim the right eye of General Drakkisath, chief agent of the Lord of Blackrock.

Do this and you will remove two great evils from the world. Then I will cleanse the artifact you hold.

entries.name: The Eyes of the Spire
entries.how:
This was once a helm of sorts, though it is difficult to tell it now in its twisted form. We can restore it, however. Like all things, there is a cost to this.

Go to the bastion of Blackrock Spire and claim the left eye of the false warchief, Rend Blackhand. From there, reach the pinnacle of the stronghold and claim the right eye of General Drakkisath, chief agent of the Lord of Blackrock.

Do this and you will remove two great evils from the world. Then I will cleanse the artifact you hold.

This was once a helm of sorts, though it is difficult to tell it now in its twisted form. We can restore it, however. Like all things, there is a cost to this.

entries.name: The Weight of the World
entries.how:
You wade through toil and torment in search of riches and glory, ever pushing onward and upward. The weight of such an existence weighs heavily on all of us who choose this life. Should we not unburden our enemies of that which weighs heavily on their shoulders? 

In the city Stratholme reside two great, but opposing evils. Bring me the mantle of the false crusader, Dathrohan in his great bastion, and the pauldron of the one called Rivendare in his slaughterhouse sanctuary.

entries.name: Blood Pact
entries.how:
The ruin known as Dire Maul is a solemn tomb. Countless kaldorei souls have died to pay the balance of a grim bargain struck with an unthinking, uncaring evil. All in the name of maintaining the splendor and immortality of a privileged few. 

Go there and slay the beast known as Immol'thar that lies at the center of the western wing of the city. Bring me a phial of its cursed blood and break the cycle of death in that haunted place. Then I will cleanse the artifact you carry.

entries.name: Heart of Flesh, Heart of Stone
entries.how:
There's power in a creature's heart. It's the core of one's life, and without it, the living cease to live. I sometimes miss the beating of my own heart, though I acknowledge that requiring a pulse to live is... strictly a liability.

Travel to the Shaper's Terrace overlooking Un'goro Crater and retrieve the still-beating heart of the great Direhorn Matriarch there, as well as the hardened heart of the watcher, Nanaya.

Do this and I will cleanse the armor piece you carry.

entries.name: A Kingly Tribute
entries.how:
In the ruins of Dire Maul lies the seat of the king of the Gordok ogres. This warlord has plundered most of the riches of the fallen kingdom of the kaldorei, including the crown jewels of the ruling house of ancient Eldre'Thalas. I require these gems and you will retrieve them for me.

These riches will be well hidden, so you may need to use guile to not only defeat the king, but earn the tribute of his followers. Return the jewels to me and I will purify the corrupted leg armor you carry.

entries.name: The Path of Frost
entries.how:
The Lich called Ras Frostwhisper resides on the isle of Caer Darrow, in the Cult of the Damned training grounds known as the Scholomance. This creature has a number of alchemical components of some value, including a sample of Everfrost taken from the Frozen Throne itself.

I need you to retrieve it for me.

Oh, and while you are there, I also want you to dispose of the headmaster of the school, Gandling. Bring me his signet as proof.

entries.name: Return to Jereman
entries.how:
Jereman is fortunate to be alive. It sounds like she fled from the lodge in quite the hurry, no doubt thrilled to be freed from her predicament. 

She will wish to speak with you. Go, find her.

entries.name: Luck Be With You
entries.how:
Ah, I can tell just by lookin' at ya -- you be wantin' to make a lucky charm. Mau'ari always knows!

To da south. you'll find a canyon, an' giants made a' solid ice. The giants sometimes be carryin' dem, but ya can always gather da shards yerself from da canyon. These shards have a powerful reflective quality.

Bring back 10 frostmaul shards, and my lucky charm will be yours.

entries.name: Cache of Mau'ari
entries.how:
Now, before I give ya dis charm, I better explain how ta use it.

If you carry da charm with ya, you'll find dat certain items will drop from creatures ya fight. If you don't have da charm with you, you won't find them. Understand?

You'll know these special items by the name -- they be called E'ko. If you find any of these items, just bring dem to ol' Mau'ari, and she help ya out.

Wait here while I fix your charm.

entries.name: Are We There, Yeti?
entries.how:
Now that I have what I need to cover the mechanical moving parts, I only need one other thing. Well, actually two. Two horns!

The ice thistle patriarchs and matriarchs have the largest horns, so of course, those are the ones I want. That type of yeti inhabits a cave to the southeast. There are plenty of them there; you shouldn't have any problem finding them.

Remember, I only want the best looking ones -- no beat up or broken horns, please!

entries.name: Are We There, Yeti?
entries.how:
My friends are always coming up with great ideas. I've never felt like I could match them... until today! I just drew up the plans for something great! If you promise not to tell, I'll let you in on the secret... 

I'm going to make a mechanical yeti! Not only are my friends sure to be freaked out when they see it, but when they get over that, I know they'll be impressed!

I need thick yeti fur from the ice thistle yeti to start with. Will you help? You'll find them to the southeast.

entries.name: Frostsaber E'ko
entries.how:
In Winterspring, you will fight great cats called frostsabers. These beasts possess incredible speed an' cunning. If you wish ta gain the speed a' da frostsaber, bring me da E'ko you find from dem.

Rememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.

entries.name: Winterfall E'ko
entries.how:
In Winterspring, you will fight misguided creatures known as da Winterfall furbolg. Through the wishes of their leader, dey have gained incredible strength. If you wish ta gain the power a' da Winterfall, bring me da E'ko you find from dem.

Rememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.

entries.name: Shardtooth E'ko
entries.how:
In Winterspring, you will find large bears wit extremely thick hides. These Shardtooth bears gain much protection from what dey can withstand. If you wish ta gain the resistance against fire, bring me da E'ko you find from da Shardtooth.

Rememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.

entries.name: Chillwind E'ko
entries.how:
In Winterspring, you will fight great flying creatures called da Chillwind. These beasts possess da power ta wield frost magics. If you wish ta gain resistance ta frost, bring me da E'ko you find from da Chillwind.

Rememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.

entries.name: Ice Thistle E'ko
entries.how:
In Winterspring, you will fight great creatures called da ice thistle yeti. These beasts move slowly, but dey are able to evade many blows from da protection their thick fur provides dem. If you wish ta gain da ability to dodge attacks, bring me da E'ko you find from dem.

Rememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.

entries.name: Frostmaul E'ko
entries.how:
In Winterspring, you have fought da large ice giants called frostmaul. Sheer power and force is at their disposal. If you wish ta gain da force of da frostmaul, bring me da E'ko you find from dem.

Rememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.

entries.name: Wildkin E'ko
entries.how:
In Winterspring, you will fight creatures of might dat seem to possess an innate magic ability. These wildkin can use strong magics. If you wish ta gain an increase in your intellect bring me da E'ko you find from any a' da owlbeasts you find der.

Rememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.

entries.name: Chillwind Horns
entries.how:
I have most of what Tinkee needs, but I'm missing one important component, and that's chillwind horns.  The horns of the chillwind chimaera in Winterspring are a concentrated source of cold, but only pristine, uncracked horns will do!  I'll need a supply of those to complete Tinkee's order.

Bring me the uncracked chillwind horns, and I'll prepare a package for Tinkee.

entries.name: Return to Tinkee
entries.how: Ok, everything is prepared and packed and ready for transport!  Good luck in your journey, and make sure you tell Tinkee that she owes me!

entries.name: Strange Sources
entries.how:
To tell you the truth, although there are no volcanoes here in Winterspring, I believe that there are far more threatening reasons for these hot springs...

Well, I think you'll want to see it for yourself. You'll need to travel the length of Winterspring, and head to the very south. When the air becomes thick and muggy, and the sky turns dark, you'll have found what I believe to be the source of the hot springs.

Have a look. I'm sure you'll have many questions when you return.

entries.name: Enraged Wildkin
entries.how:
Hey there, lad! I was chased from my camp in southern Winterspring by some bloodthirsty wildkin! Well, I suppose I got too close to something the wildkin were guarding.

I barely managed to get away safely; I fear a buddy of mine wasn't as lucky. Would you mind braving the wildkin and heading to the camp? I really need my supplies, and I'd also like to get back the amulet I unearthed yesterday at the dig site.

entries.name: Enraged Wildkin
entries.how:
Looking around, you don't see much that Jaron could want here. However, you do notice that the crate you found has been smashed open, almost as if this was what the wildkin were after...

Looking to the east, you can barely make out an abandoned wagon. Perhaps you might find Jaron's things there. It's worth a look.

entries.name: Enraged Wildkin
entries.how:
After inspecting the contents of the box, you decide that Jaron could make use of the tools and other items inside. However, there is no sign of the amulet.

It appears that the wildkin inhabit the lands to the north and east of here, so you decide that the next step is to face the creatures and reclaim the amulet from them.

entries.name: Guarding Secrets
entries.how:
You are unsure of the significance of the necklace that fell from the neck of the recently-slain wildkin. It glows brightly, slowly fading in and out.

Trull Failbane might be able to tell you more, since his knowledge of the wildkin seems extensive. Perhaps you should ask him about it.

entries.name: Guarding Secrets
entries.how:
While I do possess much knowledge about the owlbeasts you defeated in Winterspring, I am not very learned on the subject of the magics they wield. But I do believe I know of one that would be able to examine the necklace and most likely tell you what it is.

Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff is an expert in this field; see her. Good luck, {name}.

entries.name: Guardians of the Altar
entries.how:
At the very top of the ridge lies what I believe to be an altar of the goddess Elune. From what I can tell, we need to light the five torches in each cave, and then we will be able to access the altar directly.

I transcribed some incantations carved into the stone in the ancient ruins of Kel'Theril, which I believe are the secret to unlocking the altar. I'll need your help to light each torch, while I recite the spell.

If we are successful, you'll be able to report our findings to Erelas!

entries.name: Wildkin of Elune
entries.how:
That's fascinating!

I have always wondered about the truth... Well, you must share this knowledge, definitely! Go to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm right away -- you'll find him in Darnassus, in the Cenarion Circle. Explain to him what happened, just the same as you told me. I'm sure he will be just as interested!

This is important information, {name}!

entries.name: Frostsaber Provisions
entries.how:
If you wish to prove yourself, you may begin by doing a very simple, but very important task.

Gather meat from the chimaera and from the shardtooth bears in the area. Bring it to me so that I may use it to feed the frostsabers that are being trained.

entries.name: Ursius of the Shardtooth
entries.how:
In the snowy mountains of Winterspring, to the northwest, a skilled hunter stalks his prey... I speak of Ursius of the shardtooth bears, an agile and clever beast.

I send you now against him. He roams the sloping hills to the northwest of Everlook. Find and hunt him, before he discovers your intent.

All that have gone up against Ursius have quickly found themselves to be the prey, and he, the hunter. Stay on your guard.

entries.name: Brumeran of the Chillwind
entries.how:
Swift, and clever, Brumeran glides silently across the snowy landscape of southern Winterspring. But do not let her graceful appearance convince you that she is harmless. All that cross her pay considerably, and often with their own lives.

Seek out Brumeran of the chillwind among the chimera. Defeat her, then return again to me.

entries.name: Shy-Rotam
entries.how:
In northern Winterspring, great cats assemble around a large landmark called Frostsaber Rock. The leader of these cats is known by the name Shy-Rotam. Defeating the matriarch of the frostsabers would grant you much respect in the eyes of your fellow {race}.

Go again to the harsh wilds, and once there, gather sacred meat from the frostsabers. Find the stone of Shy-Rotam, and place it there. Placing the meat of her kin before her will summon Shy-Rotam, in anger.

Be ready for her fury, and defeat her.

entries.name: Past Endeavors
entries.how:
Before you spoke to me, {name}, I had heard of your endeavors... that you had an unyielding desire to prove yourself, that you had an exceptional ability as a {class}, and I now know these things to be the truth.

Those that excel as you do are worthy of recognition. Take this marker to a friend of mine in Thunder Bluff named Melor Stonehoof. I'm sure he will remember you, and what you accomplished so long ago. Speak to him of you recent victories, and do not ever forget what you have accomplished today.

entries.name: Cap of the Scarlet Savant
entries.how:
A finer cap you may never see. From the pristine hide of the beast, our expert crafters will create the most phenomenal hat a prestidigitator could ever hope to don!

Fifty gold pieces along with the listed items and your head shall be graced with the Cap of the Scarlet Savant:

*The pristine hide of the Beast.

*Frayed abomination stitchings.

*Arcane crystals.

*Enchanted scarlet thread.

BEHOLD!

entries.name: Leggings of Arcana
entries.how:
While the crafting of such an item has never successfully been accomplished, it is thought to be possible - under the right circumstance.

Should the seeker of arcanum desire to imbue leggings with immense power, the following they must find:

* The pristine hide of the Beast.

* Frayed abomination stitchings.

*Arcanite Bars.

*Frostwhisper's embalming fluid.

BEHOLD!

entries.name: Breastplate of Bloodthirst
entries.how:
It is said that only one Breastplate of Bloodthirst has ever been created and that it was made for the legendary assassin, Garona. Whether this world will ever see another is doubtful.

Regardless! Our master crafters can reproduce the item given the necessary components:

*The pristine hide of the Beast.

*Frayed abomination stitchings.

*Arcanite bars.

*The skin of shadow.

BEHOLD!

entries.name: Threat of the Winterfall
entries.how:
I came to Winterspring to investigate the Frostfire Hot Springs. I've noticed that the water seems to have ...strange qualities. I haven't yet been able to discover the source, and to tell you the truth, I've had some difficulty lately, due to the Winterfall furbolg.

They seem to be drawn to the springs, just as I am. They have become extremely protective of the water, and won't let me come near the two larger springs to the north of here.

I'd like to continue my studies, so won't you help me?

entries.name: Winterfall Firewater
entries.how:
This vial that you picked up from the Winterfall furbolg is empty, but you can detect a few drops of a strange green liquid inside; it almost glows.

Is it something important?

Donova Snowden would probably be able to tell you more, since she has been camped by the hot springs in Winterspring for some time now.

entries.name: Falling to Corruption
entries.how:
This greenish liquid... it reminds me a bit of the sludge I saw when traveling through Felwood. And I have seen some Winterfall Runners passing into Timbermaw... Perhaps these things have something to do with the flask you found, {name}.

There is a large group of furbolg just past Timbermaw Hold, in Felwood. Called the Deadwood tribe, they have been corrupted and driven mad by the fel. Why don't you look around there and see if you can find any evidence of dealings between the Winterfall and the Deadwood?

entries.name: Mystery Goo
entries.how:
The greenish substance inside the cauldron appears to be similar to what you found in the flask. This strange gooey stuff could be as corrupted as the furbolg that created it...

If the Winterfall furbolg are using it, does this mean that they will soon be as corrupted as the Deadwood tribe?

It would be best to report back to Donova with your findings, along with a sample of the liquid in the cauldron.

entries.name: Toxic Horrors
entries.how:
I've studied the sample you returned with, and while I can't say for sure, I believe it contains traces of toxic elements. However, the only way to know for sure is to gather some as a comparison.

I believe that the Deadwood furbolg may be gathering these elements from other corrupted creatures in Felwood; in particular, the elementals living in the Irontree Woods, called toxic horrors.

Collect a few samples for me to compare, but be careful -- it's very dangerous there!

entries.name: Winterfall Runners
entries.how:
Very interesting, {name}...

When this toxic substance is mixed with the water from the hot springs, it loses its toxicity, only retaining the ability to temporarily affect those that ingest it. This must be why the Winterfall protect the hot springs so fervently -- they need them to purify their firewater.

We need to stop this -- cut off contact between the Winterfall and the Deadwood. A group of runners walks the distance between their village and Felwood. Find and defeat them, and steal their shipment.

entries.name: High Chief Winterfall
entries.how:
While we still know very little about why the furbolg have been ingesting this strange substance, I do think it's best that we put a stop to it before it gets out of hand.

The Winterfall furbolg are not a normally aggressive tribe, and this change in their behavior leads me to think that they must be under orders from their chief. We most likely can't undo the damage that has already been done, but I think that if their leader is slain, they will not get any worse.

Head east to Winterfall Village.

entries.name: The Final Piece
entries.how:
The log you found on the high chief looks extensive, but after looking through a couple of the pages, you find that you cannot read the text. The markings are so crude and poorly-formed that you are not sure if anyone would be able to read them.

But perhaps Donova will be able to tell you what it says...

entries.name: Fiery Plate Gauntlets
entries.how:
By Thaurissan's beard!

Where did you find them?

More importantly, are you willing to part with them? Naturally, I would pay you for such a noble gesture.

I'll tell you what, {name}. If you give me those unfired gauntlets, I will teach you how to make a set all your own. All you need to do is collect the parts for me so that I may narrow down the exact recipe.

Do we have a deal??

Here's the list of what I need, I'll front the non-enchanted thorium myself since you're supplying the gauntlets.

entries.name: Lorax's Tale
entries.how: The Satyr paces about and talks to himself. Do you wish to question him?

entries.name: Words of the High Chief
entries.how:
The Winterfall are no longer a threat to me, but if you still want to find out what was driving the furbolg to create and consume this strange firewater, I think you should seek out Kelek Skykeeper.

He is part of a group known as the Emerald Circle, druids that are committed to their work in Felwood, healing the land from the corruption.

Kelek has much experience with the furbolgs in Felwood, and may be able to tell you more about the log.

Thank you, again, {name}.

entries.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
entries.how:
We understand what the cursed brood of Deathwing attempts to do and we know that it cannot be allowed.

Because of the protection Blackrock mountain affords Nefarian, it has become increasingly difficult for us to intercede.

We can, however, empower you, mortal - should you so choose.

The path before you is one full of peril. You must decide whether to accept our help. Ponder this and speak with me again when a decision has been made.

entries.name: Are We There, Yeti?
entries.how:
It's all ready, {name}!

Now, I sent some mail to my friends already, telling them that I have a surprise for them. This is where you come in!

I'm going to give you my mechanical yeti, and you need to surprise them by paying each of my friends a visit, turning the yeti on and sending it towards them.

 Once you have shown Legacki in Everlook, Sprinkle in Gadgetzan, and Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge, come back and tell me what happened!

Please bring my yeti back to me then, too.

entries.name: Winterfall Intrusion
entries.how:
My presence goes unnoticed by most, {name}. However, there is an annoyance that seems firmly rooted here in Winterspring: the Winterfall furbolg.

Although I have never directly attacked the furbolg, they seem crazed, fearful of anything in their path. I have watched them slay countless creatures that had the misfortune to simply be in the wrong place at the wrong time.

I am weary of their meddling -- please, help me by fighting back. Slay the furbolg and keep them away from Frostsaber Rock.

entries.name: The Ruins of Kel'Theril
entries.how:
The story behind Kel'Theril is one of a cursed race, bound to the place where they attempted an unfortunate ritual...

The highborne that you will find there once stole a sacred artifact, believing that they could siphon its power for themselves, becoming even more powerful. In their efforts, the relic shattered in a huge explosion, driving the pieces below the ice of the lake...

Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper if you'd like to learn more; he has recently visited the area and can tell you more.

entries.name: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril
entries.how:
The highborne spirits are miserable creatures, that's for sure. They are still searching for pieces of the very thing that has cursed them to Kel'Theril forever -- the stolen relic.

If you are that interested, take my pick and go south to the lake, see if you can gather the pieces of it from within the ice.

Now, I can't tell you a thing about what you find, but I do know of someone who might... Aurora Skycaller; she dwells near the Northpass Tower in the northern part of Eastern Plaguelands.

entries.name: Remorseful Highborne
entries.how:
The... the crystal...

The highborne here are clouded by their own misssery...

I am sorrrrrowful, but I realize the errorrrr of what happened so long ago. Even though there is no waaaay to change the past, I am now at peacccce knowing that you have recovered the crystal of Zin-Malor...

Youuu must return it...

It muuuussst be returrrned.

entries.name: The Crystal of Zin-Malor
entries.how:
Quite impressive, {name}.

The crystal of Zin-Malor can never be returned to the temple which, as you know, lies in ruin. But I believe that your effort to undo the evil of the past should not go unrewarded.

Seek out Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus, and bring the crystal to him, {name}. It should be in the hands of those that will not abuse its power. From the looks of it, only a handful of the strongest magic users would be able to control such a power.

entries.name: Rampaging Giants
entries.how:
Around 4,000 years ago, Tyrande Whisperwind saved the life of the frostsaber queen, at the hands of rampaging giants. Since then, the frostsabers have been allies of the night elves.

These same giants that once were a danger to the frostsabers, still exist not too far from here. They are called the frostmaul, and they have taken over the large valley to the south.

Prove your loyalty to the frostsabers; kill these giants in the name of the frostsaber queen, Shy-Rotam!

entries.name: The Everlook Report
entries.how:
I am looking for a responsible individual to aid me in a small but nonetheless important matter.  I'm here as a representative of the Argent Dawn's interests to the local governance of Everlook.  I need to get a progress report to Argent Officer Pureheart at Chillwind Camp; it's a ways from here, located along the southern fringe of the Western Plaguelands.

If I may be so bold - this would be a perfect means to introduce yourself to my superior and perhaps earn some work from her!

entries.name: The Everlook Report
entries.how:
I'm looking for a responsible individual to aid me in a small but nonetheless important matter.  I'm here as a representative of the Argent Dawn's interests to the local governance of Everlook.  I need to get a progress report to Argent Officer Garush at the Bulwark; it's a ways from here, located along the western fringe of the Western Plaguelands, east of Tirisfal Glades.

If I may be so bold - this would be a perfect means to introduce yourself to my superior and perhaps earn some work from him!

entries.name: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff
entries.how:
A recluse medium found in these parts by the name of Umbranse has provided the Argent Dawn with quite a literary masterpiece... one that amounts to quite possibly the largest collection of jibber-jabber I've ever seen written.

One of the Dawn's most respected leaders, Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff, is a brilliant linguist.  Could you take this to him for me - for a reward, of course?  Light's Hope Chapel - that's where he's currently at, far in the eastern part of the Eastern Plaguelands.

entries.name: Trouble in Winterspring!
entries.how:
There's trouble in Winterspring!

Why, sure, I spend some time out in the wilds and know about these things... I'm always mighty proud to say it. I consider the hours I spend out there in the hills to be golden. Help you cultivate quick reflexes, a cool head and a keen eye...

It takes judgement, brains and maturity to appreciate the wilderness in the way that I do.

Now, what was I talking about?

Ah yes, trouble. See Donova Snowden at the hot springs and she can tell you more.

entries.name: Enraged Wildkin
entries.how:
Have you noticed the abandoned camp to the south of here? It looks like the wildkin went crazy and destroyed just about everything they could find!

I heard a rumor that one of the survivors of the attack is resting at Starfall Village, west of here. I'm sure curious about what happened... aren't you?

entries.name: A Strange One
entries.how:
I just got back from Felwood, {name}. On my way through, I stopped at Bloodvenom Post and I met a very odd character... She seemed intent on one thing, and I suppose I could tell you what that is, but I think she'd like to explain it to you herself.

If you're interested, head to Bloodvenom Post in western Felwood and look for Winna Hazzard.

Who knows, she might need your help...

entries.name: A Little Luck
entries.how:
We can always use a little luck, eh? A small advantage is all it takes to turn things in your favor...

I happened to make the acquaintance of a rather eccentric witch doctor some time back. She made me a lucky charm... for a price. Believe me, though, it was well worth it!

Maybe you'd be interested in one of your own? Find Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook. I'm not giving mine up!

entries.name: Winterfall Ritual Totem
entries.how:
You have found one of the Winterfall furbolg's ritual totems.  The totem itself is of non-descript construction, but it seems to emanate an almost tangible sense of dread and despair.  If many of the Winterfall furbolgs do indeed carry these, it certainly would go a long way in explaining their current condition.

One of the furbolgs inside Timbermaw Hold may have a use for such an item... that is, if you've earned their trust enough for them to speak with you.

entries.name: Red Bag Blues
entries.how:
What you want is safely hidden, and I can only hope the same can be said for what I'm looking for.

I had a red bag containing some valuable tooling that I use for electro-optics. But, I lost it in a zeppelin accident over Burning Steppes! The bag could still be there, but with orcs, ogres, and poachers, I've had to put my work on hold.

If you can locate it and bring it back to me, I'll let you have Jurgens' old book.

entries.name: Bookin' it Back
entries.how: Nami hands over Jurgens' book. With it safely stowed, you begin the long journey back to the other side of the world.

entries.name: Demonic Deceptions
entries.how:
De loa have told me of a poison gatherin' strength in Ashenvale, on the tainted land where the great demon Mannoroth was slain. Someone be drawin' power from the pit lord's remains.

They must be usin' illusions to hide their rituals. If you are to stop them, you'll be needin' protectin from their deceptions.

My tribe uses an extract from owlbeast glands in an enchantment to discern truth from lies. Collect these glands from the owlbeasts in Winterspring.

entries.name: Fiery Plate Gauntlets
entries.how:
By Thaurissan's beard!

Where did you find them?

More importantly, are you willing to part with them? Naturally, I would pay you for such a noble gesture.

I'll tell you what, {name}. If you give me those unfired gauntlets, I will teach you how to make a set all your own. All you need to do is collect the parts for me so that I may narrow down the exact recipe.

Do we have a deal??

Here's the list of what I need, I'll front the non-enchanted thorium myself since you're supplying the gauntlets.
rewardItems: Plans: Fiery Plate Gauntlets of the Hidden Technique

entries.name: Shroud of the Winter Wilds
entries.how:
Folks have been trying to get onto Mount Hyjal since the end of the war, but there's one big problem... all the demons in Darkwhisper Gorge!

I think I have the solution. A concoction made from locally-sourced ingredients might be able to make the drinker blend in with the Winterspring surroundings so that creatures here can't see you as easily.

I'd love to test this theory, if you're game for bringing me a few small things!

entries.name: Cleansing the Corruption
entries.how:
You have helped me greatly, {name}. Thanks to your efforts, the corruption will spread much quicker.

Unfortunately, this will be the last time that you will be needed.

entries.name: Secret of the Barrow Deeps
entries.how: <The corrupted shards combine into a gem seething with tainted power. The Watchers will want to see this.>

entries.name: Secret of the Barrow Deeps
entries.how:
If we could enter the prisons directly, I would be down there this very moment. But the corruption has twisted our ancient wards, barring our way.

If you are truly dedicated to our cause, assist me in wielding this gem against our foe. With its tainted magics attuned to our fallen sisters, we can use it to forge a key that will grant us access to the depths below.

I will need a few reagents first. Nelanna may spare a filigree to one who has proven themselves an ally, but the rest is up to you.

entries.name: A Ring of Gems
entries.how:
{name}, a moment of your time, please?

I have heard the others speak praise of your deeds within the Barrow Deeps. Conveniently, I was recently commissioned to create rings to empower our ranks. I would like to give you the opportunity to pick the first among those I craft. I have the gemstones necessary, but without enchanted metals they will fail to be of any use.

Enchanted Thorium Bars will satisfy this need. I, and the Watchers, would be grateful if you could procure some for us.

entries.name: Secret of the Barrow Deeps
entries.how:
It is finished. With this we can enter the Vord'anaar prisons and put an end to our fallen sisters.

Take no pity on them, {name}. They were dead the moment the corruption took hold of their hearts.

Ashal thera'das!

entries.name: Shardtooth Pulling
entries.how:
The Shardtooth are becoming more rabid every season. They compete with each other and the predators of the wilds for what limited food sources they can reach.

More often, they attack us, hunger driving their aggression in the bitter cold.

The bears are numerous and strong-willed. With their numbers reduced, the families that remain will grow stronger than ever.

Help them on their way. Cull the eldest of them.

entries.name: Two-Headed Ravagers
entries.how:
These chimaeras are a cruel joke. Two tongues, both foul, snarling frost and hunger. As if this wasteland needed more teeth.

This clearing is all we have, constantly overcome by storms before we can settle further. The two-headed Chillwind Ravagers circle us, testing our resolve, bleeding our time.

We spend more hours driving them back than building anything of worth.

Cull them. Break their presence here. With fewer prowling beasts, we may yet carve something lasting from this frozen waste.

entries.name: Too Bad to Bear
entries.how:
There are two old matriarchs, long aged past their cub rearing cycles. Perhaps they are sisters. They could also be two kindred bears who've shared a similar passing of seasons.

Regardless of what has brought them together, they still have a ferocity and will to live that demands respect. Attempting to set up a camp like this one has been difficult for us, with these two grizzled Shardtooths.

Bring back the heads of Kuroma and Kamuro, and try to end them swiftly, skillfully, and with mercy.

entries.name: Shroud of the Winter Wilds
entries.how: Back for more, eh? You know the drill! Bring me some Chillwind Chimaera Fur and Winterspring Owl Feathers, and I'll use the ingredients to mix up a shrouding potion that'll help to conceal you from the eyes of the creatures living around here.

entries.name: Moontouched Wildkin
entries.how:
Wildkin feathers from the Hinterlands appear to contain traces of magical qualities. These powers... they don't seem to be wielded by the creatures, it's more like they are simply inherent to the species -- part of their very essence.

During my studies, I heard that a large population of wildkin inhabit the snowy lands of Winterspring. Could these creatures have the same powers? Please help me find an answer, {name}. Go to Winterspring and gather feathers that have dropped to the ground, then return to me.

entries.name: Find Ranshalla
entries.how:
Yes, yes, these feathers seem to hold the same magical enchantment that I noticed previously... While I am not certain what we might find, I urge you to continue searching for answers, {name}.

A colleague of mine recently traveled into Winterspring to observe the wildkin there, in their own habitat. Why don't you catch up with her and see what she has found?

entries.name: Favored of Elune?
entries.how:
Wildkin are quite unpredictable creatures, {name}. Capable of incredible gentleness, these creatures will show extreme ferocity if something they deem important is threatened.

These beasts are rumored to have been created by Elune, and I am interested in finding if this is really the truth.

Recently, I heard about a population of wildkin living in the Hinterlands -- Vicious, Primitive, and Savage Owlbeasts. They can be found amongst the wildlife there. Will you gather some wildkin feathers for me?

entries.name: Starfall
entries.how:
In Winterspring, to the northeast of Felwood, there are many ancient elven ruins. It's a harsh land, but it holds many secrets and places to explore.

My studies here keep me so busy that I have not had the opportunity to travel to Winterspring for some time. But there's no reason why you shouldn't travel there and study the ruins.

While you're there, look for Wynd Nightchaser. He spends most of his time in Starfall and he knows a lot about the area.

Tell him that you are a student of mine...

entries.name: Crime and Punishment
entries.how:
As if the neglect for the residents of Duskwood was not bad enough, now the House of Nobles spits in the eye of the Darkshire Council with their decision to imprison Dextren Ward in Stormwind rather than behead the villain as per Lord Ebonlocke's sentence.

Ward was caught selling bodies from the cemetery to Morbent Fel, a crime punishable by death.  Yet Stormwind claims Ward as their prisoner.

Assassinate Ward in The Stormwind Stockade - bring me his hand - and I shall reward you.

entries.name: The Fury Runs Deep
entries.how:
You have proven your loyalty to King Magni, {class}.  And your hatred for the Dark Iron scum is as great as my own.

There is a task I wish to complete myself but I am bound by honor to stay with Longbraid.  But Roggo has gathered intelligence that proves Kam Deepfury was a conspirator in the attack on the Thandol Span.  It was by Deepfury's planning that Longbraid lost his kin.

Deepfury is being held for political reasons in the Stormwind Stockade.  I want him dead, {name}.  For Longbraid!  Bring me his head!

entries.name: What Comes Around...
entries.how:
Targorr the Dread served under Gath'Ilzogg as supreme Executioner.  His methods were ruthless, even by filthy orc standards.  Men who fought bravely to defend the Kingdom were tortured on his whim.  Now he is being held in the Stormwind Stockade, sentenced to die.  Yet something is amiss.  One of the bureaucratic nobles put a hold on his execution.  I am sure foul play is in the works.

Put an end to Targorr the Dread, {name}.  Travel to The Stockade and behead him before trickery is upon us.

entries.name: Quell the Uprising
entries.how:
The uprising must be quelled!  I need your assistance.  If word gets out that the prison is overrun I will lose my job!  This is a case of foul play if I've ever seen one.  But what's important now is forcing these prisoners into submission for the safety of Stormwind.

The punishment for insurgency is death.  Kill some of these deviants!  That ought to get things under control.

entries.name: The Color of Blood
entries.how:
Bitterness flows through my veins like a cold river.  My grandson, Mac, was such a good boy.  A mere 14 years old.  When the army was sent off to the front, Mac took up arms to defend the city.  He was a guard in The Stockade, where the Defias gang is locked up.  Mac reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their wool blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang.  For that Mac was stabbed in the back.

I want revenge.  Bring me 10 of their precious Wool Bandanas.  They are the color of blood.

entries.name: The Stockade Riots
entries.how:
Let's get one thing straight, {name}: I don't trust you. But, with the situation as it is, you probably won't make a difference.

So here's how it's going to be: go down there and have your talk with Thredd. If you're really on our side, then kill him and bring me his head when the job's done. And if it turns out you're on his side, and don't come out... when we find you, you'll die along with the rest of the maggots.

entries.name: Leaders of the Fang
entries.how:
The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration.  They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to heal the Barrens, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.

The Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem.  Even now their faces haunt me!  Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the Barrens may again know peace.

Go, {name}.  You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.

entries.name: Trouble at the Docks
entries.how:
Oops!

Had a little mishap, as you can see! The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. That's when everything came tumbling down.

Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. No way I was going in there.

Maybe you're brave enough to find him?

entries.name: Serpentbloom
entries.how:
The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great Undercity of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, {name}. Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the Forsaken.

Recently I studied a rare specimen of flora named Serpentbloom. I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential.

Unfortunately Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the Barrens.

entries.name: When Dreams Turn to Nightmares
entries.how:
Naralex sleeps again!

Long ago, Naralex journeyed to this cavern with the honorable goal of entering the Emerald Dream and regrowing the Barrens into a lush forest. His focus waned and his thoughts became tainted by serpentine visions.

Now, reptilian beasts seep from his dreams to the land. He must be awoken from the nightmare or he will be forever lost, and a great evil unleashed.

Only after his corrupted servants, the Fanglords, have been slain can I perform the awakening ritual.

entries.name: Deviate Hides
entries.how:
As Naralex descended deeper into his nightmare, a strange breed of beasts arose from beneath the Barrens into the Wailing Caverns.

These deviate creatures have strange, otherworldly properties. While evil in nature, it is my opinion that some good can come from their existence here in Kalimdor. I believe their hides will be of particular use in the ways of leatherworking.

If you feel up to the task, venture into the caves below and retrieve some deviate hides.

entries.name: Deviate Eradication
entries.how:
Naralex had a noble goal.

Our great leader aspired to enter the Emerald Dream and help regrow these harsh lands back into the lush forest it once was. But something went terribly wrong.

Naralex's dream turned into a nightmare and corrupt creatures began to inhabit the caverns.

While some Disciples of Naralex seek to awake our master, my concern is with ridding these caves of the evil beasts.

Brave the caverns, {name}, and eradicate the deviate spawn.

entries.name: Hamuul Runetotem
entries.how:
The shells you brought me have a taint, one I have never before seen.  I am certain the water of the Oases is the cause, and I can sense the confusion they cause this land.  It is as if the land dreams and cannot awake.

The Wailing Caverns must be the source of the taint.  But before you go there, speak with Hamuul Runetotem, the elder druid.  I sent word to him of the happenings in the Barrens.  He is wise, and can offer you counsel.

You will find him in Thunder Bluff, on the Elder Rise.

entries.name: Nara Wildmane
entries.how:
I entered the land of dreams, and dreamed of a cult of druids who dwell in the Wailing Caverns.  I saw that their goals were once noble, but they have lost their way.  They are now servants of the taint seeping through the Barrens.

I am old and my strength fails.  I could not long dwell in that dreaming place and know little more of the tainted druids.  But Nara is young and her spirit is fierce.  She remained in the dreaming when I fled.

Speak with Nara.  She is in the tent, over yonder.

entries.name: Smart Drinks
entries.how:
Ok, so the raptor horns didn't work so well.  But that's all right -- no one got rich on their first try!  And besides, I think I found something that'll work even better in my smart drinks!

There is a substance called Wailing Essence, and I think it is the cause of the strange plants and animals in the Barrens.  Get me some and I'll try it in my drink!

I heard the essence gathers in ectoplasmic creatures in the Wailing Caverns to the west.  Hunt those creatures and gather the essence.

entries.name: Waking Naralex
entries.how:
The Fanglords are dead! All hope is not lost!

The awakening ritual is quite complex, however. It cannot be done alone.

I will handle all of the necessary preparations but I will need you to protect me. The nightmares summoned from Naralex's journey through the Emerald Dream prove to be quite formidable. Without your help, this mission is doomed.

When you are ready to defend me, say the word, and I shall lead the way to Naralex's chamber.

entries.name: The Glowing Shard
entries.how:
The shard is a brilliant green, and although solid, what looks like smoke swirls just below the surface. You can't help staring into the depths of the crystal; at the same time, you know there is something very disturbing about it.

Maybe you should see if anyone in Ratchet can tell you more about this strange shard.

entries.name: Knowledge in the Deeps
entries.how:
As you might know, I collect lore.  Old lore.  Powerful lore.  Lore that opens doorways, and lore that can awaken Those Who Sleep.

There are rumors of an old piece of lore, the Lorgalis Manuscript, at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale.  That place is the old dwelling of long-dead elves.  Elves who held great knowledge before their city fell to ruin.

Search Blackfathom Deeps for the manuscript.  Do this, and I will not forget it.  Not even after ... the end days.

entries.name: In Search of Thaelrid
entries.how:
Many rumors circulate these days about the union of the Twilight's Hammer and the naga in Blackfathom Deeps on the coasts of Ashenvale.

My role here with the Argent Dawn is to collect as much information as I can, so we know when and where help is needed.

It has been weeks now since I sent a scout to check on the activity at Blackfathom Deeps. Argent Guard Thaelrid has not yet reported back.

My other scouts are preoccupied with pressing matters.

Seek out and aid Thaelrid for me, {name}.

entries.name: Twilight Falls
entries.how:
Empowered by the ancient rites of the chaotic Old Gods the members of the Twilight's Hammer strive to bring about the return of their dark patrons and spread death and terror across the world.

We believe that the Twilight's Hammer has allied with the naga and are amassing in Blackfathom Deeps on the coast of Ashenvale.

Whatever evil plan brews in the depths of the old temple must be thwarted.

Wage war on the Hammer and bring back proof of your deeds. Your efforts will be rewarded handsomely.

entries.name: Blackfathom Villainy
entries.how:
Strength has left me. Your help is needed!

Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Selgorm in Darnassus, {name}, please.

entries.name: Researching the Corruption
entries.how:
Foolish blood elves toil with demonic magic. Have they not witnessed what happened with the naga and with the satyrs of Kalimdor?

I fear that the blood elves will meet a similar deformation. Azeroth cannot afford to give birth to another vile race of monsters.

I wish to study the brain stems of the satyr and naga so that I might deduce what fate the elves are headed toward. In Blackfathom Deeps, on the coast of Ashenvale, you will find both satyr and naga.

'Tis a long journey, {name}.

entries.name: Blackfathom Villainy
entries.how:

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, {name}, please.

entries.name: Trouble in the Deeps
entries.how: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, {name}. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.

entries.name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
entries.how:
Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component.

Will you help me, {name}? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.

entries.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
entries.how:
Some poor handwriting is scrawled on the crumpled up note:

"Yes, tell all the priestesses to bring the crystals to me. The water elemental spirits are strong within them and they will aid our aquamancers greatly in their own summonings.

By controlling the power within the crystals, we will appease Aku'Mai. One day we will have enough power to bring Aku'Mai back to us and the world will return to its greatest era! An era of rule by the Old Gods!"

entries.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
entries.how:
This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods--creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, {name}. I cannot do it myself--I am too weak.

Go into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.

entries.name: Amongst the Ruins
entries.how:
The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.

{name}, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water.  In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!

entries.name: The Heart of the Void
entries.how: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead.  Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.

entries.name: The Heart of the Void
entries.how: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead.  Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.
