Return to Belgrom in Orgrimmar. He will want to see her head for himself!

Ah, this is indeed a good day. Thank you for your help, {name}.

entries.name: Exploring the Horde
entries.how:
Azeroth is a large world, and the territory of the Horde is vast. The Undercity, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff all have very unique people and culture.

If you are to be a guest of the Horde here on Azeroth, it would do you good to visit each of our capital cities in turn. Speak with my advisor Nazgrel for directions.

entries.name: Welcome to Azeroth
entries.how:
It's a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.

The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the Horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the Horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, {name}.

entries.name: Karolek
entries.how:
We have done well to create great relationships with the merchants and craftspeople of Orgrimmar. Among these excellent relationships is an orc named Karolek, a leatherworker who ensures a steady supply of hides and other useful equipment to us.

He also happens to be great at making signs!

If you'd like to get your sign made fast, I would recommend him over anyone else. Let him know I sent you.

entries.name: A Quick Craft
entries.how:
The materials for the sign should be easy to come by as an accomplished crafter like yourself. All we will need is oa Heavy Leather and oa Mithril Bars.

Normally for a rush order I would charge a few gold, but I have had a craving for homemade Goldthorn Tea lately. Don't worry, I enjoy making it myself, but I do need oa Goldthorn to make it happen.

If you bring me all of these, you'll have your first sign ready to go in no time!

entries.name: Your First Riding Wolf
entries.how:
Lok'tar, {class}. Come to bond with your first wolf? Good.

There is no stronger bond than that of an orc and their wolf. They are no mere mount, but are a lifelong companion and friend.

Ours is not a bond chosen by vanity. No, each orc and wolf forms a special bond that goes beyond a mere purchase.

They will choose you as much as you will choose them. You will understand when you meet them.

Go and find which wolf speaks to you. Return to me when you have your answer.

entries.name: Learning to Ride
entries.how:
Mok'ra, {class}. You are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride one of our wolves, for a fee of course.

Ogunaro will provide you with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough gold, and I will teach you about wolf riding.

entries.name: Learning to Ride
entries.how:
Ey, welcome {class}! Ya now be seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride one of our raptors, for a fee of course.

Zjolnir will provide ya with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts ya would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but ya will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when ya have enough gold, and I will teach ya about raptor riding.

entries.name: Yelmak's Medley
entries.how:
Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.

He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.

entries.name: Meal Appeal
entries.how:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.

entries.name: Favorite Food
entries.how:
Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea. 

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily. 

Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!

entries.name: Whuut's the Rush
entries.how:
Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.

He is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.

Give him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.

entries.name: Rocks to Rests
entries.how:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium-sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?

entries.name: An Earnest Proposition
entries.how:
Hail, {class}! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world.  Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.

Perform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.

I'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus.  Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.

entries.name: Just Compensation
entries.how:
You've proven to be a very reliable individual, {name}.  As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.

For now I will exchange your belt and gloves. If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
rewardItems: Divine Will Gloves and Belt Set

entries.name: Anthion's Parting Words
entries.how:
Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.

I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
rewardItems: Merciful Boots, Legs, and Shoulders Set
Radiant Boots, Legs, and Shoulders Set
Divine Will Boots, Legs, and Shoulders Set

entries.name: Saving the Best for Last
entries.how:
A truly amazing story, {name}! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.

As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
rewardItems: Divine Will Helm and Chestpiece Set

entries.name: Swift as the Wind
entries.how:
Ey, welcome back {class}! 

Zjolnir will provide ya with a free armored mount once you have trained journeyman riding with me, and after that ya be able to purchase any additional armored mounts.

Speak to me when ya have enough gold, and I will teach ya to master raptor riding.

entries.name: Swift as the Wind
entries.how:
You have returned. Good. It's time to take your next steps. 

Ogunaro will provide you with a free mount once you have completed your final leg of training with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like, as before.

Speak to me when you have enough gold, and I will finish your training.

entries.name: An Epic Ride
entries.how:
Lok-tar, {name}. It is good to see you again. 
 
As you know, there is no stronger bond than that of an orc and their wolf, and now you have enough experience to handle and ride our fiercest and fastest wolves. 
 
Many of these fine wolves remember you from the last time you were here and have grown since you first met. They are stronger, faster and braver than before, much like yourself. 

Go and find which armored wolf speaks to you. Return to me when you have your answer.
rewardItems: Horn of the Swift Timber Wolf
Horn of the Swift Brown Wolf
Horn of the Swift Gray Wolf

entries.name: Until Death Do Us Part
entries.how:
Filthy scum! Leaves me for his damn crusade. Because "the Light is the most important thing we have against the threats the undead pose."

Well, what about his children?! What about ME?! Night after night I sat patiently waiting for him... always second to his blasted duty!

Well, witness what "justice" brings you, {name}! He's dead and I'm bearing the very thing he was trying to stop!

Take this piece of junk and put it on his tomb at the Sepulcher. I want nothing to do with it anymore... or him!

entries.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
entries.how:
Attention, young adventurers!  The wilds of Ashenvale await you!

The Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens.  Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde!  Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there.  Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!

entries.name: Preparation for Ceremony
entries.how:
{name}, my brother soon stands before Chief Bloodhoof, and it is my honor to make his headdress for him.

I want to ask a favor of you while I finish tanning these leather straps. There is not time for me to find enough feathers, and I was wondering, would you gather more for me?

You can find feathers of the correct size from the harpies residing far to the north and northwest of Thunder Bluff. I need only 6 azure and 6 bronze feathers to complete the design.

entries.name: Gathering Leather
entries.how:
Greetings, young one.  You have a gleam in your eye; I can tell you are eager to venture back to the plains for the hunt.  May you bring honor to your clan!

I work with the skins of beasts, fashioning them into clothes and armor for the people of Thunder Bluff.

If you hunt beasts and bring me their skins, then I will fashion something for you.

entries.name: Kodo Hide Bag
entries.how:
The kodo beasts of Mulgore are strong and sturdy -- traits much respected among us.  If you are skilled in leatherworking and wish the knowledge to make a Kodo Hide Bag, then bring me supplies for my trade.

Do this, and I will share my knowledge with you.

entries.name: The New Frontier
entries.how:
Attention, heroes!

The Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor!  A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.

All interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle.  Speak with the Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder's Rise of Thunder Bluff for more information!

entries.name: Forsaken Aid
entries.how:
The tauren have a bond with the land, and it pains me to hear of Stonetalon's plight.  But I fear that to heal the land, we must first remove the disease upon it.

Is it not fortunate, then, that the Forsaken are allied with us?  They know much of disease.  I believe they can aid us, and by doing so they will strengthen the trust between our people.

Speak with Apothecary Zamah.  She is a scholar and an emissary of the Forsaken.  You will find her in the Pools of Vision below the Spirit Rise.

entries.name: Journey to Tarren Mill
entries.how:
To rid Stonetalon of the Venture Company, we must take extreme measures.  Extreme, but without bloodshed.

A colleague of mine may have just the tool we need.  His name is Lydon; he dwells in the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, in the distant land of Lordaeron.

To reach Hillsbrad, travel by zeppelin to our capital, the Undercity.  Then go north to Tirisfal Glades, southwest to Silverpine, and south to Hillsbrad.

Seek Lydon and bring him this note.  It details our needs to him.

entries.name: Blood of Innocents
entries.how:
I will create a toxin to bleed the violence from the Venture Company, rendering them weak and docile.  That should fix the Horde's problem in Stonetalon, yes?

But to create the toxin, I will need the blood of innocents, a difficult ingredient to obtain.

Fortunately the Syndicate, a group of human brigands in this area, employ shadow mages... and those mages collect innocent blood for their own, unsavory purposes.

You can find the Syndicate shadow mages in Durnholde Keep to the southeast.

entries.name: Return to Thunder Bluff
entries.how:
Here is the toxin.  If you use it against the Venture Company it should produce favorable, perhaps even contagious, results.  I must say, it is quite exciting to see my work applied in the field!

But before using it, take it to Apothecary Zamah.  She must create a delivery method for the toxin to maximize its effect.

entries.name: The Flying Machine Airport
entries.how:
The toxin is ready.  All that remains is its delivery.  You, {name}, must make that delivery.

The Venture Company must have a means of sending messages and light cargo between its headquarters and its operations in Stonetalon.  It is likely a small sky port -- not big enough for a zeppelin, but perhaps for a flying machine.  You must search the areas in Stonetalon under control of the Venture Company and find this sky port, if it exists.  If you find it, then place the toxin there.

Place it, and run.

entries.name: Rabine Saturna
entries.how:
For this task, Keeper Remulos' majordomo in Moonglade - Rabine Saturna - seeks aid in exploring the vast wastelands far to the west of Tanaris and Un'Goro.  He is located in Nighthaven, the main village of Moonglade.

I want to impart on you the importance of your presence.  There are growing tensions between the night elves of Darnassus and the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade.  Look beyond racial boundaries and tap into the wisdom of your ancestors in dealings with the Circle there, {name}.  Good luck.

entries.name: Melor Sends Word
entries.how:
{name}, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.

If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.

entries.name: Steelsnap
entries.how:
At times we hunt for food.  At times we hunt for honor.  And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.

But the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things.  It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.

The hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens.  He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.

Find Steelsnap, {name}.  Find him, and defeat him.

entries.name: Frostmaw
entries.how:
{name}, it is now time for you to travel to far-off lands.  You are ready.

You now hunt Frostmaw, a yeti in the Alterac Mountains.  He is elusive, his white coat blending into the snows of his mountain home.  He rarely shows himself.

But I will show you how to entice a creature such as he.  Here, take this scroll.  On it I have written how Frostmaw may be lured.

Now go, {name}.  Your journey is long and many challenges lay waiting.  When you return with Frostmaw's mane, only then is your task complete.

entries.name: The Sacred Flame
entries.how:
The Galak centaur in the Thousand Needles are protecting an artifact from the time of the centaurs' creation.

We would like to retrieve it, but we require a phial of water from one of the night elves' moonwells.

To collect the water, you will first need to obtain one of the phials carried by the dryads near the Raynewood Retreat in the heart of Ashenvale Forest. There is a moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road, where you can fill the phial.

entries.name: The Sacred Flame
entries.how:
Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern Thousand Needles. You can get to the Thousand Needles by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the Barrens.

I wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.

entries.name: The Sacred Flame
entries.how:
Using the water you brought, you will be able to temporarily douse the flame that holds the centaur relic. It will not work permanently, however, so you will have to be quick about it.

You will find Splithoof Crag, the centaurs' stronghold, to the north of here. The flame is kept in Splithoof Hold, a heavily guarded part of the crag.

Be careful, though, the Galak centaur have great numbers here, and will be rather reluctant to surrender something so dear to them.

entries.name: <nyi> Investigating Mosarn
entries.how: Talk to Guard Komak. Asking questions gets you killed.

entries.name: The Platinum Discs
entries.how:
I shall focus my energies on these discs; they will reveal their true workings to me in due time.

As for you {name}, I will now reward you for your diligence in bringing this to my attention.  Take this voucher to Bena Winterhoof, the alchemy trainer for Thunder Bluff.  She will give you a special item I believe you will find appealing, and she will supply you with a choice of potions from my personal stock.

Return to me soon, as I sense there is much more at hand for us to do regarding this find.

entries.name: Portents of Uldum
entries.how:
Ah, {name}, it is fortuitous that you have come to me again.  Your revelations at the Uldaman dig site have certainly given us sages much discuss.  I was doing just that with one of the druids, Nara Wildmane, when it dawned on me that her past adventuring experiences may have some great importance as to the next step we need to take.

I would like for you to speak with her concerning her travels to the Valley of the Watchers in the Tanaris desert.  She waits for you on the Elder Rise.

entries.name: Seeing What Happens
entries.how:
Sage Truthseeker and I would like you to take the miniature discs you found to the sealed gates of Uldum.  We... we aren't sure what will happen when you do this.

This sounds risky, sure, we acknowledge that.  It might, however, do nothing.  You might need to use the discs on something.  Perhaps the doors unlock when you have the discs in your possession.  Be open to try anything, and be ready for anything to happen.

Learn what you can, then return to me. We will have much to discuss.

entries.name: Return to Thunder Bluff
entries.how:
You access the pedestal again; the platinum discs suddenly appear once more in your backpack.

With the knowledge of the stone watcher learned and the discs returned to your possession, the time has come to return to Thunder Bluff and inform the Nara Wildmane of your discovery.

entries.name: A Future Task
entries.how:
Well {name}... we seem to be at an unfortunate impasse.  We know what we need - the Plates of Uldum - but we have no idea where they might be.  We will research this, and then devise a solid plan of attack.  I have a couple ideas where to start looking; I have high hopes that soon, we'll be asking you to rejoin our efforts to discover the truth.

Sage Truthseeker needs to be informed on this, {name}; no doubt, he also wants to thank you personally for once again heeding the call.

entries.name: <UNUSED>
entries.how:
Imagine yourself racing across the plains, through forests and over mountains, the wind in your face... Traveling over unseen territory; the wonder of the road ahead, your destiny resting just over the horizon.

Always remember that on hoof, many things are achievable; as a Tauren, you will be granted the swiftness of Plainsrunning. There is no limit to the distances you might go.

entries.name: Un'Goro Soil
entries.how:
The soil of Un'Goro Crater is reportedly enriched with potent magical qualities.  The Cenarion Circle wants to study this soil in large quantities; go into the wilds of Un'Goro and acquire enough of it for our continued research.

The rich soil will stick out in piles from time to time, and some of the beasts might have usable samples on their being.  Take them all outside to Ghede; just look for the piles of dirt and the tauren barking orders.  He means well, just don't get him riled up though!

entries.name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
entries.how:
Excuse me {class}, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.

The Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project.  While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research.

Please - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff proper.

entries.name: Morrowgrain Research
entries.how:
With what we call an Evergreen Pouch, we have cultivated Tharlendris seeds in the soil from Un'Goro Crater.  These seeds have blossomed into an array of random, potent herbs.  One result is morrowgrain, a mysterious herb we know little about; I very much hope to unravel this mystery for the Circle.

Take this voucher over to my daughter Bashana, and she will give you some seeds so you may assist us.  If you run out, you will need to purchase more from her.

entries.name: Morrowgrain Research
entries.how:
Here's your Evergreen Pouch that you'll need to use the Tharlendis seeds with.  You also need to have Un'Goro soil samples on hand to use as fertilizer for the seeds.  Just use the pouch when you have everything; the pouch will take care of the rest.

When you have enough morrowgrain, bring them to me here on Elder Rise.  Please don't bother the Arch Druid; he'll be very busy with the research, as well as the multitude of concerns he has!

entries.name: Morrowgrain to Thunder Bluff
entries.how: The Arch Druid is always looking for more morrowgrain for the Cenarion Circle's research project on Un'Goro Crater.  We take them in increments of ten, and award you with a cache of goods you should find useful.  When you have ten, let me know and I will award you accordingly.

entries.name: A Donation of Wool
entries.how:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Thunder Bluff for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

entries.name: A Donation of Silk
entries.how:
As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low.  Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community!  If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

entries.name: A Donation of Mageweave
entries.how:
Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks!  By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal.  Such generosity would not go unnoticed by Thunder Bluff, I assure you!

If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

entries.name: A Donation of Runecloth
entries.how:
{name}, you've been a tremendous contributor to our cloth drive.  As we work hard to replenish our reserves, one form of cloth remains critically low - runecloth.  We are in absolutely dire need of it, and we hope that you will be able to help us as you have in the past!

If you are willing, please bring me what runecloth you can spare.  We'll initially accept a single donation of sixty, and then we'll go from there.

entries.name: Additional Runecloth
entries.how:
Greetings once again, {name}!  Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them.  For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continuing efforts on behalf of Thunder Bluff.

Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it.

entries.name: Traditions of the Bluff
entries.how:
Blessings of An'she, friend.

We tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.

entries.name: Never Coming Back
entries.how:
Gaaah!

I'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?

One moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?

When I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.

Could you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.

entries.name: Trouble In Darkshore?
entries.how:
How nice it is to see a {class} interested in the great archeological wonders of our world.

Oftentimes our work is dismissed as mere hobby by our friends in the Alliance. But what many fail to realize is that recent discoveries in Khaz Modan have proven that a great and powerful force threatens all of Azeroth, from Lordaeron to Kalimdor.

I am most worried about my crew that I sent to Darkshore. They haven't sent word in weeks.

Travel to Auberdine and look for a clue as to their whereabouts.

entries.name: The New Frontier
entries.how:
Attention, heroes!

The Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor!  A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.

All interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle.  Speak with the Arch Druid in Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm, for more information!

entries.name: Tears of the Moon
entries.how:
Lady Sathrah was once beloved of Elune. Graceful and pure, the spider spun her silver threads through the moonlight, catching the evening mist. The silvery dew had strong healing powers and was kept here in the temple.

But of late, Sathrah has descended into madness. Her future generations are now threatened as well.

Find Lady Sathrah, {name}, and end her suffering. She dwells along the northern borders of Teldrassil, near Wellspring Lake. Gather her silvery spinnerets and bring them back to me.

entries.name: The Temple of the Moon
entries.how:
A once great creature of the forest is in need of help, {race}.

There is a difficult task that must be done.

Please seek out Priestess A'moora; she will explain things to you. Find her to the southeast of here, inside the Temple of the Moon.

entries.name: Sathrah's Sacrifice
entries.how:
Now you must finish the task to which you have been appointed. Take the spinnerets and offer Lady Sathrah's sacrifice to Elune; lay the great spider to rest.

Inside this temple, find the central fountain. There is where you may leave the sacrifice.  The holy waters will purify and cleanse the corruption that drove Sathrah mad.

When you have completed this, return to me.

entries.name: Assisting Arch Druid Staghelm
entries.how:
Excuse me {class}, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.

The Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is looking for seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project.  While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm is spearheading this research.

Please - if you are interested, speak with him directly in the Cenarion Enclave within Darnassus proper.

entries.name: Un'Goro Soil
entries.how:
The soil of Un'Goro Crater is reportedly enriched with potent magical qualities.  I want to know facts from falsehoods; go into the wilds of Un'Goro and acquire enough quality samples of soil for our continued study.

You may think that collection tasks are beneath you; that sort of attitude does not endear yourself to me or the Cenarion Circle.  Bring the samples to Jenal, who is no doubt wasting time outside behind this tree; just look for the piles of dirt.  He will handle the logistics - not I.

entries.name: Morrowgrain Research
entries.how:
With what we call an Evergreen Pouch, we have cultivated Tharlendris seeds in the soil from Un'Goro Crater.  These seeds blossom into an array of random, potent herbs.  One result is morrowgrain, a mysterious herb we know little about; I intend to unravel this mystery.

Take this to Mathrengyl downstairs, and he will give you some seeds so you can get started.  If you run out, you will need to purchase more from him.

entries.name: Morrowgrain Research
entries.how:
Here's your Evergreen Pouch that you'll need to use the Tharlendis seeds with.  You also need to have Un'Goro soil samples on hand to use as fertilizer for the seeds.  Just use the pouch when you have everything; the pouch will take care of the rest.

When you have enough morrowgrain, bring them here to me in the enclave.  Please don't bother the Arch Druid; he's a very busy man, and he doesn't need to be disturbed every time someone returns with another batch of morrowgrain!

entries.name: Morrowgrain to Darnassus
entries.how: The Arch Druid is always looking for additional morrowgrain for the Cenarion Circle's continued research.  We take them in increments of ten, and award you with a cache of goods you should find useful.  When you have ten, let me know and I will reward you accordingly.

entries.name: March of the Silithid
entries.how:
It would seem that the silithid's intent, nay - reason for being, is to devour everything in their path that is not of their ecology.  Their focus is singular, and it is for this reason they are a grave threat to all life on Azeroth.

What we've seen to date is but the first stages.  I suspect that their strength comes from deeper in Kalimdor: Un'Goro Crater.  Go to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg.  Tell him of my theory; he will surely aid us in fighting the silithid.

entries.name: Calm Before the Storm
entries.how:
{name}, your help has been immeasurable.  The time will come, no doubt, when I'll ask for your assistance against the silithid once more.  We must absorb what we have learned in Un'Goro; I fear that my assumptions that the silithid originated from Un'Goro are now wrong... that indeed there is a far stronger presence somewhere.

Take this note to Idriana at the bank.  She'll give you something from my vault that should be viewed as a token of my gratitude.  Thank you for your assistance, brave {class}.

entries.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
entries.how:
Hear ye, hear ye!  All heroes are called upon to heed these words!

A call to arms has been issued by the Kingdom of Stormwind!  All able bodied individuals are entreated to take up arms against the dark threat of the Scourge in the northern lands of the Eastern Kingdoms!  Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the Plaguelands!

Heroes of the realm - seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist who has set up his base camp in Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains!

entries.name: Nessa Shadowsong
entries.how:
A friend of mine, Nessa Shadowsong, is a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village.  She needs a parcel taken to Darkshore, and is looking for someone to help her.

If you're interested, then to reach Nessa you must take the portal in Darnassus to Rut'theran Village.  You will find the portal west of the Temple Gardens.

entries.name: The New Frontier
entries.how:
I have relegated my second, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, to deal with Moonglade's call for aid.  Speak to him on this matter - NOT me.

Let me give you some... friendly... advice.  It is I who led us out of the darkness - NOT the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade - when all was lost for our race.  Teldrassil gives us all new life!  They would have you believe otherwise, and to believe their propaganda would be a fool's task.

I'll leave it to you to decide whether or not you're a fool.

entries.name: Rabine Saturna
entries.how:
For this task, Keeper Remulos' majordomo in Moonglade - Rabine Saturna - seeks aid in exploring the vast wastelands far to the west of Tanaris... and even further west of Un'Goro.  You should find him in Nighthaven, the main village of Moonglade.

While your work will no doubt be of tremendous benefit to us all, I advise you to tread gingerly.  There are tensions between Darnassus and Moonglade... ones that may grow over the course of time.

entries.name: A Donation of Wool
entries.how:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Darnassus for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

entries.name: A Donation of Silk
entries.how:
As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low.  Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community!  If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

entries.name: A Donation of Mageweave
entries.how:
Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks!  By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal.  Such generosity would not go unnoticed by Darnassus, I assure you!

If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

entries.name: A Donation of Runecloth
entries.how:
{name}, you've been a tremendous contributor to our cloth drive.  As we work hard to replenish our reserves, one form of cloth remains critically low - runecloth.  We are in absolutely dire need of it, and we hope that you will be able to help us as you have in the past!

If you are willing, please bring me what runecloth you can spare.  We'll initially accept a single donation of sixty, and then we'll go from there.

entries.name: Additional Runecloth
entries.how:
Greetings once again, {name}!  Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them.  For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continuing efforts on behalf of Darnassus.

Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it.

entries.name: Your First Feline Friend
entries.how:
Greetings, friend! I see today is a big day indeed; today you will bond with your first saber.

As you may or may not know these sabers are fiercely intelligent and extremely loyal to their bonded rider. You won't find a more noble and steadfast companion. As such, you have an important choice to make. You and your saber will traverse the world together, so choose wisely! Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the correct one.

Go, examine the sabers and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: Learning to Ride
entries.how:
Hello, {class}! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a saber, for a fee of course.

Lelanai will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts ye would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding sabers.

entries.name: Eyes of the Sentinels
entries.how:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.

entries.name: The Sisterhood of Elune
entries.how:
Blessings to you, {class}. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.

entries.name: Swift as the Wind
entries.how:
You've returned, {name}. Very good. It's time to learn to ride a proper mount, your armored sabercat.

Lelanai will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts ye would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding sabers.

entries.name: An Epic Ride
entries.how:
Greetings, friend! I am pleased to see you again. Today you have enough experience and aptitude to bond with our fastest and fiercest sabers.

These sabers are, of course, extremely intelligent and fiercely loyal to their bonded rider. You won't find a more noble and steadfast companion.

As such, you have an important choice to make. You and your saber will traverse the world together, so choose wisely!

Go, examine the armored sabers and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: The Crone of the Kraul
entries.how:
Poor Heralath! And this dwarf... Lonebrow. What a brave soul he was.

We must not let their valiance go for naught. This crone... Charlga Razorflank ... must be stopped.

Surely, infiltrating the Kraul will be perilous. There isn't time to send word to Darnassus. {name}, assemble a party to slay the crone.

Bring me Razorflank's Medallion as proof of demise.

entries.name: A Vengeful Fate
entries.how:
Cairne is a noble leader for uniting our people here on Thunder Bluff.

But I cannot forgive those who drove us from our ancestral lands as easily as some. My people inhabited the southern Barrens for decades. The land was holy to us. But we were driven off by numerous foes.

A vengeful fate awaits the crone, Charlga Razorflank, who musters a foul army from within Razorfen Kraul.

Bring me Razorflank's heart and I can die in peace, {name}.

entries.name: Going, Going, Guano!
entries.how:
As you can see, {name}, we're up to some very.... interesting experiments at the Royal Apothecary Society.

As the Master here, it is my job to oversee the most ambitious of our alchemical attempts. So much work and so little time!

You look well traveled for a {class}. Perhaps you can aid me.

I'm in need of a rare substance. It's foul material; it comes from a rare species of bats only found in the muck-hole known as Razorfen Kraul. Bring to me the guano from the Kraul Bats so we can begin our work...

entries.name: Mortality Wanes
entries.how:
I have not long to live... so... so... weak.

...the b-b-brave dwarf, Lonebrow, has been sent to w-w-warn Falfindel...

But before I... d-d-die...

...my wife, Treshala... her pendant of bonding to me... stolen... by one of the f-f-foul aggressors...

Find it p-p-please... and return it to Treshala in Darnassus...

...along with w-w-word of my lonely... death.

entries.name: Willix the Importer
entries.how:
At last, help has arrived!

You have no clue how long I've been held prisoner here. I can't remember the last time I saw the outside of this place.

You see, I am an entrepreneur. Always out for a copper, as they say. I caught wind that Mebok Mizzyrix was paying well for Redleaf Tuber from this here pig pen. I figured it would be an easy in, easy out kind of affair. As you can see, I was a bit wrong!

Anyway, if you'd be so kind as to help me get out of here, I'll make it worth your while.

entries.name: Blueleaf Tubers
entries.how:
Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.

And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.

It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.

entries.name: Field of Honor: Week 8
entries.how: This time it's gonna be every gob for himself! Get yourself over to the Gurubashi Arena and make Kha'damu proud!

entries.name: Deadwood of the North
entries.how:
There is a camp of Deadwood furbolgs directly to our southwest.  Corruption permeates the camp, and I wish to put an end to it before they become a problem.

The Deadwood tribe is evil, but it is the effects of the fel that pollutes their minds.  Their hostility is not truly an innate quality, yet they cannot be helped.  For this reason, I am deeply saddened by having to fight my own brethren.

Please, {name}, do what must be done, and do not mention the details; they upset me far too much.

entries.name: Winterfall Activity
entries.how:
The Timbermaw tend to stay to themselves, {name}. While we do allow safe passage to those that have proven they can be trusted, we try to avoid other furbolg tribes if at all possible.

Lately I have noticed that the Winterfall tribe has become increasingly hostile towards us. They seem to be in a state of rage, completely engulfed by their own fear and hatred of anything they do not understand.

If you could reduce their numbers this would help us greatly, {name}.

entries.name: Deadwood of the North
entries.how:
There is a camp of Deadwood furbolgs directly to our southwest.  Corruption permeates the camp, and I wish to put an end to it before they become a problem.

The Deadwood tribe is evil, but it is the effects of the fel that pollutes their minds.  Their hostility is not truly an innate quality, yet they cannot be helped.  It saddens me that we must fight our own brethren.

Please, {name} - I ask you to do what must be done.  Simply spare me the details; such troublesome images upset me far too much.

entries.name: Winterfall Activity
entries.how:
The Timbermaw tend to stay to themselves, {name}.  While we do allow safe passage to those we trust, we try to avoid other furbolg tribes if at all possible.

The Winterfall tribe as of late has become increasingly hostile towards us.  They seem to be in a state of rage, completely engulfed by their own fear and hatred of anything they do not understand.

I must ask you to thin their numbers as to lessen the threat against us.  Seek them out in Winterfall Village, far to the east of here.

entries.name: The Root of All Evil
entries.how:
{name}, thanks to you we have devised a way to summon forth the root of all evil for the Winterfall tribe - the corrupting demon that dominates them!

Take this torch to the mouth of High Chief Winterfall's personal cave and plant it there.  Doing so will force the demon to reveal itself and investigate.  This is when you and your allies must strike it down!  Only the essence of the fallen demon will begin the lengthy healing process of the Winterfall tribe... and the salvation of Timbermaw Hold.

entries.name: The Brokering of Peace
entries.how:
Your deeds go beyond the tale of a simple hero, {name}.  If you are a representative of your people, then your people are ones we would work to make peace with.

Please - take this offering to the dwarven king that resides in a mountain of iron; I believe you call this city Ironforge.  In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his Alliance.  It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your Alliance's efforts in brokering peace.

entries.name: The Brokering of Peace
entries.how:
Your deeds go beyond the tale of a simple hero, {name}.  If you are a representative of your people, then your people are ones we would work to make peace with.

Please - take this offering to the orcish warchief that resides in the lands of Durotar; I believe you call this city Orgrimmar.  In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his Horde.  It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your Horde's efforts in brokering peace.

entries.name: Timbermaw Reinforcements
entries.how:
With the satyr weakened, now is the time to mount a counter-offensive. Prince Halanox, commander of the Legashi Stronghold, will be our target. However, we still lack the numbers to face him head-on.

Since the Legashi drove us out we have been cut off from the furbolgs of Timbermaw Hold. We could call upon them for reinforcements, but we will need an emissary. You will be that emissary, {name}.

Go to Timbermaw Hold and find a furbolg named Gorn One Eye. He will provide us with the soldiers we need.

entries.name: <UNUSED>
entries.how: This quest will send you mail to your mail box. Just hit complete.

entries.name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
entries.how:
It is good to see you in good health, {name}. The glorious battles you have undertaken affect all life on this planet. Hakkar must never leave the confines of Zul'Gurub as the world will surely collapse beneath his immense hunger.

Give me your talisman and I shall amplify its strength. Use the Strength of Mugamba to punish our enemies!

entries.name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
entries.how:
Master {name}, you return! Molthor has sent word of your deeds to the King. Your name is known even in the South Seas. Perhaps one day you will be a legendary warrior - a story for the ages.

Give me your talisman so that I may once more amplify its power.

entries.name: The Rage of Mugamba
entries.how:
King Rastakhan sends his regards, Master {name}. Such an honor has never been given to one outside the Zandalar tribe.

<Jin'rokh bows.>

Give me your talisman so that I may enhance it once more. Know that the Rage of Mugamba is now intrinsically connected to your very soul.

entries.name: The Heathen's Brand
entries.how:
I may have been too hasty in my judgement, {class}. It seems as if your blind faith in this Light has some value after all.

Give me your brand and I shall amplify its power.

entries.name: The Heathen's Brand
entries.how:
I must confess, I did not think you had the resolution to see this cause through, {class}. Zandalar now considers you an invaluable ally. Well done, indeed.

Give me your brand and I shall once more amplify its power.

entries.name: The Hero's Brand
entries.how:
The King has acknowledged your existence, {class}. You are the first of your kind to be accepted by Rastakhan as a true ally of Zandalar.

You will be rewarded greatly for your efforts. Present your brand and I shall apply the final amplification.

entries.name: The Eye of Zuldazar
entries.how: Welcome priest. The Eye of Zuldazar pulses with energy. You are ready to take the next step. Hand me the talisman and I shall perform the imbue.

entries.name: The Eye of Zuldazar
entries.how:
Tales of your battles against the Gurubashi are whispered in the winds, priest. Even royalty is beginning to talk of your deeds. It is rumored that King Rastakhan even mentioned you by name.

The time has come to imbue the Eye. Hand me the talisman and I shall perform the service.

entries.name: The All-Seeing Eye of Zuldazar
entries.how:
If only we had ten-thousand more like you, {name}. The armies of Hakkar would be scattered to the wind in the blink of an eye.

<Al'tabim sighs.>

Alas, the Eye is ready to realize its full potential. Give it to me.

entries.name: The Pebble of Kajaro
entries.how: Welcome back, {class}. I can see that the pebble has seen much use. Many of our foes have fallen to your otherworldly abilities. Their suffering has been great. It is time that I enhance the power of the pebble. Give it to me.

entries.name: The Pebble of Kajaro
entries.how:
Hakkari fear you, {name}. They speak of horrors they believed that only their faceless God could perpetrate. You have burned them with the force of Kajaro. They now know fear in two places.

It is time to further strengthen the pebble. Hand me the talisman.

entries.name: The Jewel of Kajaro
entries.how: Give me the talisman, {name}. I must show you something.

entries.name: Kezan's Taint
entries.how:
Honor is earned amongst the Zandalar trolls, {name}. With honor comes reward - friendship, alliance...

Hand me the talisman so that I may enhance its power.

entries.name: Kezan's Taint
entries.how:
I am ready for you, {class}. Once more I will enhance your talisman. I only ask that you continue in your destruction of Hakkar and his minions.

Give me the talisman.

entries.name: Kezan's Unstoppable Taint
entries.how:
Call forth your demons, {class}. Let them bask in the energy of Kezan's Taint. Command them on the field of battle! Decimate the enemy!

Yes... The time has come to apply the final enhancement to Kezan's Taint. Give me the talisman.

entries.name: Enchanted South Seas Kelp
entries.how: Hey mon! It be good to see you again. The tribe be talking about your killin' of the Hakkari and all that. Molthor gave me the word to be adding more mojo to your talisman. Just give it here and Maywiki make it better.

entries.name: Enchanted South Seas Kelp
entries.how: How be that talisman, mon? It look like it be time to add a little more magic and mojo to its leaves. It need a little bloom in its wilt. Give it here and Maywiki fix it right up.

entries.name: Pristine Enchanted South Seas Kelp
entries.how: {name}! It been a long time since I seen you. Did you know that King Rastakhan himself be givin' me the order to add the final bit of mojo and magic to your talisman? It be true, mon! I wouldn't have believed it had I not seen it with me own eyes. Give it here.

entries.name: Vision of Voodress
entries.how:
Sha-mon! Maywiki make a joke!

<Maywiki laughs.>

So, you been using the spirits and elements against our enemies in Zul'Gurub, eh? Spirits be praised!

Maywiki gonna brighten your orb. Give it here, {name}.

entries.name: Vision of Voodress
entries.how:
Good news, {name}. Molthor be singin' your praises lately. He say how you be turnin' into a real hero of Zandalar.

He also say for Maywiki to polish your orb some more! Give it here so Maywiki can brighten the vision.

entries.name: The Unmarred Vision of Voodress
entries.how:
<Maywiki points to your talisman.>

Look at it, {name}! It's come alive. The spirits dance around the orb.

Give it to Maywiki so she can make one last adjustment.

entries.name: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
entries.how:
I sense that you have dealt countless fatalities to the Hakkari, {name}. You carry the stink of their mojo.

I assume the Shadow talisman has assisted in the culling? Give it to me and allow me to enhance its power.

entries.name: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
entries.how: Impressive, {name}. You have a gift for killing that I have not sensed in another in many years. Even Molthor is aware of the work that you have done for Zandalar. It is time to enhance your talisman further. Give it to me.

entries.name: Zandalarian Shadow Mastery Talisman
entries.how: It yearns to grow, {name}. The talisman has soaked in all that you have done. The thousands of troll corpses littering Zul'Gurub have fueled its power. Hand it to me and I shall make the final enhancement.

entries.name: The Maelstrom's Tendril
entries.how:
Ah, {name}, it is good to smell you again.

<Falthir grins.>

You'll have to excuse my sense of humor. It can be most foul at times.

I sense that you have caused great anguish to our enemies. The forces of Hakkar cry out your name in anger. This is most excellent.

You have earned another weave on your talisman. Hand it to me.

entries.name: The Maelstrom's Tendril
entries.how:
Even from here I can hear the sound of your volleys laying waste to our enemies. Their cries echo in agony.

You have made quite a name for yourself among the trolls of Zandalar, {name}. We are grateful for all that you have done.

Hand me your talisman so that I may add another weave.

entries.name: Maelstrom's Wrath
entries.how: Molthor delivers word from King Rastakhan, {name}. The royal court is most impressed with your decimation of the Hakkari forces. I am to award you with the final weave in your talisman. Hand it to me.

entries.name: Presence of Might
entries.how:
Zanza can create the ancient troll enchantments with the right components.

The first is a primal Hakkari idol that must be taken from the most powerful of the Hakkari lieutenants: Jin'do and the Bloodlord.

The second is a punctured voodoo doll. These can be found in the piles of refuse that litter this foul place. Look inside the jinxed hoodoo piles.

Bring me these things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!

entries.name: The Savage Guard - Arcanum of Protection
entries.how:
Zanza can create many ancient troll enchantments with proper components! Have you heard of the Savage Guard? No, of course you haven't. Your mind is addled with the inferior elven magic.

Bring me an arcanum of elven creation so that I may destroy the aberration. Do this and the Savage Guard will be yours.

entries.how:
Zanza can create the ancient troll enchantments with the right components.

The first is a primal Hakkari idol that must be taken from the most powerful of the Hakkari lieutenants: Jin'do and the Bloodlord.

The second is a punctured voodoo doll. These can be found in the piles of refuse that litter this foul place. Look inside the jinxed hoodoo piles.

Bring me these things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
