While you're out doing what you adventurers do best, see if you can't keep an eye out for any documents they may have misplaced. With enough of them, I should be able to piece together their intentions.

entries.name: Curious Trinkets
entries.how:
My, what have we here? A brave new {class} come to save us from our woes? How charming! Maybe you can help me with something then? I'd quite like to learn more about this cult in Sunnyglade.

Like any cult, they operate in a caste system. Those with an affinity for magic are often in high favor and are given tokens to demonstrate such. These charms are then imbued, and thus have a rich abundance of cultist magic.

I wish to see these tokens for myself. Be a dear and see if you can bring me a few, hmm?

entries.name: An Unsettling Discovery
entries.how:
I've had enough of this cave. Once you clear your way out, I'll slip out amidst the chaos.

I'm afraid I'm in too weak of condition to carry those samples, however. Their energy is overwhelming, and I've been trapped down here for Light knows how long. Once we get out of here, please take them to Lady Amberhall immediately. I must rest.

entries.name: Field Marshal's Log
entries.how:
The log is full of meticulous recordings on the comings and goings of Twilight's Hammer forces throughout the Riverglades. 

The author is nowhere to be found, but this information could help shed light on enemy movements.

Someone in Farholde will want to see this.

entries.name: The Western Front
entries.how:
As helpful as you've been here in Farholde, I believe your talents could be put to better use elsewhere.

A patrol of ours went missing some time ago. They were in charge of our western borders, but with the information Miss Amberhall has uncovered, I fear they walked right into the Twilight Hammer's central encampment.

We can handle the cleanup in Sunnyglade ourselves. If the good lady is right, it's critical that we check on our wayward sergeant. He could use all the help he can get.

entries.name: Saving Marshal Ryan
entries.how:
Field Marshal Ryan is one of our best. His keen eyes and reliable intel have been paramount to our war efforts.

His final reports refer to a Twilight's Hammer fortress to the west. Find him before it's too late. And take his logbook with you. It may offer more clues as to the whereabouts of our missing marshal.

entries.name: No Soldier Left Behind
entries.how:
If Amberhall is so impatient for her report, it would have been nice if she sent more than one {class}. Must be hard work hiding in her ivory tower.

Look, every attempt to contact Farholde Keep ends with our runners being captured by Twilight scouts. I can't afford to risk any more troops going into that fortress, but we can't keep my people imprisoned in there either.

You want us to return? Help me rescue my soldiers first. You should be able to find the keys to their cages off their champions' corpses.

entries.name: Carving a Path
entries.how:
It seems every day the Twilight's Hammer are drawing more into their order, while we haven't heard so much as a word from Stormwind. Sooner or later we'll be overrun.

I don't care what a bureaucrat like Amberhall says. I'm not abandoning this position while an army amasses in our own homeland. If we leave now, we'll only have to deal with these cultists again later. Only next time, on our doorstep.

If your orders are to babysit me anyway, at least make yourself useful and help me cull these zealots.

entries.name: Bring Me His Head
entries.how:
With this kind of momentum, we can't stop now. The soldiers we rescued are itching to draw blood, and you've already proven yourself a capable battering ram.

Return to the Twilight's Shroud and finish what we've started. Their leader, an orc by the name of Overlord Kilgar, hides deep within his keep while his underlings are lost in their panic.

If we want to put an end to this, bring me the head of Kilgar. These gods-fearing cowards can't make a single decision on their own.

entries.name: News to Farholde
entries.how:
Seems like things are quieting down around here for now, but I want to keep an eye out. You want to send Amberhall a report? Send her this.

<Sergeant Riftan tosses Kilgar's head back to you.>

That ought to shut her up. At least for a while. Good work out there.

entries.name: Dying Wish
entries.how:
It's too late for me, stranger. I'm not going to be making it out of this one. Take my crest to the Knight Commander. Warn him...

<Ryan's eyes begin to glaze over as he mumbles to himself.>

I'm sorry. I should have come home. Abigail...

entries.name: Delivering Closure
entries.how:
So, his final thoughts were of Abigail?

I know this is not your business, friend, but I must ask you to deliver the news of the Marshal's passing on my behalf. Ryan's betrothed, Abigail Lawson, did not join us when we established Farholde Keep. The two of them apparently had a disagreement, and while I do not know the specifics, I do know that she now resides within Stormwind City.

Please take the Marshal's crest to Terry for me. I don't think my presence would be a welcome one.

entries.name: The Twilight Threat
entries.how:
Lady Amberhall told me of your exploits with the Twilight's Hammer. I'm impressed. But concerned.

Farholde started its campaign originally to remove the Horde from our homeland. While that remains our primary goal, we cannot take this sudden surge in cultist activity lightly. If our pleas to Stormwind remain unheard, we will be overwhelmed as we face foes on two fronts alone.

With the evidence you carry, perhaps they can set aside their pride long enough to listen. At this point it's our only option.

entries.name: A Small Favor
entries.how:
You've been such a good little {class} for me, I wonder if I could ask you to do one more small favor.

With the reagents you collected being so finely attuned to Twilight's Hammer magic, they are perfect for a summoning ritual. However, we'll need to take them to the source of their power.

Should you happen upon a conduit while you're gallivanting about the Twilight's Shroud, see if you can't call upon one of the cult's thralls and capture it with this soulstone for me. For questioning, of course.

entries.name: Hats Off
entries.how:
<Robbie leans in to talk to you, as if sharing a grave secret.>

Psst! Hey mister, I need your help!

My sister got me a hat for my birthday but I lost it playing in the river. I'm not allowed to be down there because of the murlocs so I can't ask Dad or Ellie for help because then they'll know where I was!

It's a good hat. I bet one of those murlocs found it and kept it for himself!

entries.name: Hunting the Hunters
entries.how:
The orcish poachers are a bloodthirsty lot. They'll kill anything that moves--be it men, lions, or horses. They are a threat to all life in the Riverglades, and must be stopped.

They roam the plains in packs, like rabid animals. If you see any, put them down.

entries.name: A Fur Trade
entries.how:
Farholde prides itself on its independence, but there are a few things we can only get through trade.

We've negotiated an arrangement with a dealer at Powderfuse Port. We provide her with goods that are dangerous to acquire, and she provides us with specialty munitions.

Currently, she's in the market for lion fur. A pride of them live atop a large hill in the center of the plains. If you'd like to make yourself useful, you could aid me in harvesting some of their hides.

entries.name: Drop the Hammer
entries.how:
Like most ogre weaponry, this hammer is large, unwieldy, and well-worn. A creature of any other race could hardly swing it at all.

To you, it is of little more use than a trophy, but perhaps someone at Farholde would appreciate knowing of Komuk's demise.

entries.name: Dunston Checks Out
entries.how:
When you're ready, I'll unlock my shackles, and we'll commence the escape. We'll take the quickest route, right through the center of camp. Be prepared for a fight.

Once we're out, I'll return to Farholde for medical treatment. As a final favor, I ask that you update Cornelius on my whereabouts. Frankly, the last thing I want after all this is to get an earful from that man.

entries.name: A Few Furs for Friz
entries.how:
These hides are to be delivered to Powderfuse Port. It is a goblin-run port to the northeast.

When you get there, deliver the hides to Friz Frazzlespark. Tell her they're from Cornelius. The details of our trade have already been worked out, so she'll know what they are for.

entries.name: Stolen Saws
entries.how:
The boys up at Southern Watch do a good job keeping gnolls out for the most part. Every now and then a few sneak into the camp at night and cause a bit of trouble. They especially like to steal saw blades, which they likely use to make weapons out of the sharp metal.

If you could get some back for us, it'd be a big help. The gnolls have probably got 'em stashed away somewhere in their camps up in the hills to the west.

entries.name: Biting the Hand
entries.how:
<The gnoll pulls a bit of gold from his pocket and waves it at you.>

{race}, I offer trade! There is more where this came from. Help me get revenge, and I will show you!

entries.name: Bloodmaster's Ring
entries.how:
Alright, so you got a few wins under your belt. So what?

You're a long way from becoming the champ, bub. But I tell ya what--I'll make sure this next battle ain't one you'll soon forget.

Hope you're ready for a surprise.

entries.name: Biting the Hand
entries.how:
Come, {race}. It is time to leave this place. If any try to stop us, we will tear them to shreds!

Once we are safe, I will take you to your reward.

entries.name: Bloodmaster's Ring
entries.how:
Let's see if we can keep this crowd's excitement goin'.

This next contender ain't no joke.

Best of luck to ya! See you soon, maybe.

entries.name: Bloodmaster's Ring
entries.how:
Alright, so I'll place the treat and then you enter the ring and prepare for what's comin'.

What? Why you lookin' at me like that? I said we're gonna feed her. What I may have forgotten to mention was that ol' Snufflesnout gets pretty riled up at the sight of her favorite treat.

You're in a bit of a sticky situation here, bub. Proving yourself to our ogre friends is of the utmost importance, but boy oh boy would I be nervous inflicting harm to Chubchob's precious companion.

Well, off ya go!

entries.name: Rescue Roundup
entries.how: <The horse bows its head in your direction then nudges its nose into your underarm. Wherever you go, it may follow.>

entries.name: Eyes for the Watchman
entries.how:
Oh! Sorry, I didn't see you there.

I was just putting together a little something for a friend of mine. Well... more of an acquaintance, really. Have you met Watcher Fredericks yet? He's stationed at Southern Watch just west of here.

He comes by the ranch on patrol every now and then. I thought it would be nice to give him a little something to show my appreciation.

I'd deliver it myself, but I need to keep an eye on my little brother and tend to the ranch.

I'm sure you understand.

entries.name: On the Other Side
entries.how:
If you be gettin' tired of dem wide open plains, my old friend Uzer'i always be lookin' for help. He always be twistin' dem magics, but little do most o' dem people know he be quite da hunter too.

If you's interested, you can find him all da way out at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

Tell him ol' Tan'jani sent ya.

entries.name: Frazzlespark's Crate
entries.how:
Time for a special delivery.

Knight Commander Demar Brant at Farholde is waiting for this. For some reason he always makes me say his full name. What an odd fella.

Anywho, you can find him holed up in the keep southwest of here. Massive stone fortress. Ya can't miss it.

entries.name: Frazzlespark's Crate
entries.how:
Time for a special delivery.

Old Krom'rosh is waiting for this package over at Rog'mar just west of here.

I suggest you get it to him quickly, but carefully. Why, you might ask? It's better to not ask questions.

entries.name: Bloodmaster's Ring
entries.how:
Ok, listen up. You've showed quite a bit of prowess in the ring. You've managed to upset Chub'chob more than words can explain. Sure glad I ain't you right now.

Just in case you was wonderin', I should remind you that your entry fee does not cover accidental death.

It's been great knowin' ya, but you're on your own from here on out, bub.

Best of luck to ya.

entries.name: Preventative Measures
entries.how:
The orcs have become an encroaching threat ever since their arrival. First, claiming the lands by the river and now their presence grows within the plains...

I'll never understand their kind, nor do I care, truth be told, but I'll be damned if they think there's more ground to be taken.

entries.name: The Rog'mar Situation
entries.how:
The message we've delivered is clear.

Return to Brant within the keep and show him the report. I'm certain he'll be pleased with our progress.

entries.name: Saltwater Savages
entries.how:
Murlocs, murlocs, murlocs! That's all I ever hear about; from the sailors, the fishermen, even my own kids! Everyone's on my case about 'em! They're a nuisance, I admit, but I got a port to run here!

Help a guy out, would ya? Kill a couple 'a those things and I'll make it worth your time.

entries.name: Unfriendly Competition
entries.how:
You know the Eastsea crew? Real unsavory bunch, and that's coming from the guy running a place called "Powderfuse Port".

They're destructive, bloodthirsty, and, worst of all, cutting into my bottom line. They steal cargo, and sink ships, both of which end up costing me the big bucks!

We gotta take down their whole operation, starting with the ones closest to here. You can find 'em along the beaches to the north.

entries.name: WANTED: Old Rot-Chum
entries.how:
Sailors and swimmers beware! An especially aggressive murloc, nicknamed "Old Rot-Chum" by local fishermen, has been seen attacking rowboats and other small vessels in the waters to the south, near a collection of murloc-infested islands.

A reward is being offered by Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz in exchange for proof of the creature's demise.

entries.name: A Taste of the Sea
entries.how:
Welcome to Fimbo's cafe on the water! Today's menu is roasted boar, and roasted fish...same as every day...

This menu needs a shake up, badly. I've had my eye on a new seafood stew recipe, but I'm gonna need some fresh meat. A few murloc eyes and some crab meat oughta do.

You can find both along the beaches nearby. Can't beat some good ol' fashioned local ingredients!

entries.name: Unchecked Expansion
entries.how:
Those Eastsea pirates you whacked, while dangerous, were just the small fries. They've got bigger, badder brothers in arms north of here. They ransacked Windstead--took all the plunder they could, then burned it to the ground.

They've gotta be stopped before their turf gets any farther inland. Thin out their ranks so that doesn't happen.

entries.name: A Blast Ye Scurvy Dogs!
entries.how:
As much as I love seeing Eastsea heads roll, we also gotta take out their ships. Can't have 'em running off for reinforcements, now can we?

I've got a plan for that, but we're gonna need some gunpowder. A LOT of it.

The pirates are probably storing some near the freshly-demolished Winstead to the north. See if you can get your hands on it. I'll fill you in on the rest later.

entries.name: Admiral Lamora
entries.how:
Now it's time to go after the big man himself: Admiral Lamora. Obviously, I want him dead, but I need a little something extra from him too.

Seeing how all his plundering has been costing me a fortune, I figure it's only right that I recoup some losses.

Lamora's on one of the Eastsea's boats northeast of here. Find out which and where on it he's keeping his loot. Bring me whatever he's got. If it's locked up, he's likely got the key on him.

entries.name: The Lost Scout
entries.how:
You... where did you come from? You shouldn't be here!

<Bolain struggles through the pain--bruised, battered, and a disease-ridden bite wound to his leg.>

Take this to Dalton. Head north up the road and east where the plains open wider than this gash in my damn leg. I'd tell you to tell him he was right, but I won't give him that satisfaction... at least not until after I'm dead.

I hate these damn hills!

entries.name: Southern Watch Gnoll Report
entries.how:
As much as I'd like to deliver the blood-soaked message to the knight commander himself, I'd also like to keep my post. I've cleaned it up a bit so it's less... well, bloody.

Given the recent gnoll uprisings, I'm afraid the task of delivering the news falls upon you.

entries.name: Stuff 'Em and Stick 'Em
entries.how:
Our training dummies are starting to show significant wear and tear. If we don't fix them up soon I worry our recruits may be unprepared for battle.

If you hadn't seen it on your way in, there's a small farmstead just outside the keep run by a man by the name of Wheeler. He may have a few extra bushels of hay he'd be willing to part with.

I'll see to it he's compensated if he's able to spare supplies for our efforts.

entries.name: Remember That I Love You
entries.how:
If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.

If you see little Jeremy, do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?

entries.name: Paletusk Harvesting
entries.how:
With so little land not claimed by the humans or Twilight's Hammer, this ranch is one of our very few sources of food. Ogres aren't much in the way of farmers, but they love a good paletusk roast, and have agreed to let me stay so long as the meat keeps coming.

As our war advances, the demand for food is only ever increasing. Now I hardly have enough food to keep these ogres from looking at me like I'm their next meal.

If we want to have enough meat for Rog'mar, I'll need your help with the harvest.

entries.name: Drive Them Back
entries.how:
As you can see, there are more pigs strewn about the valley than there are in their pens. Gorgegut has been less than an ideal farmhand, but he keeps the humans away.

Some of the little ones have escaped across the river. They're still too small to be harvested out in the field so we need to return them here. Take this stick and give them a good swat! That should send them scampering back to their pens.

entries.name: See Ya, Scallywags!
entries.how:
So, here's how we're gonna sink those ships. 

I can use that gunpowder you stole and make timed charges. All you've gotta do is hop on each of the Eastsea's boats, and plant one charge in the hull of each. Look for a spot near their cannons, that gunpowder'll make our explosives even more powerful. Once the charges are set, get outta there, and I'll hit the detonator!

The elegance of the plan is in its simplicity, don't ya think?

entries.name: Twilight Scouting Report
entries.how:
Quiet down!

<Azka snaps, adjusting her gaze in your direction.>

I'll have your head before you give away my position to the cultists.

Watch your step and keep a low tone when traveling through these hills. Otherwise I'll be sending a report to Krom'rosh that another of our own has been taken.

Now take this and get out of here quickly... and quietly! Krom'rosh is waiting on this report. You can find him and the others at the outpost inland to the east.

entries.name: Step One: Rock
entries.how:
You want ogre weapon? Me know no. You small. Can't hold good.

You bring Hamur more rocks, me make you tiny weapon. Good for tiny creature.

Find good rocks for good weapon. Hamur has discerning eye. Not just any rock will do. Find rocks near river outside Bolder'ok.

entries.name: The Sharpest of Blades
entries.how:
The rigors of training for battle are one thing, but these trainees don't yet understand the difference between a training sword and the well-kept blade of a seasoned veteran.

I think it's time we show our recruits how a sharpened blade can be the difference between victory and death.

If you can find us a few sharpening stones, we'll put them to good use. There are certain craftsmen known to study this trade. I'd suggest starting there.

entries.name: From Port to Port
entries.how:
Got another job for ya, kiddo. How do you feel about traveling the world?

This here is some of the finest port you ever laid eyes on. Trouble is, it's gotta go quite the distance to one of my customers all the way over to Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. When you've reached trees taller than you've ever seen before, you know you've reached the spot.

One of my guys packed it airtight but there's no telling what might set it off, so handle with care, okay bub?

entries.name: WANTED: Trapclaw
entries.how:
Calling all anglers!

I'm in the market for some crab meat. Not just the usual shreds either, I'm talking whole claw. I've seen a big one crawling around under the docks, stealing bait and cutting lines.

I'll pay a reward to anyone who brings me that thing's pincer. You'll also get a helping of the dish I whip up.

-- Fimbo Greasemitz

entries.name: Terrors From the Deep
entries.how:
The hide is painted with broad strokes of fish guts and squid ink. It appears to depict some kind of sea monster, rising up from the waves, with a long neck. What could this beast be?

The nearest port is Powderfuse Port. If this monster is real, and lurks these waters, a sailor there has surely seen it.

entries.name: It Takes Guts
entries.how:
That monster...with the long neck, just like you said. I've seen 'im around those islands -- out on my boat. I tried <hic> tellin' folks, but ohh nooo, you can't <hic> believe ol' Argo. He's just some...some...drunkard fisherman! Makin' up stories!

We'll show 'em...soon as I get some bait...

Hey! Quit standin' around! I'm gonna need entrails, a LOT of 'em. Any beast from around here. The smellier <hic> the better. I'm also gonna need some Rotflesh mushrooms. Those grow in that cave by Windstead.

entries.name: The Monster Surfaces
entries.how:
The last part's <hic> easy...just take that big ball 'a guts, aaand chuck it in the water! Er...not here though...that'd be a disaster.

Go to those <hic> murloc islands, where ya found the drawing. Look for fresh wreckage in the water. That's where you gotta throw the bait.

Soon as that thing sticks its head up, chop it off! We'll make a decoration of it...for the boat!

entries.name: It Is Time, Brother...
entries.how:
The threat is greater than we thought. Rog'mar must be warned.

Do not stop for anyone on your path.

entries.name: Smuggler's Paradise
entries.how:
You look like you're in the habit of doing whatever other people tell ya. I like that in a lackey. With a little trainin' you could be a great asset. Let's put that to the test.

Recently some of those Eastsea pirates made off with a shipment of MY stolen goods. That's bad sportsmanship. I stole them first!

Lesson one, lackey. Never backstab a backstabber. Go show them that they messed with the wrong goblin and take back my stuff. With force, preferably.

entries.name: Smuggler's Special
entries.how:
Those goods you procured from the Eastsea pirates were supposed to be shipped directly to me. That means ol' Bentcoin thinks he can muscle in on my turf. Looks like he's fixin' to start a trade war. We, however, are civilized people.

Lesson two, lackey. We don't need to stoop to their level. Take this crate I made 'specially for the good captain. You'll find him on his ship along the Eastwind Shore. He deserves a reward for his shrewd negotiatin' tactics.

entries.name: Smuggler's Bargain
entries.how:
Friz sure knows how to get her point across. Well, you won't hear any objections from me. The Eastsea pirates won't interfere with her business. In exchange, maybe we can come to an arrangement. Pirating's a little difficult when you've got a scorned goblin sending marauding adventurers after you all day.

Run along back to your master, {class}. Let Friz know there's a new captain in charge, and he foresees a profitable relationship in our future.

entries.name: I Know a Guy
entries.how:
Ya did good with those pirates, lackey. But here's a lesson for ya you may want to remember. What some may call a pirate, others call a freebooter. And you can't spell freebooter without free booty. And there's no better place for free booty than Booty Bay!

<Friz waits for your reply.>

Keep up with me here, kid. I'm sayin' I need you to go to Booty Bay to meet with my contact. He gets goods from the local pirates there-- err, freebooters. Look, just go find Ruzzgot. He'll explain the rest.

entries.name: Shipping and Handling
entries.how:
Sounds like you're ready for your next lesson, champ. I got some negotiatin' of my own to do here in town, so I need you to run a few errands for me while I'm busy.

All I need you to do is take the next ship over there by the docks and deliver this crate to my associate in Steamwheedle Port.

Don't gimme that look. It'll be plenty excitin', I'm sure. Gettin' a goblin to pay his dues is much harder than roughin' up the local riffraff, not to mention gettin' through customs. You'll figure it out.

entries.name: Coming to Collect
entries.how:
I don't have Friz's money. Well, I had her money, but I bet it all on ol' Slugjaw here in Fizbuz's arena in Gadgetzan.

Don't gimme that look. It was a sound investment. I won big! I just haven't had a chance to collect my winnin's yet. If you're Friz's new errand boy, why don't you go get it for me? I got a bad back, you know.

Hey, you don't want to go back to your boss empty handed, do ya? Gadgetzan is just west of here. You can't miss it.

entries.name: Tazzik's Dues
entries.how:
Tazzik sent you to collect his winnings? That's a joke, right? His slackjaw champion didn't even last two minutes in the arena! That loser didn't earn a single copper.

It's none of my business, pal, but if I were you I'd skedaddle back to Steamwheedle Port. While you're standin' here talkin' to me, that little rat Tazzik is probably tryin' to hop the next ship outta here.

entries.name: Get the Goods
entries.how:
Your timin' couldn't be better, friend. I was just on my way to collect my shipment from the Bloodsail Buccaneers. They're good friends of mine. Always happy to supply anything Friz is willin' to pay for.

But, ahem, just in case, it couldn't hurt for you to be my liaison. A good caravaneer knows it doesn't hurt to show off a little muscle. Just as a deterrent, of course.

They said they left my stuff in a chest on the hill outside of town for safekeepin'. Why don't you take a look for me, eh?

entries.name: We've Been Robbed!
entries.how:
I already spent good coin on that crate. We ain't just going to let them have it!

You want your shipment? Go to the Venture Co's camp up north and find out who's responsible for this backstabbin'! This ain't about money anymore, {name}. This is about justice! And maybe a little about the money.

entries.name: The Big Payback
entries.how: <The ledger contains a log of each of Ruzzgot's deliveries. The final note marks the heist a success and Ruzzgot's valuables collected by a nearby Venture Co. agent. The goods must still be with him.>

entries.name: All's Well That Ends Well
entries.how:
Looks like a deal's a deal. The Venture Co. got their comeuppance, Friz gets her loot, and everybody's happy. Overall a pretty smooth transaction if I do say so myself.

Now scram, I got another shipment comin' in soon from some Southsea Pirates.

entries.name: Out in the Field
entries.how:
There is a watch tower overlooking the plains to the north. It serves as an observation point to track any motion of the Horde's forces.

The watcher stationed there is named Cornelius. Speak to him and get a status report. He is all alone out there, so I like to check on him with some regularity. Fair warning, he can be a bit...taciturn. It's why he was assigned such a remote post in the first place.

entries.name: Love Thy Neighbor
entries.how:
My husband and I have a farm north of here. I come to Farholde after each harvest to sell what we grow. In good seasons, I like to set aside whatever we don't sell to give to folks who need a little pick-me-up. Gotta take care of your neighbors, I say.

There's a logging camp north of our farm, right on the river. I'm sure those boys could use some fruits and vegetables to give 'em some variety in their diet.

If you're heading that way, could you give this to the foreman there? Name's Halligan Turner.

entries.name: Shipping and Handling
entries.how:
<Wharfmaster Steamfizzle inspects the coin you offered him.>

Whoa-ho! Ol' Friz sure is training the new generation right. Apologies for the delay, sir. You're here to deliver a crate to someone in town, right? I don't know anythin' about that, but if I did, I'd go talk with Tazzik on the dock. He seems to be interested in things like that.

But be quick about it though, yeah? Don't need folks gettin' the wrong idea, ya know.

entries.name: The Purple Ones
entries.how:
Clubtoe see friends go. Some no come back. Some come back purple. Dat weird. Purple ones no act like friends no more.

Where others go? Why they no come back? Make Clubtoe think.

You hit hard. Maybe you go find friends in cave? Maybe you turn purple. Dat weird too.

entries.name: Spread the Word
entries.how:
Me done with Twilight. Clubtoe free ogre now.

Me go find Clugfist. He biggestest ogre Clubtoe ever see. He leave Twilight. Take many friends with him. It Clubtoe's turn. Me join free ogres. They go to the hills. Clubtoe miss hills. No more smashing rocks. Maybe you come sometime?

Me stay here till coast is clear. You take Chogg'Zac's heads back to friends. Well. Maybe one head. Me get one too. Fair trade.

entries.name: Land of Giants
entries.how:
Clearly these wayward ogres are no friends to the Twilight's Hammer. We orcs have an honored history fighting alongside ogres, and it may be time to call upon those old alliances again. And this head may be the key.

There have been reports of ogre activity in the hills far to the north. If this Clubtoe is to be believed, that must be where this clan calls home. Go to their stronghold and offer this trophy as a token of our friendship. With luck, they will listen to your proposal before they step on you.

entries.name: Might Makes Right
entries.how:
Here ogres value strength and blood.

Weak ones leave Bolder'ok. Go back to Twilight's Hammer.

You no big. Maybe you strong. Show Clugfist strength and smash weak ogres. If tiny creature can.

entries.name: Unworthy Champion
entries.how:
Klunk once Clugfist's greatest champion. Him strong. Me give Klunk mighty weapon.

But Clugfist wrong. Klunk weak like others. He leave Bolder'ok. Return to Twilight's Hammer. Take ogres with him to cave east to water. Take mighty weapon with him!

That Clugfist weapon! Bash Klunk's skull and take back Skullbasher. He nobody's champion!

entries.name: Rog'mar Supplies
entries.how:
Supply delivery to this area is no easy feat. All sorts of unscrupulous characters surround us in all directions, each seeking their own piece of the pie.

Now, with that said, perhaps this is an opportunity to slow Rog'mar's growth. What do you say to throwing a little wrench in our orc friends' plans?

Head north of Rog'mar to their training grounds and steal their supply shipments. The recovery time alone ensures our forces remain battle ready while theirs... well, you see where this is going.

entries.name: Twilight No More!
entries.how:
Clubtoe friends... dead? Why?

This Chogg'Zac fault! Dey say they make ogres strong! They lie!!

No more smashing rocks! Tiny creature help Clubtoe smash Chogg'zac stupid heads instead!

entries.name: Clugfist's Decree
entries.how:
Little {race} smash Twilight good. Maybe your Horde stronger than Clugfist think.

You free to stay in Bolder'ok. For now.

Tell other tinies we spill blood again soon.

entries.name: Rumblings of Discontent
entries.how:
As I've shadowed our enemy's movements, I have discovered a weakness among their ranks. Ogre dissidents have begun to rebel, seeking the same freedom as their Bolder'ok kin. Word of your deeds has spread. We must exploit this.

I spied a Bolder'ok warrior heading to the caves west of here in search of his brothers and sisters. Find him, and join his efforts to rally his people.

entries.name: Rise Up!
entries.how:
When Crag'rog hear {race}-ling free ogres, Crag'og want free ogres too.

With tiny {class} here, we smash Twilight together. Break them bones. Make them scream. Free ogres! Then be home in time for stew.

entries.name: Death to the Executioner
entries.how:
When Clugfist leave Twilight, one ogre stand in way. Morg.

Morg massive ogre. Nearly as massive as Clugfist. But not massivest. He need tinies to protect him. Clugfist never got fair fight. Now WE no fight fair.

Find Morg. Bring many tinies with you. Kill him. Take mace back to Clugfist. Then Twilight know they challenge us no more!

entries.name: Consolation Prize
entries.how:
I'm tellin' ya, I can't pay Friz back! I got nothin' left but the shirt off my back!

Why are you lookin' at me like that...

entries.name: Apple of My Eye
entries.how:
<The loud cries of baby Dawnbright echo through Farholde Keep. Tessa looks at you with a tired smile.>

Oh, hello there adventurer. Sorry for the noise. Little Emma here seems to be quite fussy today, but I'm not sure why. Maybe some food will help.

Do you think you could help me find something for her to eat? My husband stepped out to get some supplies so my hands are a little too full to get them myself. If you could find a few apples around here I could make a lovely mash for her.

entries.name: Cut Off the Heads
entries.how:
I have a confession to make. Lady Amberhall did send me to collect those samples, but in truth I volunteered. Sunnyglade was my home before the war took it from me, and I could not rest knowing monsters still taint it. Be it horde or Twilight.

There is no victory here by learning from them. There's nothing to learn. They're beasts, plain and simple, and should be put down like beasts.

We must slay their master at the bottom of this cave and bring an end to this. Surely my mistress will understand.

entries.name: The Purple Ones
entries.how:
<This dead ogre must be one of the friends Clubtoe was looking for. The Twilight's Hammer seem to be conducting rituals on their members, empowering some and killing more.

These ritualists and their monstrosities must be stopped before they spread.>

entries.name: Sickening Lights
entries.how:
Me hate smashing rock. All day me smash. Chogg'Zac say so. He big boss. Say we smash tinies, but now we work for tinies. That stupid.

Why smash rock? Me no know. Find shiny light in rocks. Chogg'Zac like shiny, me guess. Are you here for shiny light too? Others won't like that. They really like light. They draw pictures with it.

Clubtoe not get it. Light make Clubtoe feel sick. Me hate light. Me want SMASH shiny pictures! But Chogg'Zac be mad. Squish Clubtoe. That bad. But someone should.

entries.name: Bats in the Belfry
entries.how:
Since brother Lowley and I began serving Farholde in a more secular capacity, the church here has fallen into disuse. I'd like to think that once the fighting is over, we will be able to bring the Light back to this place. Although, I fear that may not be for a long while...

Still, we need to keep the church in working order, in the hope that day will come.

To that end, a colony of bats has taken to roosting in the upper stories of the church. It would be a great help if you could remove them.

entries.name: Keeping the Light On
entries.how:
While we no longer hold service at the church, I feel it important to keep the candles lit on the graves of our fallen in the church's crypt. To me, keeping the candle's flame alive is a symbol that they are not forgotten and their sacrifices were not in vain.

If you would, bring me candles so that I might continue this ritual. It would mean a great deal to me.

If you're not sure where to find them, speak with Marla in the house just outside of the church. She's a friend and may have some to spare.

entries.name: In Memoriam
entries.how:
If you don't mind, I'd like you to do the honor of lighting these memorial candles. Go to the cemetery just outside and place a fresh candle wherever you see one that's gone out.

Such a task is a far cry from the excitement of your other adventures, I'm sure. Think of this as an opportunity for service and reflection--a quiet moment to acknowledge those who left this world before us, so that we might carry on and make it a better place.

entries.name: Abominable Magics
entries.how:
You there! Thank the light you've come. Did Amberhall send you to find me?

No? Figures as much. Ashe Amberhall sent me down here to investigate the Twilight's Hammer. As you can see, they are digging for something within the Riverglades, but I need a sample of their witchcraft to figure out what.

It's imperative Farholde gets those samples. Please, {class}. Take this catalyst. It's enchanted to absorb the powers of the cult. Runes, cultists, it doesn't matter. Just hold it aloft and it will do the rest.

entries.name: Indiscriminate Purge
entries.how:
As Lady Amberhall's apprentice in the dark arts, I may not look it but I'm usually quite capable of handling things on my own. I did not, however, anticipate an entire cave of void-infused ogres.

If you managed to get all the way down here without being captured, you must be powerful yourself. I was not so lucky with those ogres and their masters roaming about. Do the world a favor and kill the hideous beasts. Nothing good comes from a fanatic with a purpose, empowered or otherwise.

entries.name: Clear 'em Out
entries.how:
If you wanna land a big score, you gotta go where others wouldn't dare! This cave behind me's rich with untapped mineral deposits. I'm talkin' BIG bucks if we can get a crew in there.

There's just this... teeny tiny... dragon problem. It's nothing, really.

If you're willing to go in there and save me the hassle of clearing the dragons out, there's a nice reward in it for you. Not to mention, you'll be in the good graces of a future mining tycoon!

entries.name: WANTED: Scoutmaster Vargas
entries.how:
An Alliance scouting party has been seen on a small island northeast of Rog'mar. They are led by a scoutmaster who has made tracking enemy movements increasingly difficult. The bastard even named his filthy pet after me as an open mockery. He knows I'm hunting him.

This human has eyes everywhere, and they need to be put out. I already claimed one before he managed to flee. Bring me his other as proof that the scoutmaster is no more. Show him he is not as untouchable as he thinks.

-- Neza Bloodsnout

entries.name: WANTED: Blademaster Kaijo
entries.how:
With each orc we cut down, another takes its place--somehow even more capable than the last. A skilled warrior must be training this new generation. If we are to make a dent in their numbers, we need to ensure they don't have a chance to recoup their losses.

If any soldier is brave enough, it's imperative we find this blademaster and put an end to him. He is likely at the trainee camp north of the Horde outpost even now. Kill him, take his banner, and destroy the orcs' morale.

-- Ember Bladewhisper

entries.name: Fit for a Princess
entries.how:
<Tessa rocks her baby, trying to help her sleep.>

If she isn't hungry, maybe she's just tired. To be honest, Emma here was a delightful surprise, but that means we were a little unprepared. My husband built her this lovely bassinet, but I worry these blankets are too old. She deserves the best, after all.

If you're still willing to help, I would be forever grateful if you could find some pelts for me to line her bed with. If this stops her crying, I think everyone in Farholde would be grateful.

entries.name: Proof of Profit
entries.how:
My surveying tools show signs of a never-before-seen mineral in these caves. Cubic draconia, I call it. Probably worth a fortune.

Exciting as this is, no one's gonna come help me dig it up if I can't show 'em proof that it exists. Sure, I have the readings from my tools, but people like to hold a big shiny crystal, not look at charts.

I'm sure there's a few crystals poking up from the dirt in there. If you're willing to dodge a few dragons and get one, you'd really be helpin' a gal out.

entries.name: Hail the Dragonslayer
entries.how:
The dragon's head is all teeth, scale, and ash--a grisly prize taken from a grisly creature. Holding it, you feel the heat of its last fiery breath still radiating from its mouth.

While the threat Scaldaron once posed is no more, the sentries at the Southern Watch ought to know about what happened here.

entries.name: Hail the Dragonslayer
entries.how:
The dragon's head is all teeth, scale, and ash -- a grisly prize taken from a grisly creature. Holding it, you feel the heat of its last fiery breath still radiating from its mouth.

While the threat Scaldaron once posed is no more, the warriors of Rog'mar ought to know about what happened here.

entries.name: Foreman's Plight
entries.how:
G'day, lad. Name's Bertrand, Bertrand Ironbrow! At yer service.

<Bertrand extends a filthy hand.>

These fine folk contracted me tae oversee construction of this here keep. What they lack in experience they make up for in spirit! Problem is, I misplaced me tools.

Had a bit of a run in with a few Twilight in a small grove northwest o' here. Had to choose between me life or me tools. On one hand, I'm alive. On the other... ye see where this is goin'.

Think ye could help find me tools?

entries.name: Fetch 'n' Fletch
entries.how:
'Ey boss-mon, ya need help from ol' Tan'jani? Don't worry about it, I fix you up good.

Orcs be good at hittin' humans with axes, but when you wanna stick 'em before dey see ya comin', that's when you call on the headhunters. You wanna learn to stick 'em too? I see it in your eyes, heheh.

First we get you your own spears. Dis one's mine. Go to the human camp to de west and take their wood. Take knife with ya. You can sharpen their lumber into good spears for stickin'. Den bring 'em back.

entries.name: Stick 'Em
entries.how:
You got de spears, now ya gonna learn how to throw dem.

De Riverglades be full o' crocolisks. Nasty tings. Snap you up if ya ain't quick. Perfect for target practice, heheh.

Go stick yourself a bunch of dem. Den you come back to ol' Tran'jani for ya prize. If ya can stick a crocolisk, ya can stick any'ting.

entries.name: Drink Up!
entries.how:
Here ya go, champ. One drink for ol' grumpy guts over there. If this doesn't sober him up, nothin' will.

Oh and uh... wash your hands after touchin' this. And don't get it in your eyes.

entries.name: Stepped Out
entries.how:
<Tessa's baby continues to wail loudly.>

I guess she isn't tired. Oh... everyone makes it look so easy. Her father always knows how to cheer her up. If only he'd come home already.

{name}, I hate to ask this, but can you see what is taking him so long? He set out a while ago but he should have been back by now. Emma just lights up when she sees him.

You should find him at Powderfuse Port-- he seems to go there a lot lately. You'll know my Gray when you see him. He shines as brightly as the sun.

entries.name: Her World
entries.how:
Tess says little Emm can't sleep without me? And you did all that for them? A total stranger? Damn it. What was I thinking...

Even if I can't guarantee a perfect world for her, I still need to be a part of it. What am I even fighting for if I can't hope for a brighter future?

Thank you for helping my family in my absence, friend, but it's time for me to go home. If I could ask one more favor, can you pick some flowers and take them to Tess? Let her know I'll be home soon? I need to clean up first.

entries.name: Not My Circus
entries.how:
Folks keep dumpin' their furry friends here like I know what I'm doin'. And then they blame me if they come back and their horse or wolf or... whatever they brought is dead or ran off. What do I look like, I'm runnin' a charity?

You look like you know your way around a trough. Mind whippin' me up some grub I can use to keep these beasties in check?

If you can't make it yourself, someone might be willin' to sell you some. And hurry! Last thing I need is a stampede of hungry animals.

entries.name: A Feast for Buzzards
entries.how:
The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery.

You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to the nearby watchman and see what he knows.

entries.name: Song of the Strider
entries.how:
These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one's especially large. The leader of the nearby pride, most likely.

If rumor spreads about a man-eating lion prowling around on my watch, Demar will be furious. Fortunately, I have a plan.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. We can use that to lure the beast out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound. There's tallstriders all over the plains. Get me a beak, and make it snappy!

entries.name: King of the Wild Plains
entries.how:
The whistle's made, {name}. 

Take it, and go to the top of the hill where the lions are. Should be just north of here.

Once you're there, blow the whistle, and our man-eater should appear. I'd tell you not to come back if you don't manage to kill him, but you'll probably be dead anyhow.

Now then, off with you. Let's see if you fare better than our skeletal friend.

entries.name: Goes Down Smooth
entries.how:
Talked to Gray, didja? Ball of laughs, that guy. Last thing he needs is you gettin' him another drink. This is an inn not a bar. He's lucky I haven't thrown him out.

You tryin' to take him with you, be my guest. Though I don't think he's in any condition to go anywhere like that. Not without a little goblin pick-me-up.

Why don't ya gather some ingredients for me from this list while I prepare your little friend his 'drink.' We'll see if he still wants booze after he's had my specialty cocktail.

entries.name: WANTED: Ghostmaw
entries.how:
It's dangerous enough transportin' horses 'round the glades without talk of some mysterious phantom crocolisk snappin' up my prized ponies! They say this one must be at least three times as big as a regular croc. And twice as mean!

I ain't a gamblin' man. I ain't takin' no chances with my horses till someone puts this good-fer-nothin' monster down. If anyone finds this varmint along the rivers, bring me its tooth so's I know it's safe to travel again. Till then, I'm stayin' put!

-- Wheatley

entries.name: WANTED: Ghostmaw
entries.how:
Dese waters be treacherous. My headhunters keep the paths clear as dey can, but there be a beasty stalkin' de rivers even we cannot catch. Excitin', eh?

Boss say we gotta clear it out, so we got a little competition goin'. Find de white one patrollin' de rivers and bring me its fang. Whoever sticks this slippery crocolisk win de whole pot. Just don't get snapped yourself, heheh!

-- Tan'jani

entries.name: High Stakes
entries.how:
One thing that never ceases to amaze me is the drive of humans. They see a desolate warzone teemin' with orcs and cultists and figure that's the perfect spot tae set up shop! Amazin'.

But, it's not me job tae tell 'em where to build. Just gotta show 'em how. And if we want this keep tae be as big as they say, we're gonna need lots o' wood.

With how dangerous the roads have become our lumber shipments from the mill tae the northwest are slowin' to a crawl. Think ye can fetch a few bundles for us?

entries.name: A Miner Problem
entries.how:
We should be thankful that our foe is stupid. An army of ogres at their disposal, and the Twilight's Hammer have them working in the mines nowhere near the fight. I don't know if I chalk it up to mismanagement or an internal struggle, but either way they're in no position to defend themselves.

That's where we come in. With the cult's focus divided, we have an opportunity to strike the enemy while they're vulnerable and split them further. Go to this mine and sow some chaos among their ranks.

entries.name: Step Two: More Rock
entries.how:
Dese good rock. Now need finishing touch. More rock.

Only rock can make rock stronger. Dat the way of rocks.

Me see some tinies make extra heavy rock. Bring me heavy rocks and me make weapon.

entries.name: Might Over Magic
entries.how:
Bal trapped to annoying head. Mog follow everywhere Bal go. Annoying!

He say magic strongest. Please. Without Bal, Mog cast magic on nothing!

Bal no need Mog! Bal show fist is enough! We kill many tinies. Show Mog fist best.

entries.name: Magic Over Might
entries.how:
Bal stupid. He only want hit things.

Mog smart. Mog learn magic to make Bal'mog stronger.

We show Bal he stupid. We use magic. Use magic to show Mog better!

entries.name: Gaseous Gold
entries.how:
The fuel of the future's not coal, or oil, it's gas, baby! Those marshy ponds to the southwest spew it out by the ton, and I've got just the invention to put it to use--a new type of engine that runs on the stuff. The gas is a real pain to collect, though.

If you feel like making a humble contribution to the future of science and industry, why don't you help me get some of that gas? You can see it coming up from vents near the water.

entries.name: Rock 'em and Sock 'em
entries.how:
You may have noticed my mechanical companion here, G45-B4G. Whirlin' around in that burlap chest of his is the one, and only, working prototype of my gas-powered engine.

I figure it's in need of some stress testing. How'd you like to take him on in a fight? I can power him up with the gas you've collected.

Oh, and don't worry about hurting him. He can't feel a thing!

entries.name: Wound Dressings
entries.how:
If there is one thing a fighting force always needs, it's bandages. Unfortunately, Farholde has no reliable way to manufacture cloth. Thus, we depend on imports from the goblins or, if we are lucky, what we can take back from the orcs.

Currently, our supply of quality cloth is running low. I will have to start making bandages of old shirts before long. If you have the means to aid us, you would be saving many lives.

entries.name: Doctor's Orderly
entries.how:
I will fashion the cloth you've given me into bandages. In the meantime, please take these ones that I have already made, and dress the wounds of the soldiers who need it. It should be a matter of basic first aid.

Your assistance here is both necessary, and highly appreciated. I simply cannot be everywhere at once.

entries.name: Clerical Quarantine
entries.how:
You have done all you can here, for now.

If you wish to be of further aid, go up the hill to the chapel. It is the smaller building outside the main church.

Sister Rowland is looking after a few quarantined soldiers there who have contracted an unknown illness.

entries.name: Something's in the Water
entries.how:
I will spare you the grisly details, but these soldiers are violently ill. The nature of their sickness leads me to believe there is an issue with either their food or their water.

I've already checked the crops coming in from the nearby farms, so this only leaves the water, which comes from the local rivers. The best place to collect a sample is from the pools in the plains to the north. Nearly every river runs through the area, so it would be wise to check for contamination there.

entries.name: Upstream Contamination
entries.how:
The impurities in this sample look organic in nature. Not quite waste, but certainly something toxic.

I am no expert on wildlife, but I would guess that there is something upstream causing the water contamination. Some kind of animal, or at least a creature.

Follow the rivers as far north as you can, and see if you can find what is responsible for this. If it is an animal, it must be put down. It is for the safety of all here in Farholde.

entries.name: A Feast for Buzzards
entries.how:
The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery.

You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to a hunter at Rog'mar and see what they know.

entries.name: Song of the Strider
entries.how:
These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one is especially large--the leader of the nearby pride.

I would gladly hunt the beast myself, but you have first claim. Instead, I will aid you.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. You can use it to lure the lion out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound.

There are tallstriders all over the plains. Find me a beak and the hunt can begin!

entries.name: King of the Wild Plains
entries.how:
The whistle is made, {name}.

Take it and go to the top of the hill south where the lions dwell.

Once you are ready to face your quarry, blow the whistle and the beast should appear.

I wish you luck in your hunt. May you return in glory.

entries.name: Feathers for Fletching
entries.how:
A hunter goes through more arrows in her lifetime than there are stars in the sky.

Personally, I make mine by hand. I only trust my own work.

The coarse feathers of the nearby buzzards make for excellent fletching. Would you aid me by collecting a few?

entries.name: Poison Tips
entries.how:
Arrows are always essential, but sometimes you need something more potent to take down your prey.

This is where poison coatings come into play. They ruin the meat, but if you need something dead, they do the job.

Poisons can either be brewed or, if you are brave, gathered. You strike me as the latter.

The vipers by the pools to the south produce a powerful venom. If I have estimated you correctly, I think you could collect some of it.

entries.name: A Hunter's Quiver
entries.how:
As important as a hunter's weapons is her quiver. A good quiver holds many arrows, while not being so large as to slow the wearer down. It must be durable, and fit snugly onto the body.

Around here, there is no better material for a quiver than the pelts of lions. They are already well-suited for the life of a hunter on the plains.

The lions gather on a hill to the south. You can see it from here. Please, bring me their pelts.

entries.name: In Need of Relief
entries.how:
Now that the lion hides have been collected, and the orcish poachers culled, I can finally get a break.

At least, that's what I would say, if the man who was supposed to relieve me of my watch wasn't missing.

Dunston Willis, explorer extraordinaire, went to investigate the ogre settlement to the north a few days ago. He said he'd take over my post upon his return.

Find him. If he's alive, bring him back here. If he's hanging up on meat hooks, bring me proof so Demar can send me someone else.

entries.name: An Ogre's Captive
entries.how:
I'm not sure how you got in here, but please, listen to me.

As you know, I serve as a watchman for Farholde Keep.

While on patrol, I was ambushed by a band of these brutes and taken prisoner. Now, I am forced to fight in the ring for their amusement.

I haven't much strength left. If I'm to escape, it's now or never. 

My captor is an ogre they call "Gronok the Butcher". He has the key to my shackles. Will you bring me that key and help me out of here?

entries.name: Armory of Sunnyglade
entries.how:
You look like a healthy, able-bodied {race}. I am looking for someone to travel to Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades just north of the Redridge Mountains.

My family owned an armory there, once. Now I imagine it is a burnt husk, but I would have you retrieve a tome containing my family's ancestral armor crafting techniques. It was originally in the basement, so hopefully it has not succumbed to the elements just yet.
rewardItems: Tome of Tremayne Family Blacksmithing Techniques

entries.name: Welcome!
entries.how:
Welcome to the World of Warcraft!

As special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Dalia Windbreeze in Thendal Grove. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.

Thanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!

entries.name: Coming of Age
entries.how:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.

entries.name: Harmony in Balance
entries.how:
We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.

The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.

Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.

entries.name: Infestation Investigation
entries.how:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.

entries.name: The Cirrusfly Queen
entries.how:
If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.

Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.

Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.

entries.name: Elemental Unrest
entries.how:
Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.

Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them. 

My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.

entries.name: Agitators
entries.how:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, {class}?

entries.name: Call of Earth
entries.how:
While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve.

Travel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.

entries.name: Call of Earth
entries.how:
A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.

The sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that.

Seek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass east of here. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you will see what you need to see.

entries.name: Call of Earth
entries.how:
Take this Rough Quartz from me and bring it to the one you call Windshaper Boro as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this shard will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.

Be patient, {name}. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what the elements ask of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.

entries.name: Return to Rorian
entries.how:
You've done enough here, {class}. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.

entries.name: Foul Matriarch
entries.how:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the west. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.

entries.name: Aetheen of the Gales
entries.how:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.

entries.name: The Next Step
entries.how:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.

entries.name: Aggressive Encroachment
entries.how:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.

entries.name: Falling With Style
entries.how:
Well hello there, {name}! Want to play a game?

All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!

entries.name: zzOLD UNUSED Cult Ambush
entries.how: The cultist you just killed dropped what appears to be orders from a high priestess of the Cult of Al'Akir. It makes mention of a spy in Shen'dar Village and cult operations in a place called Falaath Village. The authorities at Shen'dar Village will want to learn of this.

entries.name: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
entries.how:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.

entries.name: The Problem With Prideclaws
entries.how:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.

entries.name: Hippogryph Harassment
entries.how: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.

entries.name: The Criminal Element
entries.how:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.

entries.name: DNT Return to Aonda
entries.how:
<Faladiel regains his composure after a moment.>

Listen to me carefully. None of this ever happened. It's critical that you tell no one of this and if anyone asks, you don't know me or anything about a letter to Valanaar. I'm going to get on the next caravan out of town and then book the fastest ship to Shen'dramar. I suggest you do the same.

Trust me, the people who did this are not to be trifled with.

entries.name: DNT Delinquent Debts
entries.how:
So you wish to help our governor maintain peace and order? Well, it's quite encouraging to see our youth so devoted to the rule of law. Very well, let's put your sense of duty to the test with something easy.

The yokels in these parts are, let's say... somewhat lax at maintaining payments for their debts to Zephras. There are several citizens who owe the provincial seat a tidy sum and I need you to help me collect. The largest debt is owed by Shen'dar Village itself, so I'd start with Constable Aonda.

entries.name: DNT - Good Help Is Hard to Find
entries.how:
I dispatched a local courier to deliver a vital piece of correspondence to Valanaar yesterday and it seems the messenger never made the delivery! When I reached out to the intended recipient in Valanaar today via the sending stones I received word back that they had no record of receiving my courier.

I need you to find that useless courier and ensure that he's not drinking his wage away, passed out at some vagrant camp in the wilds. The message was of the utmost importance and is... highly sensitive.

entries.name: Among the Faithful
entries.how:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.

entries.name: Falaath Village
entries.how:
It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.

entries.name: Al'Aketh Thugs
entries.how:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.

entries.name: Havoc in the Highlands
entries.how:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.

entries.name: Stolen Supplies
entries.how:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.

entries.name: Restocking the Larders
entries.how:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?

entries.name: To Valanaar
entries.how:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, {name}.

entries.name: The Windshapers
entries.how:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift. 

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

entries.name: The High Order
entries.how:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

entries.name: Reading the Leylines
entries.how:
Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from leylines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these leylines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.

Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a leyline there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.

entries.name: The Gift of Skysight
entries.how:
As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.

entries.name: DNT Trouble in the Forest
entries.how:
My scout reports that a large force of cultists just marched north into the Shadowgale forest. Other than the pylon, there isn't much there of interest.

Head north into the forest and catch up with them, but give the shrine a wide berth for now. Take as many of the cultists out as possible once you reach the Shadowgale and try to determine why they are there. These cultists aren't much for thinking for themselves so taking out their commander can generally cause them to crumble quickly.

entries.name: Desperate Times
entries.how:
Since engaging the cult in the open is not viable, our best chance is going to be to use this opportunity to attack the shrine itself. We can take Lorthuna herself off the board before she can finish her part of this scheme.

It so happens that Valennia has been preparing a strategy for a potential assault on the Shrine for some time now. The only problem is, we will need help. 

Speak with Valennia for the details.

entries.name: Disrupting Logistics
entries.how:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.

entries.name: The Turncoat
entries.how:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.

entries.name: Unfortunate News
entries.how: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>

entries.name: Breaking the Breaker
entries.how:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, {class}.

entries.name: Confront Lorthuna
entries.how:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, {class}.

entries.name: Blood Tithe
entries.how:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.

entries.name: Make Yourself Useful
entries.how:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.

entries.name: Flutterfly Dust
entries.how:
I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.

entries.name: Ornery Ornery Galestriders
entries.how:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.

entries.name: The Hills Have Eyes
entries.how:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.

entries.name: Standing Our Ground
entries.how:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

entries.name: What Is My Purpose?
entries.how:
