<You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>

...Function error...

...Question...

...What is....

...Function...

<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>

entries.name: The Supreme Magister
entries.how:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here. The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.

You should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

entries.name: The Grand Skyseer
entries.how:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

entries.name: To Valanaar
entries.how:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, {name}.

entries.name: Deliver the News
entries.how:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, {name}. 

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.

entries.name: A Grand Adventure
entries.how:
The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.

We'll need strong young adventurers like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.

entries.name: A Grand Adventure
entries.how: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and it's youths like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.

entries.name: The Missing Scholar
entries.how:
Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.

One of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to gather data on the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.

If you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.

entries.name: Unwelcome Visitors
entries.how:
The Shadowgale Forest is incredibly dangerous and is usually off limits to normal adventurers. In recent months there's been an explosion in the shriekling population and they've started to expand their territory outside the woods, which is a potential problem. I have an interest in the alchemical properties of shriekling talons, so a much-needed culling also presents an opportunity for scholarly gain.

Travel to Shadowgale Forest and hunt the beasts. Bring me as many of their talons as you can.

entries.name: Avenged Tenfold
entries.how:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

It's clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.

entries.name: Catching Wind
entries.how:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.

entries.name: The Missing Scholar
entries.how: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>

entries.name: The Missing Scholar
entries.how:
I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety, however, is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!

After it's done, you'll find me back in Valanaar. I need to report to the Supreme Magister what occurred here and the status of my mission.

entries.name: In Service of Zephras
entries.how:
The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.

entries.name: In Service of Zephras
entries.how:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.

entries.name: Return to Valanaar
entries.how:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, {class}.

entries.name: The High Elder's Request
entries.how:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.

entries.name: Making Our Move
entries.how:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, {class}.

entries.name: Infiltrating the Cult
entries.how:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.

entries.name: Prepare for Battle
entries.how: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.

entries.name: What Comes Next
entries.how:
Please extend my thanks to Elaadrin for all that the High Order and your new friends from this "Kirin Tor" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the High Order's plans to leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, this mission will be all the stronger for it.

Winds be with you, {name}.

entries.name: What Comes Next
entries.how:
Please extend my thanks to Ayessa for all that the Windshapers and your new friends from this "Earthen Ring" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the plan to take the Windshapers' shamans and leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever solution the Windshapers find can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years.

Winds be with you, {name}.

entries.name: The Haunted Forest
entries.how:
Aye then, do you not believe me? I may be a drunkard, but I tell you true that the foresht is haunted by a twisted pygmy spirit... ghost... demon... thing! *hic* He were shmall in stature, but his magics are deadly as the day is long. His lair is filled to the brim with terrible totems of power that can turn you to dusht!

The foresht spirits shwarm him and protect him. If you ever see him for yourself, you'll know. You'll know! *hic*

entries.name: The Strange Hermit
entries.how:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... it's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?

entries.name: The Forest's Bounty
entries.how:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!

entries.name: The Ancient Hilt
entries.how:
In the faint illumination of your torchlight, you can make out a small glint of metal. Upon further inspection, it's clear that this is the broken hilt of an ancient sword.

Despite missing a blade, you can clearly see that this hilt is a product of masterful workmanship. This is a precious heirloom, and there may be those who are interested to learn more about this.

entries.name: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears
entries.how:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.

entries.name: zzOLD UNUSED Nightclaw Gratitude
entries.how:
You have our gratitude, {class}. Please express our gratitude for the delicious treat to the fleshy moustached forest spirit when next you find yourself on the west end of Shadowgale Forest. 

Four winds bless you, friend.

entries.name: zzOLD UNUSED
entries.how: I've had a bit of a think since you brought me back this old gadget. I may have had a change of heart about getting my memories back...

entries.name: Free the Hollows
entries.how:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but it's definitely a song and it's... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?

entries.name: (UNUSED) The Rusty Gadget
entries.how: <As the roiling currents that hold the Wind Hollow together begin to dissipate, a small metal device tumbles to the ground at your feet. It appears to be some sort of mechanical gadget. The Strange Hermit mentioned he was still missing some equipment. He might be interested in this.>

entries.name: The Malfunctioning Construct
entries.how:
The construct before you buzzes and spurts and is clearly not functioning correctly. Drawing on your limited experience as an engineer, you suspect that it needs some form of repairs.

There are a few Artisans in Valanaar that have some experience servicing cyclone constructs such as this one, and the hermit who taught you engineering may also have some insight.

entries.name: DNT The Tardy Courier
entries.how:
I dispatched a courier to deliver a vital piece of correspondence to Valanaar last week and the courier has not returned. The trip does not take that long even on foot and I am worried for the boy.

This courier was carrying a vital report containing our supply and weapons losses to bandits and cult activity, and without resupply we are incredibly vulnerable. He was last seen approaching the nearest bridge to the village, just southwest of here. You might start there to try and pick up his trail.

entries.name: Crab Season
entries.how:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!

entries.name: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable
entries.how:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.

entries.name: Pilfered Windstones
entries.how:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?

entries.name: Tower Defense
entries.how:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.

entries.name: More Al'Aketh Ears
entries.how:
The Al'Aketh cult normally gives this forest a wide berth, fearing the rumors that it is haunted... rumors we are happy to maintain. The Druids of my order wish only to live quiet, peaceful lives here in Shadowgale and they threaten that. 

Many among us are afraid.

I come with an offer. Fight the cultists for us, and bring us the ears of those you kill. We will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to our secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.

entries.name: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
entries.how:
You've got that "High Order" look to you. Those with Highborne ancestry always seem to have a slight twinkle in their eyes that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident High Order elder Rathiril Sunlance. You can find him here in the main lodge, just around the corner from me.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.

entries.name: Harvesting Windstones
entries.how:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?

entries.name: The Port of Valanaar
entries.how:
This used to be a port back when the skycutters could travel between the provinces, but since we've long since lost contact with the other islands, the docks are mostly for show. Though we keep our ships in good repair, well... just in case.

Since you are new to Valanaar, it might be worth your time to show yourself around. I'm sure there's work to be had for an enterprising adventurer as well, if you ask around. When you've finished, please deliver this note to High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong for me.

entries.name: The Broken Construct
entries.how:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.

entries.name: Unwelcome Spirits
entries.how:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.

entries.name: The Broken Construct
entries.how:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then. 

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.

entries.name: The Broken Construct
entries.how:
Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though?

The High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly forbidden them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience.

I think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do.

entries.name: Blood for Blood
entries.how:
A number of our Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands this morning. We can't be certain but there is a strong chance that the Al'Aketh are responsible. Windshapers trade blood for blood, every time.

Head north and kill any Al'Aketh you encounter. Bring me their windstone prayer charms as proof of the deed. We do not forgive and we do not forget.

entries.name: A Firm Response
entries.how:
The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.

Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.

entries.name: Confront Lorthuna
entries.how:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, {class}.

entries.name: The Fate of Zephras
entries.how:
Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.

entries.name: The Western Watch
entries.how:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!

entries.name: A Last Request
entries.how: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>

entries.name: Deliver the Signet
entries.how:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. 

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.

entries.name: Bugged
entries.how:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.

entries.name: A Little Beauty
entries.how:
The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.

entries.name: The Inner Sanctum
entries.how:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.

entries.name: The Fate of Zephras
entries.how:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.

entries.name: Meddlesome Mages
entries.how:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.

entries.name: A Magical Affront
entries.how:
The recent emergence of the leylines on the surface of Zephras has been profound for our order. We have more direct and tangible access to the energies that permeate this place and it has increased our understanding of said magic greatly.

The Windshapers, however, view these emergences as scars on the land that must be "healed". This is an affront to our order and is something we simply cannot abide.

Go to the leyline in the forest to the southwest and drive off the Windshapers you find there.

entries.name: The Anchors of Zephras
entries.how:
Greetings, young {name}. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.

entries.name: Unnerving Silence
entries.how:
A moment if you will, {name}. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.

entries.name: Tears of the Lady
entries.how:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.

entries.name: Feathers for Binding
entries.how:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.

entries.name: Unwanted and Unworthy
entries.how:
The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.

entries.name: The Ties That Bind
entries.how:
The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.

entries.name: The Wounds of Betrayal
entries.how:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.

entries.name: Ripped Missive
entries.how: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>

entries.name: The Fate of the Den
entries.how:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, though the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, {name}. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.

entries.name: A Sacrifice in Vain
entries.how:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you explain yourself.>

So the message did not get to Valanaar. We are in dire straits indeed then.

<Elegael sighs deeply then looks resolute.>

Then we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.

entries.name: UNUSED
entries.how:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a house just northwest of Valanaar, just inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, find out and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.

entries.name: The Cult's True Plans
entries.how:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.

entries.name: Aid For The Refugees
entries.how:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.

entries.name: The Fate of a Loved One
entries.how:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.

entries.name: Violent Winds (Temp Disabled)
entries.how:
When our home started to fall into the sky that fateful night, it's as if the elements themselves were waiting to consume us. Wind spirits began appearing as we were fleeing, and to our dismay they began attacking the fleeing survivors.

We lost many villagers to the sky, but even more to the relentless anger of those wind spirits. I don't know if it was our village falling into the sky, but they are extremely dangerous.

If you are able, please put them to rest.

entries.name: Hopping Helpers
entries.how: [PH] Collect frogs

entries.name: Valanaar Vintages
entries.how: [PH] Collect grapes from the vineyard

entries.name: The Magical City of Dalaran
entries.how:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.

entries.name: The Earthen Ring
entries.how:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. 

Banu-Alah, {name}.

entries.name: Your First Riding Galestrider
entries.how:
Now that you have completed your training, it would seem the winds wish you to bond with your first strider.

These galestriders have been ridden by our ancestors for generations. Despite their wispy and slender appearance, they are steadfast and fierce mounts.

You and your strider will traverse the world together, so you have an important choice to make. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go examine the striders and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: Eluvi'ana
entries.how:
If I may beg your pardon, that blade you carry there, may I see it? Much like the ancient hilt you brought me previously, I believe that blade was also created by the same master magesmith, Luminarian. 

If I am correct, it is called Eluvi'ana and it was the twin of the blade whose hilt you gave me, which itself was called Eluvi'tor. What are the odds that you would come into possession of both of these priceless artifacts? It must be fate.

Let me inspect it to be sure...

entries.name: Learning to Ride
entries.how:
Hello, {class}! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a galestrider, for a fee of course.

I will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about riding galestriders.

entries.name: Al'Aketh Assassins
entries.how:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.

entries.name: Swift as the Wind
entries.how:
Ah, you've returned. Very good. Are you ready to learn to ride an armored galestrider?

As before, if you take the next step in your training with me, I will provide you with a free mount, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. 

It won't be cheap, but speak to me when you have enough coin. I will teach you about riding armored galestriders.

entries.name: An Epic Ride
entries.how:
Gales greetings, {name}! I can't believe this day has come so soon. Today I am proud to say you have mastered galestrider riding, so I may now offer you our finest, fastest and boldest striders.

Like before, you and your strider will traverse the world together, so you have an important choice to make. Many of these striders have grown in your time apart, but I would be willing to bet they still recognize you.

Go examine the armored striders and return to me when you have made your choice.

entries.name: Fillion's Mission
entries.how:
I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail.

The data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.

entries.name: The Gods of the Summit
entries.how:
<Jereman shifts her weight, her feathers bristling in anger as she clacks her beak in displeasure.>

I do not know what awaits us here, but there is an overwhelming sense of wrongness about the mountain I have not felt in centuries. Having gotten a taste of the Wild King's magic first-talon however, I know he must be stopped.

I only pray we have arrived in time to save the other Wild Gods who reside here.

entries.name: The Darkness Below
entries.how:
We've done what we can for my fellows, but this is far from over. Something is very wrong down here in the dark.

There is something ancient down here, yes... very ancient indeed. And there is... pain and loss. Whatever this feeling is, it makes my feathers crawl.

Whatever these druids are doing, they must be stopped.

entries.name: The Wild King Must Die
entries.how:
Valdrus Blackthorne. The 'Wild King'.

<Jereman lets out a low hiss.>

He has turned his back on his oath as a druid and will pay for his crimes against the natural order! Only blood can repay the harm he has done here.

Go, {name}! Enter the domain of Wild King and end him.

I will remain here with Nythus to ensure that he is protected from any lingering remnants of Blackthorne's forces, and to ensure that none interfere as you bring the Wild King to justice.

entries.name: Field of Honor: Week 6
entries.how: You're in luck, pal. I'm sending you on an unpaid vacation to the sunny Darkspear Isles. Get in there and do your thing. Just uh, try not to die, okay?

entries.name: Field of Honor: Week 7
entries.how: I think we've got a regular virtuoso of violence in you, buddy. I'd like to see a bit more of your tenacity though, this week.

entries.name: Conflict at Darkspear Islands
entries.how:
The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands. 

Go, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.

entries.name: Conflict at Darkspear Islands
entries.how: The fight in Darkspear Islands is ceaseless, {name}. Together, we will destroy the Alliance dogs in the Theramore Expeditionary Force!

The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us. 

It is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!

entries.name: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!
entries.how:
The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, {class}. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is. 

Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, {class}!
