entries.name: Take Full Control
entries.how:
There have been many battles at Darkspear Islands. However, they still be too close for our liking. This next one, defeat the Alliance while controlling all the outposts.

Do this and show the dominance of the Darkspear Raiders.

entries.name: Darkspear Island Domination
entries.how:
You've handed the horde a decisive defeat at the Darkspear Islands, and now it's time to break their spirits once and for all. Dominate the battlefield utterly, and defeat the enemy while controlling all four outposts. 

Do this and show the Horde the unrelenting supremacy of The Theramore Expeditionary Force.

entries.name: Conquering the Isles
entries.how:
It's not enough to merely win against the Horde, {class}. Our victory must be decisive. Return to Darkspear Islands and achieve victory there while controlling at least three outposts.

For the Alliance!

entries.name: Conquering the Island
entries.how:
It not be enough to just defeat the Alliance. We must be demoralizing them to drive them from the Darkspear Islands for good. Return to Darkspear Islands and show them no mercy. Win in the battle while controlling at least three outposts.

Crush the Alliance and claim big victory for the Darkspear Raiders!

entries.name: A Frightened Request
entries.how:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not to worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.

entries.name: Remember That I Love You
entries.how: <A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.>

entries.name: Light's Justice
entries.how:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!

entries.name: The Wrath of Rath'mael
entries.how:
Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth. 

Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, {name}.

If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.

entries.name: Crest of Lordaeron
entries.how: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>

entries.name: Bloodied Insignia
entries.how: <The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.>

entries.name: Crest of Lordaeron
entries.how: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.>

entries.name: The New Plague
entries.how:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.

entries.name: Abominable Creatures
entries.how:
What do you want, {race}? Can't you see there is a war to be won?

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.

entries.name: Unending Torment
entries.how:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>

entries.name: Unending Torment
entries.how:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the Alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.

entries.name: Unending Torment
entries.how:
With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.

We simply need to motivate it.

Fetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.

We have a potion to make!

entries.name: Unending Torment
entries.how:
I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.

Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.

And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.

entries.name: The Secret Prison
entries.how:
Can't say I've ever thought much about Alcaz. Near as I can tell, it's an abandoned outpost from the third war of little significance. Never heard nuthin' about a prison there. 

Well, there's nothing for it--we've got to get you in there and see what you can see, especially if there's a chance that the king is there.

entries.name: Somber News
entries.how: <The King is dead--killed in an escape attempt just before the Naga attacked. This is devastating news and will shake Stormwind to its core. You need to return to Sully and tell him what you've learned as quickly as possible.>

entries.name: No Orc Left Behind
entries.how:
Your orders are simple-- Go into the dungeons beneath the keep and find Commander Folkar. Free him if he lives, and learn what you can about what in the twisting nether is going on here.

There's an army waiting for you down there and you won't survive on your own. I hope you have allies... preferably strong ones.

entries.name: The Honor of the Kor'kron
entries.how:
My good axe arm is broken and most of my elites are dead. The honor of the Kor'kron rests with you now.

We were sent here to extract a prisoner, but not just any prisoner... We are here for the King of Stormwind, Varian Wrynn. We intercepted information that he was being held here and our Warchief commanded us to bring him back to Orgrimmar alive. The presence of black dragons... complicates things.

I need you to press on and find Wrynn. I will wait for you here while you search for him.

entries.name: Thrall Needs to Know
entries.how:
Thrall needs to know what happened here. I will meet up with Ulka and see to it that he is fit to travel before returning to Orgrimmar, so I am trusting you to bring this information to the warchief in my stead.

Go now, soldier of the Horde. Tell our warchief what fate befell Varian Wrynn.

entries.name: A Little Payback
entries.how:
A second wave of Naga was approaching the keep when we were falling back. I suspect that the battle is still raging inside. 

We Kor'kron play blood for blood. If you are going in there anyway, I want you to kill any Naga you see. I saw a sorceress among them as well, and you can bet that was their leader. Bring me her head.

We lost a lot of good orcs today and I won't rest easy knowing that we didn't give as good as we got.

entries.name: Blood Red Bandanas
entries.how:
Most of the humans we fought wore blood red bandanas. I seem to recall hearing of a criminal organization operating in the Eastern Kingdoms known as 'The Defias Brotherhood' who are known for their red masks. Why they are active here in Kalimdor I don't know, but kill any that cross your path and bring their masks to Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. 

He'll be able to determine if these are in fact Defias masks.

entries.name: The Man in the Iron Chains
entries.how:
Wow! That was impressive. The way you took down that dragon was really something!

While you are here... do you think you might be able to help me get out of this ball and chain?

If he hasn't fled or been killed already, the torturer they call 'The Questioner' should have the keys to these shackles. Get the key from that sadist and bring it to me.

I promise that I'll make it well worth your while if you do.

entries.name: More Valuable Than Gold
entries.how:
I told you that I'd make it worth your while to free me. I don't have any gold for you, but I have something better.

Take this. It will help you find a treasure more valuable than gold. Do what you want with it, but if anyone asks you where you got it, tell them that the person who gave it to you died. 

Tell them he was vaporized by dragonfire... blown out to sea.

entries.name: Bad News for Folkar
entries.how: <The King is dead--killed in an escape attempt just before the Naga attacked. Many Kor'kron died to learn this news, but this knowledge could shake the Alliance to its core. You need to return to Commander Folkar and tell him what you've learned as quickly as possible.>

entries.name: State Secrets
entries.how: <It occurs to you that as an advisor to the Warchief, Nazgrel might be very interested to see the documents you've recovered from Westfall. Ask him if any of these documents make any sense to him.>

entries.name: State Secrets
entries.how: <It occurs to you that Shaw's right-hand goblin might be interested to see the documents you've recovered from Westfall. Ask him if any of these documents make any sense to him.>

entries.name: State Secrets
entries.how: <It occurs to you that a goblin who deals in asset recovery might be very interested to see the documents you've recovered from Westfall. Ask him if any of these documents make any sense to him... and more importantly, what he might be willing to pay you for them.>

entries.name: A Bit of Wet Work
entries.how:
Was spyin' on the shore of Alcaz with my trusty lookin' glass whilst you were off eavesdroppin' on Lady Proudmoore. I think the island may be under attack. I saw naga--lots of them, chargin' onto shore. 

The enemy of my enemy is certainly not my friend when it comes to naga, so let's do the world a favor and take some of them out. I also spied what looks to be the leader--a spellcaster type barkin' orders. Take her out as well, if you can.

entries.name: The Dragon's Journal
entries.how:
Timear and I have been scrying the area on Kalimdor known as Alcaz Island and we've all but confirmed the presence of a powerful magic user there. The mage in question was able to dispel our probes, but before she did, I was able to glean an image of a tome of some sort. I believe it was a journal, written in ancient draconic script.

I don't know what is in that book, but I'd like to study it. We want you to travel to the hidden prison beneath Alcaz Island and recover that book for us.

entries.name: Valley of Bones
entries.how:
It is time, outsider, for you to learn of our great discovery... but Warug will not be the one to tell it!

Head south to the other end of the village. Look for a big, stinky centaur named Orgrul.

You will know when you get there.
You will know when you see him.
If he thinks you deserve to know, you will know.

And if he doesn't? Well. You can be happy knowing Warug has a new crown.

entries.name: Mountain of Bones
entries.how:
Some sort of necromantic energy has permeated throughout the Valley of Bones, for reasons we have yet to understand.

Those reasons are also of no importance to us. The magic is ours now, and those who do not fight with blade or mallet are trained in this new magic.

If you think I intend to start you off with a challenging task, think again. For now, go into the Valley of Bones and fetch some bones for me. I am sure you can handle that.

entries.name: Outcast Necromancers
entries.how:
Have you noticed the puny centaur stomping about around here? Those are of Gelkis descent.

We Magram have already established a foothold deeper into the canyon. When the Gelkis took notice of our presence here, some among them chose to follow in our footsteps. I know not whether they wish to join us or attempt to overthrow us, but I do know that their clanmates have sentenced them all to exile.

They're lone wolves meddling in powers that do not belong to them. I want them dead.

entries.name: Corrupting Tears
entries.how:
Outsider, did you notice the weapon that the outcast necromancers held in their hands? We will ensure the Gelkis will not live long enough to master the ways of necromancy, but their methods of channeling caught my interest. They even use those same crystals Warug asked you to steal.

I think we can use this technique to our advantage. Venture back into the valley to recover some wood from the accursed trees, and see if Warug will part with some of his crystals. I will make staves from them.

entries.name: Proof of Concept
entries.how:
We already know these crystals are capable of more than sundering the ground--the Gelkis have proven that they can be twisted for necromantic power. Do you remember the bones I had you collect? I assembled them as best I could just up the hill. There was enough for two workable skeletons.

<Orgrul hands you a newly made staff.>

I will deliver the Necrokhan's staff while you play with your new toy. Return only once you can prove that you know how to use it.

entries.name: No Mercy for the Weak
entries.how:
As you tread further into the Valley of Bones, you will find Gelkis wanderers that dared to enter our territory. I instructed they be kept alive so they could feed the bone worms burrowing about, but they seem uninterested in their prey being alive.

This task is simple. Find the prisoners, then snuff out their life. Don't give them a brief glimmer of hope for freedom.

entries.name: Bone Raising
entries.how:
I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet?

Of course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further.

As you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic.

I have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back!

entries.name: Strange Pylons
entries.how:
<You approach the strange crystal, guarded mere moments ago by emaciated mana elementals.

Its pedestal, though ancient, is noticeably less dilapidated than the elven ruins it is built upon.

A weak hum of power radiates from the fractured gemstone, but with its magic so heavily depleted its purpose will ultimately remain a mystery for the time being.

Perhaps there is more to discover nearby.>

entries.name: A Brief History Lesson
entries.how:
You will have to forgive me for sending you on such a series of tasks without providing any context. I hadn't considered how suspicious this may have seemed, more so now that the skies have taken on such a dramatic appearance.

I will gladly answer your questions.

entries.name: Valley of Bones
entries.how:
One of our scouts returned to the village while you were away, with news that confirmed my fears.

The Magram are up to something, {name}. It is not good.

The Valley of Bones far to the east is a cursed land that few centaur dared to enter and fewer still ever return home. Our enemy has found something there, something evil, and we need to learn what it is.

Seek out the scout Nerlokh at the southern entrance, but you may have to prove yourself further to the Gelkis.

entries.name: Ravaging Ravagers
entries.how:
You need not peer far to see the undead shambling about ahead of us, but have you noticed something unusual about them?

They walk on two legs, not four! These skeletons are not even our fallen kin. The Magram must be defiling the bodies of those who died long before the Desolace was our domain. I cannot imagine how they justified turning their backs on Mother Theradras and took to desecrating corpses that have rested here for centuries.

Put the undead to rest, {name}.

entries.name: Outing Outcasts
entries.how:
While I waited for your arrival, I peered a bit further between the arches and noticed something I need you to confirm for me.

I cannot bear saying it aloud. Not until my suspicions have been proven true.

{name}, while you are getting your bearings in the valley, slay some of the necromancers that look weaker than the others. Tear off their ritual garb, carefully, and bring it to me. I must know whether I am of clear mind and vision.

entries.name: Facing the Truth
entries.how:
This discovery is devastating for our clan, but it is in our best interest to keep this only to those who need to know. Uthek is one such person who needs to be aware of what is going on here. I suspect she will know how to proceed.

Take this to show her. For good measure, we should also bring evidence of the necromancy itself to her. Find a skull that looks recently cursed. I suspect they may be hoarding them in the maws of one of the goliath's skeletons.

entries.name: Saving Our Own
entries.how:
There was a brief battle between a few of the necromancers just around the hill, and I used that to take a closer look inside.

{name}, not all of our recent losses were defectors. There are Gelkis being held captive further in the valley! I was not able to investigate their situation because a hulking Magram brute started charging my direction. I consider myself fortunate he lost interest quickly.

You must go back into the Valley of Bones and free them. The Gelkis stand together.

entries.name: Bone Burying
entries.how:
About this staff of yours. I recognize it as one of Uthek's, and you mentioned it was constructed with Theradras' Tears, augmented with a Draenethyst Crystal, and that it can dispel dark magic?

I noticed that there are skeletons stuck just underneath the rocky soil further into the valley. I believe these are failed summons from the Outcast Necromancers, doomed perhaps forever to an existence smothered in dirt.

Laying them to rest again would be good for our cause, and their spirits.

entries.name: Bristleback Retreat
entries.how:
On the other side of the valley, we have established a small foothold to prepare to march into the forest nearby. Before you head straight there, I want you to deal with a recent Bristleback intrusion along the way. They seem to have arrived right around the same time we did, but managed to secure an artifact from the nearby temple that has kept us at bay.

This task is simple. Look for the thorns and the pigs. Kill a bunch, indiscriminately. Then report to Hagiak at the camp I mentioned.

entries.name: Long-Term Solutions
entries.how:
There is a second centaur village out here, to the southwest. That one belongs to the Gelkis. You expect me to send you over just to spill some blood, right? Good. That had best be your first thought, else I would cast doubt on your allegiance to the Magram!

What are you waiting for? Go! Kill!

entries.name: Checking Things Out
entries.how:
We have all underestimated the power and presence of the Magram clan in this area, but this could prove an advantage.

With so many of their own distracted and their refusal to accept other clans' exiles, who is left to defend the village? What of their Khan?

I need you to go into the valley, deeper than you have gone before, and look around. If the Magram are as well fortified here as they seem, they may have left themselves vulnerable at their village...

entries.name: Going Home
entries.how:
You! I saw you outside fighting the outcasts. I know not where you come from, but I need your help.

I was lured here by my Gelkis brethren with an assurance of safety. I knew the war in the Desolace was escalating beyond our control, but I never imagined my own people turning to necromancy in a convoluted bid to defect to the Magram clan. When I spoke out against this, they threatened to kill me if I ever stepped hoof outside this tent!

Please help.

entries.name: Threat of Starvation
entries.how:
Since you seem overly eager to help our clan, I am sure you would be willing to fetch some supplies while you are over in the Outcast Hideaway.

Felling our foes should be enough motivation for a Magram, but I see no reason why we could not profit from the endeavor, too.

When we have the exiles dealt with, we can secure this place for the Magram and raise an army to bring the other clans to their knees!

entries.name: Return to Orgrul
entries.how:
You have done enough on the front lines. We can handle ourselves.

Tell Orgrul that you have served your purpose. The Magram Front is stronger now, and we have our sights set on the outcast encampment as our next settlement when another fleet of fighters joins the fray.

Well? Get going!

entries.name: Forlorn Gardens
entries.how:
As the garden's caretaker, it was my responsibility to ensure it thrived.

I knew there would come a day when I could no longer maintain it, so I enchanted a necklace gifted from my daughter to transform a new generation of saplings into treants, so they could watch over the garden in my stead. I placed it on an enchanted pedestal, sheltered within a small shrine.

The garden was in great hands. I must know what happened.

entries.name: What They've Done to My Peonies
entries.how:
Please spare the details of how the life may have been twisted there. My heart is broken enough with the loss of my necklace.

But while I weep, the plants suffer.

{name}, I would like you to go back to the garden and cull some of the angered flora. Please be swift and merciful; they can feel pain, and they have been hurt enough. If you intend to go hunting for my necklace as well, I would ask you to prioritize that before visiting the gardens again... in the unlikely chance you find it.

entries.name: Meeting the Magister
entries.how:
I suspect your curiosity is luring you toward the grand structure now, yes? Good!

The Shen'dralar there are unlikely to welcome you with open arms, but so long as you tread respectfully, I do not think you will run into any trouble.

With any luck, my old friend Kirandis might be easy to find. Of everyone, he is the most likely to be amicable to your presence.

entries.name: Phantasmal Problems
entries.how:
Being corporeal has its challenges, as you know, but being INcorporeal is a whole other situation. Will I fall through THIS chair? Will I trip over THAT cat? Worst of all, however, it makes everyday work impossible!

Do you see this sword on my anvil? I began work on this thousands of years ago, but met my demise before it was finished. Now it taunts me, AND takes up precious real estate! I cannot work with it! I cannot MOVE it!

I need you to help, uh, "ferry" it to the spirit realm. What do you say?

entries.name: Phantasmal Problems
entries.how:
Ah, you look to be a sensible individual. Likely more sense than the last oaf that passed by. I need a small favor of you.

You see, I had a problem. My greatest masterpiece of swordsmithing was left unfinished before my passing, and I needed someone to assist in bringing it into the spirit world so that I may finish it. The last person was gracious enough to help, and they succeeded!

Now I have a new problem. Through every fault of his own, the previous adventurer can no longer bring it back to me.

entries.name: Spectral Iron Ore
entries.how:
Finally, FINALLY I can use this anvil for something other than a monumentally heavy table. I am delighted to finally hone my craft again after centuries of missed practice.

Now, you are probably thinking, "Vindael, this sounds like you are setting the stage for another request." And you would be correct!

I need to replenish my supply of iron, but your iron has a similar predicament to my blade. Fortunately, the solution is MUCH simpler.

<He hands you a ghostly pickaxe, without a chance to refuse.>

entries.name: Partially Digested Collar
entries.how:
<You hold a grimy collar retrieved from the belly of a slain creature. The material is of a high-quality leather, clearly stitched with care.

A tag dangles from a corroded buckle. You swipe away the gunk and can see Thalassian text, though the letters are stylized beyond readability, perhaps even to those familiar with the language.

Now, you are presented with a choice. Do you disregard this and move on with your life, or do you attempt the impossible and seek to bring closure to its owner?>

entries.name: Corpsefeeder's Carapace
entries.how:
<With a terrible crunch, you removed a piece of the worm's carapace upon its demise.

Despite its enormous size and hefty weight, it is disappointingly ordinary. This creature was seemingly not the result of a cruel experiment nor carefully bred to be an all-devouring beast.

It is simply an impressive shell, likely desired only by collectors. Perhaps you could find one, though other than the centaur, who else might be alive around here?>

entries.name: Word of the Woods
entries.how:
Among the treants borne of the necklace, one in particular stood above all the others to have received the gift of life and sentience. I suspect if they have fallen, he may be the only one that remains.

He spent his days tending to each and every bloom and bud, and his evenings rooted in the ground to serve as a nest for the smaller critters.

If he is alive, and I pray that to be true, then he may know what happened.

I am holding out hope for my good friend, Woodwyrd.

entries.name: Passing the Blame
entries.how:
If you wish to recover the woman's gift, march north into the Valley of Bones.

It was stolen. The quilboar are to blame. I saw it. With my own two eyebulbs.

They are why this garden is doomed to die.

Do not forgive them.

entries.name: Not on Squealing Terms
entries.how:
Quolga the Wise is Kog'thug's life mate. Quolga great thornweaver, that why Kog'thug like her. Quolga also has necklace Big {race} seeks.

Problem? We not on squealing terms. She mad we stole necklace in first place. Then why use it? That what Kog'thug want know!

BUT! Quolga like flowers as much as thorns. Know where we can get flowers? Where we got necklace!

Maybe she not be mad at Kog'thug if Big {race} bring flowers and this blood for him? Maybe she trade necklace!

Tell her Kog'thug sorry.

entries.name: Forlorn Necklace
entries.how:
<The necklace you have been seeking is at last in your possession, but unfortunately the magic contained within has been entirely depleted. While not ideal for your current situation, at least it made its acquisition from the quilboar relatively easy.

It is probably best to bring this back to Mithera.>

entries.name: Tattered Journal
entries.how:
<Found near Shen'dralas, this dirty old tome no longer holds most of its knowledge.

Of the text that remains, individual letters are difficult to distinguish from words. It may prove challenging to read at first, but one of them appears to be a surname.

Perhaps its author, "Evenshade", may be found nearby.>

entries.name: Fragments of the Pylons
entries.how:
Although I am sure we can attribute the damage to both pylons to the reckless centaur stomping about, I suspect the timing of their rampage resulted in the shards being separated. I know little about their quarrels, but I do know there are at least two main factions that have trespassed into Shen'dralas: the ferocious Magram and the cunning Gelkis.

Keeping these treasures in the midst of a battlefield would be unwise. By now, I am assuming they have taken their trophies back to their own villages.

entries.name: Powering the Pylons
entries.how:
You may have seen the floating sparks of mana scattered throughout Shen'dralas. This is a new phenomenon, likely the result of the damage the pylons have endured.

We need this mana back in a semicrystallized form. We can accomplish this by using the Mana Sieve found within the temple. Borrow the sieve and collect any floating mana orbs you find.

The temple's denizens will not appreciate their precious artifact being borrowed without their consent, but they will understand in time.

entries.name: Tempered Expectations
entries.how:
Let me be the first to share that I was a master swordsman in life. I forged weapons by day and wielded them by night.

As you are quite well aware, my relationship with this particular blade is now extraordinarily complicated. Though I think I could swing it around, I'm not convinced it would be of much use unless I was fighting other spirits. Is that really of any value to me in Shen'dralas?

Nonetheless, I would like its capabilities tested and I think our forests could use a gentle culling.

entries.name: A Heart of Crystal
entries.how:
While I watched in horror as you frolicked through the haunted woods with my precious relic, your meddling did inspire an idea.

The unstable rifts you encountered are the precursors to our pylon guards. We have been unable to conjure more for centuries, and I worry what might happen when those that remain inevitably flicker out.

I know it seems counterintuitive, but see if you can find another pylon protector nearly on the verge of collapse and recover their Crystal Heart. I'll explain more after.

entries.name: Mana Mania
entries.how:
While sourcing the gems necessary to conjure the elementals is a challenge itself, the bigger concern is whether there is still enough loose mana in Shen'dralas to create them. With this heart, we can confirm once and for all whether we need to begin researching other means of defense.

For you, the task is simple. Simply toss this gem into one of those unstable rifts. If we're lucky, you'll have a fight on your hands. Don't feel compelled to hold back, if it works once, it will work again.

entries.name: Horrors in the Highland
entries.how:
These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.

The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.

Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.

entries.name: Lost in the Thicket Things
entries.how:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.

entries.name: Dragonmaw Rumors
entries.how:
The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Broken symbols carried only that much to me.

A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.

entries.name: Elder Knowledge
entries.how: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.

entries.name: Open the Maw
entries.how:
Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>

The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?

Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.

If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.

entries.name: Changing Tastes
entries.how:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?

entries.name: Seeking Caitlin
entries.how:
From time to time, I correspond with others in my craft--herbalists or eccentrics who study rare plants and local oddities. We trade discoveries, and sometimes warnings of what lies ahead.

One alchemist in the Wetlands wrote of an excavation team her husband was part of, uncovering signs of a long-lost primordial grass... but she never sent word of its abundance or accessibility.

If you can, check on Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

entries.name: Songblade Search
entries.how:
Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.

Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.

Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.

If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?

entries.name: Fallen in the Fen
entries.how:
<You cover the dwarf's body with his cloak.>

Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.

entries.name: Heartwoven
entries.how:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.

entries.name: Lost Relic Carry
entries.how:
You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'

Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.

entries.name: Highland Hides
entries.how:
The Highlands are host to ruins of some sort, secrets now being explored by an expedition team. What I know is that they've got their own wildlife and beasts lurking in that mountain marshland. How about you take a foray in there with some well-equipped friends, and we work a trade?

I don't care if they're hiding, I want their hides! Bring me the skins from four of the Thicket Raptors, I'll have a trade worked out for you to make it worth it.

entries.name: Earthen Echo
entries.how:
Truly, this is a fascinating object.

It shows indications of being much more than a mere carving or sculpture.

While our elders may be interested in observing this artifact, the Earthen Ring are who would carry the most wisdom for our buried ruins and forgotten lands. Seek out Muln Earthfury, a direct approach is fitting for the gravity of what you carry.

You can find him and other elders of the Earthen Ring council at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.

entries.name: Prehistoric Prism
entries.how:
With titan-like inscriptions like that on its facets, nothing less than Ironforge's Hall of Explorers is the right place to bring it.

I'd like to think that you'll be noted in the history for it in the catalogue -- "Recovered by {name}! Authenticated by Prospector Whelgar..." Ah, I'm gettin' meself carried away.

High Explorer Magellas will receive you, and given the exquisite nature of what you carry, will surely be most generously appreciative should you donate it to the museum.

Good find!

entries.name: Greaser Greetings
entries.how: Introduce yourself to the others here so they won't be surprised to see a stranger helping out with some of the labor. <PH>

entries.name: Eye of Mugg
entries.how:
Of the few that managed to infiltrate the cave, most have perished. It seems these Twilight have a foothold much larger than we thought. We will not stand by while these cultists continue to ravage these lands and make sacrifices of our allies. We end this now, {name}.

Infiltrate this stronghold, slaughter their forces and bring me proof of their leader's demise.

entries.name: Krol'dok No More!
entries.how:
Don't ask. You wouldn't believe me if I told you.

Let's just focus on getting me out of here! Oh, and you as well, of course.

entries.name: Tome of Twilight
entries.how:
With their location revealed, it is likely that within this stronghold are secrets kept well hidden from those we have encountered thus far. It would be wise for us to locate and recover any information that may be of use to our fight against these cultists.

See what you can uncover, {name}. I await your return.

entries.name: Krol'dok Moulding
entries.how: <The moulding appears to be for a key.>

entries.name: Key Ingredients
entries.how:
The moulding is crude and worn, but we may be able to fashion a key.

It may take some time to gather the components necessary. I'll keep these embers running hot while you gather the materials.

entries.name: A Token of Vengeance
entries.how:
Our work here is not finished, {name}. These cultists have inflicted unimaginable pain upon our allies and rendered these lands for their taking.

We will not tolerate these actions any longer.

To the north lies a hidden cave network, masked by the rugged terrain. Our scouts spoke of cultist movement under the veil of darkness.

Seek out this cave and find where these cultists are hiding. It's time we deliver a message they won't soon forget.

entries.name: Krol'dok Moulding
entries.how: <The moulding appears to be for a key.>

entries.name: Key Ingredients
entries.how:
The moulding is rather crude, but we may be able to fashion a key with the right materials.

I'll keep the embers running hot while you gather the necessary components.

entries.name: Eye of Mugg
entries.how:
Our scouts mentioned a network of caves to the northwest along the mountains, hidden by natural surroundings. Most who sought information from deep within have yet to return. I fear they may be lost.

Those watching from a distance mentioned a Twilight presence moving in and out of the caves, often in darkness.

Locate this stronghold. If it is what I think it is we must deliver a deathly blow to their leader. Only then may we continue our efforts to remove them from these lands.

entries.name: Twilight Mementos
entries.how:
The stories our scouts shared were quite horrid. I'll spare you the gruesome details. What we've discovered confirms previous reports of a cultist hideout.

To the north lies a cave, well hidden by its surroundings. This cave leads to... well, a place we've yet to infiltrate. We believe it's a foothold, nestled deep within the mountains.

It's time we repay the cultists for their actions against our allies.

Venture north, seek out our enemies, and return to me with proof of their demise.

entries.name: Tome of Twilight
entries.how:
No matter our efforts, the Twilight forces persist. We've deduced they must be coming from somewhere else.

With the new pet you brought me, I was able to politely ask our dear Twilight Thrall if it knew anything about where its former masters were coming from. Of note was mention of shadow magics and an ogre by the name of Nar'gurk in a hidden stronghold north of Sunnyglade.

Seek him out. Kill him and recover what you can. There must be something we can learn from these efforts.

entries.name: Lingering Essence
entries.how:
We mustn't linger. Take these to the keep at once.

Find Ashe Amberhall. She may be a pain, but she's well respected in her field of study. Perhaps she can shed some light on what energies are contained within these objects.

entries.name: Curios of Curiosity
entries.how:
Quite simple to dispel, really. Remnants of something, that's for sure. What, exactly, I do not know.

Well, I'm afraid I've done all that I can. I'm sorry if you were expecting more from me, but... on second thought, the craftsmanship of these is quite unique. Perhaps they could be of some use.

Take these to Melanie Sable. Tell her I sent you. Let her know they're safe.

She may have some use for them just yet.

entries.name: Krol'dok No More!
entries.how: NYI

entries.name: Vengeance of the Highborne
entries.how:
In the region known as the Riverglades to the southeast, there is a place called the Krol'dok Stronghold. A highborne known as Zalfan Moonshadow has been seen there in the company of the Twilight's Hammer.

I'd pay handsomely if you'd rid the world of this cretin for me. He brings shame to the proud lineage of the highborne by consorting with fanatics and using stolen arcane knowledge in their service. There are few enough of us left without worms like him sullying our good name.

entries.name: A Rest Without Pain
entries.how:
I would ask one last favor while I have you here, friend. Could you deliver the poultice I have made to two of my companions here in camp?

Enho is in our infirmary to the left. He is very weak but I yet hope he will be able to overcome the infection. I have been spoon-feeding him broth to try to help him regain his strength.

The other is Maruke.

<Ortak hangs his head in silence for a moment.>

You will find her north of here, where we keep the few mounts we have left.

entries.name: Ewe Wandered Off
entries.how:
<Mirt's eyes grow wide as you approach.>

Whoa, who are you? My mom said there was a new person here. She said you killed a lot of Scourge and are super strong! Have you ever fought a bear? *gasp* A DRAGON!? I--

<Mirt looks behind himself, then looks bashful.>

Maybe... you could help me? I was supposed to be watching the sheep but they got out when I was making mud dragons. They are over on THAT side. I'm not allowed to go over there. Mom says they might hurt me. Could you go find the sheep?

entries.name: Unsullied Owl Statuette
entries.how:
<You discovered an intriguing owl figurine while exploring the Barrow Deeps. It is carved out of an unusual and durable stone, with two sapphires socketed into its eyes. A small hum of magic accompanies a subtle, dying glow from the two gemstones.

The Watchers standing vigil outside of the tunnels would likely be interested in this discovery.>

entries.name: The Darkened Glaive
entries.how:
Return to the depths of the Barrow Deeps. Hunt the demon responsible for the corruption of Quel'Shalla. You must not recoil from the demon's strength, but rather meet it head on. Lean into it and allow the glaive to drink in its power... its very essence.

The blade hungers for this and it will let you know when the time is right. Once Quel'Shalla's thirst is slaked, bring its power to bear to unmake the demon forever.

entries.name: Old Ironforge Incursion
entries.how:
Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults. 

My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard. 

Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!

entries.name: The Restless Dead
entries.how:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!

entries.name: An Ancient Grudge
entries.how:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...

entries.name: Important Heirlooms
entries.how:
You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.

I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.

entries.name: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Ogre's Strength

entries.name: Digestible Research
entries.how:
<This journal seems to have been torn to shreds. From what little you can make out, it looks as if this was a field journal of one of the unfortunate Explorers' League adventurers.

Chew marks on the outside of the journal suggest it was likely raptors.

Perhaps its pages can be found and reassembled.>

entries.name: Panic at the Digsite
entries.how:
Ye there! Aye, I'm talkin' ta ye! We've made the discovery of a lifetime down in Un'Goro! Can ye believe it?

There's just one problem... our dig site's been overrun by voracious beasts of the killin' nature. Very unpleasant indeed.

With yer help, we can reclaim our camp and git back ta workin'. Now, what do ye say? I'll make it worth yer while.

entries.name: Mapping the Way Forward
entries.how:
{class}, we've made the discovery of a lifetime! I can't believe it; the ruins in Un'Goro are open!

We've already sent a team but they have encountered... trouble. If you're headed in there anyway would ya be able to finish this map?

It sounds like there's an Achromatic Crystal in there and an unearthed watcher somewhere near a giant Western Gate that sounds interesting.

The other landmarks that would be helpful are the Pillar of Assimilation, the Western Gate and the Regrowth Vestibule.

entries.name: The Dark Crystal
entries.how:
You there! I have a job for someone of your... skills.

I have gotten word from my sources of a crystal found in Shaper's Terrace that can seemingly drain the elements around it. Or perhaps it can drain life essence itself. It is unclear from this report.

I must have a fragment of this crystal! Just think of the applications of such a powerful artifact.

Go to Shaper's Terrace and bring me back a sample of this colorless Achromatic Crystal, and I will reward you for your efforts.

entries.name: Crystalline Elements
entries.how:
Ah, it is good you have come here, {class}.

I have been studying crystals of late and word has reached me about a peculiar set of crystals said to be from Un'Goro Crater. I have samples of the most basic ones, but I have heard tell of larger more potent crystals seen in a place called Shaper's Terrace.

I do not know much of this place aside from it containing these crystals that supposedly have the very elements within them. If you find yourself there, please bring me a sample of each color.

entries.name: Essence of Seeping Slimes
entries.how:
If you're headed into Shaper's Terrace, I would ask a favor of you.

There are reports of slimes that live in the pools by the colorless Achromatic Crystal. I believe their essence could be of use in my experiments, and would like you to bring me some samples for study.

I will make it worth your while.

entries.name: Shrouded in Nightmare
entries.how:
Corruption seeps from this object.

There may be a link between this object and the dragons coming forth from the Dream. You must find someone that can decipher the meaning of this item. Perhaps the druids of the Moonglade or Cenarion Hold could assist you further.

entries.name: Waking Legends
entries.how: The waters of Lake Elune'ara should dissolve the nightmares engulfing this object. Give me a moment to perform the cleansing, {name}.

entries.name: Stinking Up Southshore
entries.how:
Celebrate Hallow's End in style... by bringing grief to our enemies in Southshore!

Take one of these specially crafted stink bombs.  It is filled with an odiferous funk that no human - or any weak-willed beast for that matter - can stand to smell.  You'll need to throw it right in the heart of Southshore for it to do its job, so be prepared for a fight against the Alliance!

When you've completed this task... this tribute to our liberation, return to me!

entries.name: Crashing the Wickerman Festival
entries.how:
I need brave individuals to head up to Tirisfal Glade and check out the Wickerman Festival.  I'm not going to lie - heading up there will be dangerous.  The guards at the festival will be exceptionally vicious.  Still, we need to know how big the festival is this year, and how much trouble the Forsaken are going to cause us during Hallow's End.

If you're up for it, head to Tirisfal and scout out the festival.  Return to me with the information, and I'll make sure you're well compensated.

entries.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
entries.how:
Have a wondrous Winter Veil, friend!  Be sure to say hello to Greatfather Winter!  If you've been nice this year, you'll receive wondrous treats on the day of the Feast of Winter Veil.  Be sure to tell him what you hope to get this year!

Also, be sure to stock up on treats to give those who've been nice this year.  We have a great selection to choose from.  Fresh from our farm to your plate - it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness!

entries.name: Treats for Great-father Winter
entries.how:
Hey, can you do Greatfather Winter a favor, um, little boy?

Not to needlessly talk about myself in the third person, but Greatfather Winter has been at this all day and he could use a treat himself.  Some gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk to wash them down with would really hit the spot.  Think you could be a friend to the Greatfather and fetch some for me?

entries.name: Stolen Winter Veil Treats
entries.how:
Listen... not to shatter the magic of the season here, but Smokywood Pastures could use some assistance - the kind you adventuring types are known to give.

We're missing an important shipment of treats that was restocking us for the season, and now we're missing the agent of Smokywood Pastures that we sent out to the field to find it!  Please - the shipment was last reported in the Alterac Mountains, and that's where our man went to look for it.

See if both are out there, safe and sound!

entries.name: The Reason for the Season
entries.how:
Gifts, treats, presents... bah, I say!

Those goblins pollute the true meaning of this season - the Feast of Winter Veil.  This is a time of renewal; the land slumbers under a blanket of snow brought forth by Greatfather Winter, who is NOT the bumbling fool over there in the red suit!

If you're interested in learning what the Feast is all about for yourself, ask Sagorne Creststrider.  I'm sure he'll be surprised that someone cares about history rather than getting presents.

entries.name: You're a Mean One...
entries.how:
A c-c-creature called "The Abominable Greench" is the one w-w-who stole our shipment of t-t-treats, {name}.  Be c-c-careful though!  He is t-t-the one who turned me into this s-s-snowy mess!

You're g-g-gonna need some help in f-f-facing him.  I've seen him w-w-wander all around where the y-y-yeti are; he's s-s-surely here s-s-somewhere!  F-f-find the treats {name}, take them b-b-back to Smokywood Pastures in Orgrimmar, and t-t-tell them I n-n-need to be unfrozen!

entries.name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
entries.how:
We at Smokywood Pastures appreciate the recovery of the stolen treats, {name}.  For that, we'd like to offer you a special gift... presented by none other than Great-father Winter himself!

Please, speak with Great-father Winter, and he will give you your Feast of Winter Veil gift from us here at Smokywood Pastures.  From our farm to your plate, it's always Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness... thanks to you, of course!

entries.name: The Feast of Winter Veil
entries.how:
Here - if you are interested in learning more about the Feast of Winter Veil, read this book.  While I think our recognition of the legend is the appropriate one, I'm enough of a student of legends to appreciate the collection of all information into a single source.

When you're done, take the book to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.  I know for a fact he'd be interested in hearing that others have taken an interest in the lore of our people.

entries.name: Honoring a Hero
entries.how:
During the Harvest Festival of Azeroth, we give thanks to heroes for the sacrifices - in some cases ultimate sacrifices - they have given on our behalf.  The Alliance acknowledges many heroes, but none weave a more tragic tale than that of Uther Lightbringer.

Help us honor Uther by taking this offering to his tomb in the Western Plaguelands.  Place it at his statue, and then return to me.  I'll only be here through the end of the festival, so waste no time in giving Uther his tribute.

entries.name: Honoring a Hero
entries.how:
During the Harvest Festival of Azeroth, we give thanks to heroes for the sacrifices - in some cases ultimate sacrifices - they have given on our behalf.  The Horde acknowledges many heroes, but none exemplify strength and sacrifice more than Grom Hellscream.

Help us honor Grom by taking this offering to his monument in the Demon Fall Canyon of Ashenvale.  Place it at the base, and then return to me.  I'll only be here through the end of the festival, so waste no time in giving Grom his tribute.

entries.name: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!
entries.how:
I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick.  If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have!  I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

Each of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for!  Also, a little gnome named Talvash in Ironforge is handing out candy as well.  When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!

entries.name: Hallow's End Treats for Spoops!
entries.how:
I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick.  If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have!  I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

Each of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for!  Also, a troll named Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village is handing out candy as well.  When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!

entries.name: Rotten Eggs
entries.how:
The humans of Southshore love their ale, and as such they prize the ale served at the Southshore Inn.  With the chaos of Hallow's End now upon them, we can use it to ruin their latest batch of beverages for weeks - if not months to come!

Take these rotten eggs and place them in the main brew keg inside the Southshore Inn.  Your presence alone will cause strife, so be prepared to defend yourself!

Once you've given Southshore a taste they'll not soon forget, return to me here at the festival!

entries.name: Chicken Clucking for a Mint
entries.how:
Ah, trick-or-treating for a sick child, are we?  I was going to say, you're a little old to be rummaging about for candies...

Well, for my treat - an Ironforge Mint - you will need to... cluck like a chicken!  Yes, chickens love mints... well OK, maybe they don't LOVE them... but I won't give you a mint unless you chicken cluck for me!

Well {class}, are you up to the challenge or not?!  Time to earn your treat!

Well {class}, are you up to the challenge or not?!  Time to earn your treat!

entries.name: Incoming Gumdrop
entries.how:
A trick-or-treater!  Huzzah!

Well now, even though you're doing something noble and collecting candies for a sick child, I can't let you off the hook that easily.  I have a yummy Gnomeregan Gumdrop to give to the sick child... if you make a train noise for me!  Haha, yes, that'll be the trick!  The price of this gumdrop is one train noise!

Chugga-chugga, {class}!

entries.name: Flexing for Nougat
entries.how:
That's an... interesting costume you have on.  Even though you're being nice and helping a sick child trick-or-treat this year, I'm afraid I'm going to have to ask you perform a trick for me!

Let's see... you look so strong and buff in that... costume... let's see you flex!  Yes, go on now and flex for me, strong man!

When and only when you flex, I'll give you some tasty Stormwind Nougat.  It's a great Hallow's End treat.

entries.name: Dancing for Marzipan
entries.how:
Even though you're trick-or-treating for a sick child, you still need to perform a trick for the treat!  We can't very well change the tradition, now can we...

I believe the cost of a piece of marzipan nowadays is to bust out and DANCE!  That's right, let me see your moves!  Dance for me, and I'll give you some tasty marzipan!

entries.name: The Power of Pine
entries.how:
The thing I hate the most about Hallow's End are the stink bombs the Forsaken use on Southshore.  Who knew that celebrating liberation would have to involve such a smelly mess?

During Hallow's End, use this cleaner to remove any nasty stink bombs the Horde may drop here in the village.  It uses the power of pine to fight funky smells.

Do your part to keep Southshore clean, and I'll give you some Hallow's End treats I'm sure you'll enjoy.  We have a deal?

entries.name: Ruined Kegs
entries.how:
The rotten eggs have been successfully placed inside the keg.  Future batches of ale from the Southshore Inn are sure to be ruined!

You should now report back to Darkcaller Yanka at the Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade and report your success.

entries.name: Metzen the Reindeer
entries.how:
DISASTER has struck!  Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!

Metzen is one of Great-father Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures.  We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen.  With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here!  Please - find Metzen and return him to us!

Check out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!

Please, hurry!

entries.name: The Hero of the Day
entries.how:
Listen... I'm not really supposed to be telling you this, but since you're the hero of the day and all...

There's fresh holly everywhere this time of the year, but it never lasts.  We've got a machine that preserves holly - it never goes bad!  We use it to spice up the holiday... and profits during the summer!

I'll let you use the preserver, but only if you're a master cook.  You'll need some deeprock salt and two, three, oh let's say five gold.  It'll net you a nice batch that's yours to keep.

entries.how:
I hear Greatfather Winter - with the generous support of Smokeywood Pastures - has put presents for everyone under the tree in Ironforge. I wish I could go, but I've got to look after the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt.

But you should definitely check it out. I'm sure Greatfather Winter has some presents with your name on them.

entries.name: New Year Celebrations!
entries.how:
Stormwind is holding a celebration for the new year!  All day long today you can get free booze, and at night they'll put on a firework show!  It should be pretty nice... but Booty Bay is also having a party today; I bet it'll be even better!

Well anyway, Innkeeper Allison in Stormwind needs a supply of Smoky Wood Pasture fare to help feed all the party goers.  Can you do me a favor and deliver it!

Thanks, {name}!  Innkeeper Allison is in the Gilded Rose, in the Trade District of Stormwind.

entries.name: New Year Celebrations!
entries.how:
Thunder Bluff is holding a celebration for the new year!  All day you'll find free booze there, and at night they'll put on a firework show!

It should be pretty nice... but Booty Bay is also having a party today; I bet it'll be even better!

Well anyway, Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff needs a supply of Smoky Wood Pasture fare to help feed all the party goers.  Can you do me a favor and deliver it!

Thanks, {name}!  Innkeeper Pala is in the inn near the bridge to Hunter's Rise.

entries.name: Elune's Blessing
entries.how:
The beast Omen was once a hero of this world.  A wolf of great strength and fortune, Omen fought beside the heroes of the War of the Ancients until he succumbed to demonic magics.  Turning against his allies, he raged across Azeroth and carried death and terror in his wake.

Finally defeated here, in Moonglade, Omen now sleeps among the silt of Lake Elune'ara.  But each new year, during the festival, he stirs...

Gather cohorts, {name}, and summon and defeat the beast Omen.  Earn the blessing of Elune!

entries.name: Dearest Colara,
entries.how:
I've got to keep watch here at the gate, but I'm always worrying about my sweetheart, Colara. I only get to see her for a few hours, if I'm lucky, and well, just look at me. I've got a minor officer's pay and I could be called to the front any day now.

Would she just forget about me? There are a lot of men in the city. A lot of rich ones.

Anyways, I've scribbled some things down... nothing much, but if you could take it to her for me, that'd be great.

entries.name: Dearest Colara,
entries.how:
I met a lass in Stormwind when I was last there on the bank's business. She stole my heart away. Now, I can't stop thinking about her! I'd like to send her this message - I've rewritten it twelve times!

The mail is so full now, and I want to make sure it gets there.

If you're heading that way, could you help me?

entries.name: Dearest Colara,
entries.how:
How to describe her beauty? Thousands of years of words and I am at a loss.

These mortals confound the mind and leave us babbling fools.

I've stared at these words too long. No more eloquent meaning can I squeeze from them. No, she must have it now, or some other suitor will surely steal her eye.

entries.name: Dearest Elenia,
entries.how:
She was so sad. I could see that, once I saw past her state. I mean, she seemed sad - wouldn't you?

But after talking to her, there was a connection. I didn't think anyone could understand what I was thinking, but she could.

When I told the others, they laughed at me, so I never spoke with her again. But I miss her. Can you take this letter to her for me? I want to be sure it finds her hands.

entries.name: Dearest Elenia,
entries.how:
Have you ever known love, young one? It was a thing foreign to me until lately, when I met a girl from the Undercity, Elenia. It is rare enough for one of my kind to look outside our own, let alone one of the Forsaken.

But now thoughts of her occupy my mind both days and nights.

If you can, could you take this letter to her? I want her to come here to Mulgore. I hope that she will say yes.

entries.name: Dearest Elenia,
entries.how:
A lifetime ago, I was betrothed to marry Elenia, my childhood sweetheart. It's been years since I thought about her last, but of late, she frequently occupies my thoughts.

Perhaps, even with everything that has passed, there can be some room in each other's lives for our love.

I'm sure she has changed, also. Can you deliver this letter to her for me? I am too nervous to give it in person.

entries.name: Dangerous Love
entries.how:
There's something unnatural about this epidemic of love. It's not proper, it's an eyesore, and at worst, it could be a threat to the the safety of the Alliance itself.

Just think: what if the guards have been taken in by this strange affliction? Something must be done.

Go to one of the guards here in Stormwind and see if they've been caught up in this foolishness.

entries.name: Dangerous Love
entries.how:
There's something unnatural about this epidemic of love. It's disgusting, and as it lowers our defenses, it could be a threat to the all of us.

It's bad enough that so many of our people are caught up in this ridiculous behavior. But I think that it has spread even to our guardians, who should be immune to such things.

Find one of our guardians and see if they've been caught up in this foolishness.

entries.name: Fenstad's Hunch
entries.how:
I believe I know the cause of this recent behavior. Have you smelled the new fragrance on the wind, over the stink of the canals? The new colognes and perfumes that have come into fashion?

Our thinking has been clouded by some foul alchemy.

There is only one way to be sure - bring a bottle of cologne and perfume to my friend, Apothecary Zinge. The Royal Apothecary Society will find the truth.

 I will reimburse you for their purchase when you return.

entries.name: Zinge's Assessment
entries.how:
This is unexpected. It looks like Fenstad might be on to something after all. I found traces of substances used in mind control potions.

It isn't unheard of for perfumes to have some of this, but a few of the ingredients I detected... This is serious alchemy, along the abilities of a member of the Royal Apothecary Society.

entries.name: Gift Giving
entries.how: Have you come to deliver a present of love and adoration to your favorite leader?

entries.name: Tracing the Source
entries.how: We must find who the supplier is. I noticed Apothecary Katrina with a bottle of the perfume tucked in her pack. She told me that she purchased it from Norman, the innkeeper.

entries.name: Tracing the Source
entries.how:
Something's wrong with my product? Well, I've never seen so many people wanting something so badly.

I bought my supply from a merchant named Mara Rennick. She's new in town.

She mentioned she had some goods she had to deliver to the tailor in the Mage Quarter.

entries.name: The Source Revealed
entries.how:
Look, the actions of a rogue apothecary are not my concern. If he's undermining our efforts, then let me be the first to point you in the right direction

If he's innocent, then he's got nothing to hide, right?

I purchased the goods from Apothecary Staffron Lerent. He's working in a secluded area past Ravenholdt Manor in the hills over Hillsbrad. To be honest with you, I thought he was a little odd.

entries.name: Gift Giving
entries.how: Have you come to deliver a present of love and adoration to your favorite leader?

entries.name: Aristan's Hunch
entries.how:
I've got it! Have you smelled the new fragrance on the wind? The new colognes and perfumes that have come into fashion? Our guards wouldn't neglect their duties so easily.

That is, unless their thinking has been clouded by some foul alchemy.

There is only one way to be sure - bring a bottle of cologne and perfume to Morgan Pestle, and tell him my suspicions. I will reimburse you for their purchase when you return.

entries.name: Morgan's Discovery
entries.how:
Well, I'll be. It looks like Aristan might be on to something after all. I found traces of substances used in love potions and insidious mind-altering draughts.

It isn't unheard of for perfumes to have some of them, but a few of the ingredients I detected... Smells funny.

entries.name: Tracing the Source
entries.how: We've got to find the source. I've seen a lot more people than usual - guards included - going in and out of The Gilded Rose. Talk to Allison. If she's selling them, she can tell you where they came from.

entries.name: Tracing the Source
entries.how:
Something funny about the cologne? It's possible. I've never seen so many people after one product like this.

Look, if there's something wrong with it, I want to know, too. I bought my supply from a merchant named Evert Sorisam. He's new in town.

He mentioned he had some goods he was going to deliver to The Finest Thread.

entries.name: The Source Revealed
entries.how:
What? Treason? No, no. I assure you, my intentions are completely harmless.

Is it so wrong to help those who wish to ease the painful ritual of courtship? Come, that is no crime.

And to prove that I mean no harm, I will even tell you my source.

They were shipped to me by a Staffron Lerent, an apothecary of some sort. I never spoke with him.

Our goblin middle man said that he worked in the foothills over Hillsbrad past that mysterious Ravenholdt Manor. I wish you luck in finding him.

entries.name: Stolen Winter Veil Treats
entries.how:
Listen... not to shatter the magic of the season here, but Smokywood Pastures could use some assistance - the kind you adventuring types are known to give.

We're missing an important shipment of treats that was restocking us for the season, and now we're missing the agent of Smokywood Pastures that we sent out to the field to find it!  Please - the shipment was last reported in the Alterac Mountains, and that's where our man went to look for it.

See if both are out there, safe and sound!

entries.name: You're a Mean One...
entries.how:
A c-c-creature called "The Abominable Greench" is the one w-w-who stole our shipment of t-t-treats, {name}.  Be c-c-careful though!  He is t-t-the one who turned me into this s-s-snowy mess!

You're g-g-gonna need some help in f-f-facing him.  I've seen him w-w-wander all around where the y-y-yeti are; he's s-s-surely here s-s-somewhere!  F-f-find the treats {name}, take them b-b-back to Smokywood Pastures in Ironforge, and t-t-tell them I n-n-need to be unfrozen!

You're g-g-gonna need some help in f-f-facing him.  I've seen him w-w-wander all around where the y-y-yeti are; he's s-s-surely here s-s-somewhere!  F-f-find the treats {name}, take them b-b-back to Smokywood Pastures in Orgrimmar, and t-t-tell them I n-n-need to be unfrozen!

entries.name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
entries.how:
We at Smokywood Pastures appreciate the recovery of the stolen treats, {name}.  For that, we'd like to offer you a special gift... presented by none other than Greatfather Winter himself!

Please, speak with Greatfather Winter, and he will give you your Feast of Winter Veil gift from us here at Smokywood Pastures.  From our farm to your plate, it's always Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness... thanks to you, of course!

entries.name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
entries.how:
We at Smokywood Pastures appreciate the recovery of the stolen treats, {name}.  For that, we'd like to offer you a special gift... presented by none other than Great-father Winter himself!

Please, speak with Great-father Winter, and he will give you your Feast of Winter Veil gift from us here at Smokywood Pastures.  From our farm to your plate, it's always Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness... thanks to you, of course!

entries.name: Metzen the Reindeer
entries.how:
DISASTER has struck!  Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!

Metzen is one of Greatfather Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures.  We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen.  With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here!  Please - find Metzen and return him to us!

Check out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!

Please, hurry!

entries.name: Metzen the Reindeer
entries.how:

Metzen is one of Great-father Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures.  We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen.  With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here!  Please - find Metzen and return him to us!

Check out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!

Please, hurry!

entries.name: The Hero of the Day
entries.how:
Listen... I'm not really supposed to be telling you this, but since you're the hero of the day and all...

There's fresh holly everywhere this time of the year, but it never lasts.  We've got a machine that preserves holly - it never goes bad!  We use it to spice up the holiday... and profits during the summer!

I'll let you use the preserver, but only if you're a master cook.  You'll need some deeprock salt and two, three, oh let's say five gold.  It'll net you a nice batch that's yours to keep.

entries.name: The Hero of the Day
entries.how:

There's fresh holly everywhere this time of the year, but it never lasts.  We've got a machine that preserves holly - it never goes bad!  We use it to spice up the holiday... and profits during the summer!
