To this end, I have hidden a cache among the cliffs behind me. You can see it if you stand by the fire in the center of the village. Reaching it will be no easy feat. Within the cache is a rune of great power.

Your test is to find this rune, and return when you have learned its secrets.

entries.name: The Lost Rune
entries.how:
The warriors of the Alliance have much to teach you, but you must also seek out new techniques on your own.

Another young warrior recently ventured into the Echo Ridge Mine. She was experimenting with engraving mystical runes onto her equipment to improve her combat prowess.

I suspect she was overwhelmed when the kobolds captured the mine. Find the rune among the kobolds and learn this technique yourself.

entries.name: Into the Brambles
entries.how:
The warriors of the Horde have much to teach you, {name}, but you must also seek out new techniques on your own.

As you may know, there is a group of hostile quilboars to the east. Another fledgling warrior ventured into their territory some time ago, and never returned. He was experimenting with engraving mystical runes onto his equipment to improve his combat prowess.

Find the rune among the quilboar and learn this technique yourself. Return to me when you have done so.

entries.name: The Lost Rune
entries.how:
The warriors of the Alliance have much to teach you, {name}, but you must also seek out new techniques on your own.

There is a cave full of Frostmane trolls south of here. Another fledgling warrior ventured inside some time ago, but never returned. He was experimenting with engraving mystical runes onto his equipment to improve his combat prowess.

Find the rune among the trolls, one of them is likely carrying it, and learn this technique yourself. Return to me when you have done so.

entries.name: The Lost Rune
entries.how:
The warriors of the Alliance have much to teach you, {name}, but you must also seek out new techniques on your own.

There is a cave full of Frostmane trolls south of here. Another fledgling warrior ventured inside some time ago, but never returned. He was experimenting with engraving mystical runes onto his equipment to improve his combat prowess.

Find the rune among the trolls, one of them is likely carrying it, and learn this technique yourself. Return to me when you have done so.

entries.name: The Lost Rune
entries.how:
The Dark Lady's warriors have much to teach you, but you must also seek out new techniques on your own.

Another warrior recently ventured north into Night Web's Hollow. He was experimenting with engraving mystical runes onto his equipment to improve his combat prowess.

I suspect he was overwhelmed by the spiders infesting the mine. Find the rune among their webs and learn this technique yourself.

entries.name: The Old Champ
entries.how:
This arena may not look like much, but I'll tell ya, this place used to be quite the attraction. Prize fighters, adventurers, even a few cartel folks, would all step into the ring for a chance at coin and glory. 

Between the gambling and concessions, I was making a killing!

Things started to die down after the old champ, Kajind, retired, though. He was a real serious type -- left for Azshara one day without a word. If you found him, we could get the arena back up and running again.

entries.name: Defanged
entries.how:
Battle is all I know, {name}. During the third war, countless fell before my blade. When the war ended, I made my way as a prize fighter. That is when I came upon the arena of Gadgetzan.

My days there were glorious, but I soon tired of being champion. I came to Azshara in search of a greater challenge; a blue drake who roams south-east of here. Alas, the creature got the better of me. I escaped alive, but my blade was taken for its hoard.

If you recover my blade, I will return with you to Gadgetzan.

entries.name: Return to the Arena
entries.how:
I am an orc of my word. You have avenged me, and I will return your favor in kind. Go to Gadgetzan and tell Fizbuz he has his champion back. 

I hope to see you in the ring.

entries.name: Fight Night
entries.how:
Everything's set for the grand re-opening of the Gadgetzan Arena!

The rules are simple: you'll have three fights, ending with the champ. You'll get a short break between fights, but you can't leave the arena at any point. If you do, you forfeit.

When you're ready, the fight's on!

entries.name: Voodoo Feathers
entries.how:
Your honor has brought some peace to me.  It is only right that I offer you something in return.

My weapons and armor were splendid in life, and yet they are of no use to me now.  They would be better served in your possession.

Travel to the sunken temple and destroy the troll guardians Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro.  They carry magic feathers that can reform my physical body long enough to grant you a reward.

entries.name: Legacy of Valor
entries.how: The spectral champion yields and motions toward the altar.

entries.name: Infinite Midnight
entries.how: The towering titan envelops you in an aether aurora, wisdom and experiences of the ages joining your memories.

entries.name: The Golden Disk
entries.how: You have no idea what this item could be, but it's clearly an artifact of substantial power. You should find someone who can tell you more about this artifact and its true purpose.

entries.name: Scale of the Dragon Lord
entries.how:
<Riosus listens as you recount your tale>

Yes, Garek had the right of it, this is not the true Dragon Soul... and thank the titans for that. I'd feel no more comfortable with a dimwitted mortal like yourself wielding an artifact that powerful than I would the Lord of Blackrock himself. Regardless, this is still dangerous and we should see to its disposal. The original Dragon Soul was not easy to destroy. Come, let us speak of options for the disposal of this lesser simulacrum.

entries.name: Grim Batol
entries.how:
Nefarian has long been engaged in experimentation involving the five dragonflights, and it seems this "simulacrum" of the Dragon Soul was one such experiment. I shudder to think of what could come of him successfully emulating even a fraction of the power of the true Dragon Soul. Please, seek out agents of the red dragons near the ruins of Grim Batol. 

I will enchant the simulacrum you carry to mark you as a friend of the red flight.

entries.name: No Good Deed Goes Unpunished
entries.how: With that, I fear that you've outlived your usefulness. Don't worry though, I'd not dream of letting your service go unrewarded, so I'm going to bestow the honor of being devoured by me in my true form. It's really quite the honor, {class}.

entries.name: A Just Reward
entries.how: You've done much to defend our brood, {class}. It seems fitting that we repay you with a gift that you may use to continue to defend others. Speak with me when you are ready and we'll destroy this false Dragon Soul together. I believe that I can harness some of the energy released as the simulacrum's magic dissipates along with a bit of my own magic to create something special for you.

entries.name: A Scribbled Letter
entries.how: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, {name}. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local hunter trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

entries.name: The Warrior's Path
entries.how:
While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.

entries.name: The Skybreaker Bulwark
entries.how:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Along the coast of Silverpine, west of the Sepulcher, you will find a shrine that has become tainted by the plague. The spirits there no longer speak to our people and it will be up to you to defeat the manifestation and cleanse the pool.

Take the elemental's bracers, along with the remaining drops of Brine's potion, and place them on the brazier. The ritual should be enough to summon a pure spirit for you to communicate with.

Bring me proof the task is done, and I will reward you with your totem.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Take shard. Take shard and give life.

Give life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.

You protect and give life with water's power.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how: Light explodes as you finish the incantation. The sounds of the water drops hitting the flame have died down and your senses are overcome as the corrupt spirits around you are destroyed.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Islen will have one more task for you before rewarding you with your next totem. The vial of water I've given you is necessary for whatever that task is.

Go now and find her. We shall meet again some day.

entries.name: Water Sapta
entries.how: I'm sorry to see you need another Sapta, but you've earned it.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Greetin's, brotha! Have you too come to purify the waters here and prove your understandin' to Islen?

I've just defeated the corrupt water spirit meself, and I'm just 'bout to put da bracers and remaining drops o' water on the brazier.

What's dat? Ahhh. Tiev understan' all too well when somethin' goes wrong. Well, Tiev can help you plenty if you be needin' to see the pure water spirit again.

Bring me a water sapta from Islen as proof that you be ready, an' I'll wait to turn in me parts.

entries.name: Earth Sapta
entries.how: You return to me without a sapta, nor your totem of earth. Unfortunate.

entries.name: Earth Sapta
entries.how: So, you be needin' another sapta for your quest,{name}?

entries.name: Fire Sapta
entries.how: If you have lost in battle to the manifestation, then speak to me and I shall give you another sapta in which to see the spirits at the shrine above.

entries.name: Call of Earth
entries.how:
The time is now, young {class}. You've grown strong and your spirit endures like the earth. Following the shaman's path shows you have wisdom before even proving yourself.

The element of earth will guide your destiny, becoming part of you if you are ready. But you must stand before the earth itself. If you are ready, then you will see things only shaman know of.

Seek out the Felstalkers to the north, and take from them two of their hooves. Return to me then, and we shall speak more of your future.

entries.name: Call of Earth
entries.how:
A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.

The sapta is always drunk in a holy place, and never anywhere else--remember that.

Seek out Spirit Rock southwest of here--it is found at the end of the Hidden Path. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you shall see.

entries.name: Call of Earth
entries.how:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Canaga Earthcaller as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this pebble will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.

Be patient, {name}. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.

entries.name: Call of Earth
entries.how:
The time has come, young {class}. Your body ages and grows strong, and your spirit endures like the earth. I see it within you-you have wisdom already.

The earth guides our people, and it speaks to us, as it will to you in time. But you must be tested. If you are ready, then you shall see things only our kind know of.

Seek out the Bristleback shamans in their ravine to the east, and take from them a salve they use in their rituals. Return to me only when you have enough for your own potion.

entries.name: Call of Earth
entries.how:
A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the open minded to see the elements as no one has seen them before. Your spirit will forever be tied to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few of our kind know the secrets of its creation.

The sapta is always imbibed in a holy place, and never anywhere else.

Seek out the shaman shrine to the east of here and drink of the sapta.

entries.name: Call of Earth
entries.how:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Seer Ravenfeather as proof of our meeting. She will craft a totem for you, and this pebble will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast mountains.

Be patient, {name}. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
Fire be witcha, mon. I see you be strong in da ways of earth already, an' me tinkin' you be ready to talk to Kranal.

Kranal live north of da Crossroads in da Barrens. He be strong in da ways of da elements and can teach ya da ways of fire... if you tink you be ready.

He be easy ta find, just don' go too far--ya go too far an' ya find yerself in da elves' lands.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
Long has it been since you were last tested, {name}. You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about destruction... and chaos. The element of fire is yours for the understanding, if you're prepared to pay for it.

Seek out Kranal Fiss in the Barrens. He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the night elf lands, you've gone too far.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
You are powerful enough to wield the totem of fire, but that does not mean you are ready.

Along the Southfury River in Durotar, before the Great Sea, lies a hidden trail to one of the highest peaks in the land. Find your way to the top and you shall find one of our holy shrines watched over by Telf Joolam--the Shrine of the Dormant Flame.

Take this torch to him--it marks that you attempt to tame fire. Return it to me aflame by the brazier at the shrine and I will see you are given the totem of fire.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
But you did not come here for a history lesson, did you? You came for the Eternal Flame and fire totem.

The first step is to create a sapta and bind you to the flame.

I can create the fire sapta for you if you bring me two items. The first is fire tar, a simple item usually carried by Razormane spellcasters in eastern Barrens.

The second item will be more dangerous: a reagent pouch from one of the cultists of the Burning Blade. You can find them in a cave above the ravines northeast of Razor Hill.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
The fire sapta is finished. The time has come for you to face the flame. Use the sapta at the shrine and head to the top of the mountain to face the manifestation there. He will not attack until you are ready, but he will realize you are able to see him.

Strike him down swiftly, {name}, for he shall only grow in power the longer you take to slay him. Once he is defeated, place his glowing embers within the brazier and light the torch.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Durotar. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.

You start off down the path back to the Barrens in search of Kranal Fiss.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Water be in ya future, mon. I see you be strong in da ways of fire already, an' me tinkin' you be ready to talk to Islen.

Islen live along the coast of da Barrens. If ya head south along the Southfury River, ya canna miss her--look fer da big shark! She be strong in da ways of da elements and can teach ya da ways of water... if you tink you be ready.

She be easy ta find, just don' go too far south--she be jus' beyond Ratchet.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Long has it been since you were last tested, {name}. You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about the purity of water.

Seek out Islen Waterseer in the Barrens. She is along the eastern coast, south of the Southfury River and Ratchet. You will find her there at her fishing hut. Good luck to you, {name}.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
If there is one lesson you must learn of water, it is this: water means rebirth.

Its power flows, erodes, and makes clean all manner of things. You will find its ability to heal and replenish incomparable, but only when it is pure.

When you understand that water, when polluted, can devastate all that it touches, you will appreciate how vital a resource it is.

If you wish the water sapta, find Brine deep in Southern Barrens. Her home is continually molested by the quilboar there.

entries.name: Call of Air
entries.how:
You be makin' headway now, mon. Your be ready to prove yerself worthy of the air totem, but first, ya must fin' Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles. She be willin' ta tell ya how to get yer air totem if ya treat her wit enough respect.

Head south through the Barrens, and after ya reach Thousand Needles, head east. You'll find her hiddin' in a hole wit' her boyfriend--haha, don' tell her I be dissin' her none--she not take it too kindly.

entries.name: Call of Air
entries.how:
The winds of Kalimdor rush to meet you and you shall be counted among some of our most powerful brothers. I am proud to see you have come this far and have such a promising future.

The element of air is a difficult one to control, but I have faith that your skills will overcome any obstacles that are placed in front of you.

Head to the very south of the Barrens, and enter Thousand Needles. It is there, far to the east, that you will find Prate Cloudseer. She will teach you more.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Take this waterskin and head deep into the lush forest the night elves call Ashenvale. It is to the far north of the Barrens.

Once you've entered the forest, travel west. Along the mountains that separate Stonetalon and Ashenvale, and beyond Lake Mystral, you will find a holy place: the Ruins of Stardust. At the center of the lake you will find a small fountain.

Bring me a sample of the fountain's water. It will be the final component you'll need before I send you back to Islen.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
To find understanding and gain the sapta from me, you must seek out only the purest forms of water. As you fetch the samples for me, take note of your surroundings. Be aware of the creatures that rely on the water, that protect it. See how it affects forests and deserts. Witness how the very substance that sustains life will force creatures to take lives.

We shall start with a simple task: down below my hut there is a pond of the precious liquid. Fill this skin with it and return to me.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Long ago I followed some companions into the Hillsbrad Foothills. We defended ourselves from some tenacious humans who make their home there and we found ourselves in a small town the Forsaken had taken over: Tarren Mill.

It was there I found a most peculiar thing: in the center of town was a small well of fresh spring water. I'm not sure the plagued citizens of the town even realize its value--it's a small holy vestige in an unhallowed sea.

Bring me a sample of that water in this waterskin.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
It's been some time since you were tested last, {name}. You've been patient thus far in your studies, but it's time for you to learn about greater powers... it's time you learn real power. The element of fire is yours if you're prepared to pay for it.

Seek out Kranal Fiss in the Barrens. He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the blasted night elf lands, you've gone way too far.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
Long has it been since you were last tested, {name}. You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about destruction... and chaos. The element of fire is yours for the understanding, if you're prepared to pay for it.

Seek out Kranal Fiss in the Barrens. He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the night elf lands, you've gone too far.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
You look ready for your next test, {name}. You've been patient in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about the purity of water.

Seek out Islen Waterseer in the Barrens. She is along the eastern coast, south of the Southfury River and Ratchet. You will find her there at her fishing hut. Good luck to you, {name}.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Long has it been since you were last tested, {name}. You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about the purity of water.

Seek out Islen Waterseer in the Barrens. She is along the eastern coast, south of the Southfury River and Ratchet. You will find her there at her fishing hut. Good luck to you, {name}.

entries.name: Rune-Inscribed Tablet
entries.how:
Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, {name}.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the shaman trainer Shikrik. She would have words with you when you're ready.

entries.name: Rune-Inscribed Parchment
entries.how:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, {name}.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the shaman trainer Shikrik. She would have words with you when you're ready.

entries.name: Rune-Inscribed Note
entries.how: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, {name}. I believe she was sent by the shaman trainer Meela. If this note is from Meela, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.

entries.name: Material Assistance
entries.how:
{name}, there is a pressing matter I hope you can help with... both materially and spiritually.  Allow me to explain.

Within the depths of the Scholomance in Lordaeron is a chamber called the Great Ossuary.  I need to complete a device that would pierce the shadows of this horrid room.  To finish what I have started, I need two diamonds: an Azerothian and a Pristine Black.  These are not trivial items, I know - I just don't have the resources myself.

Could you provide me with one of each?

entries.name: The Darkreaver Menace
entries.how:
Death Knight Darkreaver lords over the Great Ossuary in the Scholomance.  He threatens to twist the spirit realm to do his own bidding, and he must be stopped!  This is where the scryer you helped make comes into play.

Use the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to call forth Darkreaver's spirit minions.  Defeat the spirits and the death knight himself will appear.  {name}, bring me his head!  Only his demise will reverse the damage dome to the spirit realm!

entries.name: The Darkreaver Menace
entries.how:
Death Knight Darkreaver lords over the Great Ossuary in the Scholomance.  He threatens to twist the spirit realm to do his own bidding, and he must be stopped!  This is where the scryer you helped make comes into play.

Use the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to call forth Darkreaver's spirit minions.  Defeat the spirits and the death knight himself will appear.  {name}, bring me his head!  Only his demise will reverse the damage done to the spirit realm!

entries.name: Elemental Mastery
entries.how:
Bath'rah the Windwatcher has sent out a summons for a shaman of your wisdom.  He requests you bring a sample of each of the elements to show you are ready.

To find Bath'rah, go to the river east of Tarren Mill.  Follow the river north until you come across the ruins where Bath'rah resides.

entries.name: Mastering the Elements
entries.how: Welcome, mon.  You bring me the elements and then we do the talkin'.

entries.name: Spirit Totem
entries.how:
The elemental spirits of this place don't be likin' me any more.

You know about the totems more than any, and I be needin' a spirit totem to protect me.  We already got the elements, now we need somethin' more with more nature.  More primal.

In the Western Plaguelands you can kill bears for claws and spiders for their eyes.  The carrion birds eat everything, so they might have either one.

entries.name: Da Voodoo
entries.how:
The spirit totem just isn't enough.  We be needin' some voodoo magic to make it work jus' right.

The trolls in the sunken temple have feathers strong with voodoo magics.  Go there and kill Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro.  Then we have magic enough for a real spirit totem.

entries.name: Icons of Power
entries.how:
Shamanism is an ancient practice, {name}. Many artifacts, full of spiritual energy, can be found across Azeroth. I had recently discovered an icon of notable power myself, but it was stolen by those pesky scorpids.

One of them is likely carrying it around, thinking it a shiny curio to be used as a decoration for their nest. 

When you find the icon, learn its power and return to me.

entries.how:
Shamanism is an ancient practice, {name}. Many artifacts, full of spiritual energy, can be found across Azeroth. I had recently discovered an icon of notable power myself, but it was stolen by those pesky scorpids.

One of them is likely carrying it around, thinking it a shiny curio to be used as a decoration for their nest. 

When you find the icon, learn its power and return to me.

entries.name: Icons of Power
entries.how:
Shamanism is an ancient practice, {name}. Many artifacts, full of spiritual energy, can be found across Azeroth. I had recently discovered an icon of notable power myself, but it was stolen by the quilboar.

Go to their territory, to the east, and find the stolen icon. It is likely being carried by one of their own shamans attempting to understand its secrets. 

Once you find the icon, learn its power and return to me.

entries.name: Elemental Distress
entries.how:
Listen, {name}. The corruption I spoke of before goes beyond Baron Aquanis. I've been sensing a certain unease within the elemental world for some time. I fear something is gravely wrong, and the corruption of Baron Aquanis only furthers my suspicions.

Find more of those elementals who are suffering: here in Ashenvale, and in the nearby Stonetalon Mountains. Bring me motes of their essence. Perhaps I can analyze them, and begin to understand the nature of their rage.

entries.name: Elixir of Insight
entries.how:
The motes you gathered are an important clue, {name}, but we will also need some spiritual guidance if we're to fully understand the situation.

There is a ritual I often practice that requires an Elixir of Insight. The visions it grants will reveal the next steps we must take.

I can brew the elixir from two others. An Elixir of Water Breathing to free the body, and an Elixir of Wisdom to open the mind.

Bring these to me, and we can begin the ritual.

entries.name: Elixir of Insight
entries.how: The elixir is ready, {name}. Go down to the bonfire, on the beach, and drink it. Heed the vision given to you by the spirits, and return to me with your findings.

entries.name: Hirzek
entries.how:
That quilboar you saw in your vision; I believe it was Hirzek. 

The Earthen Ring has known of the Quilboar's crude version of shamanism for some time. However, there are rumors that a few have recently been making troubling strides. Hizrek is one such Quilboar. 

From what you saw, it seems he is enslaving elementals, rather than cooperating with them as you and I would. No doubt this is causing distress among the elemental plane.

You must stop him, {name}. For the good of Shamans and elementals alike.

entries.name: Storm, Earth, and Fire
entries.how:
Floodin' the Thousand Needles is no small feat, {name}. If I hadn't felt the elements' outrage meself, I'd have never believed it. But here we are.

The quilboar aren't the first tae weaponize the elements irresponsibly, and they won't be the last. If we want to prepare our own counter-ritual, we'll need a better understanding of these twisted elements. Take this book. It details the many denizens of Azeroth and how they practice shamanism.

If you can learn from them, maybe we can find a solution.

entries.name: Elemental Aid
entries.how:
Now that you have mastered the elements, you have an obligation to them, and thus to all of Azeroth herself. We call to them for aid, we do not demand their power. It is time you return the favors granted to you. And I think I know how.

The quilboar twist the elements for their own ends, and seem to be extending their reach within these borders. Go into their kraul and put an end to whatever they scheme. These lands must be protected.

entries.name: Storm, Earth, and Fire
entries.how:
So the quilboar mean to flood the Thousand Needles with their twisted shamanism, do they? It seems almost unimaginable, but you yourself have seen that these creatures are not to be taken lightly.

I had wished to continue your training in earnest, but there is no time for that now. These lands are home to many different creatures, friend and foe alike, and none of them deserve such a fate. We must act.

Take this tome. It was meant for study, but may now hold the key to dispersing this coming storm.

entries.name: Eyes on the Sky
entries.how:
The note you found says the Razormane have burrowed into the Thousand Needles for some sort of unseen ritual. Raging storms and rising tides...

The quilboar must be using some cruel sorcery they learned from Hirzek, a shaman who went to great lengths to twist the elements. If they plan to flood the canyon, this would require devastating elemental powers.

We are ill equipped to deal with this, but a powerful shaman like you must have an idea. Return to your allies and see if you can't find an answer.

entries.name: With Wind Beneath Your Wings
entries.how:
Here mon, a Squall-breakers Potion be what you need. Drink this to protect yourself against the elements of the storm, but remember it only goin' to last for a short while.

Now go, return to your friends in need. There's nothing more I can do for you.

entries.name: Heed My Call
entries.how:
Now that you have the twisted totems, we must wield them to summon forth the corrupted elementals the quilboar are calling upon. Defeat them to cleanse these lands and put an end to the Razormane's abominable ritual then report back to Rau Cliffrunner with your success.

You should begin your clensing at the steam pools to the west. That area is rich with each of the elements. But be careful, {name}. The quilboar will not sit idly while you interrupt their plans.

entries.name: The Tempest's Weapons
entries.how: Our people cannot thank you enough, but I have no real use for this eye. I have heard of an old shaman in the Alterac mountains that has an eye for storm elemental magic. Perhaps he may be able to craft something for you.

entries.name: Clarifying Air
entries.how: <The shaman's corpse is picked clean. There is ooze stuck to what remains, hinting to the culprit behind his demise. His bag is missing as well. A torn scrap of parchment mentions a Murky Air Sapta. The oozes must have taken it along with the rest of his research. You feel strangely compelled to find the sapta and drink it.>

entries.name: Call of the Elements
entries.how:
The elements are uneasy about the corruption you've found. They believe that fragments of their essence will bring forth the source of this corruption so you may put a stop to it for good.


Informing other shamans can wait until after the danger has been dealt with.

entries.name: Answering Air's Call
entries.how:
You strong enough. Understand... yes... you stop corruption.

<The elemental shifts in discomfort.>

Elements in Feralas. Use Essence to find Shrine.

Take fragment. Will help with corruption.

entries.name: Purifying Fire
entries.how: <The shaman's corpse is picked clean. What remains is charred, hinting to the culprit behind her demise. Her bag is missing as well. A burnt scrap of parchment mentions a Murky Fire Sapta. The elementals must have taken it along with the rest of her research. You feel strangely compelled to find the sapta and drink it.>

entries.name: Purging Earth
entries.how: <The shaman's corpse is picked clean. There is fur, earth, and venom stuck to what remains, hinting to the culprits behind her demise. Her bag is missing as well. A trodden scrap of parchment mentions a Murky Earth Sapta. The creatures must have taken it along with the rest of her research. You feel strangely compelled to find the sapta and drink it.>

entries.name: Cleansing Water
entries.how: <The shaman's corpse is picked clean. Fel energy clings to what remains, hinting to the culprit behind his demise. His bag is missing as well. A waterlogged scrap of parchment mentions a Murky Water Sapta. The satyr must have taken it along with the rest of his research. You feel strangely compelled to find the sapta and drink it.>

entries.name: Answering Fire's Call
entries.how:
You strong. Strong enough.

<The elemental sparks and flickers.>

Elements of Feralas. Essence. Find Shrine.

Take Fragment. Will help.

entries.name: Answering Earth's Call
entries.how:
Life grow now. Need more. Need stop corruption.

<Rocks scrape against each other as the elemental shifts.>

Feralas. Elements. Essence and Shrine.

Find. Use Fragment and find. Help life grow.

entries.name: Answering Water's Call
entries.how:
Strong spirit. You help stop corruption.

<Water rages as it swirls around the elemental.>

Bretheren. Elements of Feralas help. Essence will find Shrine.

Fragment help too. Cleanse corruption.

entries.name: Da Voodoo
entries.how:
The spirit totem just isn't enough.  We be needin' some voodoo magic to make it work jus' right.

The trolls in the sunken temple have feathers strong with voodoo magics.  Go there and kill Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro.  Then we have magic enough for a real spirit totem.

entries.name: Heavy Metal
entries.how:
The large flat disc of elementium you hold before you seems to thrum with elemental energy. When you hold it you can almost hear the elemental spirits whispering to you. You aren't sure what use you can find for this, but the connection you feel to it is instantaneous.  

With a little work from a sufficiently talented smith able to work with the mysterious metal known as elementium, you suspect that this could be made into a weapon or piece of armor.

entries.name: A Particular Set of Skills
entries.how:
Krixix is a genius for sure, but he may not be too friendly if you just storm into that mountain demanding his help, to say nothing of the goons that place is likely crawling with. You'll probably want to find a way to get to him without burning the place down along the way which is likely to be pretty tricky. 

If you can figure out a way to get in there without stabbing, shocking, or burning anyone that is probably a good start. I've got no real ideas myself on how to do that though, so good luck!

entries.name: Efficiency Is Priority One
entries.how:
Actually, I just gave myself an idea. You see, the biggest problem when workin' with elementium is keeping the forge hot enough. If I had something that I could use to keep the fire goin' full strength longer, I wouldn't have to waste as much time as I do stoking it. 

If you can find me a magical means to keep my forge hot, I could free up a bit of my time for side hustles like your little request. Now go, beat it. See what you can rustle up for me.

entries.name: Commit to Quality
entries.how: I've been thinking about what to do with that hunk of metal and I think I've got the perfect thing for it. Give me just a few minutes here and I can whip it up for you.

entries.name: Elemental Distress
entries.how:
Listen, {name}. The corruption I spoke of before goes beyond Baron Aquanis. I've been sensing a certain unease within the elemental world for some time. I fear something is gravely wrong, and the corruption of Baron Aquanis only furthers my suspicions.

Find more of those elementals who are suffering: here in Ashenvale, and in the nearby Stonetalon Mountains. Bring me motes of their essence. Perhaps I can analyze them, and begin to understand the nature of their rage.

entries.name: Embracing the Elements
entries.how: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.

entries.name: Call of Earth
entries.how:
Aye, the time's come, young shaman. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the shaman's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.

entries.name: Call of Earth
entries.how:
Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few shaman know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.

Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... see what the earth has to show ye.

entries.name: Call of Earth
entries.how:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, {name}. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
It's been long since ye were last tested, {name}. Ye've shown patience, aye -- but now it's time ye learned of chaos... of destruction. Fire's call is loud, and if ye're ready to pay its price, it'll speak to ye. 

Seek out Bruegs Kindleborn, far east in the mountains. He dwells in a cave above South Gate Outpost. He'll know if ye're truly ready.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.

Beyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame. 

Take this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
Bah, ye didn't trek all this way for tales, did ye, {name}? Ye seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem.

First, ye'll need a sapta to bind yer spirit to the flame.

I'll craft it--but I'll need two things: fire tar from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north, and a reagent pouch from a Stonesplinter Seer lurkin' in the southern hills. Dangerous work, but worthy of the flame.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
The fire sapta's ready, {name}. Now ye face the flame. Use it at the shrine, then climb to the peak. There, ye'll see the spirit--he'll not strike 'til ye do, but he'll know ye see him.

Strike fast, lad. The longer ye wait, the stronger he burns. When he falls, take his glowing embers and place 'em in the brazier. Light the torch and earn the fire's favor.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.

You start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.

entries.name: Earth Sapta
entries.how: You return to me without a sapta, nor your totem of earth. Unfortunate.

entries.name: Fire Sapta
entries.how: If ye have lost in battle to the manifestation, then speak to me and I shall give ye another sapta in which to see the spirits at the shrine above.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Long has it been since ye were last tested, {name}. Ye have shown patience thus far in yer studies, but the time has come for ye to learn about the purity of water.

Seek out Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. He is along the north western edge o' the lake, south of Stonewrought Dam. Ye will find him there at his burrow hut. Good luck to ye, {name}.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
If there's one truth ye need to learn about water, it's this: water means rebirth. It carves stone, cleanses filth, and heals the weary -- but only when it's pure. Taint it, and it'll ruin all it touches.

If ye seek the water sapta, find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands. Her family dwells in a cave beneath the southern falls.

Go on then, don't let the river outrun ye.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Ah, so ye've come seekin' the sapta, have ye? Well then, listen close, love. To find understandin' and earn the sapta, ye must seek water in its various forms. As ye gather the samples, keep yer eyes open. Watch the beasts that guard it, the land it nourishes, and how it changes lives.

We'll start simple: fill this skin at the base o' the falls, where the fresh meets the brackish. Go on now, and mind the marsh.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls.

Bring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Take this waterskin and journey deep into the emerald shade o' Ashenvale. Astranaar rests cradled by waters untouched by corruption. Ruins litter the bed o' the lake, hinting at a bygone era. Bring back a sample from the lake. Pure, ancient, and possibly enchanted water.

It's the last liquid I need before I send ye back to Norric.

Board the boat in Menethil to Auberdine. It stops in Southshore on the way over.

And mind yerself... the forest's got eyes, and they don't blink.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how: Norric will have one more task for ye before rewarding ye with the water totem rites. The vial of water I've given ye is necessary for whatever that task is. Go now and find him. We shall meet again some day.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
In Westfall, outside o' Moonbrook lies Stendel's Pond. Once a pure spring, now touched by dark forces. The spirits there 'ave gone silent. 

Ye must drink the water sapta, then face the corruption that fouls the waters. Take its bracers and the last drops o' Hervdana's potion, then place 'em on the shrine. That'll call forth a spirit, cleansed and true. Speak with it, learn what ye can.

Bring me proof the deed's done, and I'll grant ye the totem.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how: Light erupts as the final word leaves your lips. The hiss of water turning to mist fades into silence, and your senses reel as the corrupt spirits around you unravel, their essence scattered like ash in the wind.

entries.name: Call of Water
entries.how:
Take shard. Take shard and give life.

Give life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.

You protect and give life with water's power.

entries.name: Water Sapta
entries.how: I'm sorry to see you need another Sapta, but you've earned it.

entries.name: Call of Air
entries.how:
The winds o' Azeroth greet ye, and soon ye'll stand among some o' our mightiest kin. I'm proud to see how far ye've come--your future looks bright indeed.

The element o' air's a tricky one to master, but I've faith your skill will see ye through any challenge.

Make your way north into Arathi Highlands. In its northern hills, you'll find Veyric Thundervein. He'll teach ye more.

entries.name: Tainted Shrines
entries.how:
Shrines cleansed. Good.
Nature heal.
<A shudder passes through the elemental.>
No.
Danger!

entries.name: Odd Totems
entries.how:
The spirits have shown me a vision of heat, sun, and endless rolling dunes. A pair of lonely carved totems, overlooking the bones of a mighty beast half-buried by the sands of time. I was shown the desert hills of Tanaris, I am quite sure. 

The totems' purpose is not known to me, but there is surely a purpose for their lonely vigil. I wish for you to seek this place out and see if you can solve this mystery.

entries.name: Challenge of the Desert Wolf
entries.how:
<The totem pulses with wild magic. The image of a ghostly wolf appears in your mind, beckoning you. 

It appears to be offering you a challenge.

Another totem--a twin to the one that your hand now rests upon, appears in the distance just beyond the large sun-bleached skeleton nearby.>

entries.name: The Tempest's Weapons
entries.how:
Ye did good, and I can see yer itchin' fer yer reward. Sorry tae say, I'm not exactly a dwarf of many possessions.

<Veyric gestures broadly at his remote location.>

Tell ye what, though. I hear a troll named the Windwatcher lives out in the Alterac Mountains. He's a powerful shaman himself, and an expert in storm elementals. If ye bring that there elemental core to him, I bet he can make ye a weapon worthy of yer victory.

entries.name: Bold Ogres
entries.how: Those ogres in Arathi Highlands have been up to something suspicious. It appears they want to harness lightning. Go see what they are up to.

entries.name: Lightning Rod
entries.how:
<Your nature magic stirs in response to the apparent lightning that has repeatedly scarred the ground before you.

The ogres must have some secrets related to lightning. Perhaps you can relieve them of these.>

entries.name: Offering to the Wind Spirit
entries.how:
<The winds have calmed. The altar has deemed you worthy of its challenge.

A scrap of parchment flutters around the base of the altar. On it is a list of ingredients, listing both quantity and name.

Is this some form of test, perhaps?>

entries.name: Whispers of Wind Spirits
entries.how:
The spirits have whispered to me of a great unrest in the lands known as Thousand Needles. They tell me of gale force winds tearing through the region, making travel more perilous than it already is.

A mighty altar to the great wind spirit was stolen by the Grimtotem of Darkcloud Pinnacle, which has upset the spirits greatly. These are no doubt related. I need you to go and see what is causing this disturbance. Put a stop to it.

entries.name: Leap of Faith
entries.how:
<An offering appears before you. You get the feeling that the next test is both final and the most challenging. It appears to be wanting to test your faith.

The altar observes you silently, waiting for you to make your choice.

Will you accept its test?>

entries.name: Heed My Call
entries.how:
Euck, just bein' around these blasted totems is givin' me the willies--but that's good. This much twisted corruption will be exactly what we need tae summon the quilboar's elementals.

Go to the Thousand Needles and find a suitable spot for your defenses. The steam pools should work. They're rich with fire, earth, water, and air alike. Place these totems and be ready for a fight. The Razormane won't take too kindly to yer interference.

entries.name: Call of Air
entries.how:
As you have no doubt experienced yourself, the elements of Azeroth are unique to those in Zephras. It is one thing to channel the forces of nature within the elemental plains, and another thing entirely to do it down here in the muck.

I could grant you your totem of air, but I think it would do you more good to meet with the one who trains the other earth-bound initiates. What say you, {name}?

entries.name: Call of Earth
entries.how:
It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave Shaman. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.

Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.

entries.name: Elemental Aid
entries.how:
So yer a big shot shaman now, eh? Ye've mastered the elements and want tae put 'em to good use? I think I got just the thing.

If ye want the elements' respect, ye gotta repay yer debts to 'em. They help you, you help them. And right now they need all the help they can get from those who would abuse their power.

Earth's rumblin', {name}. It speaks of the quilboar amassin' for some ritual of terrible power. We need tae go investigate their kraul and see what they're up to. Bring me back whatever ye find.

entries.name: Material Assistance
entries.how:
{name}, the spirits weigh heavy, both materially and spiritually. I'm in need o' yer help. Deep within the depths of the Scholomance in Lordaeron lies the Great Ossuary, thick with shadows. I'm craftin' a device to cut that dark, but I lack the means to finish.

Bring me two diamonds: one Azerothian, and one Pristine Black. These are not trivial items, aye -- I just don't have the resources myself. Could ye provide me with the two diamonds?

entries.name: The Darkreaver Menace
entries.how:
Death Knight Darkreaver lords over the Great Ossuary in the Scholomance.  He threatens to twist the spirit realm to do his own bidding, and he must be stopped! This is where the scryer you helped make comes into play.

Use the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to call forth Darkreaver's spirit minions.  Defeat the spirits and the death knight himself will appear. {name}, bring me his head! Only his demise will reverse the damage done to the spirit realm!

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
Even though we are in the realm of Skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.

Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of his former brothers and sisters.

You will find Skypriest Faladiel at the farm to the northeast past Valanaar, just to the south of the Shrine of Akir. Kill the betrayer. Bring me his heart. It is a gruesome task, but it is needed for the ritual we are to perform.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
The residents of the Shen'dar Highlands speak of an ancient forest sprite called Kuramaa. They say it lives inside of a twisted stump at the summit of a hill near the highlands Anchor Pylon.

Go to the highlands and find this stump. Rap your fist upon the bark and Kuramaa will appear. Best the spirit in combat, and bring me its wooden mask.

Be warned however, this entity will be exceptionally resistant to much of your magic. Only the touch of flame will lay low the spirit.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how:
Now we will perform the ritual. 

I will place the materials onto the altar and call forth the spirits of flame. If the offering is accepted, they will appear and light the Eternal Flame. You will then hold your torch forth and capture the flame.

Carry the lit torch to Valanaar and place it in the Brazier of Eternal Flames. You must do so quickly, for the flames of the Firelands are quick to dissipate here in Skywall.

entries.name: Call of Fire
entries.how: Greetings, young Skyborne. The spirits have spoken of you, and tell me that you are ready to heed the call of fire. However, I shall not be the one to start you on that Path. Return to your home in the elemental plane, seek your mentors there. They will tell you what must be done.

entries.name: Archaic Rune
entries.how: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the shaman trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

entries.name: Gaffer Jacks
entries.how:
I came to Auberdine because of the quiet.  I want to invent my inventions where it's quiet, because after a night of drinking I don't like all the noise of Ironforge!

So I took a ship to Auberdine and had a little too much to drink on the way.  I dropped my box of gaffer jacks overboard!  I need my gaffer jacks!

I don't know exactly where I dropped them, but if you fish for them in the ocean you might get lucky...

entries.name: Electropellers
entries.how:
We know you're lucky, but... just how lucky are you, {name}?

One night I was wandering the roads of Darkshore.  I was looking for a good river or lake to try my new self-propelled, exploding duck decoy and I think I was a little tipsy... because I passed out and awoke hours later in Auberdine.  My hair was singed and my bag of electropellers was gone!  I must have dropped them in the water!

I need those electropellers!  Maybe you can fish them out of some lake or stream in Darkshore...

entries.name: Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme
entries.how:
Can't say I really enjoy fishin' much. Figure I been at it for a good 20 or 30 years now.

I reckon people are driven to do what they do for different reasons.

Now, I'm not saying you need to fish for 30 years or catch every fish in the sea to become a master fisherman. I reckon you just need to be determined - determined enough to sit on your duff for hours at a time, doin' nothin'.

I'll tell you what, catch me a few rare fish and I'll teach you a thing or two. Here's a list:

entries.name: You Too Good.
entries.how:
Lumak no can teach {name} no more. You too good! Find Lumak friend, Nat Pagle. Is human but no eat! Is Lumak friend! Nat teach you fish gooder.

You find Nat in Dustwallow Marsh, south of Humie town, Thermorosomethinglikedat. Nat probably fishing. Go now!

entries.name: I Got Nothin' Left!
entries.how:
I'm a dwarf fer cryin' out loud, lad! I ain't been designed to fish! I mean look at me! I'm practically made outta stone.

I got nothin' left - ye tapped me out. I've taught ye all I know, flipflop!

Don't ye get it? Ah, fine. I got an ol' friend over on Kalimdor who can help ye out. 'Is name be Nat Pagle, a fine lad. Find him on the islands south o' Theramore. Git goin'!

entries.name: Master Angler
entries.how:
Every Sunday, we have a contest to determine the greatest anglers of them all! Just be among the FIRST 0 PEOPLE to bring me some Tastyfish fished from the Tastyfish schools found along the coasts of Stranglethorn and you will be declared a Master Angler!

If you're too slow, my apprentice here will still reward you with money for some Tastyfish you bring her.

Oh, and don't delay, Tastyfish go bad quickly, so don't even think about holding onto them for next week!

entries.name: Rare Fish - Keefer's Angelfish
entries.how:
*Whir* *Click*

  I seek rare fish for Fishmaster Bluegill to catalogue.   If you bring me a Keefer's Angelfish, I will provide you with this fine reward. 

 *Zzzap* *Whir*

entries.name: Rare Fish - Dezian Queenfish
entries.how:
*Whir* *Click*

  I seek rare fish for Fishmaster Bluegill to catalogue.   If you bring me a Dezian Queenfish, I will provide you with this fine reward. 

 *Zzzap* *Whir*

entries.name: Rare Fish - Brownell's Blue Striped Racer
entries.how:
*Whir* *Click*

  I seek rare fish for Fishmaster Bluegill to catalogue.   If you bring me a Brownell's Blue Striped Racer, I will provide you with this fine reward. 

 *Zzzap* *Whir*

entries.name: Tip the Scales - Keefer's Angelfish
entries.how: An angelfish for some tastyfish. Feels like a fair trade to me.

entries.name: Tip the Scales - Brownell's Blue Striped Racer
entries.how: If you got yourself a few of those Striped Racers, I've got a few tastyfish. Deal?

entries.name: Tip the Scales - Dezian Queenfish
entries.how:
A QUEENFISH? Well well, I didn't expect to be among royalty...

Best I can do is a few tastyfish.

entries.name: Supplying the Front
entries.how:
The mountaineers of Loch Modan are fighting troggs, and having a busy time of it!  They need constant supplies of new armor and weapons if we're ever to get a handle on those troggs.

That's why my colleague Thorvald is there, trying to keep the mountaineers in good gear.  So if you were to make some copper axes and copper chain belts and bring them to Thorvald, he would be obliged.  He might even share his knowledge with you.

Thorvald is in Loch Modan's southern guard tower.

entries.name: Gearing Redridge
entries.how:
We dwarves aren't the only ones fighting.  Our human allies have their hands full too!

Redridge is under periodic attack from blackrock orcs, and their supply of equipment is always low.  If you were to help them out, I'm sure their resident blacksmith, Verner Osgood, would teach you a trick or two.

entries.name: Barbaric Battlements
entries.how:
Twenty generations of Omosh have held this hammer, {name}. A hundred thousand tons of metal we have molded. Tragically, it all ends at Orokk, failure of the Omosh: Without kin and incapable of producing offspring.

I cannot let the secret recipes of Omosh die with me! Someone must continue the legacy, Omosh or not!

Prove to Orokk you are capable, {name}. Bring for Orokk the following: Two patterned bronze bracers, two bronze greatswords, and two sharp claws. Bring them for Orokk and we shall continue.

entries.name: On Iron Pauldrons
entries.how:
Orokk sees the eagerness in your eyes, {name}. Like a sponge you soak in the wisdom of the Omosh.

Three lessons I shall teach!

Return to the anvil, soak in the heat of the forge, create for Orokk four bronze battleaxes and four bronze warhammers. Only then will you learn of the iron pauldron.

entries.name: Trampled Under Foot
entries.how:
Only two more lessons Orokk will teach, {name}. Your muscles ache, I know, but continue on for the Omosh!

Bring to Orokk four green iron helms, four green iron bracers, and two green iron leggings - for this you learn and your enemies suffer!

entries.name: Horns of Frenzy
entries.how:
The final lesson Orokk teaches you, {name}. To the sacred anvil and forge you return! Bring for Orokk two solid iron mauls, two silvered bronze boots, and two silvered bronze gauntlets.

See the fear in their eyes as you approach!

entries.name: Joys of Omosh
entries.how:
Orokk is not crying, {name}. Soot is in eye.

<Orokk wipes a tear away.>

There is one last Omosh family secret Orokk will teach you. Orokk will die happy, thanks to {name}.

Learn Omosh dance of joy and then you learn fist of iron!

entries.name: The Old Ways
entries.how:
In the time of legends, Aturk would crush the skulls of his enemies and grind the bone into a fine powder for use in filament. Long gone are those days, {race}. The Warchief calls for peace among the clans. Old enemies are now only watched with weary eyes!

Unbelievable, I know, but such is the will of Thrall.

Enough lamenting! You are here to learn, and learn you will! Bring me four steel breastplates and four steel helms and you will gain a taste of war!

entries.name: Booty Bay or Bust!
entries.how:
Listen, kid, you're not gonna learn anything hanging around here.

I know a guy who knows a guy. He hangs around the smithy in Booty Bay. If you show him this insignia, he'll tell you all about mithril.

So whadd'ya say? Leave this kid stuff to the babies in diapers, {name} -- it's time to move on.

If you're interested, his name's McGavan. Show him this trinket and he'll recognize your commitment.

entries.name: The Origins of Smithing
entries.how:
When I was about your age, a dwarf by the name of Galvan took me under his wing and trained me in the ways of the armorsmith. Before he left for Booty Bay, he made me promise to train all those with the desire and determination to advance in the craft of blacksmithing -- so here I am -- all these years later.

So, now it's time for you to learn a little something. Make me six golden scale bracers and you will learn where smithing comes from, {name}.

entries.name: In Search of Galvan
entries.how:
Although Galvan left Booty Bay many years ago, members of the order still remain in town, hoping to one day find another worthy of Galvan's tutelage.

Take this insignia and present it to McGavan in Booty Bay.

If you actually make it that far, he'll know that you are worthy. I have faith, {name}!

entries.name: The Mithril Order
entries.how:
Most of our recruits never make it to Booty Bay, {name}. The shine of the insignia is enough to trigger the loot lust in even the staunchest of blacksmiths. Fools they be, as the insignia is a drop in the bucket compared to the wealth of items you'll see!

Find Galvan the Ancient and show him this pin. His residence is far to the north, between Zul Gurub and the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound.

entries.name: Smelt On, Smelt Off
entries.how:
Many blacksmiths believe that mining and smithing are separate, independent jobs; but can there be blacksmithing without mining? Ah ha -- it is an impossibility! The accomplished blacksmith must also be an accomplished miner.

Show Galvan that you are capable, {name}. Bring me forty bars of iron and forty bars of mithril. For this, Galvan will teach you the ways of the ornate mithril pants!

entries.name: The Great Silver Deceiver
entries.how:
It is said that truesilver is stronger and more durable than mithril. Galvan does not disagree with this assessment of the minerals, but contrary to its name, truesilver is not true! Mithril is a far nobler mineral! HAH! Regardless, for this lesson you will need to find the great silver deceiver, {name}.

Bring me forty bars of mithril and five bars of truesilver. In exchange, you will be taught the secret of ornate mithril gloves and more importantly, learn that truesilver is a liar!

entries.name: The Art of the Imbue
entries.how:
The harvesting of precious gems is of utmost importance to our craft, {name}. Few gems are more precious than the citrine. The magical properties we imbue into our goods are amplified greatly by the presence of citrine.

For this lesson, we will fortify forty bars of mithril with four citrines. The result will be a better understanding of magical gemology and the knowledge to create ornate mithril shoulders.

entries.name: Galvan's Finest Pupil
entries.how:
If you are ready to conclude your training with Galvan, you should journey to Gadgetzan.

There, you will find my finest pupil: Trenton Lighthammer. He has much to teach you in the ways of ornate mithril. Otherwise, remain here and learn!

Oh, Gadgetzan is in Tanaris, of course!

entries.name: Expert Blacksmith!
entries.how:
When you first came to me, I knew that you would turn out to be one of my finest pupils! It was without hesitancy that you gave up a trinket of some power to McGavan. You did this only so that you could meet me. Such blind faith and devotion to the craft should be rewarded.

You have attained expertise over blacksmithing, {name}. Reap the rewards!

entries.name: A Good Head On Your Shoulders
entries.how:
It seems as if master had this planned from the start. I was not taught to create the items which you learned to create and you were not taught the items which I learned to create.

The master is wise, {name}. We shall teach each other!

Show me how to make a mithril coif and ornate mithril shoulders and I shall show you how to create an ornate mithril helm.

entries.name: The World At Your Feet
entries.how:
At last year's All-Valley Blacksmithing Championship, all those who watched saw my leg get swept from under me by a cowardly dog from the Venture Co. Foundry. What they didn't know, however, was the reason I was able to continue and ultimately win the tournament: That's right, ornate mithril boots!

I will need to learn how to craft ornate mithril pants for this year's tournament, however, as a Venture Co. shredder is an entrant! Teach me the way of the pants and learn the way of the boot!

entries.name: The Mithril Kid
entries.how:
Around these parts I am known as the Mithril Kid. I supply ornate mithril to adventurers from around the world.

<Trenton whispers.>

Little do they know that I do not know the technique to fashion ornate mithril gloves. Shhhh! This will be our little secret.

Teach me the technique to create ornate mithril gloves, {name}, and in exchange, I will show you the resultant of the culmination of my training under Galvan: the ornate mithril breastplate.

entries.name: Did You Lose This?
entries.how:
You have done much for the Order, {name}. The sheer dedication it takes to get this far would have turned away any ordinary person. There is no doubt in my mind, or in the mind of Galvan, that you are one of us.

Which is why I think you deserve a little reward. It is nothing really, just a trinket. You may be familiar with its properties, as I do believe it is what brought you to us in the first place.

entries.name: Hot Fiery Death
entries.how:
The only thing that remains of this human are some charred bones. He seems to have died within arms reach of what he was after - unfired plate gauntlets.

Perhaps you should grab the gauntlets and get out of the fire?

entries.name: The Art of the Armorsmith
entries.how:
So ye made the smart decision.

There ain't no love lost betwixt me an old Ironus here. That good for nothing toy maker knows who the true craftsmen round here be.

The truly great wars are won with a good defense. When it be go time, no offense is gonna be helping ye out.

Right, so let's get to work. All ye need to do is show me that ye've got some raw talent. After that, I'll yank whatever impurities be left in ye and mold ye into an armorsmith. Ye do know how to make ornate mithril, don't ye?

entries.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
entries.how:
As a weaponsmith you'll find that more often than not, heroes and adventurers will be coming to you for gear. While the workload can be unbearable at times, the riches more than make up for the back strain and ash lung.

Oh yes, {name}, weaponsmiths are the ones with all the gold!

If you wish to join our ranks, you'll need to show me that you can make me a silver or two - I mean, show me that you've got what it takes to be the go to guy when people need superior quality weapons. Get to work!

entries.name: The Art of the Armorsmith
entries.how:
Satisfaction. It is what I draw from the hammer and the anvil. To see a proud Horde warrior protected under my steel reminds me of what it is to be alive. It is an addiction that I dare never give up, {name}.

I can not grant you this satisfaction, merely set you upon the path. As with all of life's endeavors, the path of the armorsmith is a journey.

If you wish to be one of the select few, you need only to ask and I shall train, but, a task you must first complete.

entries.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
entries.how:
One day, I will create a legendary hammer. A hammer fit for a Warchief!

It is my life's work, {name}. My passion. I recognize that you have the potential to be among us, one of us - a weaponsmith. I am the one that can help you harness that potential.

A simple task is all that you must complete. Simple for one of your exceptional skill.

entries.name: Sweet Serenity
entries.how:
Within the confines of the Scarlet Bastion lies sweet Serenity. The Crimson Hammersmith guards the recipe with his life. Defeat him and bring me his apron. For that, I shall train you to become a hammersmith.

Understand this: Once you have chosen the path of the hammersmith, the paths of the swordsmith and axesmith will no longer be available.

entries.name: Snakestone of the Shadow Huntress
entries.how:
Don't let her beauty fool you, {class}. The shadow huntress, Vosh'gajin is deadly and deranged.

<Kilram points to the scar on his face.>

Aye, she gave me that - a love tap, she called it.

The time for vengeance has finally come.

You can find Vosh'gajin in Blackrock Spire. Slay her and return to me with her snakestone. Do this and I will teach you the ways of the axesmith.

entries.name: Corruption
entries.how:
If I am short with you, it is for a reason. The plans for the creation of the great blade, Corruption, have been stolen by the Black Guard: Elite skeletal units of Baron Rivendare.

Yes, Baron Rivendare of Stratholme.

The Black Guard swordsmith now guards those plans with his... undeath.

Slay him and return proof of this deed and I shall train you in the ways of the swordsmith.

entries.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume I
entries.how: The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.

entries.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume II
entries.how: The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.

entries.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume III
entries.how: The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.

entries.name: Imperial Plate Belt
entries.how: For the belt plans, I'll be needin' 20 thorium bars.

entries.name: Imperial Plate Boots
entries.how:
For the boot plans, I'll be needin' 40 thorium bars. Yep, 40. Are you gonna cry? Would you like a hanky?

<Derotain laughs.>

entries.name: Imperial Plate Bracer
entries.how:
For the bracer plans, I'll be needin' 20 thorium bars.

Are you alright, sonny? Yer getting' all red.

entries.name: Imperial Plate Chest
entries.how:
For the chest piece plans, I'll be needin' 60 thorium bars.

Oh boy, there you go again. Are you gonna be runnin' to yer blue Gods, askin' why they have forsaken you?!? Toughen up, Nancy! Nobody ever said life's fair.

entries.name: Imperial Plate Helm
entries.how: Just hand over 50 thorium bars and the helm plans are yers.

entries.name: Imperial Plate Leggings
entries.how:
Just hand over 60 thorium bars and the leg plans are yers.

I know, I'm driving you into bankruptcy! I've heard it all before so you can save your sob story, weakling.

entries.name: Imperial Plate Shoulders
entries.how: For the shoulder plans, I'll be needin' 20 thorium bars.

entries.name: Sweet Serenity
entries.how:
Within the confines of the Scarlet Bastion lies sweet Serenity. The Crimson Hammersmith guards the recipe with his life. Defeat him and bring me his apron. For that, I shall train you to become a hammersmith.

entries.name: Seeking the Kor Gem
entries.how:
Greetings, {name}. What can I do for one who follows a holy path?

Ah, yes, Stilwell, the blacksmith... from long ago. I remember him well, though, I have not heard his name in some time.

He never struck me as an impudent man, so I can only assume his desire for a Kor gem is noble.

If you truly wish for one of the gems, then you must head to the northwest of Ashenvale. You will find Blackfathom Deeps there within some ancient ruins. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, {class}.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
In all things, a paladin must reflect the Light which supplements our strength. To strive to be divine for one of our kind does not mean we strive for godhood--we strive to be good in all actions.

Although called upon to smite evil in these harsh times, you must always remember that it's aiding others that will truly set you apart from the citizens of Azeroth. Compassion, patience, bravery--these things mean as much to a paladin as strength in battle.

Know this well, and never forget it.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
Your task then, {name}, is to find someone here in Stormwind that is in need of aid. Someone who is pure of heart and motive. Perhaps someone helping others. Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.

Do this, and return to me when you are finished. Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a paladin of the Light.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
Bless their hearts, most of them have no families because of the Scourge attacks in the last decade.

My husband John collects the materials for me to make the shirts and pants for the children, but I haven't even had time to do that. I've been too focused on keeping food on their plates, and a roof over their heads.

What's that? You'd be willing to help? Oh, thank the Light, and thank you, {name}.

If you could bring me some linen cloth so I can sew clothes for the kids, that would help me out so much.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
In all things, a paladin must reflect the Light which supplements our strength. To strive to be divine for one of our kind does not mean we strive for godhood--we strive to be good in all actions.

Although called upon to smite evil in these harsh times, you must always remember that it's aiding others that will truly set you apart from the citizens of Azeroth. Compassion, patience, bravery--these things mean as much to a paladin as strength in battle.

Know this well, and never forget it.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
Your task then, {name}, is to find someone here in Ironforge that is in need of aid. Someone who is pure of heart and motive. Perhaps someone helping others. Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.

Do this, and return to me when you are finished. Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a paladin of the Light. I will remain here in the temple for your return. Other paladins will need my guidance also.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
My wife and I run an orphanage in Stormwind, mostly for children who have lost parents due to the attacks by the Scourge in the last decade. I come to Ironforge every month or so to see about collecting more supplies from the citizens here, and talk to the various groups to see if they can do anything to help.

This trip's been agonizingly slow, and not very productive.

If I could just get some more linen for my wife to make some clothes, I could finally send a shipment home.

entries.name: The Tome of Valor
entries.how:
Valor, and all the virtues that go along with it, are like rare minerals: you must cherish them when you find them because of their value, but you must also take time to harvest them... refine them. When mixed together properly, a strong alloy is formed, sometimes unbreakable by even the most powerful blows.

This strength, your faith, your bravery, must be tested. You must learn to never lose faith and realize that with the power of the Light, you can overcome things that most others cannot.

entries.name: The Tome of Valor
entries.how:
Good! Your lack of hesitation is a sure sign that you are prepared and eager to test yourself. So be it.

At the very ends of Westfall's Longshore, a small house overlooks the ocean. There, a couple lives, the Stilwells. Jordan is an incredible smith, and he's gone to Ironforge to meet with the dwarves for a while. But this has left Daphne, his wife, alone and unprotected.

Reports suggest that the Defias have all but taken over the area, Daphne may need some protection from the villains. Go there.

entries.name: The Tome of Valor
entries.how:
Now, they'll be coming again soon, I'd wager, so get yourself ready.

I've got myself a gun in the house. I'll grab it and be ready to help you out, but for the most part, you're on your own.

I've no idea how many they'll send, but I'm sure it'll be more than the few they sent earlier.

Ask the Light for whatever blessings you can because... did you hear that? I think they're coming.

We make our stand near the house!

entries.name: The Tome of Valor
entries.how:
Please, return to Duthorian and let him know that I'm safe for now. I have you and the Church to thank for that.

He'll send word to Ironforge to let my Jordan know that he has nothing to fear.

Oh, how I miss my husband. I can't wait till he returns.

entries.name: The Test of Righteousness
entries.how:
Actually, I have no doubt that Jordan himself would like to thank you, and seeing as I need a messenger to send word that his wife is safe, I think you'd be a perfect choice.

Jordan was to be a paladin of the Light before his dedication to his father's craft took him on another path--he's intimately familiar with our way of life and is considered among our most faithful.

He should still be in Ironforge--he likes to work outside the gates during the day, something about the cool mountain air.

entries.name: The Test of Righteousness
entries.how:
I'd like to reward you if you'd be willing to accept such a thing? Don't misunderstand me, my generosity is dependent on how much help you can be, but I see us both benefiting greatly from such an alliance.

I will craft for you a weapon worthy of what you've accomplished, a symbol of paladinhood and the Light, but you must gather the items I need to craft it. I've already started taking notes on the items, it just requires someone brave and skilled enough to recover them. What do you say, {class}?

entries.name: Bailor's Ore Shipment
entries.how:
Ach, ya startled me, man! Can't ya see I was lost in thought?

What's that? Jordan's shipment... fer Ironforge. Ahhh, yeah, I know whatcha speak of. Mo'grosh ogres... dat's who took me ol' friend's ore shipment. Caravan was headin' here from the Wetlands and was ambushed. The guard who survived their attack just passed away a few days ago--healer couldn't get to 'em fast enough.

If you want the shipment, you'll have to head northeast across the Loch. It's got to be there somewhere.

entries.name: The Tome of Nobility
entries.how:
I greet you once again, {name}. I am more proud to call you brother than ever before--your dedication is a tribute to us all.
