The time has come for me to bestow a great gift upon you. But know this, for now I give you this freely, but later, when time permits, this will be a much greater challenge to all paladins who choose to undertake my quest.

Speak to me again and I shall grant you a great boon.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how: I'm going to see about making plans to return home soon. Hopefully, Stephanie is doing well back in Stormwind. I can't wait to see her again. Till next we meet, {class}.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
I want you to take this, {name}. It is called the Symbol of Life.

You've proven charitable and patient, and now I want you to prove just how adept you've become in both combat, and power.

My husband Muiredon returned recently from an encounter with some Dark Iron dwarves, and he barely escaped with his life--he's over there having his wounds healed by one of our priests.

Take the Symbol and speak to him. If you can help him, then we will speak again soon. May the Light shine upon you.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
I'll take these to the children this very day. Please be safe, good {class}. It is not often men of your character show their faces in the city, but you've proven that the paladins here in Stormwind shall never turn their backs on those in need.

Farewell.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
Take this, {name}. It is called the Symbol of Life.

You've proven charitable and patient, and now the time has come to see if you're powerful enough to focus one of the Light's greatest gifts.

My friend Gazin returned recently from an encounter with some Defias in Elwynn near Heroes' Vigil--he barely escaped with his life. He's near the altar having his wounds healed by our priests.

Take the Symbol and speak to him. If you can help him, then we will speak again soon. May you bask in the Light's glory.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
We was spyin' on some of the Dark Iron dwarves that've bunkered down south of Helm's Bed Lake. We knew they was up to no good, so Narm an' me thought we'd take a closer look--got ta see their leader given orders to some o' his men.

Narm an' me took the chance to kill a few of 'em, but they proved tougher than we thought, an' more of 'em got the jump on us. Narm tol' me to run an' get support, so 'ere I am.

Narm needs help, an' I'll not rest till he gets it.

C'n ya help, {name}?

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
Before I fell in battle, Muiredon and I had almost defeated one of the Dark Iron spies near that small house. We witnessed their captain passing orders to them, and sought to kill him and take the orders.

Some of the council in Ironforge do not yet believe the presence of Dark Iron dwarves exists in Dun Morogh. By attaining one of those scripts, we'll not only have proof of their movements, but possibly an idea of what they're planning.

Get one of those scripts and take it back to Muiredon, {name}.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
I c'n see me wife's o'er there beamin' wit pride already. Ya better get yer tuchus o'er there pronto. I be thinkin' she'd have some words wit ya.

Light be witcha, mighty {class}. I'll be lookin' fer ya on the battlefield against the Scourge and dem Dark Irons when the time comes.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
Henze and I had made it to Heroes' Vigil, an island in the middle of Stone Cairn Lake in northeastern Elwynn. We'd heard the Defias had infiltrated our borders and we wanted proof to take to the king's advisors.

We caught sight of a couple of the scum going over some documents, and we attacked. Unfortunately, we were quickly overwhelmed by more of the mages.

Henze held them off for me while I escaped... the daft fool, going and being brave.

He's out there now, Henze is. Can you help us, {name}?

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
We'll have time to talk more about the Symbol at a later time. What's important now is to get those papers we saw the Defias going over. If we can get our hands on them, we'll be able to prove the Defias have infiltrated Elwynn and hopefully gain some insight into what their plans are.

I'm in no shape for battle as of now, {name}. Do you think you're strong enough to get those papers from the Defias here on the island?

If you're able to get them, bring them back to Gazin and let him know I'm all right.

entries.name: The Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
I'll take the script to the King's advisors after Duthorian's taken a look at them, but in the meantime, you should go speak to Duthorian now. He'll be wanting to pat you on the back for sure!

Thank you again, {name}. I hope we meet again. You're surely an ally I'm proud to call friend.

entries.name: The Symbol of Life
entries.how:
If you fail to help Narm after you've used the Symbol of Life, {name}, then return to me and I shall give you another.

It is important to both my husband and I that you return successful. Please, make haste.

entries.name: The Symbol of Life
entries.how:
Make haste, {name}, more than one life hangs in the balance if you fail.

If for some reason you fail to help Gazin and Henze, then return to me and I will give you another Symbol of Life for your travels.

Don't mistake my aid as simple charity, you must prove yourself worthy like any other paladin and continual failure may reflect upon you later.

entries.name: The Test of Righteousness
entries.how:
Why don't we go over to the forge and get started on this? I've been preparing for your arrival for some time, so it shouldn't take long at all.

When we're done, you'll be far more prepared to defend the Light than you have been, this much I swear.

I'll be somewhat honest, {name}, seeing the results of your exploits makes me somewhat envious. But knowing that I can contribute to your adventures in my own significant way does bring me some joy.

entries.name: Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
Hello, {name}. I know you're busy helping out the people of Dun Morogh, but when you have the time, you should make your way up to Ironforge to speak to one of our most respected ilk: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger paladins go to when it's time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of ya.

You can find her upstairs in the Hall of Mysteries. If you've never been there, it's in the Mystic Ward. Good luck to ya, {name}.

entries.name: Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
Greetings, brother. Duthorian Rall, one of our most influential paladins, was speaking about you recently. I overheard him talking about how it was time you be put to the test some... along with some very complimentary things about how well you've performed thus far.

If I were you, I'd head to Stormwind and speak to him when you have time. I'm sure he's in the Cathedral of Light--that's where he spends most of his time.

entries.name: Tome of Divinity
entries.how: Hello, {name}. I know you're busy helping out the people of Dun Morogh, but when you have the time, you should go upstairs and speak to one of our most respected ilk: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger paladins go to when it's time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of ya.

entries.name: Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
Hello, {name}. I know you're busy helping out the people of Azeroth, but when you have the time, you should return to Ironforge and speak to one of the most respected paladins of your home: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger dwarven paladins go to when it is time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of all of us.

You can find her upstairs in the Hall of Mysteries which is located in the Mystic Ward.

entries.name: Consecrated Letter
entries.how: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, {name}. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Brother Sammuel, our local paladin trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

entries.name: Consecrated Rune
entries.how: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the paladin trainer Bromos. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

entries.name: Tome of Divinity
entries.how:
Sorry to interrupt your travels, {race}, but I thought you should know that word was sent from Stormwind recently asking that paladins report there for training.

If I didn't know any better, I'd say your close to reaching a special time and it's time you started studying the Tomes.

Look for Duthorian Rall in Stormwind. He usually trains paladins in the Cathedral of Light.

entries.name: The Tome of Nobility
entries.how:
Hello, {name}. I see your dedication remains strong, as does your faith.

I think it is time you spoke with Duthorian Rall in Stormwind. There are some more lessons for you to learn, and I feel you are prepared.

Seek him out in the Cathedral of Light, and {name}, take these lessons seriously. You've attained your status through humility and hard work, do not disappoint us by becoming arrogant.

Be well.

entries.name: The Tome of Nobility
entries.how:
Well, well, well, look at the mighty paladin in all his regality.

Sorry, {name}, I meant no offense... I just get a little jealous sometimes when I see some of the feats you've accomplished. Tiza tells me it's my weakness, and I swore to her I'd work on it. It's just hard sometimes, you know?

But the reason I wanted to talk to you was because Duthorian Rall in Stormwind sent word for you to meet him in the Cathedral of Light when you're ready. Sounded important. Sounded like something's going on.

entries.name: Emphasis on Sacrifice
entries.how:
In order to prepare yourself for this task, you must first show due sacrifice and judgment... with an emphasis on sacrifice.

You must acquire High Priest Rohan's exorcism censer for your task.  Even though its use will be for good and just reasons, due compensation must be given for it.

Proceed to Ironforge and speak with the High Priest.  By bringing ample coin with you to help offset the loss of his censer, it will show your due sacrifice.

Go now {name}, time is of the essence.

entries.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
entries.how:
The time has come, {name}, for you to learn about what it will take for you to acquire something you have no doubt waited on for some time... your charger.

Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker here in Stormwind's Cathedral District.  It is he who will guide you not only though the legerdemain of a Paladin's most trusted mount, but the tasks before you to acquire one of your own.

I wish you the best in this trial.  For the Light, noble brother!

entries.name: To Show Due Judgment
entries.how:
With my blessings, take the censer.  I myself have used it in several exorcisms, and it should serve you well for the arduous tasks that lie ahead.

Return now to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind, {name}.  Your quest continues with him.

entries.name: Exorcising Terrordale
entries.how:
I have added a pinch of dirt from the tainted ground of Terrordale in the Eastern Plaguelands to the censer.  You will now use this censer to find areas there that show signs of spiritual turmoil and disturbance.  Look for green auras that permeate the ground as the physical world buckles under the torment of the spirit realm and use the censer to drive out the evil spirits.

When you have passed sufficient judgment on the spirits there, you will be ready to proceed.

entries.name: The Work of Grimand Elmore
entries.how:
A paladin's charger is nothing more than a pack animal without proper barding for it.  The barding used by your charger not only needs to be of the finest materials possible, but because of the circumstances involved it must also be sufficiently attuned to the spirit realm.

First things first, {name} - let's get your barding made.  In Stormwind's Dwarven District is one of the finest craftsmen living today, Grimand Elmore.  His work will not be cheap, but his quality is what we seek.  Speak with him.

entries.name: Collection of Goods
entries.how:
You'll need four things for the barding - runecloth for the lining, arcanite bars for the plating, Arthas' Tears for the spiritual attunement, and Stratholme holy water for the spiritual imbuement.  Actually, you need five things... gold for my fee.  That fee includes all labor as well as a handcrafted saddle and stirrups.

Once you've got all that, I'll be able to finish your barding.  Until then, there are some things I can get started on for you while you assemble your collection of goods.

entries.name: Ancient Equine Spirit
entries.how:
Your barding needs a special form of blessing, one from an appropriate spirit.  In Dire Maul is such a spirit, the Ancient Equine Spirit.  It is currently held by a corrupt treant, Tendris Warpwood.  Pass judgment upon this foul beast, {name}.

Know this - freedom alone is not enough.  You must soothe the spirit before receiving its blessing.  For that, special horse feed is needed.  Travel to Southshore first and speak with Merideth Carlson on this... and prepare for more sacrifice.

entries.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
entries.how:
As the barding rests on the back of the Ancient Equine Spirit, it glows ever so slightly.  The air is thick with power for a brief moment, and then the barding disappears from the back of the horse and is now secure in your backpack.

It would seem that the barding has been blessed.  As per Lord Shadowbreaker's instructions, you should now return with it to him in Stormwind.

entries.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
entries.how:
The Silver Hand thought me MAD when I told them that I could make a special horse feed that could nourish spiritual horses.  EVERYONE thought I was mad!  Well, now it's payback time!

I'll make what you need, PALADIN... so-called CHAMPION... but it will cost you.  I need special biscuits - Enriched Manna Biscuits sold only by the Argent Dawn - for this blend.  I also demand, yes DEMAND gold as compensation for the misery I have endured!

Show me the sacrifice you tout so much, PALADIN.

entries.name: The Divination Scryer
entries.how:
We now must assemble a Divination Scryer - this will begin the trial that will allow you to redeem the fallen charger.  Your scryer, actually, is almost done.  The exorcism censer used in Terrordale is the catalyst for it, and I will fashion a suitable housing for the device.

The last components needed, though, are two diamonds.  They must be as juxtaposed in brilliance as they are in purpose - an Azerothian and a Pristine Black.  These two will be the beacon by which the scryer will pierce the shadows!

entries.name: Judgment and Redemption
entries.how:
Take this satchel - in it are the items you will need for your task.

Use the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to bring forth accursed spirits that must be judged.  Use your judgments wisely during this trial - they will prove more potent than you realize.  After the spirits, the death knight will appear; defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the charger.  Only then {name}, will you be able to redeem it and place your barding upon your new steed!

Good luck!

entries.name: Grimand's Finest Work
entries.how:
<Grimand wipes sweat from his brow, beaming with a sense of pride.>

There you are, my friend.  This is some of my finest work - as good as the barding I personally made for Lord Shadowbreaker when he went for his own charger.  I thank you for your trust in me to provide for you the best.

No doubt Grayson will want to see the work for himself as well.  Take your barding to him, and give him my thanks for his honorable business.

entries.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
entries.how:
The time has come, {name}, for you to learn about what it will take for you to acquire something you have no doubt waited on for some time... your charger.

Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.  It is he who will guide you not only though the legerdemain of a Paladin's most trusted mount, but the tasks before you to acquire one of your own.

I wish you the best in this trial.  For the Light, noble brother!

entries.name: Dispelling Evil
entries.how:
Greetings, {class}.  Crusaders like you are a welcome sight in these desolate reaches.

Your holy strength is needed to help fight the endless undead here.  We need you to collect a large number of scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis.  The high priest can be found guarding Uther's Tomb in Sorrow Hill, not far from here.

Only one with an Argent Dawn Commission can hope to find scourgestones, so speak to Officer Pureheart if you haven't already.

entries.name: Chillwind Point
entries.how: Commander Ashlam Valorfist has sent out a call for a paladin of your purity and valor, {name}.  You can find him at Chillwind Point in the southern part of the Western Plaguelands.  Seek him and aid in his cause for the Light!

entries.name: Inert Scourgestones
entries.how:
The evil has been purged from the stones, {name}.

I am aware of Commander Ashlam's plans, and he will require only a single inert stone.  Bring it to him so we may bathe the Scourge in righteous fire.

entries.name: Forging the Mightstone
entries.how:
Now we must combine the inert scourgestones and create a weapon to shatter the ranks of undead.  This is no trivial task, {name}.  Only the trolls of the sunken temple carry the kind of rare magic able to turn the evil of something against itself.

In the temple, the trolls are known as Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro.  Do not feel remorse for their corrupt souls... they are not without evil.

entries.name: Relics of the Light
entries.how:
Relics of the Light can be found across Azeroth. These relics - in particular, the Librams that have guided our order since its founding - can help you strengthen your connection to the Light.

One such libram was held in the Abbey's archives, but it has been stolen by the Defias bandits to the east. Recover the libram, then study it and follow its guidance to learn a new combat technique. Return to me when you have done this.

entries.name: Relics of the Light
entries.how:
Relics of the Light can be found across Azeroth. These relics - in particular, the Librams that have guided our order since its founding - can help you strengthen your connection to the Light.

We held one such libram in our archives, but it was stolen by the Frostmane trolls. The thief is likely still carrying it on them. Recover the libram, and follow its guidance to learn a new combat technique. Return to me when you have done this.

entries.name: A Strange Artifact
entries.how:
<The mysterious orb you hold fills you with cold dread. You can almost hear a voice echo faintly in your mind. Low and guttural, you understand well that the language being spoken is demonic in nature. 

Even as a paladin, this magic is beyond you. Find a more senior paladin here in Kalimdor who might be able to help you discern the nature of this sinister object.>

entries.name: Advice From Stormwind
entries.how:
There's a powerful darkness about this orb. Its nature is clearly demonic, but past that it is beyond my ability to discern its purpose.

Take the orb to the one known as Katherine the Pure in the Stormwind Cathedral. Consult with her for advice on the orb.

entries.name: A Second Opinion
entries.how:
I'm not sure what to make of this orb, {name}. I think we will need the help of... a specialist.

We are aware of a warlock sect operating out of Stormwind. Officially we reject the presence of warlocks in the city. Unofficially, their knowledge can be of use when dealing with demonic forces.

Find a representative of these warlocks, and seek their opinion on the orb.

entries.name: Earning Your Salt
entries.how:
I will study the orb and tell you what I learn, but you must first do something for me.

The warlocks of the Blackrock clan use specially prepared salts to enhance their summoning rituals. Collect some from the orcs in Redridge.

When you return, I will share with you the results of my studies.

entries.name: It Must Be Destroyed
entries.how:
The tendrils of sentience reaching out from this orb are too much for even an experienced warlock like myself to withstand for long. I am reluctant to admit this, {name}, but the orb must be destroyed.

The orb is nearly impervious, but it may be vulnerable to the weapon of a powerful demon lord. I have heard that such a blade is present in Ashenvale--at the site where the pit lord Mannoroth was destroyed.

Gather motes of the fallen demon's essence there, then shatter the orb upon the blade.

entries.name: Return to Delgren
entries.how: <The shattered remains of the orb lay at your feet. Delgren will want to see you have succeeded.>

entries.name: The Broken Hammer
entries.how:
<An ornate broken warhammer lies surrounded by dead Burning Blade Cultists and Scarlet Crusade warriors. A fight clearly happened here, and fairly recently. You also recognize this as the weapon of a paladin of the Order of the Silver Hand. 

While you've seen many hammers like this one, the quality and worksmanship of this weapon is fairly unique. You should search the area for clues, and return to Katherine with the broken hammer.>

entries.name: A Lost Brother
entries.how:
<Katherine winces as she holds the shattered fragments of the broken hammer> 

I won't speak of this weapon's master in detail for the telling would fill me with shame, but I'll tell you what I can.

entries.name: Orders from the Grand Crusader
entries.how:
This appears to be orders from the Grand Crusader of the Scarlet Crusade himself, Dathrohan. It seems that Aeonas has run afoul of the Crusade. Judging by the scene before you, it appears that the Crusade was able to follow Aeonas here and apprehend him. It appears that he did not go down without a fight.

The charges levied against Aeonas are grave, but that would explain some of the scene you came upon in Desolace.

entries.name: A Brother In Need
entries.how: Due to the... unfortunate nature of why he left the order, it would be bad comedy for Aeonas to die at the hands of the Scarlet Crusade now. The Crusade is an organization of zealots and lunatics and they've been growing increasingly brazen in their willingness to commit violence against anyone who they imagine to be enemies of the light. Go to the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades and find out if Aeonas still lives.

entries.name: By The Light's Grace
entries.how: <Aeonas needs immediate healing or he will die. Call upon the light and save him.>

entries.name: Aeonas the Vindicated
entries.how:
Thank you for saving me, {class}. It seems that I'm not as young as I once was, and I think I'm going to need allies for what is to come. Please, meet me in Stormwind in the Cathedral of Light as soon as you are able.

Don't worry about me, I can find my way out of here on my own. I just need a few moments to recover my strength

entries.name: Some Good News
entries.how: Greetings, {name}. I have good news. I've made contact with my friend, and I am leaving soon to meet with him. What's more, another orb has surfaced in Kalimdor.  I cannot be in two places at once so if you are willing, I'd like for you to go in my stead to follow up on this new orb. Speak with Katherine for further instructions.

entries.name: The Mysterious Merchant
entries.how:
Well met again, {name}. Shaw and his spies have provided us with information on a mysterious merchant who just arrived in Kalimdor and is looking to offload a collection of dangerous artifacts. We've come to believe that he has an Echoing Orb in his collection. He is staying at the Theramore Inn in Dustwallow Marsh. Travel quickly, retrieve the orb, and speak to no one of this. We are sending you in alone to avoid drawing the attention of our enemies. 

Be safe, and go with the light.

entries.name: Elrick, Paladin of the Silver Hand
entries.how: <The Paladin standing before you is not known to you. Speak with him to determine what he knows of the merchant and the current situation.>

entries.name: The Bloody Missive
entries.how:
<You find a missive on the body of the "paladin". It is covered in blood and difficult to read, but you can make out the message on the parchment.

It's clear upon reading the note that this entire venture to find the "merchant" was a trap. You should return to Katherine for further instructions.>

entries.name: Materials of Significance
entries.how:
Each of the Echoing Orbs is attuned to a different aspect of its master. The method you used in Ashenvale to destroy the Althalaxx Orb will not be effective on the orb we possess. I know of a ritual that may be able to destabilize the orb and allow us to destroy it, but it requires components with specific magical significance. We already possess some of the required materials, but you'll need to retrieve the rest. 

Take this, it should help you in your search.

entries.name: The Ritual
entries.how:
I wanted to thank you for your efforts, {name}. Without you, I'd likely be dead and the servants of the legion would still have possession of this dangerous artifact. I know its difficult to trust an agent of the Lich King, but it is my hope that after this is over we can sway my friend back to the light. It's clear that the man I cared for is still in there. He may only need a nudge.

Come now, we are needed by Gregory to help him complete the ritual. Let us speak again when it's done.

entries.name: Forging the Mightstone
entries.how:
Now we must combine the inert scourgestones and create a weapon to shatter the ranks of undead.  This is no trivial task, {name}.  Only the trolls of the sunken temple carry the kind of rare magic able to turn the evil of something against itself.

In the temple, the trolls are known as Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro.  Do not feel remorse for their corrupt souls... they are not without evil.

entries.name: The Price of Hope
entries.how: <Aeonas says nothing, he merely hands you the orb and turns away>

entries.name: In a Bind
entries.how:
You nearly scared me to death! I heard you coming and was convinced the dead had finally sniffed me out! All the same, you are a sight for sore eyes. 

Please, I need to escape this place and find my master, Sir Dalton. May you retrieve my weapon for me? It was torn from my grip in the field outside and I was forced to flee into this barn.

entries.name: The Fallen Knight
entries.how:
You say you found his... body? No... my lord cannot be dead. Our work is not yet finished.

I... thank you, {class}. I'm struggling to shake off the shock of it, but I am glad that you were the one to find him.

It seems that his quest now falls to me. First however, I must return to his body and burn it lest he become the very thing he sought to destroy. If I may impose upon you once more, would you please lead me to the place where Sir Dalton fell?

entries.name: A Lesson in Violence
entries.how: Your technique is very interesting,{name}. A bit rougher around the edges than Sir Dalton, but it has a more "worldly" quality to it that I feel suits me well. Thank you so much, I've already learned so much from you!

entries.name: Clearing the Path
entries.how: The pounding in my head has subsided somewhat, but I don't think I can fight my way out of here on my own yet. I hate to ask more of you, but could you help thin the ranks and clear a path for me to make my escape?

entries.name: Rowan's Quest
entries.how: <Squire Cuthbert stares blankly at the spot where Rowan's body burns. He is clearly in a kind of shock. You can tell that he is no fit state to continue on whatever quest he and his mentor set out to complete. Perhaps you should speak with him and see if you can be of more aid?>

entries.name: A Lesson in Grace
entries.how: Your technique is very interesting,{name}. A bit rougher around the edges than Sir Dalton, but it has a more "worldly" quality to it that I feel suits me well. Thank you so much, I've already learned so much from you!

entries.name: A Time to Kill
entries.how:
I feel that I've learned so much in so short a time. I don't think anyone could ever truly be ready to face what I intend to face, but I feel as ready as I'll ever be. What say you, {name}? Shall we go and end this fight? 

I'm not sure where to begin, but I suspect we'll find clues somewhere in the Eastern Plaguelands. We should probably start in areas where the Cult of the Damned congregates.

entries.name: Close Enough To Touch
entries.how:
These vile necromancers and their tricks, it's disgusting. We must find a way to break through the barrier protecting Arkonos to end him!

Many Cult of the Damned and Scourge spellcasters are known to carry a variety of fell implements and foci of dark magic. Perhaps some of the nearby Shadowmages or Dread Weavers may have something we could use to penetrate the shield?

entries.name: Finish the Fight
entries.how:
This might just be it, {name}. Dalton long studied the Cult of the Damned, and taught me of a number of blessings to use to thwart their magics. Thanks to your diligence in finishing my training, I believe I am now strong enough to impart such a benediction upon this device to purify its magic and use it to disrupt the barrier surrounding Akronos. 

Come, let us burn down that coward's shield and end him once and for all!

entries.name: Oi!
entries.how:
Oi! {class}! Yes, ye! Ye did me a solid by smashing up that depressin' mess of a meatsuit I've been riding in all these years, but I dinnae feel much of a pull to move on. I'm expectin' it's because I got some "Unfinished Business" to get up to 'afore I can be on me way. Well dull-wit, ye just been conscripted to help!

I need ye to fetch me hammer. Should be somewhere in Corrin's Crossing and it'll be hard to miss. 

Oi, take this too. It's me favorite gold tooth. Give it a rub when you've found me weapon.

entries.name: Oh No Ye Don't!
entries.how:
Great job with the hammer, {class}. Next up is me armor. Definitely need that back to move on to the great beyond.

Only problem is it's in the eh... innards o' one of them abominations. I know, I know, it's askin' a lot, but ye gotta understand I was once a mighty thane under the mountain! I simply can't move on knowin' that the ancestral armor of me clan is dissolving in the gutjuice of a giant rotting mountain o' meat!

entries.name: A Wee Bit O' Necromancy
entries.how:
So ye see, we need to find a suitable Dwarf corpse and do a bit o' ritual to em' to get my spirit grounded so I can be sent on me way! All perfectly normal stuff, o' course! We'll also need a bit o' Necrotic Runestone from a necromancer type, of course. There's one in Stratholme that goes by Maleki the Pallid. Can't expect he'll be too willin' to part with it willingly but there's a solve for that!

Get me that stone and then head to the undercroft. There's a corpse there that'll do!

entries.name: A Thane's Gratitude
entries.how:
<You hear a disembodied voice in your head as you touch the small chest> 

Can't be thankin' ye enough, {name}. Not how ye'd be expecting it to turn out, no doubt! Just so you aren't too sour about it, I've got something for ye that I've no more use for that I think ye might find useful.

Good luck to ye, {name}. Ah, one last thing... if ye happen to see a giant floating necropolis in the distance someday soon, I'd be turnin' tail and runnin' if I were ye. Hah!

entries.name: Send Me On Me Way
entries.how:
<You hear the disembodied voice of Orthas in your mind>

'Ere we are then. Let's get on with it, shall we?

entries.name: The Missing Knight
entries.how:
A knight named Rowan and his squire named Cuthbert have been operating out of this camp for some time now, investigating scourge activity in the area and helping us out here and there. They set out to Dalson's Tears some days ago geared up for a fight, and they've not yet returned. I fear the worst for them. If your travels take you that way, please keep an eye out for them.

It's not much to go on, but hopefully you can find them and if they are still alive and lend them aid in some way.

entries.name: UNUSED
entries.how: You should return to Katherine and let her know that the Orb seems to have been destroyed. This is undoubtedly good news, but you can't help feel uneasy. Who could have not only broken into one of the most heavily fortified places in Azeroth, but also do what many others could not and destroy the orb.

entries.name: Our Wayward Friend
entries.how:
I can't be certain where Aeonas is, so you may consider retracing your steps from where you last saw him. 

Please do hurry. We need to know if he is involved in what happened at the vault, or if he might be able to help identify who was. We can't be sure of the intentions of whomever was responsible and the more we can learn, the better.

entries.name: The Ruins of Andorhal
entries.how:
Remains such as the one you carry tend to have mysterious properties. Some particularly powerful relics may even seem sentient or have a personality at times, particularly in proximity to individuals and places closely tied to their living selves. 

If this truly is Uther's blood, there is a chance it may react when near to the place Uther died. Explore the town and see what happens.

entries.name: A Questionable Apology
entries.how:
You don't look as surprised to see me as I would have expected. I suppose it's not so easy to kill that which has no life, and you've had plenty of interactions with the undead in your travels. No matter, I am glad you are here and haven't yet tried to harm me. 

I've done a lot of soul searching since our last encounter and I have a desire to start fresh with you, if you would be willing. Of course you will need assurances. Let us speak further and perhaps I can set your mind at ease.

entries.name: UNUSED
entries.how: It's clear to me that I was misguided in the execution of the previous ritual, and I'd not rush to repeat that mistake. That said, the ritual was a success in its own way and having applied what I learned from my earlier failure to destroy the Mannoroc Orb makes me believe I can replicate the process with a bit less pointless sacrifice. Let us speak further about what will be required. I'll warn you however, to complete this task you may need an army.

entries.name: UNUSED
entries.how: I believe that we have what we need for you to dispel the wards that Balnazzar has put in place and face the empowered dreadlord in his lair. Be warned, the demon's power has grown truly terrifying, and it will take all of your skill an determination to defeat him.  Speak with me when you are ready and I will tell you what you need to do.

entries.name: Culmination
entries.how: Once we begin the ritual, I can't be sure what will happen. This place is crawling with demons and if they detect our ritual, we may need to defend ourselves. You and Ada will need to focus on that while I channel the spell. Please stay close however, as you yourself are a vital part of this magic.

entries.name: Worst Case Scenario
entries.how:
Time is now against us. The dreadlord mentioned Demon Fall Canyon, so the good news is we know where they are headed. The bad news is that we've likely strengthened Azgaloth's anchor to Azeroth with our failed ritual. Even if we slay Azgaloth now, he would soon manifest himself again.

I have an idea. It's desperate, but it might be our only hope. There's someone in Andorhal with a very particular set of skills that might be able to help, but we'll need to build some trust with her first.

entries.name: A Most Curious Gnome
entries.how:
What we need to finish this mission exists right here in Andorhal, it just isn't here right now. 

The room behind me contains a "gnome" named Chromie. She's a rather curious creature who is is known to utilize a very  special type of draconic magic. Time magic, in point of fact.

If we could convince her to use her magic to help us, we might be able to reach through time briefly and get what we need. It's a gambit, but it just might be our only option. See if you can convince her to lend us her aid.

entries.name: Making Ready
entries.how:
Demons invading and death rituals! That all sounds very scary. Luckily this handy little time bubble we are standing in makes connecting ourselves to a specific point in time at this location easy.

This will be dangerous, though. When you and your friend are ready, say the word.

entries.name: A Paladin of the Silver Hand
entries.how:
I said that I don't believe in fate, but I don't know if that was entirely true. My perspective has changed so much since my mortal life ended, but the longer I spend on this mission, the more I start to see patterns and connections in things. I think you know this already, but its Aeonas that has to go with you.

Believe me when I say I'd like nothing more than to leave my old friend in peace, but this is bigger than what I want. Go to Uther's Tomb and explain the situation.

entries.name: Who Says You Can Never Go Back?
entries.how:
The portal is ready.

Once you enter, you'll be transported to Andorhal, just after it fell.  In order to help you blend in a bit better, I've prepared some magical disguises for you. These will do for most of the denizens of the past but you'll still want to be careful to not get noticed. When you have what you need just make your way back to this place in the past. The portal should be waiting for you.

entries.name: UNUSED
entries.how:
I've spent enough time studying the events that transpired here that I feel very confident that I can open a portal to the moments just after Uther fell. You go in, get what you need, and get out before you, well... ruin the timeline and kill us all. I cannot stress enough how critical it is that you limit your interactions with any others in the past, living or unliving. The consequences could be catastrophic. 

Consult your allies and prepare yourself, then speak with me when you are ready to go.

entries.name: The Burning of Andorhal
entries.how:
I can't be sure what is waiting for us in there, but it won't be good. 

We need to get in, locate the place where Uther fell and see if we can gather a few drops of his blood. From there, we need to make our way back to the inn on the west side of town and make good our escape. We should hurry, but we also need to make sure we approach this with care and respect, as my lord Uther deserves. The thought of disturbing him where he fell makes me deeply uncomfortable.

Let's get this over with.

entries.name: UNUSED DNT
entries.how:
I confess, I am conflicted. I know we aren't supposed to interfere but... think of what we could change? How different would things be if Uther had survived this encounter? If Arthas had fallen before he reached Icecrown and took the mantle of the Lich King? 

I... don't know what to do.

entries.name: A Desperate Escape
entries.how:
The undead have broken through and infested the west side of the city. This is going to be hard fighting, {name}. Time is against us now, so we should avoid the areas thickest with scourge. 

Oh, I almost forgot, take this. If we somehow become separated, sound the horn and I'll make my way back to you.

entries.name: Back to the Future
entries.how:
<Aeonas winces. He is gravely wounded>  I think... this is as far as I go, {name}. It's... okay. This is... always where I belonged. I am happy to be here, with my friends... at the end.

Here, take this. I forged this... to remind me. To ensure that I'd never forget the friends I lost here and that I'd always stay true to them. That's even what I called it... Truthbearer. 

Give it to Gregory for me. Perhaps it can help him remember more of who he is. I think you see it too... he's... changed. 

I...

entries.name: The Cost of Victory
entries.how:
Thank you... for bringing me this. The blade is consecrated and will cause me considerable pain to wield, but that seems a small sacrifice to make for my... my friend.

Grief comes later. For now, it's time to end this. Gather your most trusted allies and go to Demon Fall Canyon. Azgaloth may not reveal himself to you immediately, but if you issue a suitable challenge, he will answer. 

Take the blood and use it to consecrate your weapon and destroy him. For Aeonas, and for Ada, it's time to end this.

entries.name: Truthbearer
entries.how:
Aeonas managed to see it far before I did. He saw how I've changed while on this mission. I actually feel... sadness, regret, love once again. Sadness for Ada, regret for my betrayal, and love for my friend.  I don't know exactly what this means, but I do know that I can't go back to Northrend. 

Lordaeron, perhaps? Perhaps there are others like me there. Those that fell from the light... and are slowly finding their way back to it.  Maybe I can help them like my friend helped me.

entries.name: UNUSED
entries.how: I would speak with you one last time before I depart. Please, meet me once more near the bridge to Andorhal in Sorrow Hill. We shall reflect on what transpired, and Aeonas' sacrifice to win us this victory.

entries.name: UNUSED
entries.how:
You have heard of the stronghold of the Black Dragonflight known as the Blackwing Lair, yes? The Lord of Blackrock has employed an army of alchemists and fleshcrafters to create draconic abominations wielding the power of all five dragonflights. The eyes of dragons are oft used as potent foci in magical spells, so if we were able to secure the flawless eye of such a chromatic beast, we may be able to use it counterract the wards within Strathholme. 

If you find such an item, return it to me.

entries.name: The Blood of the Lightbringer
entries.how: <Your hand trembles slightly as you hold the small vial of blood. Aside from the inscription on the label, you can feel a warmth and energy radiating from the sample. Could this truly be the blood of the legendary hero, Uther the Lightbringer? You should find someone who can verify the authenticity of this relic.>

entries.name: Just What Was Needed
entries.how:
I can already tell that you intend to bring the blood to Gregory. Good. My judgement has been questionable at best, and this was always a younger paladin's game that I've just been playing at.

I'm still not sure of how to feel, but I'm certainly happy to see that you've grown into the paladin you were always meant to be.

entries.name: Darkwhisper Gorge
entries.how:
This is... incredible. I'm far too pragmatic to believe in fate, but this is certainly a fortuitous turn of events. With this, I think we have everything we need to finish the ritual and destroy the orb for good. As with any good ritual, location is key. Are you familiar with Darkwhisper Gorge in Winterspring? It's an accursed, demon-infested place, but that is where we must go to finish this. 

I will gather the orb and the remaining materials and meet you there. The end of my mission is near at hand!

entries.name: Our Wayward Friend
entries.how:
I'm glad you are here, {name}. We've got word that a traveler matching the description of our friend Aeonas has been seen near Chillwind Camp, heading in the direction of Sorrow Hill. 

After what happened in felwood I wanted to give him space  but there are those in the order who still distrust him, and at some point he's going to need to come in from the cold to explain why he withheld his prolonged involvement with a known agent of the Lich King. Go and find him, see if you can convince him to come in.

entries.name: Our Wayward Friend
entries.how:
You look like you've grown strong since last we met. I'm very glad. If there's anything I've done right in my life, its saving your life in Felwood and that is a comfort to me.

Anyway, best be getting going back to Katherine now, unless there was anything else you needed to ask me?

entries.name: Grand Theft Echoing Orb
entries.how: Please make your way over to the southeastern area of the canals and speak with the Vaultkeeper there, Julien Faranister. He can tell you what he knows. Learn what you can about the crime. There were a lot of people who would have wanted to steal that orb, so gathering as much information as we can now while the crime scene is fresh is vital.

entries.name: A Solid Lead
entries.how:
This is undoubtedly a burning blade medallion, which suggests legion cult involvement. As for where to start, you might try to head over to the taverns in the city and try to shake down some of the more unsavory types for information.  

It's not much, but its a start.

entries.name: Plaguelands Rendezvous
entries.how:
Of course I expected you to find me here. Why do you think I left those cultist's corpses for you to find in that vault? 

Before you get too worked up; yes the orb is safe. More safe than this city, apparently. If I had entered the vault just a few moments later the orb would have been long gone.

I've said enough for now and this tavern has ears. Find me on the Island of Caer Darrow in Western Plaguelands. You'll get answers when you arrive.

entries.name: Rediscovering the Light
entries.how:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.

entries.name: Coming to Terms
entries.how:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.

entries.name: Continue Your Training
entries.how:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.

entries.name: A Second Home
entries.how:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery on the edge of the Whispering Woods. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.

entries.name: Murlocs at the Gates
entries.how:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.

entries.name: Touring the Grounds
entries.how:
Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.

When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.

I'm very glad to have met you, {name}. May the light be your guide.

entries.name: Making Repairs
entries.how:
This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.

entries.name: The Tarnished
entries.how:
Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.

entries.name: Diplomatic Incident
entries.how:
A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.

A pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.

We have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.

entries.name: A Curious Pair
entries.how:
Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.

Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.

entries.name: A Grim Fate
entries.how:
Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.

If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, it's a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.

I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.

entries.name: Into Fenris Keep
entries.how: <The fact that you found only one body is a hopeful sign. Perhaps the High Elf that Trevan and Hadrec described is still alive somewhere deeper inside the nearby fortress?>

entries.name: Lumina Windsinger
entries.how:
Quel'dorei? No, I am no "quel'dorei". I am Lumina Windsinger and I am shen'dorei. One of the Windshaper Skyborne.

I came to these lands as a guest of the Earthen Ring. My companion Banon and I were passing through Silverpine to reach the Arathi Highlands so that we could study the elemental convergences there. Clearly, we didn't make it.

We have no time for this now though. Kill the gnolls nearby. Retrieve the key to this cage and free me. I will tell you the rest once we are safely away.

entries.name: A Lesson in Divinity
entries.how:
A key tenent of being a paladin is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.

Go to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.

entries.name: A Lesson in Divinity
entries.how:
Wait, you want to... help? Why would a paladin want to help a beggar like me?

Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance. 

It's my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.

entries.name: A Lesson in Divinity
entries.how: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, {class}.

entries.name: A Lesson in Divinity
entries.how:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true paladin can do.

entries.name: A Lesson in Divinity
entries.how:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.

entries.name: A Lesson in Divinity
entries.how:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush. 

You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.

entries.name: A Lesson in Divinity
entries.how:
Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Bandarion Keep performed for us. 

You have a lot of promise as a paladin, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, {name}.

entries.name: A Paladin's Steed
entries.how:
One of the most important parts of a paladin's arsenal has always been their warhorse. These specially consecrated animals bear paladins and their arms into battle, and are as fearless and bold as the best of us.

While our situation has changed, our need for steeds to bear us into battle has not. It's time that you had such a mount for yourself.

entries.name: The Debt
entries.how:
I think you should know that it wasn't actually the Gnolls who attacked us on the road.

We were actually attacked by a giant, wolf-like creature that I now know as a "worgen". It dispatched our guards and came for me, but Banon threw himself in its path. I managed to get a spell off which startled the creature, causing it to flee, but Banon was already badly bitten. He insisted I leave him there but I refused.

We were limping back here when the gnolls found us. What came next was terrifying...

entries.name: A Moon-Kissed Blade
entries.how:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.

entries.name: Seeking the Kor Gem
entries.how:
A Forsaken paladin... here in Ashenvale? Amusing. 

So you seek a Kor Gem? Unsurprising as these are sometimes employed to empower magical weapons and implements by the paladins of the Alliance. Why should a fallen paladin like you be any different?

If you truly desire one of the gems, then you must head north to the ruins known as Blackfathom Deeps. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, {class}.

entries.name: An Underrated Talent
entries.how:
In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well-known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.

I'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.

entries.name: Ott's Masterwork
entries.how:
These are some truly fine materials, {class}. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.

entries.name: The Moonsilver Blade
entries.how: Here's the blade. You said that a paladin named Trevan sent you? Please extend my thanks to him for this opportunity when you next see him. Go with honor, friend.

entries.name: Old Fire-Eye
entries.how:
I see that you have your weapon now, {class}. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.

entries.name: Where's The Squire?
entries.how: <There is no sign of the squire named Cuthbert anywhere near the fallen knight's body. The knight has not been dead long. It's possible the squire could still be somewhere nearby.>

entries.name: A Token of Good Faith
entries.how:
Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.

Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.

entries.name: The Windshaper's Wrath
entries.how:
Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, {class}.

entries.name: Battle at the Mannoroc Coven
entries.how:
{name}, I need your aid. One of our brothers passing through Nigel's Point in Desolace overheard details of a battle that took place at the Mannoroc Coven. It was reported that one side brought powerful holy magic to bear in the battle against the warlocks there. Wielders of the light were certainly involved.

I'd like to learn more of who was involved in this skirmish. If one of our people was involved--or fell there... I want to know about it.

entries.name: Aeonas's Secret Refuge
entries.how:
Come to think on it, I do know of a secluded spot far to the south of here. Someone once told me it was called Newman's Landing, though don't ask me who this "Newman" is. You should start looking for Ol' Aeonas there.

You are welcome to make use of my old dingy moored just over yonder just past the northernmost dock. She isn't much, but she'll get you there faster than swimming.

I do hope nothin' happened to him. I'd rest easier if you went and checked on our friend.

entries.name: In Search of Aeonas
entries.how: Aeonas mentioned something about Felwood, so it's possible that's where he is. There's a small settlement in the southern portion of the woods there known as the Emerald Sanctuary. I'd suggest asking around there to see if anyone has seen him.

entries.name: (UNUSED - DO NOT TRANSLATE) A Night in the Woods
entries.how:
The paladin that left his horse here asked about the best way to reach the ridge above bloodvenom falls. I thought he was quite mad for asking, but I told him what I told you, the best and only way is up a sharply inclined rock mountainside.

He was undeterred by this and set out shortly after and just before sundown, I might add. Pushing forward after dark in these woods is... bold. That was yesterday and we've not seen him since.

entries.name: Report to Danitha
entries.how: Danitha Morr has ordered you to report back to Bandarion Keep to receive additional training. Please make your way back to the keep as quickly as you are able.

entries.name: A Worthy Endeavor
entries.how:
The time has come, {name}. As in life, paladins of the Forsaken are not complete until they are able to form a bond with a charger. This is no ordinary steed, this is a powerful spirit of retribution. 

Speak with Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep to learn more. She will guide you on what to do next. The road before you will be difficult, but as our orc allies like to say--blood and thunder brother!

entries.name: Due Sacrifice
entries.how:
No worthy endeavor is completed without some sacrifice, and this first task requires just that.

You must acquire High Priest Zayus's exorcism censer for your task. Even though its use will be for good reason, due compensation must be given for it.

Proceed to Orgrimmar and speak with the High Priest Zayus there. Zayus will seek a..."donation" for the loss of his censer. It will be a small price to pay when all is said and done.

entries.name: Exorcising Terrordale
entries.how:
I have added some dirt from the tainted ground of Terrordale in the Eastern Plaguelands to the censer. Go there and use this censer to find areas with the greatest signs of corruption. You'll know these areas by the green necrotic auras that rise up from the ground at the location where tormented souls congregate.

Use the censer to reveal these spirits. Free them from their torment. When you have put these souls to rest, return and we will discuss the next steps.

entries.name: Acts of Mercy
entries.how:
With the blessings of the loa, take the censer. I be usin' it more than once to exorcise bad voodoo spirits, and it should serve ya well for the trials what be comin'.

You best be headin' back to Danitha now, {name}. Ya quest continues with her.

entries.name: Ott of Tarren Mill
entries.how:
A paladin's charger needs a proper barding or it is little more than a mindless beast. The barding used by your charger not only needs to be of the finest materials possible, but must also be suitable for attunement to the spirit realm.

There is a smith outside of Tarren Mill that has done great work for our paladins in the past. He is a modest and unassuming orc, but his work is superb and is well-suited to our needs. Seek him out and commission him for this task.

entries.name: Collection of Goods
entries.how:
We require several things for the barding--runecloth for the lining, arcanite bars for the plating, Arthas' Tears for the spiritual attunement, and Stratholme holy water for the spiritual imbuement. Lastly, I'd charge a modest fee for the labor and for the saddle and stirrups to go with the barding.

Bring me these materials, and I will be able to complete your barding. I'll get to work on the saddle while you work on gathering these items.

entries.name: Ott's Finest Work
entries.how:
<Ott wipes the sweat from his brow and grunts at his work approvingly.>

There you are. My trade is mostly in the creation of weapons, but I believe that this might be some of my finest work nonetheless. I thank you for the trust you and your fellow paladins have shown me.

No doubt Danitha Morr will want to see the work for herself as well. Take your barding to her, and give her my thanks for allowing me to complete this commission on your behalf.

Lok-tar, {class}.

entries.name: An Offering of Vengeance
entries.how:
A paladin charger's barding requires the blessing of a powerful equine spirit. In the ruins of Dire Maul the corrupted treant known as Tendris Warpwood has such a spirit imprisoned. Seek retribution on behalf of this spirit, and free it from its bondage. With luck, it may be willing to provide its blessing. 

To help ensure success, I'd also advise you to bring a special type of spiritually-attuned feed. Travel to Eastern Plaguelands and speak with the ranger known as Nathanos Blightcaller about this.

entries.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
entries.how:
As the barding rests on the back of the Ancient Equine Spirit, it glows white hot. The air is thick with power for a brief moment, and then the barding disappears from the back of the horse and is now secure in your backpack.

Even through the leather of your satchel, you feel the heat still coming off of the saddle. It would seem that your offering of vengeance has been accepted, and the barding has been blessed. It's time to return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.

entries.name: The Divination Scryer
entries.how:
We now must assemble a Divination Scryer that will be vital for your final trial. The exorcism censer you used in Terrordale is the catalyst for it, and I should be able to fashion a suitable housing for the scrying device.

The last components needed, though, are two diamonds--one white, one black. This represents the duality of our nature as paladins of The Forsaken. These two will be the beacon by which the scryer will pierce the veil between the living and the dead.

entries.name: Justice and Retribution
entries.how:
In this satchel you will find the items you will need for your trial. Use the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to bring forth accursed spirits to face justice. The power of your judgements will be extremely valuable in this battle, so use them wisely.

Once you have dispersed these spirits, Darkreaver will appear. Defeat him and claim the lost soul of the charger. Show it the path of justice and retribution that you walk and with luck, it will take its place at your side.

entries.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
entries.how:
So you need feed to give to the incorporeal spirit of a horse? Interesting.

Yes, I suppose I can help you with what you need. I have spent a considerable amount of time rearing beasts that are... let's say--no longer entirely of this world, and I know a thing or two about how to sustain them.

I simply need some of the spiritually-enriched biscuits that the Argent Dawn sells... and a small offering of gold. For my time, of course.

entries.name: The Errant Knight
entries.how:
Welcome back, {name}. I have an assignment for you. There have been rumors spreading that a Forsaken paladin bearing a striking resemblance to my old friend Garek Bandarion has been seen fighting the scourge in the plaguelands.

The main problem with that is that Garek Bandarion is dead. Regardless of this paladin's true identity, he may need the aid and support of more of his kind. Go to the Bulwark and ask after this knight. Find him, and bring him in from the cold.

entries.name: The Errant Knight
entries.how:
Yeah, it was him. Bandarion. 

I seen him swinging that sword of his in the battle for the Undercity few years back. I'd know that Forsaken anywhere, I swear it. Don't take my word for it though, go and find him yourself. He was riding hard for Dalson's Tears to the east not more than a few hours ago.

entries.name: The Errant Knight
entries.how: As you continue to inspect the ghoul's remains you notice a set of heavy tracks leading away from the site of the battle.

entries.name: The Errant Knight
entries.how: The note appears to be a set of orders, referring to a captive that sounds much like the Forsaken you are pursuing. These men apparently ambushed the paladin and overpowered him. It appears that your quarry was not destroyed, and is now being held at a scarlet crusade camp nearby.

entries.name: The Errant Knight
entries.how:
Also, No. I am not Garek Bandarion. If I were such a hero as he, I daresay this trouble wouldn't have befallen me. My name is Xander Salsbury and I am, or I was, a squire training to be a paladin before... well, before I was what we are now. Forsaken.

As for my equipment, well... that's a long story. For now we should leave this place. Please help me escape, and we can speak further on this after we reach safety.

entries.name: The Errant Knight
entries.how:
So it was not Bandarion. I am not surprised but I do confess that I did have some small, vain hope that he was alive. Impossible, I know, but I couldn't help but wish for it. 

I only wish this forsaken you met would have come to us to begin with. He surely... 

Wait--it seems he has arrived.

entries.name: A Difficult Path
entries.how:
While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine it's of some importance to a paladin like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.

entries.name: The Reliquary of Tyr
entries.how:
You may not be a Knight of Lordaeron--though perhaps you are, in a way. However, a Paladin you remain... and you know the power of an oath.

The Blackmaw are powerful totemics, and they would recognize the power of such an artifact as the Reliquary. Undoubtedly, they still possess it.

Thusly I'd ask this of you now--finish the quest I started. Return the Reliquary of Tyr here to Tirisfal Glades where it belongs. Only then will my oath be discharged, and my spirit may move on from this world.

entries.name: Speak with Jennea
entries.how:
We mages have a task that needs doing.  One that is vital to the safety of Stormwind and Elwynn forest.

Jennea Cannon has the details.  She studies in the wizard's sanctum, in the mage district of Stormwind.  You should make your way to her with haste.

entries.name: Mirror Lake
entries.how:
This world has been victim to massive mystic struggles, which tore magic currents from once stable channels.  We struggle to determine the effects these changes have caused, and some of us fear the worst!

But I will reveal more of this later.  Right now, we need you to gather information.

Here, take this flask.  Go to the base of the waterfall at Mirror Lake, southwest of the Stormwind gates, and retrieve a sample of the water there.  Return it to me so that I might test it for magical taints.

entries.name: Speak with Bink
entries.how:
{name}!  Bink, my gnome colleague in Ironforge, sends word.  She has a task that needs doing and won't rely on anyone but a mage to do it!  Are you that mage, {name}?

If so, then speak with Bink.  She spends her time in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.

entries.name: Mage-tastic Gizmonitor
entries.how:
We mages do more than just waggle our fingers and make pretty sparks!  We control magic, the base fabric of our world!  And that takes great care, and resolve.  And knowledge... so much knowledge!

One of my devices, the mage-tastic gizmonitor, collects and stores that knowledge in huge amounts!  But it's lost!  When we fled our home of Gnomeregan, I left it in a chest in one of our huts outside the city, and now the place is crawling with leper gnomes!

Please, {name}, retrieve my gizmonitor!

entries.name: Speak with Anastasia
entries.how: {name}, Anastasia Hartwell has a task for someone of your talents.  Speak with her in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, and prepare yourself for your first task for the mages of the Forsaken.

entries.name: The Balnir Farmstead
entries.how:
The Plaguelands to the east are an aberration.  Devised by the Lich King, they spread their magic into the soil, corrupting and killing all that live.  Although there is a certain charm to the destructive forces of the plague, we, the mages of the Forsaken, believe it is unruly and must be curtailed.

But first, we must measure how far it has spread into Tirisfal.  Go to the Balnir Farmstead in eastern Tirisfal.  In the garden are flowers--snapdragons.  Gather these and return.

entries.name: Speak with Un'thuwa
entries.how:
Un'thuwa, tribal mage of Sen'jin Village, detects a disturbance in the magic currents of Durotar and asks for aid.  Speak with Un'thuwa and do what you can to help him.

Do this, and in time further secrets will be revealed to you.

entries.name: Ju-Ju Heaps
entries.how:
The warlock Zalazane of the Echo Isles has disrupted the normal flow of magic in Durotar.  He does this through tainted fetishes, ju-ju heaps, which he has placed among his huts on the main Echo Isle.

These heaps corrupt our wildlife and give power to the warlocks and infernal creatures that lurk in the land's dark corners.

You must destroy the ju-ju heaps, {name}, before the flow of magic is forever altered.

entries.name: Report to Jennea
entries.how:
Your knowledge of the craft grows, young {name}.  Are you now ready to begin your true lessons?  Are you ready to take your place in the secret war we wage?

If so, then speak with Jennea Cannon, in the wizard's sanctum in the mage district of Stormwind.  She has a task for you which will open your first window into the invisible world.

entries.name: Investigate the Blue Recluse
entries.how:
A disturbance has been reported at the Blue Recluse tavern in the Mage Quarter.  Strange, invisible creatures now wander the tavern, and I fear a mana rift has formed there.

I want you to investigate the tavern and capture those creatures.  Use the cantation of manifestation in the tavern to make the creatures visible, subdue them then use a containment coffer to capture them.  When you have enough, return to me with your filled coffers, your empty coffers and the cantation.

entries.name: Gathering Materials
entries.how:
You have served your fellow mages well, and now it is time to don your wizard's robe.  Wynne Larson can make your robe, but you must bring her the needed materials  

The robe will be made of linen which is easy to find, but you must also gain charged rift gems, and the only known location of the gems is in the Silver Stream Mine of Loch Modan, left in crates by the dwarven miners' league.

Gather the linen and the gems and bring them to Wynne Larson at the Larson Clothiers in the Mage District.

entries.name: Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic
entries.how:
Long ago, three mages studied in this tower until one fell to the dark arts.  He was urged to turn away from that evil magic, but he could not resist.  And so he was banished.

The fallen mage's new domain is the tower of Ilgalar in Redridge, and he took with him a powerful book--Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic.

We, the mages of Stormwind, would have that book returned.  Enter the tower of Ilgalar, find the tome in his library, and bring it to me.

entries.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
entries.how:
High Sorcerer Andromath wishes to speak with you, {name}.  He is at the top of the wizard's sanctum, in the mage's district of Stormwind.

It would be wise to speak with him, for Andromath is one of the most powerful mages not locked away in Dalaran.  Council with him is high council indeed.

entries.name: Pristine Spider Silk
entries.how:
Your service has been unwavering, {name}.  I think, perhaps, it is time you had a finer garment, one more suiting your station as an adept mage.  If you gather the needed materials, then we will arrange the robe made.

You must enter Duskwood and hunt carrion recluse spiders.  Extract their silk, but only the finest, most pristine silk will do.  When you have enough, take it to Wynne Larson, here in the mage district at the Larson Clothiers.  She will craft your robe.

entries.name: Speak with Deino
entries.how: The troll mage Deino has need of your assistance, {name}.  She resides in Orgrimmar, in the Darkbriar Lodge.

entries.name: Waters of Xavian
entries.how:
The fabled city of Xavian lies nestled deep within eastern Ashenvale, and tales of its ancient knowledge are well known among the learned.  It is said that the waters of Xavian hold vast magical powers.

I would have a sample of those waters, from their source.

Take this flask and go to Xavian.  Gather water from the bottom of its highest waterfall, and return to me.  And use care as you move through that ancient city--satyrs now hold the ruins and do not like mages prying into their affairs.

entries.name: Laughing Sisters
entries.how:
For your services, I have arranged for the creation of your new robes, provided you can gather the needed materials...

For these robes, you must return to Ashenvale for the locks of hair from laughing sisters--dryads who gather near the Raynewood Retreat.

When you have their hair, bring it to Kil'hala, a troll tailor at the Crossroads in the Barrens.  He will be expecting you, and will fashion your robes.

entries.name: Journey to the Marsh
entries.how:
Now it is time for you to earn your mage's wand.  To begin this quest, speak with the human hermit Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.  You will find her shack deep in the marsh, west of Theramore.

Speak with her, for her knowledge is vast.  You will find Tabetha's cottage west of Theramore, and just north of the Stonemaul Ruins.

entries.name: Items of Power
entries.how:
The building of a mage's wand is not easy.  Rare substances are required, and a vessel must be made that can store great quantities of magical energy.  You must gather these things and bring them to me.

I have written onto this parchment that which you need, and instructions on how to get it.  Bring me exactly what is on this list, and follow my written directions to the letter, for if you do not then when we make your wand things might go... badly.

entries.name: Hidden Secrets
entries.how:
To make your wand, there are key passages in a certain book that I must read.  The book is called Rituals of Power, written by the Magus Tirth.

I do not have a copy of his book, and none of the world's great libraries possess it.  So you must speak with Tirth and gain it from him.

Good luck.  Tirth used to be a great mage and scholar, but now he spends his time at the gnome and goblin races in the Shimmering Flats, drinking and gambling.

entries.name: Get the Scoop
entries.how:
I can help you with the book, but first you have to help me!

The tome you seek is in my magically locked strongbox.  To open it a special phrase must be uttered, and I can't remember the phrase!  Normally my assistant helps me remember these things but he's nowhere to be found.

If you want my book, then find my apprentice!  Ask around the race track--if you're lucky then someone has seen him.  Either drag him back here, or at least get my magic phrase from him so we can open my box!

entries.name: Rituals of Power
entries.how:
Hm... now that I think about it, I don't have my book!  You see, I had some gambling debts and to pay them off I sold the last copy of Rituals of Power to a member of the clergy....

A member of the Scarlet Brotherhood.  He must have taken it to their library in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades!

If you want that book, then you'll have to go to the monastery to find it.  And sorry about all the trouble.  I'm not myself these days...

entries.name: Mage's Wand
entries.how: I'll go make the wands now.
