entries.name: Back to Darnassus
entries.how:
The time has come for us to part ways, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me.  Mathrengyl Bearwalker walks truly in balance with nature, even as he dwells precariously close to where the balance has faltered.  Listen to his instructions, and you will soon complete your first lessons into your role as a protector of balance.

Go now, young one.  We shall meet again.

entries.name: Back to Thunder Bluff
entries.how:
The time has come for us to part ways, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me.  Though the tauren are thought to be young in the ways of Cenarius, Turak Runetotem walks with much balance in the presence of nature.  Listen to his instructions, and you will soon complete your first lessons into your role as a protector of balance.

Go now, young one.  We shall meet again.

entries.name: Body and Heart
entries.how:
Directly east of Auberdine lay many moonkin caves.  The one closest to Auberdine has a Moonkin Stone inside it.  Lunaclaw, the defender of the stone, will face you only when Cenarion Moondust is applied to it.  Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.

You've earned the right to use this Cenarion Moondust, {name}... now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!

entries.name: Body and Heart
entries.how:
On land west of Taurajo in the Barrens - just before it turns into Mulgore - lies a Moonkin Stone.  The moonkin are special beasts, not native to these parts.  Lunaclaw, the stone's defender, will face you when Cenarion Lunardust is applied to it.  Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.

You've earned the right to use this Cenarion Lunardust, {name}... now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!

entries.name: Lessons Anew
entries.how:
You're now ready to learn about poison and the power we as druids have over it, {name}.  Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to purge even the most foul of poisons with but a mere incantation.  This gift is not to be taken lightly... and to ensure you learn this lesson, you'll work to address the effects of poisonings as a layman would.

Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze; he awaits your arrival to begin your lesson.

entries.name: The Principal Source
entries.how:
The Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore serves as the principal source of drinking water for the region, and now I suspect it is the principal source of the poison that is harming the local fauna - deer specifically.  Use this sampler to draw some water from the mouth of the cave; be careful, as dangerous naga now reside in a cave by the falls.

Once filled, deliver it to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine.  She is the one that requested our aid, and you will work with her to address this malady.

entries.name: Gathering the Cure
entries.how:
The water will serve as the base of the curative salve I'll make for the deer.  For curative properties, I need some earthroot.  Herbalists know how to find it, so if we're unlucky and you aren't one then you'll need to find one to help us out.

Finally for potency, I need some lunar fungus.  Finding lunar fungal blooms is easy enough; they're all over the place in caves just to the east of here.  Moonkin reside in the caves and they're irritable as of late, so be careful.

entries.name: Curing the Sick
entries.how:
The amount of salve made out of the reagents you brought me is good enough for ten doses, {name}.  While I work with the village to try and make some more salve, I'd like for you to help us get a head start.  All around Darkshore are sickly deer; use the salve on them and cure their malaise.

Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade will want to talk to you when you're done, I'm sure.  Please extend Auberdine's thanks to the Cenarion Circle there... and let me say thanks to you directly for the help you've given!

entries.name: Power over Poison
entries.how:
You've learned what it means to cure poison without the benefit of spiritual aid.  Remember what others must endure in fighting poisonous afflictions as you soon embrace your newfound power over poison.

You should now return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus, {name}.  He, no doubt, has a very important spell to teach you now that the student understands the lesson given unto him.

Farewell, young druid.  We shall speak again.

entries.name: The Principal Source
entries.how:
Dreadmist Peak to the northwest of the Crossroads is most likely a primary candidate as to the source of the spread of the poison.  Its airy peaks have pools of water that influence the weather patterns.  I suspect the water is now tainted by the demon-worshipping Burning Blade.

Use this sampler to draw water from the pool at the very top of the peak.  Once filled, deliver it to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.  He is the one that requested our aid, and you will work with him to address this malady.

entries.name: Gathering the Cure
entries.how:
The water will serve as the base of the curative salve I shall make for the gazelles.  For curative properties, I need some earthroot.  Herbalists know how to find it, so if you are not familiar with this skill you'll need to find one to help us out.

Finally for potency, I need kodo horns - mere chips and fragments will not suffice.  Kodos you can handle wander the northern part of the Barrens; bring some down for the greater good of the balance {name}, and fetch the horns for me.

entries.name: Curing the Sick
entries.how:
I was able to make enough salve for ten doses of curing, {name}.  While I work with local authorities to try and make some more salve, I'd like for you to help us get a head start.  All around the northern Barrens are sickly gazelles; use the salve on them and cure their malaise.

Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade will want to talk to you when you're done, I'm sure.  Please extend our thanks to the Cenarion Circle there... and let me say thanks to you directly for the help you've given!

entries.how:
You've learned what it means to cure poison without the benefit of spiritual aid.  Remember what others must endure in fighting poisonous afflictions as you soon embrace your newfound power over poison.

You should now return to Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff, {name}.  He, no doubt, has a very important spell to teach you now that the student understands the lesson given unto him.

Farewell, young druid.  We shall speak again.

entries.name: Toxic Test
entries.how:
The toxin you helped me create is for a special purpose.  The great devilsaurs of the crater make it dangerous to hunt and difficult for me to survive.  Even if I possessed the necessary strength, killing a devilsaur simply allows another to move into its territory.

Take this poisoned barb and stab it deep into a living devilsaur.  The toxin should pacify the creature, though I do not know how quickly...

entries.name: Bloodpetal Poison
entries.how:
I would ask you to help me create a toxin of sorts, to pacify a great creature living here in the crater.  It is not deadly, and only the keen eyes of a {class} can hope to collect the ingredients.

You can find the bloodcap mushrooms growing within the bloodpetal sprouts all across the crater.  Gorishi stings are from the giant flying wasps inside and around the Slithering Scar, located in the southern part of the crater.

entries.name: A Better Ingredient
entries.how:
It is as I feared -- the toxin is simply too weak for such a powerful creature.

If we are to create a toxin of high enough potency, you must venture to the bottom of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, unlock the secrets of the altar and recover a putrid vine from the guardian there.  The temple is dangerous, and it would behoove you to bring friends.

Return to me when this is done.

entries.name: Torwa Pathfinder
entries.how:
A hunter by the name of Torwa Pathfinder has requested the help of a druid.  He said only we would possess the necessary skills and respect for nature to help him.

There is a road that connects the Un'Goro Crater and the desert of Tanaris.  As that road enters the crater, you will find Torwa close by.

entries.name: Relics of the Kaldorei
entries.how:
The kaldorei are an ancient people, and our lost relics can be found across Azeroth. Through these relics, the spirits can teach you ways to strengthen your connection to the Dream.

The grellkin have stolen one such relic. Slay them and retrieve the relic, then follow its guidance to learn a new combat technique. Return to me when you have done this.

entries.name: Relics of the Tauren
entries.how:
The Tauren are an ancient people, {name}, and our lost relics can be found across Azeroth. Through them, the spirits can teach you ways to strengthen your connection to the Dream.

The bristleback quilboar have stolen one such relic from us. They have likely stashed it away within Brambleblade Ravine.  Recover the relic, and follow its guidance to learn a new combat technique. Return to me when you have done this.

entries.name: Trial of The Owls
entries.how:
Let me get a good look at you, {name}.

Yes, it seems you are ready to attempt the trial of the owls. This marks a pivotal moment in your journey as a druid.

There are three symbols spread across Azeroth. To earn them, you must perform great feats of mind and body alike.

One owl sits beneath a great tree in the Eastern Kingdoms. Another is near a great tree here in Kalimdor. Yet another is at sea; off the coast of Hillsbrad.

Seek out these owls, {name}, and bring their symbols to me.

entries.name: Wisdom of the Guardians
entries.how:
Whatever Kaldorei knowledge you seek will not be found among these ruins, {class}. Not anymore.

However, while the physical lies in ruin, the spiritual remains.

Seek the guardian spirits of Azshara, the Hinterlands, and Feralas. You will know them by their shrines. Prove yourself to them, and heed their words. Their wisdom will be passed on to you, so that it will not be lost to time as so much was here.

entries.name: A Better Ingredient
entries.how:
It is as I feared -- the toxin is simply too weak for such a powerful creature.

If we are to create a toxin of high enough potency, you must venture to the bottom of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, unlock the secrets of the altar and recover a putrid vine from the guardian there.  The temple is dangerous, and it would behoove you to bring friends.

Return to me when this is done.

entries.name: The Frigid Barrow
entries.how:
Just as life springs forth from decay, so too may the unnatural come to serve the natural.

The heart can be made into a stave of shifting form, but I will need a vessel strong enough to contain its power.

There is a barrow den near Starfall Village, in Winterspring. The true entrance will only reveal itself if you are alone. 

Within is a keeper who lost his way long ago; Nandieb. His stave shall be the heart's vessel. It pains me to suggest, but he is no longer the great keeper I once knew.

entries.name: The Heart of Chromaggus
entries.how: The heart of the once-fearsome Chromaggus rests in your hands. Its kaleidoscopic hues are as exquisite as they are grotesque. You sense a great power within the heart; something beyond your comprehension. To know more will require the aid of one much more powerful and ancient than yourself.

entries.name: A Student of Nature
entries.how:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident druid trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.

entries.name: The Great Ursera Spirit
entries.how:
Greetings, {name}. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.

To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.

entries.name: Strength and Mercy
entries.how:
You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lies heavy on my heart.

My mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the magic of the winds, many creatures have begun to lose themselves... Ur'endra included. She makes her lair in a cave to the west of here, in the bluffs along the border between the Shen'dar Highlands and the Gustberry Lowlands.

End her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.

entries.name: Child of Nature
entries.how:
Greetings, young {race}. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade. 

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you. 

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.

entries.name: Child of Nature
entries.how:
Greetings, young {class}. 

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.

entries.name: Moonglade
entries.how:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.

entries.name: Moonglade
entries.how:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.

entries.name: The Great Cat Spirit
entries.how:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.

entries.name: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
entries.how:
A spirit of your homeland has recently appeared here and has asked me to guide you to it. This windborne cat spirit has come to tutor and mentor you so that you may take the feline shape of the spirit on Zephras.

All druids eventually seek this wisdom, though it seems your homeland has a slightly different shape than our traditional one. If you desire to take this spirit's feline form, you will need to undergo our trial.

It can be found in the southern part of Moonglade, south of the twin bridges.

entries.name: The Great Cat Spirit
entries.how:
To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.

entries.name: To Thunder Bluff
entries.how:
The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to the one who sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Turak Runetotem, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.

entries.name: The Great Cat Spirit
entries.how:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.

entries.name: The Great Cat Spirit
entries.how:
In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the Great Cat Spirit.

Much like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.

Go meet with the Great Cat Spirit and learn what it will teach you.

entries.how:
To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.

entries.name: To Darnassus
entries.how:
The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to the one who sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.

entries.name: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
entries.how:
In order to draw upon my spirit, you will need to undergo a trial. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me to pass the druidic trial of these lands.

entries.name: The Great Cat Spirit
entries.how:
In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the Great Cat Spirit.

Much like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.

Go meet with the Great Cat Spirit and learn what it will teach you.

entries.name: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
entries.how:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further. I do hope we meet again someday.

May the shadows forever hide you and your foes easily fall prey to your claws, young one.

entries.name: Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit
entries.how:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further.

Unfortunately I have little left to teach you for the moment. I do hope you come and visit me in Zephras again someday. I sense promise in you, young shen'dorei.

May the shadows forever hide you, your foes easily fall prey to your claws, and the winds guide your steps.

entries.name: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
entries.how:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further. I do hope we meet again someday.

May the shadows forever hide you and your foes easily fall prey to your claws, young one.

entries.name: Shadoweaver
entries.how:
The spiders of the Searing Gorge are an invaluable source of shadow silk. As you know, shadow silk is highly sought after by the artisans of our trade.

Recently, a group of poachers has encroached upon these lands, carelessly slaying spiders en masse without so much as a thought as to the long term effect of their actions. The first task I ask of you, then, is a simple one: Find them... and end them.

Begin your search to the north.

If you require assistance, speak with Raze.

entries.name: The Undermarket
entries.how:
They call themselves the Undermarket: Cutthroat traders that will sell, move, trade and do just about anything for the right price.

It gets worse, {name}. They have set up a base of operations here in the Searing Gorge. Trade Master Kovic is heading up the operation and has close ties with the Dark Iron dwarves of the region.

We must strike hard and send a message to their leadership. Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. Bring back his trader's satchel when the job is done.

To the Cauldron!

entries.name: The Undermarket
entries.how: I want you to personally deliver the news of Kovic's defeat to Vizzklick in Gadgetzan. He will be so happy to hear that Kovic is dead that I'm certain he'll give you some grand reward.

entries.name: The Mysteries of Phaseweave
entries.how:
All of life is duality. Light and Darkness. Evil and Good. Goblin and Gnome. These are abstract concepts, but as master tailors we deal in the physical, practical world. Those of us with a certain aptitude can utilize our trade to actually weave the abstract and the esoteric directly into our goods.

If you would explore these mysteries with me, you must prove your dedication by bringing me a pair of Runecloth Pants, Runecloth Boots, Runecloth Gloves, a Runecloth Cloak, two Felcloth and two Mooncloth

entries.name: Weaving the Darkness
entries.how:
Power is all there is. You make bargains with tyrants and slay until your hands are stained red for just a few paltry coins. As a master craftsman, you should also strive for greater skill and through skill, greater power. If you have the will to take what you want and abandon all that will not further your ambitions, I may be able to help you realize your potential.

Bring me 20 Felcoth and 10 Demonic Runes and I'll show you how to weave your desire to dominate into the fabric itself.

entries.name: A Warden of the Alliance
entries.how:
You have been so very kind to me, {name}.  I never dreamed that I'd have so much fun during Children's Week.  Thank you.  I don't wanna be sad about what's happened to me and all - my folks always told me to rise above anything bad that happens.  You know, when I grow up I wanna be a hero... just like you.

I'm sad to say this, but it's time for me to go home.  Let's go back and I'll tell the matron what an awesome person you are!

entries.name: Children's Week
entries.how:
You're willing to help us here at the orphanage?  Bless you, friend; your aid during Children's Week will be invaluable.

Take this whistle.  You will only be able to use it for a short amount of time - typically not longer than Children's Week itself.  When you use it, you will be able to talk with the child you've agreed to look after.  Using it again will dismiss the child.

By all means {name} - use the whistle and meet your ward!  I'm sure the child will be most eager to meet you.

entries.name: Jaina's Autograph
entries.how:
They say that Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore is one of the greatest heroes the Alliance has ever had.  When I grow up, I wanna be a hero of the Alliance too!

Do you know Jaina, {name}?  Could you do me a favor, please?  Could you get her autograph for me?  I dunno how to ask her, and she'd probably be too busy for someone like me... but you!  You're an adventurer just like she is!  I bet she'd give you her autograph easy!

Please?

entries.name: Down at the Docks
entries.how:
I have heard tales of the mighty ships that sail between Ratchet and Booty Bay!  That would be so cool to sail on the ocean and fight in many great sea battles.  Maybe I will be a mighty Horde sailor when I grow up!  Yeah!

Would you take me to see the Ratchet docks, please?  I promise I won't get into the water or cause any trouble - I just want to see the big boats and smell the salty sea water!  Yeah!

entries.name: Gateway to the Frontier
entries.how:
They say that Ashenvale is the new frontier, and that the Mor'shan Rampart in the Barrens is the gateway to it.  That would be so cool to be a pioneer, carving everything you need out of the untamed wilds!  They say that this is where the Horde and Alliance will clash the most in the future, and I want to be there {name}!

Would you take me to the Mor'shan Rampart so I can see what the frontier looks like, please?  I wanna see where the Horde is driving out those smelly night elves!

entries.name: You Scream, I Scream...
entries.how:
ICE CREAM!  Oh please please please could you get me some ice cream?!  Strawberry is my favorite flavor, and there's no better strawberry ice cream in the world than Tigule's Strawberry Ice Cream!  It's my favorite ice cream in the whole wide world!

I had it once a long time ago when I was at the Shimmering Flats race track, but I heard that they might be selling them in town now!  Please?  Pretty please?  With Tigule's Strawberry Ice Cream on top??!?!

entries.name: Cairne's Hoofprint
entries.how:
They say that Cairne Bloodhoof is one of the greatest heroes the Horde has ever seen.  When I grow up, I wanna be a hero of the Horde too!

Do you know Cairne, {name}?  Could you do me a favor, please?  Could you get his hoofprint for me?  I dunno how to ask him, and he'd probably be too busy for someone like me... but you!  You're an adventurer just like he is!  I bet he'd give you his hoofprint easy!

Please?

entries.name: Children's Week
entries.how:
You're willing to help us here at the orphanage?  Bless you, friend; your aid during Children's Week will be invaluable.

Take this whistle.  You will only be able to use it for a short amount of time - typically not longer than Children's Week itself.  When you use it, you will be able to talk with the child you've agreed to look after.  Using it again will dismiss the child.

By all means {name} - use the whistle and meet your ward!  I'm sure the child will be most eager to meet you.

entries.name: The Bough of the Eternals
entries.how:
I've heard stories about how the night elves have their bank in a tree - one that looks like a bear!  That's so cool!  Night elves are neat how they like nature and stuff, but bears are just totally awesome!

Would you take me to see the bear-tree in Darnassus, please?  There's a boat that will take us close to there, and it shouldn't take very long.  Please, please, please!

entries.name: The Stonewrought Dam
entries.how:
Ironforge is where all the dwarves and gnomes live.  Near there is a place called Loch Modan, and the dwarves built a HUGE dam there.  They say it's one of the biggest things anyone's ever made.  Wow!

Could you take me to Loch Modan and see the dam there, please?  I think it is the Stone... um... Stonewrench Dam?  Stonewrought?  It's big - that's for sure.  I'd like to look out over the big waterfall.  I promise I won't lean over too far!

entries.name: Spooky Lighthouse
entries.how:
Sometimes late at night, our matrons at the orphanage will tell us spooky stories.  Those RULE!  There's one about a ghost that haunts a lighthouse in Westfall.  They say he was a pirate captain who had his ship taken from him by other pirates.  Wow!

Could you please take me to the lighthouse in Westfall?  I wanna see if the ghost of that captain is there!  I promise to stay close to you; I won't run off or anything!

entries.name: Lordaeron Throne Room
entries.how:
The orphan matrons at my home tell mighty stories of battle and lore at night if we are good and do our chores.  One story was about how Lordaeron fell, and about how the evil Arthas took his own father's life to become ruler.

He had no honor, {name}!  When I grow up and become a mighty Horde warrior, my blade will be guided by honor - never evil!

Would you take me to see the throne room, please?  It is just before where you would go down into the Undercity.

entries.name: CLUCK!
entries.how:
"Cluck... cluck... cluck... BACAW!

Cluck... cluck... cluck."

The chicken looks up at you and then starts to scratch its claws into the ground. You think it is spelling out a word, but you are not sure what it is. Could it be... S-A-L-D-E-A-N? Before you can ask, the chicken turns away and goes about its business.

entries.name: You Scream, I Scream...
entries.how:
ICE CREAM!  Oh please please please could you get me some ice cream?!  Strawberry is my favorite flavor, and there's no better strawberry ice cream in the world than Tigule's Strawberry Ice Cream!  It's my favorite ice cream in the whole wide world!

I had it once a long time ago when I was at the Shimmering Flats race track, but I heard that they might be selling them in town now!  Please?  Pretty please?  With Tigule's Strawberry Ice Cream on top??!?!

entries.name: Lee's Ultimate Test Quest... of Doom!
entries.how:
Bah! What do think this is, some kind of Test Quest? I be there even be typos in it!

If ya be thinkin' my quest is goin' ta be easy, then ya got another thing coming!

Kill me ten sheep (1933) and don't come back until you do!

entries.name: A Warden of the Horde
entries.how:
You have been so very kind to me, {name}.  I never dreamed that I'd have so much fun during Children's Week.  Thank you.  I won't be sad about what's happened to me - my parents always told me to rise above anything bad that happens.  I'll be a hero... just like you.

I'm sad to say this, but it's time for me to go home.  Let's go back and I'll tell the matron what an awesome person you are!

entries.name: CLUCK! CLUCK!
entries.how:
*Cluck... cluck... cluck... BACAW!*

*Cluck... cluck... cluck.*

<The chicken looks up at you with small unimpressed eyes. It would seem it wants something from you.

It plucks out one of its feathers and lets it fall to the ground, then looks up at you expectantly. Perhaps the feather is a clue to what it wants?>

entries.name: WRIGGLE.
entries.how:
<The little slime seems delighted and is attempting to mirror your motions as you dance. It begins to look weary though.

The little slime hovers over a bit of sludge and absorbs it, looking slightly rejuvenated.

It seems all of this dancing has tuckered it out. Perhaps someone in the Undercity canals sells more of this nutritious sludge?>

entries.name: Beer Basted Boar Ribs
entries.how:
Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs!  Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the Alliance front. 

Maybe you can help me out?  If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample!  The secret's in the Malt!

entries.name: Dig Rat Stew
entries.how:
A {class} like you must get pretty hungry out here in The Barrens. Me, I'm starving all day long.

Tell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.

Seems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.

You can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! Haw!

entries.name: Easy Strider Living
entries.how:
Do you smell that delicious aroma? It's my secret recipe, {name}--fresh strider stew. Delicious!

Perhaps you would be interested in learning the recipe?

Before I teach you the recipe, you will need to prove that you can handle the beasts.

Now, I don't expect you to go out and tame one and ride it back to me, but if you can kill a few and bring back some of their succulent meat, I may be persuaded to show you the ways of strider stew.

entries.name: Recipe of the Kaldorei
entries.how:
Long ago, the night elves were called the kaldorei, a name that means "children of the stars." Learning of the past is an important step in your path as a {class}, {name}, so listen well to what I have to tell you.

The kaldorei have always taken much pride in their harmonious relationship with nature. This means that we only take from nature what is necessary, and that we return in kind. This balance has afforded us much, {name}.

Go out and collect seven small spider legs -- no more than that, and return to me.

entries.name: Clamlette Surprise
entries.how:
Ever heard of a clamlette? Of course you haven't! It's my latest and greatest culinary masterpiece. Oh, {name}, just thinking about a clamlette makes my mouth water.

Unfortunately, I'm all out of supplies to make any! How about I make you a deal? You gather the supplies I need to make a clamlette and I'll teach you the finer points of exotic cuisine and I'll even throw in a couple of clamlettes to boot! Deal??

Here's what I need:

entries.name: To Gadgetzan You Go!
entries.how:
How you expect Zamja teach you anything? You got all of Zamja's cooking mojo and still you crave more!

Zamja can't help. Fat {race} needs to go to Gadgetzan. You find a little goblin named Dirge there - he help you, fatty.

When you become big cook on the block, you come back and teach Zamja, ok? Now go!

entries.name: I Know A Guy...
entries.how:
I can tell by yer cooking spoon that ye know what yer doin'. Unfortunately, I can't teach ya nothin'.

Luckily fer ye, I know a guy. He's a goblin and probably the best cook on Kalimdor.

Ayep, that's the bad news, lad - ye got to travel to Kalimdor. Git to Gadgetzan and find Dirge Quikcleave. He'll set ya straight.

entries.name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
entries.how:
Who says that the undead don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! Heh, heh...

Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately.  I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.

If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!

entries.name: Desert Recipe
entries.how:
Adapting to life in the desert has been difficult to say the least.  Not only do I miss the birds and trees of Auberdine but our food selection is severely limited by this arid environment.  I'm trying to learn about desert herbs, but there aren't many.

I've seen Twilight's Hammer groups from the camp west of here hunt sandworms for food.  Sandworm meat is so bitter though, I can't imagine how they make it palatable.  Keep your eyes open if you go to their camp and let me know if you learn anything.

entries.name: Sharing the Knowledge
entries.how: While the recipe for cooking sandworm meat is legible, it contains references to herbs and spices you've never heard of.  Calandrath might have enough knowledge of the plants that grow in the desert to make sense of it.

entries.name: Kitchen Assistance
entries.how: That recipe sure will come in handy.  I'd better get to work so I can have some smoked desert dumplings ready for today.  I could use a hand in making some, I'll make it worth your while.

entries.name: Triage
entries.how:
Good day, doctor. You will be tested on your ability to triage patients accordingly this afternoon. Should you pass your examination, you will join the prestigious ranks of Horde Trauma.

Now pay attention! The critically injured must be tended to first. After the criticals come the badly injured. The injured should be tended to last. You must save 15 patients to pass this exam. You will fail should 6 of your patients die in triage.

Triage bandages will be supplied.

Good luck, doctor.

entries.name: Horde Trauma
entries.how:
Doctor {name}, I presume. It is a pleasure to see you again.

I have some wonderful news for you! Doctor Gregory Victor, chief physician of Horde Trauma has made a personal request for you to join him at Hammerfall. This could be the opportunity of a lifetime! I would give anything to be given a chance to study under the great Doctor Gregory Victor! Do not squander this opportunity!

entries.name: Triage
entries.how:
Good day, doctor. You will be tested on your ability to triage patients accordingly this afternoon. Should you pass your examination, you will join the prestigious ranks of Alliance Trauma.

Now pay attention! The critically injured must be tended to first. After the criticals come the badly injured. The injured should be tended to last. You must save 15 patients to pass this exam. You will fail should 6 of your patients die in triage.

Good luck, doctor.

entries.name: Alliance Trauma
entries.how:
Doctor {name}, I presume. It is a pleasure to see you.

I have some wonderful news for you! Gustaf VanHowzen, chief physician of Alliance Trauma has made a personal request for you to join him at Theramore. This could be the opportunity of a lifetime! I would give anything to be given a chance to study under the great doctor, Gustaf VanHowzen! Do not squander this opportunity, doctor!

entries.name: Thunderaan the Windseeker
entries.how:
I have told you all that I know, {name}. It is you who must find elementium. It is you who must destroy the Firelord's corporeal form.

Do this and gain the blessing of Thunderaan.

entries.name: Examine the Vessel
entries.how: Examine the vessel of his rebirth, mortal. It is from this that the Windseeker shall be reborn!

entries.name: Rise, Thunderfury!
entries.how: You have defeated the Wind Seeker. Take the dormant blade and force the lying wretch, Demitrian, to use the materials you provided for his betrayal to wake Thunderfury.

entries.name: Frame of Atiesh
entries.how:
With the frame formed, Atiesh is nearly whole. Only the head and base of the staff are now missing. There is also a minor issue regarding the staff being a conduit for Sargeras's evil.

Find someone that can assist you in locating the remaining pieces and exorcising the evil from the staff.

entries.name: Atiesh, the Befouled Greatstaff
entries.how:
You question why you are still alive. After all, you have in your possession an item of great evil. The answer is not clear, {name}. I only do as I must.

Kel'Thuzad sits atop his throne in Naxxramas, plotting... He seeks that which you hold and holds that which you seek.

As for the base of the staff; the dwarf, Brann Bronzebeard, held it when he entered Ahn'Qiraj. He has left Ahn'Qiraj but the base of Atiesh remains.

Should you succeed in recovering the pieces, return them to me.

entries.name: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
entries.how:
This final task will be the most difficult of all, {name}. You have faced and defeated both an Old God and the Lich King's General, but now you must face the hand of Sargeras.

Take the staff to Stratholme. It is there that you will find a piece of consecrated earth: ground where the greatest knights of Lordaeron were murdered. Place the befouled staff upon the holy ground and prepare for an entity of immense power to break from within... Defeat the demonic being that controls the staff and return to me.

entries.name: The First Step
entries.how:
In Caldoran's hubris, he thought that he could force the blade to submit to his will. He stole the lives of his most fervently loyal followers to fuel his attempt to dominate the blade. What he didn't realize is that this power can't be taken by force; its cleansing must be earned. 

Speak with me further if you wish to see the blade restored. If you are strong enough, you might just succeed.

entries.name: This Could Get Expensive...
entries.how:
In order to create this alloy, we'll need a lot of materials to experiment with. I've prepared a list and, well, I told you it might get expensive.

<Omarion hands you a list that's nearly as long as your forearm.>

entries.name: zzOLD UNUSED
entries.how: Now that we know what these monsters are up to, the path forward is clear. We must crush the Scarlet Crusade here and now. What we've learned here is very concerning however, as we can't be sure how else this newfound power could be turned against us. Try and recover more of this crystalline material however so that we may better understand its capabilities. A dozen or so fragments should do, as well as an intact weapon made from the stuff. A large-bladed weapon such as an axe would be ideal.

entries.name: zzOLD UNUSED - Force Multiplier
entries.how: Text goes here

entries.name: The Ashbringer
entries.how:
Your hand trembles as it closes on the hilt of the shattered blade. You hold the remnants of a truly legendary weapon, the Ashbringer. Holding what remains of the sword fills you with a sense of icy dread, and you could swear that you hear voices in your mind. One voice in particular rings the loudest. 

<If you would see it restored, take up the broken blade. This road may only lead to damnation, but I will show you the way.>

entries.name: A Difficult Path
entries.how:
There is a fount of great power residing at the base of the World Tree, high atop Mount Hyjal. This is a place of ancient and storied history; it was recently the focus of the final clash between the defenders of Azeroth and the Burning Legion. It is now a haunted place, steeped in the power of light and shadow... life and death. 

This power mirrors the duality of the blade and we will see the weapon tempered there. Reaching the summit of the mountain will be no small feat, however.

entries.name: On Fate's Path
entries.how:
Caldoran used a combination of holy magic, skilled craftsmanship, and ambition to "cleanse" the blade.  The Ashbringer ultimately rejected Caldoran, but some of his methods may have some merit as a place to start. 

Light and darkness are the sum of what the Ashbringer is now and the lightforged weapons wielded by the crusaders in the  Enclave may be of use to us.

entries.name: The Perfect Metal
entries.how: Now that we've got the materials, I need a bit of time to try a few different combinations and test my results. This is delicate work, and I wouldn't want to waste any of the materials that you so graciously brought me by testing too hastily.

entries.name: Emblem of Darkness
entries.how:
There is one final piece; the Emblem of the Ashbringer. In a way, the emblem is the heart of the blade. Highlord Alexandros himself used all his will and determination to transfigure an orb of pure void into a vessel of the Light itself. 

The emblem endured when Caldoran fell and the blade shattered. Adventurers recovered it and passed it into Lord Maxwell Tyrosus's care. 

Retrieve the emblem and we'll have everything we need for the next step.

entries.name: Falling Into Place
entries.how:
Here is the emblem. I warn you, do not touch it with your bare hand. It exudes a foul necromantic aura that could cause great harm. 

I wish you the best in this endeavor, {name}. I will dare hope for your success, but I will prepare for a less favorable outcome.

entries.name: Blades of Light
entries.how: Even ruined and broken, the properties of the blade you hold before you are impressive. If you could better understand the material that this blade was crafted from, it might be possible to create a truly exceptional weapon from it. First, you'll need to find a blacksmith skilled enough to ascertain its properties, and find a way to work the material.

entries.name: The Lost Craftsman
entries.how: <Crafter Wilhem seems unable to assist you but he suggested that his former master, a man called Omarion, could. Should you find him, he might know more about this material.>

entries.name: Extravagant Tastes
entries.how:
So you've got a very fancy chunk of metal there. Who cares? 

Oh, you want me to tell you more about it? Well, it's a sword, and it's broken. Are we done now?

<Omarion glares at you and then sighs heavily when it becomes evident you aren't going to walk away.>

Fine. Leave the blade with me and I'll take a look at it. While I'm at it, I could use a bite to eat. I used to know this goblin, Dirge Quickcleave. He makes the best chimaerok chops. Bring me some.

entries.name: Gathering Light
entries.how:
<Omarion seems significantly more animated than when you first encountered him.>

Okay {class}, you've got my attention. This metal is extremely unique, and I'd like to experiment with it some more. However, I'll need additional samples of the raw material. Bring me a dozen or so more ingots of this "lightforged" iron. Also, try to learn more about where these weapons are being created. A smith is only as good as his tools and his crafting space, after all.

entries.name: The Radiant Forge
entries.how:
So, it seems like it's a bit of a mess over at Tyr's Hand. That's unfortunate, but the bottom line is that I need to get a good look at the workshop where they've been crafting these armaments. Otherwise I won't have any hope of unlocking this metal's secrets. 

Just mark the location of this workshop on my map and I'll make my way there after the coast is clear.

entries.name: Journey To Moonglade
entries.how:
I suggest you start in Moonglade, the Cenarion Circle stronghold. It was Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage that ordered the way shut, but not all of the druids agree with this. Some may be willing to assist you.

You are resourceful and I am confident you can overcome this obstacle. Gain access to the summit and speak to me again.

entries.name: The Druid of the Talon
entries.how:
I have a passing acquaintance with a Druid of the Talon that might be willing to help you. The shrine of Aviana is on the slopes of Mount Hyjal and is sacred to her order, so they still have limited access to the mountain.

Her name is Thisalee Crow. I believe that she regularly visits Everlook in Winterspring to trade for supplies. She's headstrong and very impulsive, which might just be exactly what you need for your quest. 

Good luck, {class}.

entries.name: The Well of Eternity
entries.how:
We are close now. The cataclysmic destruction that the ancient Kaldorei spirits wrought upon the demon lord Archimonde took a terrible toll on the tree. The explosion scattered a myriad of debris in the area.

Gather fragments of Nordrassil from beneath the tree's boughs.  We will use that to create a special fire in which to heat the blade, before quenching it in the waters of the well itself. The magic will harden and bind the blade, restoring the magic that left it when it was shattered.

entries.name: Forgiveness
entries.how:
Alexandros Mograine was murdered by his son and the weight of that betrayal is a shackle around his very soul. The Ashbringer was as much the man as the sword itself, and the blade will not find peace until the spirit of Alexandros himself does. Take the weapon to the Scarlet Monastery cathedral in Tirisfal Glades. Once there confront Mograine's son, the Scarlet Commander. 

Mograine must find the will to forgive for this to truly end.

entries.name: The Lonely Path of the Damned
entries.how:
<The spirit standing before you shows no awareness of your presence. After a moment, you realize that Lord Maxwell Tyrosus will want to know what occurred here. You should return to Light's Hope chapel and speak with him.>

<You suspect that the Argent Crusaders may not be too excited to see you carrying the Ashbringer in its current, twisted form. You may want to keep the blade out of sight when you approach.>

entries.name: A Kind of Peace
entries.how:
I am using most of my waning strength to appear to you.

There is one fleeting hope. You may not be able to save the man, but you may still bring him some measure of peace by limiting the harm he can inflict. Mograine has returned to Naxxramas to recover and resurrect the horsemen. When that's done, his fury will be terrible.

It is wrong to ask this of you after all you've done... but please, confront the Spirit of Mograine. Do what you can to stop him, if only for now. I can help you reach him.

entries.name: The Blade Reformed
entries.how:
I think I've got the alloy to a point here we can reliably use it to craft a blade's billet. Fortunately, we also have plenty of raw materials with everything you've gathered for me so far. 

Stand back if you would. Working the forge can be... dramatic.

entries.name: Take Their Breath Away
entries.how:
I've been working with Evie Whirlbrew to secure crucial supplies, but she is driving a hard bargain and refuses to budge. She insists that she'll only trade Nivifacient Glands from blue dragonspawn for them. This gland is what allows blue dragonkin to use their icy breath, and it has a variety of special alchemical properties. 

There's a population of very hostile blue dragons at Mazthoril to the south and I could really use help obtaining some of these glands to use to satisfy this gouger.

entries.name: Logistics Challenges
entries.how:
I have a longstanding arrangement with Azzleby to transport supplies through the mountain passes on his beasts of burden. Recently, his caravans have been getting raided by Winterfall Furbolgs and they've stolen our stuff! 

Search the Winterfall encampments here in Winterspring for our missing supplies.

entries.name: As The Crow Flies
entries.how:
I really should check in with Master Omnuron about this. However, you've been so helpful to the Druids of the Talon that I'll take a chance. I'm sure that he'll understand.

It's better to beg forgiveness than ask for permission anyway! 

We'll leave now. You can't see the route we take to bypass the wards so I'll need to obscure your vision. This is irresponsible enough as it is and I definitely can't expose the secrets of the Druids of the Talon.

entries.name: The Tempering
entries.how:
<The branches of Nordrassil create a fire unlike anything you've ever seen. It almost seems to have a will and intelligence of its own. You can't be sure, but you could swear that the flame seems to have some awareness of your presence and regards you with a kind of curiosity.>

<As unsettling as that is, all that remains is to heat the blade and plunge it into the waters of the Well of Eternity.>

entries.name: Carnival Boots
entries.how:
We at the Darkmoon Faire do much walking.  We walk from one faire site to another... in fact, you'll never see us sitting down on the job!  So it is no surprise that we wear out quite a lot of boots!  We need boots that are both durable and stylish, and embossed leather boots fit that bill rather well.

You!  You're a leatherworker; make me embossed leather boots and I'll give you a Darkmoon Faire ticket for the work.

entries.name: Carnival Jerkins
entries.how:
Our Faire workers do more than sweep trash and hammer spikes!  They also help guard the carnival as it travels, and to that end they are always needing good sturdy armor jerkins.

If you make some tough leather armor and bring it to me, then I'll make sure it gets to the right people.  I'll also get you some Darkmoon Faire tickets as trade.

entries.name: The World's Largest Gnome!
entries.how:
Yebb Nebblegear is looking to add more talent to his show, and he's searching far and wide for the world's largest gnome.  Do you know any gnomes of considerable size?

Well before he finds the gnome, he wants to have its costume ready.  I think a barbaric harness would be a good foundation for the costume; can you make some harnesses and bring them to me?  Do that, and I'll have a stack of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you...

entries.name: Crocolisk Boy and the Bearded Murloc
entries.how:
Yebb is working on other attractions for his zoo, including wet, swampy abodes for a boy raised by crocolisks, and perhaps for a murloc.  We will need nice, water-tight leggings so we won't get waterlogged during prop-ups and tear-downs.  For that job, I think turtlescale leggings will do the trick.

{name}, can you make those leggings?  If you do, then a fat stack of Darkmoon Faire tickets will be your reward...

entries.name: Armor Kits
entries.how:
You might not realize this, but running a traveling carnival is costly!  Everything wears down so fast it's a wonder we can turn a profit.

Because of all those hidden costs, we're always looking for ways to maintain our equipment as cheaply as possible.  Our tents, for instance, tear regularly but I've found that leather armor kits make great patches.  Can you find and bring me some armor kits? That'll save us a bundle!  Do that, and I have a fistful of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you...

entries.name: Coarse Weightstone
entries.how:
It takes a lot of work to be the strongest woman alive!  My weight set is getting too light and if I'm too stay fit then I'll need more weights!

Do you think you could bring me some weight stones?  If you do, then I'll give you a Darkmoon Faire ticket.

entries.name: Heavy Grinding Stone
entries.how:
To help with my workout, I like to fit a staff between heavy grinding stones, then lift the staff over my head.  It isn't easy, but being the strongest woman in the world, like I am, can't be earned sitting down!

Can you help me?  I need more grinding stones - bring me some and I'll trade Darkmoon Faire tickets for them.

entries.name: Green Iron Bracers
entries.how:
I'm working on a new costume, for when I have my own booth as the strongest woman alive!  Right now I'm looking for some bracers I can wear.  They can't cover much because people want to see my muscles, but I still want to flash a little color, you know?

How about green iron bracers, {name}?  Can you make me green iron bracers?  If you can, then I have a whole bunch of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.

entries.name: Big Black Mace
entries.how:
For my act as the strongest woman alive, I plan to accept items from the audience and smash them with a big, black mace!

Can you make me a big black mace, {name}?

entries.name: Rituals of Strength
entries.how:
{name}, in my quest to become the strongest woman alive, I have traveled the world and learned muscle building secrets from distant weight masters, strength gurus, and ancient manuals.  I now know forbidden exercises that would kill the weak and cripple the uninitiated!

These feats of strength and conditioning require training with the densest of grinding stones.  {name}, can you find or make some grinding stones and bring them to me?  I'll give you tickets if you do...

entries.name: Copper Modulator
entries.how:
Yebb is developing a new attraction for the Zoo Bizarre, one that will drive people crazy with wonder, and delight!  But it will take a lot of work, and a lot of materials...

That includes copper modulators.  We need lots of modulators for the mechanical parts of the attraction.  Bring me copper modulators and I'll trade for them with a Darkmoon Faire ticket.

entries.name: Whirring Bronze Gizmo
entries.how:
My new booth will be a sight to see, yes sir!  A sight to see, and... for a lucky few, to touch!

I can already hear the whirring bronze gizmos singing their song of mechanical rapture as patrons step to my booth and test their skill!

Ah... now I need the gizmos themselves to bring my dream closer to fruition.  Please, {name}, bring me whirring bronze gizmos... and Darkmoon Faire tickets will be yours!

entries.name: Green Fireworks
entries.how:
When I finally get this booth up and running, I'll want to advertise!  And what better way is there to advertise then with fireworks?

Well, some might think that the smell of a cauldron, churning with the boiling heads of your foes is better for drawing crowds, but... we're in mixed company.  So fireworks it will have to be!

Bring me green fireworks, {name}, and I have a big fistful of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.

entries.name: Mechanical Repair Kits
entries.how:
The biggest reason I can't open up my booth is that... everything's broken!  I need mechanical repair kits to fix all this stuff!

Can you bring me those kits, {name}?  I'll trade you... kits for Darkmoon Faire tickets.  What do you say?

entries.name: Thorium Widget
entries.how:
Yebb Nebblegear, like me, is working on a future attraction.  So amazing is this attraction, says Nebb, that it will draw folks from across the world... and it will make us all very, very rich!

He says he needs thorium widgets for its construction, and wants me to collect them for him.  So what do you say, {name}?  Do you know where to get Thorium widgets?  If you're an engineer, can you make them?  Do you want to trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets?

entries.name: Small Furry Paws
entries.how:
The first lesson in drawing a crowd is: lure them with gadgets and trinkets!  Can you help me?

I need small furry paws to use for prizes.  You can find those on the cats of the Barrens or Darkshore....

Bring me some paws and I'll trade you a Darkmoon Faire ticket for them.

entries.name: Torn Bear Pelts
entries.how:
Children love toys!  And no matter what race, I've found that all children love furry, plushy toys made from torn bear pelts!

You can get those pelts from the bears of Ashenvale or Hillsbrad.  Bring me a heap of them and earn yourself a heap of Darkmoon Faire tickets!

entries.name: Soft Bushy Tails
entries.how:
It's amazing what people value!  Take, for instance, a wooden stick with a soft bushy tail attached to it.  Now, you and I might think something like that isn't all that valuable... but if you give that piece of junk a neat name like "Savage Fuzz Tail" and put it in a pretty box, then people will think it's valuable.  Trash becomes treasure!

Get me soft bushy tails from the wolves of Desolace and the Badlands, and I'll give you Darkmoon Faire tickets.

entries.name: Vibrant Plumes
entries.how:
A person's imagination is an incredible thing.  It can make the smallest hill seem like the largest mountain.  It can make the most innocuous shadow appear cast by a horrible nightmare!

We at the Darkmoon Faire let our visitor's imaginations blossom!  But to help stretch their imaginations... sometimes we have to get tricky.

I need vibrant plumes for one of my attractions.  You can get them from the birds of the more dangerous areas of Azeroth.  Bring me the plumes and many tickets will be yours!

entries.name: Evil Bat Eyes
entries.how:
Do you ever find yourself wandering in a cave, late at night, looking for adventure?  You do?  Really?  Well, then you've seen the creepy eyes of bats staring at you from high up, waiting for you to let down your guard so they can suck your blood!

Scary thought, don't you think?  Of course!  It's no doubt that bat eyes are scary!

Will you bring me some evil bat eyes, {name}?  I want them for... something I'm designing.  Something scary.

You can get them from the bats of the Eastern Plaguelands.

entries.name: <UNUSED>
entries.how:
Step right up, step right up!  If you have tickets from the Darkmoon Faire you'd like redeemed, then just say so!  You can redeem tickets in various denominations for wondrous and fantastic prizes.  Don't be shy, give it a try!

If you have X tickets ready to be redeemed, then let me know!

entries.name: Darkmoon Cards - Beasts
entries.how: Lesser Darkmoon Cards have been stolen by liars and thieves and scattered across the world.    I need them back!  I can provide you one of the very rare and powerful Greater Darkmoon cards if you can return a set of the lesser cards to me.

entries.name: Darkmoon Beast Deck
entries.how: Now that you have gathered all of the Beast cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."   You have heard that this faire alternately stops at Mulgore and Goldshire every few months, so you will have to wait until they are here next.

On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded." entries.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
entries.how:
"Your fortune awaits you in Eastvale."

The fortune Sayge handed you feels slightly warm to the touch.  Grasping it firmly, you see an image of the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.  Focusing closer in on the image, you see a haystack that sits next to a stable.

entries.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
entries.how:
"Your fortune awaits you inside the Deadmines."

The fortune Sayge handed you feels slightly warm to the touch.  Grasping it firmly, you see an image of the Deadmines inside Westfall's ruined hamlet of Moonbrook.  Focusing closer in on the image, you wind about twisty passages until you reach a shimmering portal... one that leads into the heart of the mines itself.  Stepping through it, a strange chest appears out from nowhere.

entries.name: More Dense Grinding Stones
entries.how:
{name}, thank you for all the help you've given me.  I really can't thank you enough!

Although my need is no longer great... if you bring me more dense grinding stones, I still have more Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.

entries.name: More Armor Kits
entries.how: {name}, I must thank you for all your help.  I have plenty of supplies, through no small efforts on your part, but if you wish to bring me more armor kits, then I will gladly trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets.

entries.name: More Thorium Widgets
entries.how:
{name}, you have been so good to us, bringing me goods without tiring.  You have my eternal thanks!

Although our need for Thorium widgets is not as great as it was, you may still bring them to me and I will gladly trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets.

entries.name: More Bat Eyes
entries.how:
{name}, the attraction I'm designing will be the scariest event since Gnomeregan was overrun!  And it's largely thanks to you and all the baubles you've brought me.  Many, many thanks!

I don't need much else, but... if you bring me more evil bat eyes from the bats of the Eastern Plaguelands... I might have more Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.

entries.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
entries.how:
"Your fortune awaits you inside Wailing Caverns."

The fortune Sayge handed you feels slightly warm to the touch.  Grasping it firmly, you see an image of a cave to the southwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens.  Focusing closer in on the image, you wind about twisty passages until you reach a shimmering portal... one that leads into the heart of the caverns itself.  Stepping through it, a strange chest appears out from nowhere.

entries.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
entries.how:
"Your fortune awaits you outside Palemane Rock."

The fortune Sayge handed you feels slightly warm to the touch.  Grasping it firmly, you see an image of the Palemane Rock of Mulgore.  Focusing closer in on the image, you see a tree stump that sits close to the cave entrance.

entries.name: Spawn of Jubjub
entries.how:
I'm so happy Jubjub is no longer lost.  She loves Dark Iron ale so much that when I ran out... she ran away to find more!

Now that Jubjub's back, I want as much ale as I can get!  I won't want her to run away again!

Do you have any Dark Iron Ale?  If you do, then I'll trade you one of Jubjub's frog eggs for a mug...

entries.name: Glowing Scorpid Blood
entries.how:
In all my time working the Faire, I've learned a lot of things about customers.  Here's one of those nuggets of wisdom: customers love stuff that glows!  It doesn't matter what it is - you could take a broken chair leg and make it glow, and every child will come from miles around to get one!

So, {name}, I need glowing scorpid blood.  You can find it from the scorpids of Sillithus, or the Blasted Lands, or the Burning Steppes.

entries.name: More Glowing Scorpid Blood
entries.how:
That scorpid blood is working out great, {name}!  It's amazing how a little sparkle and shine can create a prized bauble out of an otherwise piece of junk.  The patrons love the stuff, and love is what it's all about, don't you think...

You've been a big help to me, {name}, and although I don't have a great need for more glowing scorpid blood, if you bring me more then I'll still trade you some tickets.

You!  You're a leatherworker; make me embossed leather boots and I'll give you a Darkmoon Faire ticket for the work.
